CMIP6 获认可模式比较计划（MIP）汇编

CMIP6-Endorsed MIPs Summary

来源：WCRP / WGCM CMIP Panel 官方文档（2015-08-19，wcrp-climate.org），共 280 页，含 21 个 CMIP6 获认可 MIP 的申请书。

Overview CMIP6-Endorsed MIPs ｜ CMIP6 获认可 MIP 总览

更新信息见：http://www.wcrp‐climate.org/index.php/wgcm‐cmip/about‐cmip

See updates http://www.wcrp‐climate.org/index.php/wgcm‐cmip/about‐cmip

日期：2015 年 8 月 19 日

Date: 19 August 2015

基于对 2014 年 10 月 WGCM 第 18 届会议商定的 10 条 CMIP6 认可标准的评估，CMIP 专家组与 WGCM 联合主席现已认可 21 个模式比较计划（MIP）。

Based on the assessment of the 10 CMIP6 endorsement criteria that were agreed at the WGCM 18th Session in October 2014, the CMIP Panel and WGCM co-chairs have now endorsed 21 Model Intercomparison Projects (MIPs).

CMIP6 的设计将在《Geoscientific Model Development》专刊中予以阐述，该专刊预计于 2016 年 3 月底前收到一篇总览论文以及 CMIP6 获认可 MIP 的投稿。

The CMIP6 design will be described in a Geoscientific Model Development special issue with submissions of an overview paper and the CMIP6-Endorsed MIP contributions envisaged by end of March 2016.

该专刊中所呈现的实验与强迫数据集的描述，将详细界定 CMIP6。

The description of the experiments and forcing data sets presented in this special issue will define CMIP6 in detail.

有关 CMIP6 的最新信息也可在 CMIP 专家组网站 http://www.wcrp-climate.org/index.php/wgcm-cmip/about-cmip 上找到。

Updated information on CMIP6 can also be found at the CMIP Panel website at http://www.wcrp-climate.org/index.php/wgcm-cmip/about-cmip.

CMIP6 获认可 MIP 的申请

Application for CMIP6-Endorsed MIPs

请将申请材料交回 CMIP 专家组主席 Veronika Eyring（电子邮箱：Veronika.Eyring@dlr.de）

Please return to CMIP Panel Chair Veronika Eyring (email: Veronika.Eyring@dlr.de)

日期：2014 年 11 月 10 日

Date: 10 November 2014

近期提出的修订版 CMIP 结构（相关信息见 CMIP 专家组网站：http://www.wcrp-climate.org/index.php/wgcm-cmip/about-cmip）规定了一小组实验，供各模式组在开发新版模式时例行开展。

The recently proposed, revised CMIP structure (see information on the CMIP Panel website at http://www.wcrp-climate.org/index.php/wgcm-cmip/about-cmip) provides for a small set of experiments to be routinely performed by modeling groups whenever they develop a new model version.

这些所谓持续进行的 CMIP Klima 诊断、评估与表征（DECK）实验以及 CMIP6 历史模拟的输出，将通过 ESGF（地球系统网格联盟）基础设施分发，供科学界使用。

The output from these so-called ongoing CMIP Diagnostic, Evaluation and Characterization of Klima (DECK) experiments and the CMIP6 Historical Simulation will be distributed for community use via the ESGF infrastructure.

其他模式比较计划（MIP）将以 CMIP DECK 实验和 CMIP6 历史模拟为基础，并对其进行扩充，以回答广泛的科学问题。

Other Model Intercomparison Projects (MIPs) will build on the CMIP DECK experiments and the CMIP6 Historical Simulation and augment them to address a broad range of scientific questions.

此外，拟议的 MIP 实验将与 CMIP DECK 实验和 CMIP6 历史模拟一起，共同构成 CMIP 下一阶段的模拟组合。

Additionally proposed MIP experiments together with the CMIP DECK experiments and the CMIP6 Historical Simulation will constitute the suite of simulations for the next phase of CMIP.

现邀请各 MIP 为 CMIP 的下一阶段（即 CMIP6）申请认可。

MIPs are invited to request endorsement for the next phase of CMIP (i.e., CMIP6).

申请获得 CMIP6 获认可 MIP 地位的 MIP，应将其申请提交给 CMIP 专家组主席。

Applications from MIPs requesting status as a CMIP6-Endorsed MIP should be sent to the CMIP Panel Chair.

目前的 MIP 提案集现已完成，并将按商定的时间表进行修订。

The current set of MIP proposals is now complete and will be revised on the agreed timeline.

我们将在一年之后，于 2015 年 10 月举行的下一次 WGCM 会议上审议任何新增提案。

We will review any additional proposals in a year from now at the next WGCM meeting in October 2015.

各 MIP 可提议将其部分乃至全部实验纳入构成 CMIP6 的模拟组合之中。

A MIP may propose that a subset or even all of their experiments be included as part of the suite of simulations constituting CMIP6.

CMIP 专家组将与 WGCM 联合主席共同决定某个 MIP 及其实验是否满足 CMIP6 的认可标准。

The CMIP Panel will, together with the WGCM co-chairs, decide whether a MIP and its experiments meet the criteria for endorsement for CMIP6.

请注意，预计为 CMIP6 提议的所有新增实验都将由该 MIP 进行科学分析并加以利用。

Note that it is expected that all additional experiments proposed for CMIP6 will be scientifically analyzed and exploited by the MIP.

CMIP6 获认可 MIP 可以充分利用 ESGF 基础设施。

CMIP6-Endsored MIPs can make full use of the ESGF infrastructure.

为了尽可能减轻希望参与的模式组的负担，谋求成为 CMIP 第 X 阶段一部分的 MIP 必须同意在实验设计、数据格式和文档方面遵守 CMIP 标准。

In order to minimize the burden imposed on modeling groups wishing to participate, the MIPs seeking to be part of CMIP Phase X must agree to comply with the CMIP standards in terms of experimental design, data format and documentation.

总体而言，WGCM 鼓励遵守 CMIP 的现行标准。

In general the WGCM encourages adhering to the standards in place for CMIP.

MIP 获得 CMIP6 认可的主要标准如下：

The main criteria for MIPs to be endorsed for CMIP6 are

1. MIP 及其实验至少针对 CMIP6 的一个关键科学问题。

1. The MIP and its experiments address at least one of the key science questions of CMIP6.

2. MIP 展示其与 DECK 实验及 CMIP6 历史模拟之间的关联。

2. The MIP demonstrates connectivity to the DECK experiments and the CMIP6 Historical Simulation.

3. MIP 采用 CMIP 模式基础设施的标准与约定。

3. The MIP adopts the CMIP modeling infrastructure standards and conventions.

4. 所有实验均划分层级、定义明确，在多模式背景下具有价值，且不与其他 CMIP6 实验重叠。

4. All experiments are tiered, well-defined, and useful in a multi-model context and don’t overlap with other CMIP6 experiments.

5. 除非某个 Tier 1 实验仅与另一项已成熟确立的实验略有差异，否则该实验必须已由不止一个模式组完成过。

5. Unless a Tier 1 experiment differs only slightly from another well-established experiment, it must already have been performed by more than one modeling group.

6. 有足够数量的建模中心（约 8 个）承诺执行该 MIP 的全部 Tier 1 实验，并提供回答其至少一个科学问题所需的全部指定诊断量。

6. A sufficient number of modelling centers (~8) are committed to performing all of the MIP‘s Tier 1 experiments and providing all the requested diagnostics needed to answer at least one of its science questions.

7. MIP 提出一份分析计划，说明其将如何利用全部拟议实验、任何相关观测以及特别要求的模式输出，以评估各模式并回答其科学问题。

7. The MIP presents an analysis plan describing how it will use all proposed experiments, any relevant observations, and specially requested model output to evaluate the models and address its science questions.

8. MIP 已完成 MIP 模板问卷的填写。

8. The MIP has completed the MIP template questionnaire.

9. MIP 就其实验设计向 CMIP6 专刊投稿一篇论文。

9. The MIP contributes a paper on its experimental design to the CMIP6 Special Issue.

10. MIP 考虑通过与各建模组共同署名论文的方式报告其结果。

10. The MIP considers reporting on the results by co-authoring a paper with the modelling groups.

MIP 的目标

Goal of the MIP

除 CO2 外，过去的气候变化还受到多种化学活性气体、气溶胶和充分混合温室气体（WMGHG）的强迫。关于化学-气候相互作用的科学问题和不确定性涵盖从区域尺度（例如，对流层臭氧和气溶胶与区域气象的相互作用）、到远距离联系（例如，空气污染的半球输送、平流层低层臭氧和温度对地面气候的影响）、再到全球整合（例如，CH4 和 N2O 的寿命）的多个层面。

Past climate change has been forced by a wide range of chemically reactive gases, aerosols, and well mixed greenhouse gases (WMGHGs), in addition to CO2. Scientific questions and uncertainties regarding chemistry-climate interactions range from regional scales (e.g., tropospheric ozone and aerosols interacting with regional meteorology), to long-range connections (e.g., hemispheric transport of air pollution, the impacts of lower stratospheric ozone and temperatures on surface climate), to global integration (e.g., the lifetimes of CH4 and N2O).

AerChemMIP 计划通过以下方式为 CMIP6 做出贡献：1）诊断涉及 NTCF（即对流层气溶胶、对流层 O3 前体物和 CH4）以及化学活性 WMGHG（例如 N2O，也包括 CH4 和部分卤代烃**，包括对平流层 O3 的影响）的强迫与反馈；2）记录并理解大气化学成分过去和未来的变化；3）估算这些变化引起的从全球到区域尺度的气候响应。

AerChemMIP proposes to contribute to CMIP6 through the following: 1) diagnose forcings and feedbacks involving NTCF1s, (namely tropospheric aerosols, tropospheric O3 precursors, and CH4) and the chemically reactive WMGHGs (e.g., N2O, also CH4, and some halocarbons** including impacts on stratospheric O3), 2) document and understand past and future changes in the chemical composition of the atmosphere, and 3) estimate the global-to-regional climate response from these changes.

1 近项气候强迫因子（Near Term Climate Forcers）

1 Near Term Climate Forcers

要参与 CMIP6/AerChemMIP 项目，模式需要以相同的设置运行 CMIP6 DECK 试验，即在化学和气溶胶方案中启用相同级别的复杂程度。

To participate in the CMIP6/AerChemMIP project models will need to be run for the CMIP6 DECK experiments with the same setup, i.e. with the same levels of sophistication activated in the chemistry and aerosol schemes.

特别是，必须要有采用完整化学（如使用）和气溶胶的工业革命前（PI）控制模拟和历史模拟。

In particular it will be essential to have PI control and Historical simulations with the full chemistry (where used) and aerosols.

同时我们也认识到，无法参与 CMIP6 的团队也能为回答 AerChemMIP 的科学问题做出有价值的贡献。

It is also realised that valuable contributions to answering the AerChemMIP scientific questions can be made by groups unable to participate in CMIP6.

在更广泛的 AerChemMIP 项目中，我们欢迎并鼓励这些团队参与，但其数据将不构成正式 CMIP6 提交的一部分。

Participation from these groups is welcomed and encouraged in the wider AerChemMIP project but the data will not form part of the official CMIP6 submission.

最近，WCRP 将"生物地球化学强迫与反馈"批准为一个协作主题，其范围类似于重大挑战（Grand Challenges）。

Recently, WCRP endorsed "Biogeochemical forcings and feedbacks" as a Theme of Collaboration, similar in scope to the Grand Challenges.

AerChemMIP 非常适合通过所有层级的模拟为这一主题做出重要贡献。

AerChemMIP is ideally suited to provide significant contributions to this theme through simulations in all Tiers.

特别是，第 1.3 层级模拟考察甲烷变化（其具有重要的生物地球化学分量）对历史气候的作用。

In particular, simulations Tier 1.3 look at the role of methane changes (which have an important biogeochemical component) on the historical climate.

此外，空气质量是 AerChemMIP 的核心主题（例如参见第 1.2 层级），因此将实现 http://www.wcrp-climate.org/images/documents/jsc/JSC36/WCRP-GC-biogeochemistry.pdf 中强调的"生物地球化学强迫与反馈"的部分目标。

In addition, air quality is a theme central to AerChemMIP (see Tier 1.2 for example), and therefore will fulfill some of the goals of "Biogeochemical forcings and feedbacks" highlighted in http://www.wcrp-climate.org/images/documents/jsc/JSC36/WCRP-GC-biogeochemistry.pdf.

AerChemMIP 第 1 层级模拟主要侧重于理解大气成分的变化（来自 NTCF 和其他化学活性人为气体）及其对气候的影响。

The AerChemMIP Tier 1 simulations focus primarily on understanding atmospheric composition changes (from NTCFs and other chemically-active anthropogenic gases) and their impact on climate.

我们设计了一系列试验，在历史和未来气候变化中对比各种 NTCF 与 WMGHG 的强迫作用。

We have devised a series of experiments that contrast the forcing of various NTCFs with that of WMGHGs in historical and future climate change.

此外，拟议的化学-气候模拟将通过其与 O3-CH4-PM2.5 大尺度变化的耦合，实现区域空气质量（AQ）变化的诊断。

In addition, the proposed chemistry-climate simulations will enable diagnosis of changes in regional air quality (AQ) through its coupling to large-scale changes in O3-CH4-PM2.5.

我们将与 RFMIP 和 DAMIP 合作，提供对 ERF 以及对流层 NTCF 区域分辨气候强迫特征的综合分析。

We will work in collaboration with RFMIP and DAMIP to provide a comprehensive analysis of ERF and the regionally-resolved climate forcing signature from tropospheric NTCFs.

对于某些可具体归因的气候强迫，特别是处于几十 mW m-2 量级水平的那些强迫，实际的气候变化在瞬变模拟、甚至几十年时间切片中都难以检测。

For some of the specifically attributable climate forcings, in particular those at the 10s of mW m-2 level, the actual climate change will be difficult to detect in a transient simulation or even a time slice of several decades.

AerChemMIP 是由两个国际团体——观测与模式气溶胶比较计划（AeroCom，http://aerocom.met.no/Welcome.html）和 IGAC/SPARC 化学-气候模式计划（CCMI，http://www.met.reading.ac.uk/ccmi/）——为 CMIP6 开展的联合、整合性工作。

AerChemMIP is a joint, consolidated effort for CMIP6 from two international communities -- Aerosol Comparisons between Observations and Models (AeroCom, http://aerocom.met.no/Welcome.html) and the IGAC/SPARC Chemistry-Climate Model Initiative (CCMI, http://www.met.reading.ac.uk/ccmi/).

为 CCMI 第二阶段建议的试验 [Eyring et al., 2013b]——传统上使用大多给定海表温度和海冰浓度的化学-气候模式（CCM）运行——是对这套 AerChemMIP/CMIP6 试验的补充。

Experiments suggested for CCMI Phase 2 [Eyring et al., 2013b], which are traditionally run using chemistry-climate models (CCMs) with mostly prescribed sea surface temperatures and sea ice concentrations, complement this set of AerChemMIP/CMIP6 experiments.

AeroCom 第三阶段的进一步试验旨在理解气溶胶强迫对气溶胶生成和损耗过程的敏感性。

Further experiments in AeroCom phase III aim to understand sensitivity of aerosol forcing to aerosol formation and loss processes.

**我们不专门考虑寿命极长的 F 类气体（SF6、PFC 和部分 HFC），因为在百年时间尺度上其丰度不受化学过程影响。**

**We do not specifically consider the very long-lived F-gases (SF6, PFCs, and some HFCs) as their abundance is not affected by chemistry on a century time scale.**

概述

Overview

IPCC AR5（Myhre et al., 2013）将气溶胶和臭氧确定为自工业革命前以来辐射强迫不确定性的主要来源。

Aerosols and ozone were identified in IPCC AR5 (Myhre et al., 2013) as the main sources of uncertainty in the radiative forcing since pre-industrial times.

AR5 [Kirtman et al., 2013] 还指出了在预估化学活性 WMGHG 以及全球变化导致的未来空气质量方面的不确定性。

Uncertainties in projecting the chemically reactive WMGHGs as well as future air quality from global changes were also identified in AR5 [Kirtman et al., 2013].

除了 AR5 评估的变化的人为排放之外，源自生物源、沙尘或海盐的自然气溶胶是当前强迫不确定性的主要贡献者（Carslaw et al. 2013）。

In addition to changing anthropogenic emissions evaluated in AR5, natural aerosols originating from biogenic sources, dust or sea-salt are a primary contributor to the uncertainty in current forcing (Carslaw et al. 2013).

由于云对气溶胶背景水平的非线性响应，气候系统对人类扰动的响应将在很大程度上取决于自然气溶胶背景（Carlton et al., 2010）。

Due to the nonlinear response of clouds to the background level of aerosols, the response of the climate system to human perturbations will depend critically on the natural aerosol background (Carlton et al., 2010).

除气溶胶之外，生态系统的生物地球化学过程提供了 WMGHG CH4 和 N2O 以及 O3 前体物（闪电和土壤氮氧化物、挥发性有机化合物、野火排放）的大量来源。

Beyond aerosols, the biogeochemistry of ecosystems provides large sources of the WMGHGs CH4 and N2O, as well as O3 precursors (lightning and soil nitrogen oxides, volatile organic compounds, wildfire emissions).

这些来源很可能受到气候变化的影响，从而产生多种反馈；迄今为止这些反馈仅由数量有限的研究（和模式）加以量化，因此需要一套协调一致的模拟，以便在模式之间进行一致且干净的比较。

These sources are likely to be affected by climate change, leading to a variety of feedbacks that to date have only been quantified from a limited number of studies (and models) and thus demand for a coordinated set of simulations that allows for a consistent and clean comparison between models.

NTCF 的人为排放造成了一种气候强迫，其量级目前几乎与 CO2 强迫相当。

Anthropogenic emissions of NTCFs have been responsible for a climate forcing that is presently nearly equal in magnitude to CO2-forcing.

这些排放导致了多种全球气候影响，例如温度和降水的区域型态，其量级与 WMGHG 的全球平均等效 ERF 相近。

These emissions have led to a variety of global climate impacts such as regional patterns of temperature and precipitation, with a magnitude similar to the global-mean equivalent ERF of WMGHG.

此外，NTCF 的 ERF 本质上是不均匀的，且有证据表明，在区域尺度 NTCF 较大的地方，气候响应与全球等效 ERF 不同——即存在对区域 ERF 的区域响应。

In addition, NTCF ERF is inherently inhomogeneous, and there is some evidence that where NTCF on a regional scale is large, the climate response differs from the globally equivalent ERF – i.e., there is some regional response to regional ERF.

NTCF 排放还驱动着区域和地方尺度的空气质量（AQ）。

NTCF emissions are also responsible for driving regional and local air quality (AQ).

这使人们认识到，与分别减缓相比，将减缓气候变化和空气污染相结合的策略具有明显的经济效益（IPCC, 2014 – WG3 SPM）。

This has led to the recognition that a combined strategy of mitigating climate change and air pollution together has clear economic benefits compared to separate mitigation (IPCC, 2014 – WG3 SPM).

在我们未来的世界中，大多数（即便不是全部）情景都会导致决定空气质量并造成污染事件的排放和气象条件发生变化。

In our future world, most, if not all scenarios lead to changes in the emissions and meteorology that determine air quality and create pollution episodes.

迄今为止用于管理空气污染的知识库必须根据 CMIP6 将提供的关于未来空气化学气候态的更为全面的信息加以更新。

The knowledge base used to manage air pollution to date must be updated based on more comprehensive information that CMIP6 will provide on future air chemistry climatologies.

人类健康和资产（农业、建成环境、生态系统）的暴露风险将由地表臭氧和颗粒物的逐日变化驱动，此外还有硝酸盐和硫酸盐的沉降以及任何与大气变化相互作用的土地利用变化。

The exposure risks of human health and assets (agriculture, built environment, ecosystems) will be driven by daily variations in surface ozone and particulate matter in addition to deposition of nitrate and sulfate and any land-use change interacting with atmospheric changes.

臭氧变化对气候的强迫来自对流层臭氧的增加和平流层低层臭氧的减少，两者之间还存在相互作用。

The forcing of climate by ozone changes results from tropospheric increases and lower stratospheric decreases, with interaction between those.

它们是气候变化和多重排放变化的综合影响的结果。

They are the result of combined impacts from climate change and multiple emission changes.

例如，CH4 排放 ERF 的最大分量之一来自对流层 O3 的增加。

For example, one of the largest components of CH4 emissions' ERF is that from the increase in tropospheric O3.

此外，自 1970 年代以来由消耗臭氧层物质（ODS）引起的平流层 O3 损耗已导致平流层低层显著变冷，并通过南极臭氧洞与南半球对流层环流和降水型态的变化相联系，尤其是在夏季（WMO, 2014）。

In addition, stratospheric O3 losses due to ozone depleting substances (ODS) since the 1970s has led to significant cooling of the lower stratosphere, and through the Antarctic ozone hole is linked to changes in tropospheric circulation and rainfall patterns in the southern hemisphere, especially during summer (WMO, 2014).

在南半球，未来夏季环流变化同时受臭氧恢复速率和温室气体增长速率控制 [Eyring et al., 2013a]，这表明在未来的气候预估中需要考虑臭氧变化。

In the Southern Hemisphere, future summertime circulation changes are controlled by both the ozone recovery rate and the rate of GHG increases [Eyring et al., 2013a], indicating the need to account for ozone changes in future climate projections.

由于一些参与 CMIP6 的模式没有交互式化学方案，AerChemMIP 还将为 CMIP6 提供历史和未来随时间变化的臭氧以及平流层水汽浓度场。

Since some models participating in CMIP6 do not have interactive chemistry schemes, AerChemMIP will also provide historical and future time-varying ozone, and stratospheric water vapour concentration fields for CMIP6.

该臭氧数据库将是对 [Cionni et al., 2011] 为 CMIP5 提供的数据库的更新。

The ozone database will be an update of the database provided for CMIP5 by [Cionni et al., 2011].

这些数据集将由 CCM 和 CTM 模拟的组合生成，而这些模拟本身并不属于 CMIP6 的一部分。

These datasets will be generated from a mixture of CCMs and CTMs simulations which are not themselves part of CMIP6.

由于气溶胶在 AerChemMIP 的许多模拟和分析中处于核心地位，我们建议没有预报性气溶胶方案的气候模式不要参与 AerChemMIP。

Because of the central role of aerosols in many of the AerChemMIP simulations and analysis, we suggest that climate models without prognostic aerosol schemes refrain from participating in AerChemMIP.

需要特别指出的是，参与 AerChemMIP 的模式必须在其相应的、符合资格的 DECK 和历史模拟中使用 Smith et al. 于 2015 年底提供的气溶胶和气溶胶前体物排放。

It is important to note that the models participating in AerChemMIP must use for the corresponding, qualifying DECK and historical simulation emissions of aerosols and aerosol precursors provided by Smith et al. in the end of 2015.

CMIP6 气溶胶强迫数据集不得用于 DECK 和历史模拟。

The CMIP6 aerosol forcing dataset shall not be used for DECK and historical simulations.

不过，我们鼓励建模团队用其 AerChemMIP 模式版本参与 RFMIP 模拟中的给定气溶胶子集，该子集需要使用 CMIP6 气溶胶强迫数据集。

However modeling groups are encouraged to participate with their AerChemMIP model version in the prescribed aerosol subset of RFMIP simulations, where the CMIP6 aerosol forcing dataset is required.

在这种情况下，气溶胶辐射效应必须与交互式气溶胶方案解耦，并应使用来自 RFMIP 气溶胶强迫数据集的给定光学特性。

In that case the aerosol radiative effects will have to be decoupled from the interactive aerosol scheme and prescribed optical properties from the RFMIP aerosol forcing dataset shall be used.

拟议的第 1 层级试验概述

Overview of the Proposed Tier 1 Experiments

AerChemMIP 第 1 层级模拟聚焦于两个科学问题

The AerChemMIP Tier 1 simulations focus on two science questions

1. 在历史时期，NTCF 和 ODS 排放对全球 ERF 做出了怎样的贡献，又是如何影响区域气候的？

1. How have NTCF and ODS emissions contributed to global ERF and affected regional climate over the historical period?

2. 未来的政策（关于气候/AQ/土地利用）将如何影响 NTCF 及其气候影响？

2. How will future policies (on climate/AQ/land use) affect the NTCFs and their climate impacts?

3. 在历史时期，WMGHG 浓度是如何强迫气候的（包括通过其化学影响）？

3. How have WMGHG concentrations forced climate (including through their chemical impacts) over the historical period?

在以下各节中，我们分别讨论每个问题，并为每个科学问题给出回答该问题所需的模拟的说明。

In the following sections, we discuss each question separately and provide for each science question the description of the simulations necessary to answer the stated question.

注意，我们强调使用有效辐射强迫（ERF）来度量气候强迫。

Note that we emphasize the use of the Effective Radiative Forcing (ERF) to measure climate forcing.

我们在本文档末尾提供了与该计算相关的方法论说明。

We have provided at the end of this document a description of the methodology associated with this calculation.

1. 在历史时期，NTCF 和 ODS 排放对全球 ERF 做出了怎样的贡献，又是如何影响区域气候的？

1. How have NTCF and ODS emissions contributed to global ERF and affected regional climate over the historical period?

人为非 CO2 排放（例如 NTCF、卤代烃和 N2O 等温室气体……）造成了一种气候强迫，在区域尺度上与 CO2 强迫相当，尤其是在最近几十年。

Anthropogenic non-CO2 emissions (e.g., NTCFs, GHGs like halocarbons and N2O,…) have led to a climate forcing that is commensurate to CO2-forcing on regional scales, especially over the last few decades.

由于自工业革命前以来其辐射强迫存在很大不确定性，臭氧和气溶胶尤其是造成在观测数据记录上约束气候敏感性存在很大不确定性的一个关键因素。

By way of their associated large uncertainty in radiative forcing since pre-industrial times, ozone and aerosols in particular are a key factor behind the large uncertainty in constraining climate sensitivity over the record of observed data.

这些 NTCF 的空间分布不均匀，对这种非均匀强迫的区域温度和降水响应程度在科学界仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

These NTCFs have an inhomogeneous spatial distribution and the degree of regional temperature and precipitation responses to such heterogeneous forcing remains an open question within the scientific community.

此外，尚不清楚主要位于北半球中纬度陆地区域的 NTCF 是否在那里引起了相对于 WMGHG 强迫而言更大的气候响应。

It is further unclear whether NTCFs, which are primarily located at Northern Hemisphere mid-latitude land areas have led to a larger climate response there, relative to forcing from WMGHGs.

对非均匀气候强迫的一个明确无误的区域响应，是由南极臭氧洞引起的南半球夏季地表环流变化，这是对消耗臭氧层卤代烃的间接响应。

One unambiguous regional response to inhomogeneous climate forcing concerns the Southern hemisphere summertime surface circulation changes induced by the Antarctic ozone hole as an indirect response to ozone-depleting halocarbons.

有论点认为，这些变化会导致降水型态、海洋环流和海冰覆盖的变化。

These changes have been argued to lead to changes in rainfall patterns, ocean circulation, and sea-ice cover.

与其他人为强迫和自然变率相比，这些臭氧引起的变化的相对作用尚未被科学界完全厘清（一些研究得出了相互矛盾的结论）。

The relative role of these ozone-induced changes compared to other anthropogenic forcings and natural variability is not fully resolved by the scientific community (with some studies reaching contradictory conclusions).

因此需要进行多模式集合模拟，尤其是使用能分辨平流层化学、从而隔离平流层臭氧损耗作用的模式。

Hence there is a need for multi-model ensemble of simulations, especially with models resolving stratospheric chemistry that isolate the role of stratospheric ozone depletion.

试验 1.1：NTCF 和消耗臭氧层卤代烃对瞬变历史耦合海洋气候的影响（注：此试验建立在 CMIP6 历史模拟之上，后者被用作参考模拟，并且其中需要包含 AerChemMIP 诊断量）

Experiment 1.1: Transient historical coupled ocean climate impacts of NTCFs and of ozone depleting halocarbons (note: this builds on CMIP6-historical-simulation, which is used as the reference simulation, and requires AerChemMIP diagnostics therein)

1.1.1 Perturbation: Historical WMGHG (including halocarbon) concentrations, 1850 NTCF emissions. 165 years, 1-3 ensemble members

1.1.2 Perturbation: Historical WMGHG concentrations and NTCF emissions, 1950 halocarbons. 65 years (branched from CMIP6 historical in 1950), 1 up to the number of ensemble members performed for the CMIP6 historical

试验 1.2：通过给定瞬变历史海表温度（SST）模拟估算 ERF（见下文关于 ERF 的注释）。

2. 未来的政策（关于气候/AQ/土地利用）将如何影响 NTCF 及其气候影响？相关气候强迫的型态是什么，这些型态如何转化为温度和降水变化？

2. How will future policies (on climate/AQ/land use) affect the NTCFs and their climate impact? What are the patterns of associated climate forcing, and how do these patterns translate into temperature and precipitation changes?

在未来几十年，政策制定者将在 3 个大致界定的领域做出选择：1）气候变化政策（主要针对 WMGHG），2）空气质量政策（主要针对 NTCF 排放，包括作为对流层气溶胶和对流层臭氧前体物的 CH4），以及 3）土地利用政策。

For the upcoming decades policy makers will be making choices in 3 broadly defined areas 1) climate change policies (targeting mostly WMGHGs), 2) air quality policies (targeting mostly NTCF emissions including CH4 that are precursors of tropospheric aerosols and tropospheric ozone) and 3) land-use policies.

AerChemMIP 旨在识别全球和区域层面化学变化的型态、与 NTCF 减缓努力（重点关注上述领域 1 和 2 中的政策选择）相关的 ERF，以及它们在 2015 年至 2055 年间的气候（地表温度和降水）和环境（健康、生态系统、能见度……）影响（这是预计气溶胶及其前体物排放显著的时段）。

AerChemMIP aims to identify the patterns of chemical change at the global and regional levels as well as the ERF associated with NTCF mitigation efforts (focusing on policy choices in areas 1 and 2 above), and their climate (surface temperature and precipitation) and environmental (health, ecosystem, visibility, …) impact between 2015 and 2055 (this is the time frame over which aerosol and precursor emissions are expected to be significant).

影响分析将通过对比以下模拟进行：a）ScenarioMIP 的 SSP3-7（注意，这些模拟需要加入额外诊断量才能对 AerChemMIP 有用），因为它具有高气溶胶排放；以及 b）一个扰动试验，其中对 SSP3-7 的 NTCF 排放施加空气质量政策（或最大可行减排），从而大幅降低 NTCF 排放。

The impact analysis will be performed by contrasting the following simulations: a) SSP3-7 from ScenarioMIP (note that additional diagnostics will have to be included for those simulations to be useful for AerChemMIP) since it has high aerosol emissions and b) a perturbation experiment where air quality policies (or maximum feasible reductions) are applied to the SSP3-7 NTCF emissions, and therefore lead to much reduced NTCF emissions.

这些扰动将与 ScenarioMIP 合作设计，以确保扰动与所考虑情景的基本故事线一致。

These perturbations will be designed in collaboration with ScenarioMIP to ensure that perturbations are consistent with the underlying story line of the scenario in consideration.

在这个问题下，我们在第 1 层级中侧重于估算甲烷变化对臭氧（对流层和平流层）、气溶胶氧化以及自然气溶胶排放的强迫，包括与这些变化相关的气候影响。

Under this question, we focus in Tier one on estimating the forcing from changes in methane on ozone (tropospheric and stratospheric), aerosol oxidation, and emissions of natural aerosols, including the climate impacts associated with those changes.

注意，这里只计算 ERF 估算值，而相关的瞬变耦合模拟在第 2 层级。

Note that only ERF estimates are calculated, while the associated transient coupled simulations are in Tier 2.

If models have not all components to compute dynamic aerosols, tropospheric or stratospheric chemistry, models are requested to consider using the forcing fields of chemical compounds provided by AerChemMIP when performing AerChemMIP Tier 1 experiments.

拟议的第 2 和第 3 层级试验概述

Overview of the Proposed Tier 2 and 3 Experiments

AerChemMIP 还包括一些补充试验，用以最终通过较为有限的模式集合记录补充性科学问题——这些科学问题建立在第 1 层级试验的基础上，并高效利用 CMIP6 的通用设置。

AerChemMIP also includes additional experiments to document with an eventually more limited set of models complementing science questions, which are based on tier 1 experiments, and make efficient use of the general set-up of CMIP6.

第 2 和第 3 层级通过处理 NTCF 和化学活性 WMGHG 的额外组合，为第 1 层级试验 1.1、1.2、1.3 和 3.1 增加细节。

Tier 2 and 3 add detail to the Tier 1 experiments 1.1, 1.2, 1.3 and 3.1 by addressing extra combinations of NTCFs and reactive WMGHGs.

它们还增加了两个额外的科学目标。

They also add two additional science objectives.

4. 通过自然排放变化量化气候反馈（FDBCK）

4. Quantifying the climate feedbacks through changes in natural emissions (FDBCK)

5. 量化与人为排放相关的不确定性（ChemDOC）

5. Quantifying the uncertainties associated with anthropogenic emissions (ChemDOC)

注意，除一项以外，所有第 2 和第 3 层级模拟都依赖 AGCM 模拟，即海表温度（和海冰分布）取自第 1 层级中现有的完全耦合模拟。

Note that all except one Tier 2 and 3 simulations rely on AGCM simulations, i.e. sea-surface temperatures (and sea-ice distribution) are specified from an existing fully-coupled simulation in Tier 1.

Experiment 1.3. Time-slice simulations based on the 1850 control SSTs to compute the ERF for 1850 and 2014 (e.g. AR5 fig 8.15).

3.1.2 1850 年 N2O。165 年。第 2 层级

3.1.2 1850 N2O. 165 years. Tier 2

4. 通过自然排放变化量化气候反馈

4. Quantifying the climate feedbacks through changes in natural emissions

气候变化已经影响（并将继续影响）自然 NTCF 和化学活性 WMGHG 的自然排放。

Climate change will have affected (and will affect) the natural emissions of natural NTCFs and reactive WMGHGs.

这些自然排放将具有 ERF，因此会反馈到气候变化。

These natural emissions will have an ERF and so feedback onto climate change.

理想情况下，试验应分析恒定排放与变化排放的效应对比，但这过于复杂而难以实现。

Ideally experiments would analyse the effects of constant vs varying emissions, however this is too complex to implement.

这里提出的试验只是将自然排放加倍。

The experiments proposed here simply double the natural emissions.

自然 WMGHG（例如湿地甲烷）的 ERF 不予计算，因为可以从试验 1.3 获得。

The ERFs of natural WMGHGs (e.g. wetland methane) are not calculated as these can be obtained from experiment 1.3.

试验 4.1：量化自然排放加倍的 ERF（基于 1850 年对照）。

Experiment 4.1: Quantifying the ERFs of double natural emissions (based on 1850) control.

4.1.1 1850 年沙尘排放加倍。30 年。第 2 层级

4.1.1 1850 doubled dust emissions. 30 years. Tier 2

4.1.2 1850 doubled sea salt emissions. 30 years. Tier 2

4.1.3 1850 doubled emissions of oceanic DMS. 30 years. Tier 3

此外，我们将通过生物源排放研究土地利用变化的化学影响（LU-NTCF）。

In addition, we will study the chemistry impact of land-use changes through biogenic emissions (LU-NTCF).

这将使用 AerChemMIP 诊断量执行，但采用与 LUMIP 土地利用变化试验相同的协议，即基于 SSP3-7 但采用 SSP1-2.6 的土地利用。

This will be performed with AerChemMIP diagnostics, but using the same protocol as the land-use change experiment in LUMIP, i.e. based on SSP3-7 but with land use from SSP1-2.6.

模拟年数总计。第 2 层级 = 900-1230，第 3 层级 = 140

Total amount of simulation years. Tier 2 = 900-1230, Tier 3 =140

用于模式评估的模式诊断量与性能指标

Model Diagnostics and Performance Metrics for Model Evaluation

AerChemMIP 将通过建议模式评估（包括空气质量极值表征）和诊断 NTCF 辐射强迫所需的气溶胶与化学相关输出，为 CMIP6 数据需求做出贡献。

AerChemMIP will contribute to the CMIP6 data request by suggesting aerosol and chemistry related output that is required for model evaluation (including the characterization of air quality extremes) and for diagnosing radiative forcings from NTCFs.

此外，AerChemMIP 将推动地球系统模式评估工具（ESMValTool，[Righi et al., 2014]）的开发、通过 AeroCom 工具对气溶胶参数进行文档化，并将纳入用于 CMIP6 模式评估的重要化学相关诊断量和性能指标。

In addition, AerChemMIP will contribute to the development of the Earth System Model Evaluation Tools (ESMValTool, [Righi et al., 2014]), the documentation of aerosol parameters via the AeroCom tools and will include important chemistry-related diagnostics and performance metrics for CMIP6 model evaluation.

ERF 通过比较两次运行之间的大气层顶（TOA）净辐射通量来计算，两次运行具有相同的 SST 但 NTCF 排放受到扰动（见下文）。

The ERFs are calculated by comparing the net TOA radiation fluxes between two runs with the same SSTs but with perturbed NTCF emissions (see below).

有效辐射强迫模拟的设计。

Design of Effective Radiative Forcing simulations.

拟议的模拟将有效辐射强迫（ERF）分析与 NTCF 随之而来的气候影响分析相结合。

The proposed simulations combine analysis of the effective radiative forcing (ERF) and the consequent climate impacts of NTCFs.

WMGHG 的 RF 将由 RFMIP 提供。

The RF from WMGHGs will be provided by RFMIP.

内部变率（主要是云）会产生相当大的噪声，因此需要 30 年模拟来表征现今 NTCF 的 ERF。

Internal variability (mainly clouds) generates considerable noise therefore 30 years of simulation are needed to characterize the present day ERF from NTCFs.

或者，能够对其模拟的模式风场进行逼近（仅风场，朝向气象分析场或先前生成的气象场）的模式，应能用少至 3 年的模拟识别出统计显著的信号。

Alternatively, models that can nudge their simulated model winds (only, towards meteorological analyses or previously generated meteorological fields) should be able to identify a statistically-significant signal with as little as 3 years of simulation.

类似地，一对由演变中的 SST 驱动的运行，其中一个包含、另一个不包含演变中的 NTCF 排放，将提供 NTCF ERF 的时间演变。

In a similar way a pair of runs driven by evolving SSTs but with and without evolving NTCF emissions will provide the time evolution of the NTCF ERF.

对于温度和降水影响，需要使用耦合海洋的模拟。

For the temperature and precipitation impacts, simulations with a coupled ocean are needed.

同样，这需要一对包含与不包含演变中的 NTCF 排放的运行来计算影响。

Again, this requires a pair with and without evolving NTCF emissions in order to compute the impacts.

耦合海洋模式的内部变率比固定 SST 时更大，因此至少需要 3 个集合成员。

The internal variability in the coupled ocean models is larger than with fixed SSTs, so at least 3 ensemble members will be needed.

有效辐射强迫（ERF）在 IPCC AR5 中引入 [Boucher et al., 2013; Myhre et al., 2013]。

The effective radiative forcing (ERF) was introduced in IPCC AR5 [Boucher et al., 2013; Myhre et al., 2013].

其定义如下："ERF 是在允许大气温度、水汽和云进行调整之后、但地表温度或部分地表条件保持不变的条件下，TOA 净向下辐射通量的变化"。

The definition is given as follows: 'ERF is the change in net TOA downward radiative flux after allowing for atmospheric temperatures, water vapour and clouds to adjust, but with surface temperature or a portion of surface conditions unchanged'.

这与传统的辐射强迫（RF）概念不同，后者要求地表和对流层温度以及水汽和云等其他变量保持固定。

This is different from the traditional radiative forcing (RF) concept where surface and tropospheric temperature and other variables such as water vapour and clouds must be kept fixed.

用 ERF 和 RF 量化气候驱动因子对某些气溶胶效应给出不同的结果，其中 RF 概念可以量化半直接效应和第二间接气溶胶效应（分别为气溶胶-辐射相互作用的 ERF 和气溶胶-云相互作用的 ERF）。

Quantification of a climate driver by ERF and RF provides different results for some aerosol effects where the latter concept allows quantification of semi-direct effect and second indirect aerosol effect (ERF of aerosol-radiation interaction and aerosol-cloud interaction, respectively).

对于温室气体，RF 和 ERF 在量级上更为接近，但后者具有更大的不确定性。

For greenhouse gases RF and ERF are more similar in magnitude, but the latter has larger uncertainty.

目前使用两种模拟 ERF 的方法，即：i）来自固定海表温度（SST）模拟的 TOA 净通量，以及 ii）瞬变温度响应对初始辐射扰动的回归 [Gregory et al., 2004]。

Two ways to simulate ERF is currently used, namely; i) net TOA fluxes from fixed-sea surface temperature (SST) simulations and ii) regression of transient temperature response with the initial radiative perturbation [Gregory et al., 2004].

这两种模拟 ERF 的方法在 [Boucher et al., 2013; Sherwood et al., 2014] 中作了说明。

The two methods for simulating ERF are illustrated in [Boucher et al., 2013; Sherwood et al., 2014].

两种 ERF 方法各有优缺点 [Boucher et al., 2013; Myhre et al., 2013]。

Both ERF methods have their advantages and disadvantages [Boucher et al., 2013; Myhre et al., 2013].

回归方法可应用于许多典型的 CMIP 运行，但需要具有显著辐射扰动的长时运行（至少 30 年）。

The regression method can be applied to many of the typical CMIP runs, but require long runs (at least 30 years) with a significant radiative perturbation.

固定 SST 方法可应用于相对较小的辐射扰动，但并非所有建模团队都能进行固定 SST 类模拟。

The fixed-SST method can by applied to relatively small radiative perturbations, but not all modelling groups have access to fixed-SST type simulations.

固定 SST 方法还可以通过附加辐射调用进一步应用，以诊断各种气溶胶效应 [Ghan et al., 2012]。

The fixed-SSTs approach can further be applied with additional radiation calls to diagnose the various aerosol effects [Ghan et al., 2012].

对短波和长波变化分别应用单独的诊断。

Separate diagnostics for shortwave and longwave changes are applied.

为诊断间接气溶胶效应和半直接效应，通过将人为气溶胶的折射率设为零来忽略气溶胶的散射和吸收，详见 [Ghan et al., 2012]。

To diagnose the indirect aerosol effect and semi-direct effect the scattering and absorption by aerosols are neglected by setting refractive indexes of anthropogenic aerosol to zero, see [Ghan et al., 2012] for further details.

C4MIP (Coupled Climate Carbon Cycle MIP) ｜ 碳循环气候耦合模式比较计划

C4MIP 申请书：申请获得 CMIP 正式认可

C4MIP Application for CMIP endorsement

2015 年 6 月

June 2015

碳循环气候耦合模式比较计划（C4MIP）请求耦合模拟工作组（WGCM）对耦合模式比较计划（CMIP）的下一阶段（CMIP6）予以正式认可。

The Coupled Climate Carbon Cycle MIP, C4MIP, requests formal endorsement by WGCM for the next phase of CMIP (CMIP6).

背景与动机

Background and motivation

碳循环是对物理气候模式的关键补充，正是它使这些模式成为“地球系统模式”（ESM）。

The carbon cycle is the key addition to physical climate models that makes them “Earth System Models” (ESMs).

CMIP5 是将 ESM 作为标准气候变化模拟工具纳入的第一个 CMIP 阶段，碳循环结果在 IPCC 第五次评估报告中占有突出地位（例如参见第一工作组（WG1）决策者摘要（SPM）、技术摘要（TS）、第 6、9、12 章以及第二工作组（WG2）第 4 章）。

CMIP5 was the first CMIP phase to include ESMs as the standard climate change modeling tool and carbon cycle results featured strongly in the IPCC 5th Assessment Report (see for example WG1 SPM, TS, chapters 6, 9, 12 and WG2 chapter 4).

WG1 SPM 突出强调了从人为排放到全球气候变化之间的直接联系，即具有政策相关性的累积排放瞬态响应（TCRE）。

WG1 SPM highlighted the direct link from anthropogenic emissions to global climate change through the policy relevant Transient Response to Cumulative Emissions (TCRE).

这是相对于第四次评估报告（AR4）的一项关键进步——这一进步之所以成为可能，完全有赖于物理气候模式中纳入了碳循环。

This is a key advance over AR4 – an advance only possible due to the inclusion of the carbon cycle in physical climate models.

C4MIP 在这项开发工作中一直处于核心地位，首篇 C4MIP 模式比较论文（Friedlingstein 等，J. Clim.，2006）目前的引用量已超过 1000 次。

C4MIP has been central in this development work, and the first C4MIP intercomparison paper (Friedlingstein et al., J. Clim., 2006) now has more than 1000 citations.

CMIP5 数据库中的碳循环模拟得到了广泛使用，由此催生了《Journal of Climate》的一期特刊，题为“Climate–Carbon Interactions in the CMIP5 Earth System Models”（CMIP5 地球系统模式中的气候—碳相互作用）（http://journals.ametsoc.org/page/C4MIP）。

Extensive use was made of the carbon cycle simulations in the CMIP5 database which led to a Journal of Climate Special Issue titled “Climate–Carbon Interactions in the CMIP5 Earth System Models” (http://journals.ametsoc.org/page/C4MIP)

碳循环过程的进一步开发、评估与评价是全球气候模拟中心的关键重点领域之一，我们完全预期碳循环过程将在 CMIP6（及以后）中具有根本性的重要意义。

Further development, evaluation and assessment of carbon cycle processes are one of the key focus areas for global climate modelling centres and we fully expect carbon cycle processes to be of fundamental importance in CMIP6 (and beyond).

各 MIP 的申请书应包含以下信息：

Proposals from MIPs should include the following information:

* 用于初步判定某一 MIP 是否应获得 CMIP6 认可的信息。

* Preliminary information used to determine whether a MIP should be endorsed for CMIP6 or not.

** 必须随后提供的信息（且须在专家组确定哪些实验（若有）将被纳入官方 CMIP6 试验组之前提供）。

** Information that must be provided later (and before the panel can determine which experiments, if any, will be incorporated in the official CMIP6 suite).

• Several of the SSC members are also members of other MIPs : ScenarioMIP (Friedlingstein), LUMIP (Jones, Brovkin, Pongratz), OCMIP (Bopp)

MIP 的目标与简要概述

Goal of the MIP and a brief overview

• C4MIP 的首要重点是理解并量化未来（世纪尺度）陆地与海洋碳储量和碳通量的变化

• The primary focus of C4MIP is to understand and quantify future (century-scale) changes in land and ocean carbon storage and fluxes

• 理想化实验将用于分离并量化陆地与海洋碳循环对气候变化以及大气 CO2 浓度变化的敏感性

• Idealized experiments will be used to separate and quantify the sensitivity of land and ocean carbon cycle to changes in climate and changes in atmospheric CO2 concentration

• 历史实验将用于评估模式性能，并探究对未来约束的潜力

• Historical experiments will be used to evaluate model performance and investigate potential for future constraints

• 未来情景实验将用于量化碳储量的未来变化，从而在给定 CO2 排放的前提下量化大气 CO2 浓度及相关气候变化，或诊断出与给定大气 CO2 浓度路径相容的排放量

• Future scenario experiments will be used to quantify future changes in carbon storage and hence quantify the atmospheric CO2 concentration and related climate change for given CO2 emissions, or diagnose the emissions compatible with a prescribed atmospheric CO2 concentration pathway

拟议实验概述

An overview of the proposed experiments

科学背景、拟议的实验设计、拟议的分析以及所需的诊断量，将在提交至 CMIP6《Geoscientific Model Development》（GMD）特刊的一篇论文中予以完整记述。

The science background, proposed experimental design, proposed analysis and required diagnostics will be fully documented in a paper to be submitted to the CMIP6 GMD special issue.

C4MIP 将建立在 DECK 试验和 CMIP6 历史模拟的基础之上。

C4MIP will build on the DECK and the CMIP6 Historical Simulation.

以下模拟是参加 C4MIP 的先决条件：

The following simulations are pre-requisite for C4MIP participation:

DECK 试验

DECK simulations

对照模拟

Control simulation

要求用于诊断模式漂移（陆地和海洋碳库的漂移）

Requested for diagnosis of model drift (drift in land and ocean carbon pools)

• C4MIP 期望参与试验的模式每种配置都进行一次对照试验。

• C4MIP expects a control run for each configuration of a model which contributes.

• 要求进行浓度驱动对照试验，采用给定的工业化前大气 CO2 浓度，以与浓度驱动模拟相配合。

• Concentration-driven control run is required, with prescribed pre-industrial atmospheric CO2, to parallel concentration driven simulations.

• 要求进行排放驱动对照试验（排放设为零，但模拟大气 CO2 浓度的演变），以与排放驱动模拟相配合。

• An emissions-driven control run (emissions set to zero, but simulated evolution of atmospheric CO2 concentration) is required to parallel emissions driven simulations.

CMIP CO2 浓度每年递增 1% 直至 4xCO2 的模拟

CMIP 1% per year increasing CO2 up to 4xCO2 simulation

要求作为 C4MIP 气候—碳循环反馈分析的基准；同时也要求用于 TCRE 的评估。

Requested as baseline for the C4MIP climate-carbon cycle feedback analysis; also requested for assessment of TCRE.

该模拟中的氮沉降应固定保持在对照试验所用的工业化前数值。

Nitrogen deposition in this simulation should be held fixed at the pre-industrial values used for the control run.

CMIP6 历史模拟

CMIP6 Historical Simulation

CMIP6 排放驱动历史模拟：具有交互式 CO2，并由给定的 CO2 排放强迫

CMIP6 Emissions-driven Historical Simulation with interactive CO2 and forced by prescribed CO2 emissions

• 与对照试验一样，C4MIP 期望模式的每种配置都进行历史模拟。

• As for the control run, C4MIP expects historical simulations with each configuration of the model.

• 因此要求进行排放驱动历史模拟。

• Hence an emissions-driven historical simulation is required.

• 将用于模式评估，并作为第一层级（Tier1）情景模拟的起始条件。

• Will be used for model evaluation and starting conditions for scenario simulations from Tier1

CMIP DECK 与 CMIP6 试验的拟议评估/分析概述

An overview of the proposed evaluation/analysis of the CMIP DECK and CMIP6 experiments

针对 CMIP5，C4MIP 的一组论文曾汇编为《Journal of Climate》的一期专集（Special Collection）。

For CMIP5 a Special Collection of C4MIP papers was assembled in Journal of Climate.

虽然我们尚未确定 CMIP6 的具体论文，但这一做法上次很成功，可能再次采用。

Whilst we have not yet decided on specific papers for CMIP6 this was successful last time and may be pursued again.

关键分析论文包括：

Key analysis papers include:

• 一篇关于气候—碳循环反馈及其分量（陆地和海洋的增益 gain、beta、gamma）的更新论文

• an update on the climate carbon cycle feedback and it's components (gain, beta, gamma on land and ocean)

• 一篇关于历史（排放驱动）情景及其评估的分析论文

• an analysis of the historical (emissions driven) scenario and its evaluation

• 一篇关于排放驱动情景的分析论文，量化未来气候变化下碳循环反馈的作用

• an analysis of the emissions driven scenario and quantification of the role of carbon cycle feedbacks under future climate change

我们设想这些关键论文将与模拟界共同署名发表。

We envisage these key papers will be co-authored with the modeling community.

面向 CMIP6 的 C4MIP 将更加强调基于观测的碳量估计对模式进行评估。

C4MIP for CMIP6 will have a strengthened focus on model evaluation against observation-based estimates of carbon quantities.

利用 DECK 中的排放驱动历史模拟：

Using the emission-driven historical simulation from DECK:

• 模式评估：针对关键陆地与海洋量值，采用协调的自上而下与自下而上的性能指标（如 Anav 等，2013；Hoffman 等，2014）；在排放驱动历史模拟中：分析模拟的大气 CO2（浓度与同位素组成），并与长期观测（如莫纳罗亚（Mauna Loa）观测站）进行对比评估。

• Model evaluation: coordinated top-down and bottom-up metrics of performance for key land and ocean quantities (as in Anav et al., 2013, Hoffman et al., 2014), in emission driven historical simulations: analysis of simulated atmospheric CO2 (concentration and isotopic composition) and evaluation against long-term observations (eg. Mauna Loa).

• 与欧洲项目 CRESCENDO 合作开展。

• Work in conjunction with European project, CRESCENDO.

• 利用基于碳循环年际变率的涌现约束来约束未来预估（如 Cox 等，Nature 2013；Wenzel 等，JGR 2014），使用历史模拟和 CMIP 1% 模拟。

• Use of emerging constraints based on carbon cycle interannual variability to constrain future projections (as in Cox et al., Nature 2013, Wenzel et al., JGR 2014) using the historical simulation and the CMIP1% simulations

• 量化并解释自 CMIP5 以来的变化（展示“可证明的进步”）

• Quantify and explain changes since CMIP5 (show “demonstrable progress”)

• 就关键碳循环变量与 WGCM/WGNE 指标专家组建立联系，并就观测数据集与 Obs4MIP 建立联系。

• Link with WGCM/WGNE metric panel for essential carbon cycle variables and with Obs4MIP for observation datasets.

利用 CMIP 1% DECK 试验以及 C4MIP 的 1% BGC、RAD 模拟：

Using the CMIP 1% DECK and the 1% BGC, RAD simulations from C4MIP:

• 量化 Friedlingstein 等（JClim. 2006）所定义碳—浓度与碳—气候反馈项的强度及其非线性（如 Gregory 等，JClim. 2009），评估其量级、不确定性以及自 CMIP5 以来的变化

• Quantification of the strength of carbon-concentration and carbon-climate feedbacks terms of Friedlingstein et al. (JClim. 2006) and their non-linearities (as in Gregory et al. JClim. 2009), assessment of magnitude, uncertainty, and changes since CMIP5

• 人为氮沉降对氮循环的外部强迫在影响碳循环反馈和敏感性方面的作用。

• Role of external forcing of the nitrogen cycle by anthropogenic N-deposition in influencing carbon cycle feedbacks and sensitiviteis.

• 评估累积碳排放的瞬态气候响应（TCRE）：其量级、不确定性、自 CMIP5 以来的变化，以及气候变化对 TCRE 的影响（利用 COU 和 BGC 模拟）。

• Assessment of the transient climate response to cumulative carbon emissions (TCRE), its magnitude, uncertainty and changes since CMIP5 as well as the impact of climate change on TCRE (using COU and BGC simulations).

• 量化自然 CH4 和 N2O 排放对气候和 CO2 变化的响应

• Quantification of response of natural CH4 and N2O emissions to climate and CO2 changes

利用 SSP5-8.5 模拟

Using the SSP5-8.5 simulations

• 在排放驱动情形下，这些模拟将能够量化气候变化（和土地利用变化）对全球碳循环和大气 CO2 的影响，进而量化对气候响应的影响（与 ScenarioMIP 的 SSP5-8.5 浓度驱动模拟相比较时）。

• In the emission driven case, these simulations will allow to quantify the effect of climate change (and land use change) on the global carbon cycle and atmospheric CO2 and hence on the climate response (when compared to the SSP5-8.5 concentration driven simulation from ScenarioMIP)

• 量化模拟大气 CO2 浓度的不确定性（排放驱动模拟）。

• Quantification the uncertainty in simulated atmospheric CO2 concentration (emissions-driven simulations).

• 基于 SSP 情景分析 TCRE，并将其与由理想化 CMIP 1% 模拟估算的 TCRE 进行比较。

• Analysis of TCRE based on SSP scenarios and its comparison with TCRE estimated from the idealized CMIP 1% simulations.

• 刻画为很可能保持在给定气候目标之下的容许累积排放（如 IPCC AR5 的做法）。

• Characterization of cumulative emissions allowed to likely stay below a given climate target (as in IPCC AR5).

• 分析未来情景下 CO2 增加、气候变化和人为土地利用变化（LUC）导致的陆地与海洋碳库变化（与 LUMIP 协调）。

• Analysis of changes in land and ocean carbon pools for future scenarios as a result CO2 increase, climate change and of anthropogenic LUC (in coordination with LUMIP).

• C4MIP 排放驱动（E-driven）SSP5-8.5 试验将作为 LUMIP 排放驱动模拟的对照，后者采用（取自 SSP1-2.6 的）替代土地利用情景。

• C4MIP E-driven SSP5-8.5 to form the control for LUMIP E-driven simulation with alternative land-use scenario (from SSP1-2.6).

• 针对延伸至 2300 年的模拟，评估永久冻土长期碳释放、植被枯死、海洋环流变化及其对海洋碳汇影响的风险。

• Assessment of risk of longer term carbon release from permafrost, vegetation dieback, change in oceanic circulation and impact on ocean carbon sink for the extension up to 2300.

• 对于 SSP5-8.5 的 BGC 模式：分析情景世界中（与理想化的 1% 世界相对）21 世纪的 CO2—碳循环反馈；评估 CO2 引起的增温（通过与完全耦合情景试验的比较）；评估将碳吸收与海洋热吸收联系起来的过程，以及反馈度量指标在长时间尺度上（尤其是海洋中）如何变化。

• For the SSP5-8.5, BGC mode: analysis of CO2-carbon cycle feedbacks over the 21st century in a scenario world (as opposed to the idealized 1% world); assessment of CO2 induced warming (by comparison with the fully coupled scenario run); assessment of processes relating carbon uptake to ocean heat uptake and how feedback metrics vary on long timescales (especially in the ocean).

CFMIP (Cloud Feedback MIP) ｜ 云反馈模式比较计划（上）

云反馈模式比较计划（CFMIP）

Cloud Feedback Model Intercomparison Project (CFMIP)

CMIP6 认可 MIP 的申请

Application for CMIP6-Endorsed MIPs

Mark Webb、Chris Bretherton、Sandrine Bony、Jen Kay、Steve Klein、Pier Siebesma、

Mark Webb, Chris Bretherton, Sandrine Bony, Jen Kay, Steve Klein, Pier Siebesma,

Bjorn Stevens、George Tselioudis、Masahiro Watanabe、

Bjorn Stevens, George Tselioudis, Masahiro Watanabe,

Peter Good、Timothy Andrews、Roger Marchand、Robin Chadwick 和 Hervé Douville

Peter Good, Timothy Andrews, Roger Marchand, Robin Chadwick and Hervé Douville

更新于 2015 年 3 月 31 日

Updated 31st March 2015

CFMIP 的主要目标是促进改进对气候变化云反馈的评估。

The primary goal of CFMIP is to inform improved assessments of climate change cloud feedbacks.

然而，CFMIP 的方法也越来越多地被用来理解气候响应的其他方面，例如区域尺度降水和非线性变化。

However, the CFMIP approach is increasingly also being used to understand other aspects of climate response, such as regional-scale precipitation and non-linear changes.

CFMIP 始于 2003 年，其第一阶段（CFMIP-1）在与 CMIP3 同期组织了一项比较计划，该计划基于永久七月 SST 强迫的 Cess 风格 +2K 试验和含 ISCCP 模拟器的 2xCO2 平衡混合层模式试验（McAvaney and Le Treut, 2003）。

CFMIP started in 2003 and its first phase (CFMIP-1) organised an intercomparison based on perpetual July SST forced Cess style +2K experiments and 2xCO2 equilibrium mixed-layer model experiments containing ISCCP simulator in parallel with CMIP3 (McAvaney and Le Treut, 2003).

CFMIP-1 的结果对模式中云的评价以及将低云反馈确定为云反馈模式间差异的首要原因产生了重大影响，并在 IPCC 第四次和第五次评估报告中占有突出地位。

Results from CFMIP-1 had a substantial impact on the evaluation of clouds in models and in the identification of low level cloud feedbacks as the primary cause of inter-model spread in cloud feedback, and featured prominently in the fourth and fifth IPCC assessments.

CFMIP-2 的后续目标是通过提供更好的工具来支持对气候模式所模拟云的评价并理解云—气候反馈过程，从而促进改进对气候变化云反馈的评估。

The subsequent objective of CFMIP-2 was to inform improved assessments of climate change cloud feedbacks by providing better tools to support evaluation of clouds simulated by climate models and to understand cloud-climate feedback processes.

CFMIP-2 作为 CMIP5 的一部分组织了进一步的试验，首次引入季节变化的 SST 扰动试验，以及用于考察云调整的固定 SST CO2 强迫试验和用于确定陆地与纬向非对称环流对云反馈不确定性之贡献的理想化“水行星”试验（Bony et al., 2011）。

CFMIP-2 organized further experiments as part of CMIP5, introducing seasonally varying SST perturbation experiments for the first time, as well as fixed SST CO2 forcing experiments to examine cloud adjustments, and idealized ‘aquaplanet’ experiments to establish the contributions of land and zonally asymmetric circulations to cloud feedback uncertainties (Bony et al., 2011).

CFMIP-2 还通过 CFMIP 观测模拟器包（COSP）将卫星模拟器引入 CMIP，不仅是 ISCCP 模拟器，还引入了更多模拟器，以便利用新一代天基主动雷达和激光雷达促进对云的定量评估。

CFMIP-2 also introduced satellite simulators to CMIP via the CFMIP Observation Simulator Package (COSP), not only the ISCCP simulator, but additional simulators to facilitate the quantitative evaluation clouds using a new generation of active RADARs and LIDARs in space.

此外，CFMIP-2 还向 CMIP5 引入了过程诊断量，例如温度和湿度收支倾向项以及全球 120 个地点的高频“cfSites”输出。

Additionally CFMIP-2 introduced into CMIP5 process diagnostics such as temperature and humidity budget tendency terms and high frequency ‘cfSites’ outputs at 120 locations around the globe.

CFMIP 还与 GEWEX 全球大气系统研究（GASS）组织了一个名为 CGILS（CFMIP-GASS 的 LES 与 SCM 比较计划）的联合项目，通过将 GCM 的单柱模式（SCM）版本与高分辨率大涡模拟（LES）模式进行比较，开发云反馈比较个例，以评估气候模式中云反馈的物理可信度。

CFMIP also organized a joint project with the GEWEX Global Atmospheric System Study (GASS) called CGILS (the CFMIP-GASS Intercomparison of LES and SCMs) to develop cloud feedback intercomparison cases to assess the physical credibility of cloud feedbacks in climate models by comparing Single Column Models (SCM) versions of GCMs with high resolution Large Eddy Simulations (LES) models.

此外，CFMIP-2 还开发了 CFMIP-OBS 数据门户和 CFMIP 诊断代码库（详见 http://www.cfmip.net）。

Additionally CFMIP-2 developed the CFMIP-OBS data portal and the CFMIP diagnostic codes repository (see http://www.cfmip.net for more details).

由 CFMIP-2 产生的早期研究包括大量使用 COSP 的模式评价研究、将云反馈和云调整归因于不同云类型的研究，以及以下发现：不含陆地或沃克环流的理想化“水行星”试验能够捕捉各模式全球云反馈和云调整之间的本质差异。

Early studies arising from CFMIP-2 include numerous model evaluation studies using COSP, studies attributing cloud feedbacks and cloud adjustments to different cloud types, and the finding that idealized ‘aquaplanet’ experiments without land or Walker circulations are able to capture the essential differences between models’ global cloud feedbacks and cloud adjustments.

CFMIP 的过程输出还被用于发展和检验为解释并约束 CMIP5 模式中云反馈模式间差异而提出的物理机制。

Process outputs from CFMIP have also been used to develop and test physical mechanisms proposed to explain and constrain inter-model spread in cloud feedbacks in the CMIP5 models.

CGILS 证明了 LES 模式对气候强迫响应的一致性，并识别出气候模式中云反馈物理表征方面的一系列不足。

CGILS has demonstrated a consensus in the responses of LES models to climate forcings and identified a number of shortcomings in the physical representations of cloud feedbacks in climate models.

此外，由于 CFMIP 试验具有理想化性质，它们已被证明在多项与云无直接关系、而是分析区域降水和环流型对 CO2 强迫及气候变化之响应的研究中十分有用。

Additionally the CFMIP experiments have, due to their idealized nature, proven useful in a number of studies not directly related to clouds, but instead analyzing the responses of regional precipitation and circulation patterns to CO2 forcing and climate change.

使用 CMIP5 中 CFMIP-2 输出的研究仍在进行中，预计将有更多结果纳入未来对气候模式中云和云反馈表征的评估。

Studies using CFMIP-2 outputs from CMIP5 remain ongoing and many further results are expected to feed into future assessments of the representation of clouds and cloud feedbacks in climate models.

有关 CFMIP-2 成果的出版物清单，请参阅 http://www.cfmip.net 上的 CFMIP 出版物页面。

For a list of publications arising from CFMIP-2, please refer to the CFMIP publications page at http://www.cfmip.net.

鉴于 CFMIP 以往的各项工作记录以及下文所述的理由，我们谨请求将 CFMIP 认可为 CMIP6 项目，以继续支持这一重要研究领域的社区活动。

Given the previous record of CFMIP activities and the case outlined below we would like to request that CFMIP be endorsed as a CMIP6 project to continue support for community activities in this important area of research.

我们按照下文所给的标准，提供有关我们 CFMIP-3 计划的信息。

We provide information on our plans for CFMIP-3 structured according to the provided criteria below.

MIP 名称：云反馈模式比较计划（CFMIP）

Name of MIP: The Cloud Feedback Model Intercomparison Project (CFMIP)

共同主席：Mark Webb mark.webb@metoffice.gov.uk、Chris Bretherton breth@washington.edu

Co-chairs: Mark Webb mark.webb@metoffice.gov.uk, Chris Bretherton breth@washington.edu

科学指导委员会成员：Mark Webb（Met Office）、Chris Bretherton（U. Washington）、Sandrine Bony（IPSL）、Jen Kay（CIRES）、Steve Klein（PCMDI）、Pier Siebesma（KNMI）、Bjorn Stevens（MPG）、George Tselioudis（NASA GISS）、Masahiro Watanabe（U. Tokyo）

Members of the Scientific Steering Committee: Mark Webb (Met Office), Chris Bretherton (U. Washington), Sandrine Bony (IPSL), Jen Kay (CIRES), Steve Klein (PCMDI), Pier Siebesma (KNMI), Bjorn Stevens (MPG), George Tselioudis (NASA GISS), Masahiro Watanabe (U. Tokyo)

网站链接：http://www.cfmip.net

Link to website: http://www.cfmip.net

MIP 的目标与简要概述：CFMIP 的主要目标是促进改进对气候变化云反馈的评估。

Goal of the MIP and a brief overview: The primary goal of CFMIP is to inform improved assessments of climate change cloud feedbacks.

然而，CFMIP 的方法正越来越多地被用来理解气候响应的其他方面，例如环流、区域尺度降水和非线性变化。

However, the CFMIP approach is increasingly being used to understand other aspects of climate response, such as circulation, regional-scale precipitation and nonlinear changes.

这需要使气候模拟、观测和过程模拟各群体更加紧密地结合，并提供更好的工具和社区支持，用于评价气候模式所模拟的云和云反馈以及理解其背后的机制。

This involves bringing climate modelling, observational and process modelling communities closer together and providing better tools and community support for evaluation of clouds and cloud feedbacks simulated by climate models and for understanding of the mechanisms underlying them.

这一点将通过以下方式实现：

This is to be achieved by:

持续开展有组织的协调模式比较活动，其中包括试验设计以及模式输出诊断量的规范，以支持利用观测（如 COSP）和现场测量（如 cfSites）对模式模拟的云进行定量评价，并对云的维持和反馈机制开展基于过程的考察（如 cfSites、收支倾向项等）

Ongoing organized coordinated model inter-comparison activities which include experimental design as well as specification of model output diagnostics to support quantitative evaluation of modelled clouds with observations (e.g. COSP) and in-situ measurements (e.g. cfSites) as well as process-based investigation of cloud maintenance and feedback mechanisms (e.g. cfSites, budget tendency terms, etc.)

持续开发和改进 COSP 与 CFMIP-OBS 基础设施。

Ongoing development and improvement of COSP and CFMIP-OBS infrastructure.

与云过程模拟群体持续合作（通过 GASS 合作），开展 CGILS 活动，并通过新的努力建立一套连接 GCM 与在大域上运行的云解析模式（CRM）和大涡模拟（LES）模式的试验层级体系（例如通过 IMPULSE 项目联合体）。

Ongoing collaboration with the cloud process modelling community (via GASS collaboration) on CGILS and via new efforts to develop a hierarchy of experiments linking GCMs with cloud resolving models (CRMs) and Large Eddy Simulation (LES) models run on large domains (e.g. via the IMPULSE project consortium).

组织年度会议，为与 CFMIP 相关的社区活动提供核心阵地，同时也面向致力于理解影响区域气候变化预估的云、环流和降水变化的更广泛群体。

Organising annual meetings to provide a focus for community activities relevant to CFMIP and also to the broader community working to understand changes in clouds, circulation and precipitation which impact regional projections of climate change.

（这两个群体正日益紧密相连，因为为 CFMIP 设计的试验也有助于解决与云无直接关系的更广泛问题。）

(These two communities are increasingly becoming connected because the experiments designed for CFMIP are also useful in addressing a broader range of questions not directly related to clouds.)
