我们在下文论述，CFMIP 及其提议的试验满足 CMIP 专家组提出的要求，具体如下。

We argue below the CFMIP and its proposed experiments meet the requirements laid out by the CMIP panel, as outlined below.

1. CFMIP 及其试验直接针对 CMIP6 的关键科学问题。

1. CFMIP and its experiments directly address the key science questions of CMIP6.

CFMIP 最直接针对的问题是“地球系统如何响应强迫？”

The question that CFMIP most directly addresses is `How does the Earth system respond to forcing?’

CFMIP 对理解云反馈的侧重使其与这一问题高度相关。

The CFMIP emphasis on understanding cloud feedbacks makes CFMIP highly relevant to this question.

下一个最相关的问题是“系统性模式偏差的起源和后果是什么？”

The next most relevant question is `What are the origins and consequences of systematic model biases?’

CFMIP 通过使用卫星模拟器、过程诊断以及与 LES 的比较，具有很强的模式评价能力，并且在考察云过程误差与云反馈之间联系方面有着公认的业绩记录。

CFMIP has a strong model evaluation component via the use of satellite simulators, process diagnosis and comparisons with LES, and a proven track record in investigating the link between errors in cloud processes and cloud feedbacks.

CFMIP 还与“在存在气候变率、气候可预报性和情景不确定性的情况下，我们如何评估未来的气候变化？”这一问题相关。

CFMIP is also relevant to the question `How can we assess future climate changes given climate variability, climate predictability, and uncertainties in scenarios?’

CFMIP 将继续以聚焦于基本理解与云反馈相关的主要不确定性的理想化试验，来补充完全耦合的 CMIP 试验。

CFMIP will continue to supplement fully coupled CMIP experiments with idealised experiments that focus on basic understanding of the dominant uncertainties associated with cloud feedbacks.

这将继续支持将可观测时间尺度（例如季节到年代际）上的变率与更长期的气候变化响应联系起来的工作（例如通过“涌现约束”）。

This will continue to support work which relates variability on observable timescales (e. g. seasonal to decadal) to longer term climate change responses (e.g. via 'emergent constraints').

例如，下文提议的 amipPiForcing 试验将支持把可观测时间尺度上的云变率和反馈与长期云反馈联系起来的研究（Andrews, 2014）。

For example the amipPiForcing experiment proposed below will support studies relating cloud variability and feedbacks on observable timescales to long term cloud feedbacks (Andrews, 2014).

另请注意，WCRP“云、环流与气候”大挑战计划由两名 CFMIP 委员会成员（Bony 和 Stevens）领导，其指导委员会中还有另外三名 CFMIP 委员会成员（Webb、Siebesma、Watanabe），其中包括一名 CFMIP 共同主席。

Note also that the WCRP Grand Challenge on Clouds, Circulation and Climate is led by two CFMIP committee members (Bony and Stevens), and has three additional CFMIP committee members on its steering committee (Webb, Siebesma, Watanabe), including one of the CFMIP co-chairs.

这使 CFMIP 处于直接应对 WCRP 大挑战计划所提出问题的极佳位置。

This puts CFMIP in an excellent position to directly address the questions arising from the WCRP Grand Challenge.

2. CFMIP 建立于共享的 CMIP DECK 和 CMIP6 历史试验之上并与之相连。

2. CFMIP builds on and connects to the shared CMIP DECK and CMIP6 historical experiments.

AMIP 试验是 CFMIP 的 amip4K、amip4xCO2 和 amipFuture 试验的控制模拟，这些试验由 CFMIP 为 CMIP5 提出，我们希望在 CMIP6 中作为层级 I（Tier I）试验延续下去。

The AMIP experiment is the control simulation for the CFMIP amip4K, amip4xCO2 and amipFuture experiments which were proposed by CFMIP for CMIP5 and which we would like to see continued in CMIP6 as Tier I experiments.

所提议的层级 II（Tier II）试验也与 AMIP DECK 试验相连；AMIP 前工业化强迫试验和 amip 减 4K 试验同样使用 DECK AMIP 试验作为控制。

The proposed Tier II experiments also connect to the AMIP DECK experiment; the AMIP preindustrial forcing experiment and amip minus 4K experiments also use the DECK AMIP experiment as a control.

±4% 太阳常数突变试验建立于 DECK abrupt4xCO2 试验之上并与之形成对照，abrupt4xCO2 和 abrupt0.5CO2 试验亦然。

The abrupt +/- 4% solar constant experiments build on and contrast with the DECK abrupt4xCO2 experiment, as do the abrupt4xCO2 and abrupt0.5CO2 experiments.

此外，仅大气的时片（timeslice）试验建立在 abrupt4xCO2 试验之上，将每个模式 abrupt4xCO2 运行的区域响应分解为对强迫和增温各方面因素的单独响应。

Additionally the atmosphere-only timeslice experiments build on the abrupt4xCO2 experiment, decomposing the regional response of each model's abrupt4xCO2 run into separate responses to each aspect of forcing and warming.

此外，CFMIP 将为 CMIP6 历史试验提议额外的过程诊断量和模拟器输出，这将支持与 AMIP 试验开展基于过程的比较，以评估耦合 SST 误差对 CMIP6 模式中云和区域降水型模拟的影响。

Additionally CFMIP will propose additional process diagnostics and simulator outputs for the CMIP6 historical experiment, which will allow process based comparisons with the AMIP experiments to assess the impact of coupled SST errors on the simulation of clouds and regional precipitation patterns in the CMIP6 models.

3. 在试验设计、数据格式和文档方面，CFMIP 将继续遵循 CMIP 建模基础设施的标准和惯例。

3. CFMIP will continue to follow the CMIP modeling infrastructure standards and conventions, in terms of experimental design, data format and documentation.

CFMIP-2 试验是作为 CMIP5 的一部分组织的，CFMIP 共同主席已证明有能力遵循试验规程、诊断输出请求规范、数据格式和文档方面的所有相关标准。

CFMIP-2 experiments were organized as part of CMIP5 and the CFMIP co-chairs have demonstrated the ability to follow all of the relevant standards in experimental protocols, in specification of diagnostic output requests, data formats and documentation.

我们承诺将以这一精神继续开展通过 CMIP6 协调的 CFMIP 试验。

We commit to continuing in this spirit for CFMIP experiments which are coordinated through CMIP6.

4. 所有试验均分层级、定义明确，在多模式背景下有用，且与其他 CMIP6 试验不重叠。

4. All experiments are tiered, well-defined, and useful in a multi-model context and don’t overlap with other CMIP6 experiments.

这些试验概述如下，详细规范见随附的电子表格。

These are outlined below, and detailed specifications are provided in the accompanying spreadsheet.

它们被分为层级 I 和层级 II。

They are tiered into Tiers I and II.

此外，我们就当前正在开发的其他试验给出指导，这些试验未来可能作为额外的层级 II 试验提出。

Additionally we give guidance on other experiments currently under development which we may propose as additional Tier II experiments in the future.

或者，这些额外试验也可以在 CMIP 之外协调开展。

Alternatively these additional experiments may be coordinated outside of CMIP.

我们相信这些试验在多模式背景下有用，因为它们的共同目的都聚焦于理解云调整和云反馈的模式间不确定性/差异，以及区域降水和环流变化与非线性变化中的模式间不确定性/差异。

These experiments are we believe useful in the multi-model context because the common purpose that they share is a focus on understanding the inter-model uncertainty/spread in cloud adjustments and cloud feedbacks as well as that in regional precipitation and circulation change and non-linear change.

对模式间差异的考察需要多模式分析，因此所有这些试验都有用（事实上也需要）多模式背景。

Investigation of inter-model requires multi-model analysis and hence all of these experiments are useful (and in fact require) a multi-model context.

层级 I 试验对许多气候研究者的用处，已经通过使用 CFMIP-2 试验产出的大量出版物得到证明。

The usefulness of the Tier I experiments to a number of climate researchers has already been demonstrated by the large number of publications produced using CFMIP-2 experiments.

我们已经检查了与其他 CMIP6 试验的重叠情况，并确信与其他 MIP（例如 nonLinMIP、GeoMIP、SolarMIP、RFMIP 和 PMIP）的联系基于互补且不重叠的试验。

We have checked for overlaps with other CMIP6 experiments and are confident that links with other MIPS (e.g. nonLinMIP, GeoMIP, SolarMIP, RFMIP and PMIP) are based on complementary but nonoverlapping experiments.

提议试验摘要

Summary of proposed experiments

层级 I 科学问题、活动和试验

Tier I Science questions, activities and experiments

1.1 CFMIP-2 试验的延续——牵头协调人：Mark Webb（Met Office）

1.1 Continuation of CFMIP-2 experiments - Lead coordinator: Mark Webb (Met Office)

科学问题：气候模式预测的云反馈和云调整之范围背后的物理机制是什么？哪些模式具有最可信的云反馈？

Science Question: What are the physical mechanisms underlying the range of cloud feedbacks and cloud adjustments predicted by climate models, and which models have the most credible cloud feedbacks?

CMIP5/CFMIP-2 试验和诊断输出已使这些问题的研究取得了相当大的进展，但 CMIP6 需要更大比例的模拟群体参与，才能对整个多模式集合的不确定性作出更全面的评估。

The CMIP5/CFMIP-2 experiments and diagnostic outputs have enabled considerable progress on these questions but participation by a larger fraction of modelling groups is required in CMIP6 for a more comprehensive assessment of the uncertainties across the full multi-model ensemble.

我们的提议实质上是将 CFMIP-2/CMIP5 试验保留为 CMIP6 的层级 I 试验。

Our proposal is essentially to retain the CFMIP-2/CMIP5 experiments in Tier I for CMIP6.

拟保留的试验为 amip4K、amip4xCO2、amipFuture、aquaControl、aqua4xCO2 和 aqua4K。

The experiments to be retained are amip4K, amip4xCO2, amipFuture, aquaControl, aqua4xCO2 and aqua4K.

这些试验建立在 amip DECK 试验之上。

These build on the amip DECK experiment.

由于 DECK 的输出要求尚未最终确定，DECK AMIP 试验可能不会包含 CFMIP 所需的全部输出诊断量。

As the output requirements for the DECK are not yet finalised, it is possible that the DECK AMIP experiment will not contain all of the output diagnostics required for CFMIP.

出于这一原因，我们还请求增设一个包含全套 CFMIP 诊断量的 CFMIP AMIP 试验，既用于模式评价，也用于结合其他层级 I CFMIP 试验解释反馈和调整。

For this reason we also request an additional CFMIP AMIP experiment including the full set of CFMIP diagnostics, both for model evaluation and for interpretation of feedbacks and adjustments in conjunction with other Tier I CFMIP experiments.

如果所有提议的 CFMIP 诊断量都包含在 DECK 试验中，则不再需要这一额外的 CFMIP AMIP 试验。

If all of the proposed CFMIP diagnostics are included in the DECK experiment, this additional CFMIP AMIP experiment will not be required.

层级 II 科学问题、活动和试验

Tier II Science questions, activities and experiments

2.1 ±4% 太阳强迫突变 AOGCM 试验——牵头协调人：Chris Bretherton（UW）、Roger Marchand（UW）、Bjorn Stevens（MPI）

2.1 Abrupt +/-4% Solar Forced AOGCM experiments - Lead coodinators: Chris Bretherton (UW), Roger Marchand (UW), Bjorn Stevens (MPI)

科学问题：气候系统因太阳强迫变化而产生的响应与因 CO2 变化而产生的响应有何不同？该响应是否对太阳强迫的符号敏感？

Science Question: How do responses in the climate system due to changes in solar forcing differ from changes due to CO2, and is the response sensitive to the sign of the solar forcing?

云和降水的快速调整现在被认为是模式对 CO2 强迫响应的重要组成部分。

Rapid adjustments in clouds and precipitation are now recognized as significant components of models’ responses to CO2 forcing.

虽然在 SST 强迫试验中它们很容易与常规反馈分开，但在耦合模式中进行这种分离却因各种问题而变得复杂，包括海洋在年代际时间尺度上的响应。

While they can easily be separated from conventional feedbacks in SST forced experiments, such a separation in coupled models is complicated by various issues, including the response of the ocean on decadal timescales.

已有大量研究考察了以下情形的云反馈——（此句跨页，续见第 26 页）

A number of studies have examined cloud feedbacks in

——（承第 25 页）受到太阳强迫的耦合模式中的云反馈，由于给定大气顶强迫下的大气吸收较小，通常与小得多的云和降水调整相联系。

coupled models subject to a solar forcing, which is generally associated with much smaller cloud and precipitation adjustment, due to a smaller atmospheric absorption for a given top of atmosphere forcing.

太阳强迫对平流层的影响也弱于 CO2，可能导致不同的对流层上层经向温度梯度和风暴轴响应。

Solar forcing also has a weaker impact on the stratosphere than CO2, potentially resulting in different upper tropospheric meridional temperature gradients and storm track responses.

+4% 太阳试验将等同于 abrupt4xCO2 试验，但会将太阳常数突增 4%，产生的辐射强迫与 CO2 翻两番所产生的辐射强迫量级相近。

A +4% solar experiment would be equivalent to the abrupt4xCO2 experiment but would increase the solar constant abruptly by 4 percent, resulting in a radiative forcing of a similar magnitude to that due to CO2 quadrupling.

这将对 DECK abrupt4xCO2 试验提供有用的补充，并将支持我们对耦合系统在有和没有 CO2 调整两种情况下的区域响应的理解。

This would provide a useful complement to the DECK abrupt4xCO2 experiment, and would support our understanding of regional responses of the coupled system with and without CO2 adjustments.

互补的 -4% 太阳强迫突变试验将可以考察气候变冷下的反馈不对称性，也有助于解释模式对地球工程情景和火山强迫的响应，并与过去气候相联系。

A complementary -4% abrupt solar forcing experiment would allow the examination of feedback asymmetry under climate cooling, and would also help with the interpretation of model responses to geo-engineering scenarios and volcanic forcing, and relate to past climates.

2.2 Abrupt2xCO2 和 abrupt0.5xCO2 试验（nonLinMIP）——牵头协调人：Peter Good（Met Office Hadley Centre）

2.2 Abrupt2xCO2 and abrupt0.5xCO2 Experiments (nonLinMIP) - Lead Coordinator Peter Good (Met Office Hadley Centre)

科学问题：每次 CO2 翻倍所带来的区域尺度气候变化在多大程度上依赖于状态（非线性）？其原因是什么？

Science Question: To what extent is regional-scale climate change per CO2 doubling state-dependent (nonlinear), and why?

与低强迫情景或古气候模拟相比，高强迫情景下的机制平衡有何不同？

How does the balance of mechanisms differ for high-forcing compared to lowforcing scenarios or paleoclimate simulations?

为解决这一问题，我们为层级 II 提出两项新试验：abrupt2xCO2 和 abrupt0.5xCO2，以探索全球和区域尺度的非线性响应，突出一切照旧情景、减缓情景和古气候模拟下的不同行为。

To address this question we propose two new experiments for Tier II, abrupt2xCO2 and abrupt0.5xCO2, to explore global and regional-scale nonlinear responses, highlighting different behavior under businessas-usual scenarios, mitigation scenarios and paleoclimate simulations.

未来可能为层级 II 提出更多试验，或通过 CFMIP 在 CMIP6 之外协调开展。

Additional experiments may be proposed for Tier II in the future, or coordinated via CFMIP outside of CMIP6.

这些包括 abrupt4xCO2 和 abrupt2xCO2 的 100 年延长试验；从 1pctCO2 试验结束时开始的 1% 阶梯下降；以及从 abrupt4xCO2 第 100 年起突降至 1xCO2。

These include 100-year extensions to abrupt4xCO2 and abrupt2xCO2; a 1% ramp-down from the end of the 1pctCO2 experiment; an abrupt step-down to 1xCO2 from year 100 of the abrupt4xCO2.

这些试验将用于探索更长时间尺度的响应、更精确地量化非线性机制，并理解气候变化的可逆性。

These would be used to explore longer-timescale responses, quantify nonlinear mechanisms more precisely and understand the reversibility of climate change.

2.3 amipMinus4K 试验：牵头协调人：Mark Webb（Met Office）

2.3 amipMinus4K Experiment: Lead Coordinator: Mark Webb (Met Office)

科学问题：当受到气候变冷而非变暖的影响时，云反馈是否对称？如果不是，原因何在？

Science Question: Are cloud feedbacks symmetric when subject to climate cooling rather than warming, and if not, why not?

amipMinus4K 试验将采取与 amip4K 试验类似的形式，只是海表温度将均匀降低 4K。

An amipMinus4K experiment would take a similar form to the amip4K experiment, except that the sea surface temperatures would be uniformly reduced by 4K.

这将用于在理想化试验中考察云对变冷气候的不对称响应，从而与 PMIP 建立联系。

This will be used to investigate asymmetric responses of clouds to a cooling climate in an idealized experiment, providing a link to PMIP.

该试验也是对 abrupt0.5xCO2 和 -4% 太阳试验的补充，因为人们可以在有海洋相互作用和无海洋相互作用的情况下识别增温/降温响应的不对称性。

This experiment also complements the abrupt0.5xCO2 and the -4% solar experiments in that one can identify asymmetries in the warming/cooling response with and without interactions with the ocean.

该试验是在与 PMIP 代表（Pacale Braconnot、Masa Kageyama 和 Masakazu Yoshimori）讨论后为 CFMIP 提出的。

This experiment has been proposed for CFMIP following discussions with PMIP representatives (Pacale Braconnot, Masa Kageyama, and Masakazu Yoshimori).

2.4 AMIP 试验中的反馈：牵头协调人：Tim Andrews（Met Office）

2.4 Feedbacks in AMIP experiments: Lead Coordinator: Tim Andrews (Met Office)

科学问题：20 世纪期间的气候反馈与作用于长期气候变化和气候敏感度的反馈是否不同？

Science question: Are climate feedbacks during the 20th century different to those acting on long term climate change and climate sensitivity?

试验与理由：先前的 CFMIP 设计无法诊断随时间变化的反馈，而这些反馈可能削弱简单的线性强迫—反馈范式，并可能与观测和模式估计的气候敏感度之间的差距有关。

Experiment and rationale: The previous CFMIP design was unable to diagnose time-dependent feedbacks that potentially undermine the simple linear forcing-feedback paradigm and which may be relevant to the gap between observed and modeled estimates of climate sensitivity.

为解决这一问题，我们提出一项名为“amipPiForcing”（amip 前工业化强迫）的额外试验，它与标准 amip 运行（即 SST 和海冰）完全相同，但在 1870 年至今的时段内使用——（此句跨页，续见第 27 页）

To address this we propose an additional experiment called ‘amipPiForcing’ (amip pre-industrial forcing), which is exactly the same as the standard amip run (i.e. SSTs and sea-ice) but run for the period 1870-present with

——（承第 26 页）恒定的前工业化强迫（即所有人为和自然强迫边界条件与 piControl 运行相同）。

constant pre-industrial forcings (i.e. all anthropogenic and natural forcing boundary conditions identical to the piControl run).

由于该试验中的强迫成分不发生变化，因此可以方便地对模拟的大气对观测 SST 变化的反馈进行简单诊断，随后可将其与代表长期变化和气候敏感度的反馈（例如来自 abrupt4xCO2 或 amip4K）进行比较。

Since the forcing constituents do not change in this experiment it readily allows a simple diagnosis of the simulated atmospheric feedbacks to observed SST changes, which can then be compared to feedbacks representative of long term change and climate sensitivity (e.g. from abrupt4xCO2 or amip4K).

这比另一种方法更具优势：即先估计强迫和调整（例如来自 RFMIP），再从 amip 试验中将其去除，因为本方法只需要单个试验（而不是成对试验），从而降低了噪声。

This has an advantage over the alternative approach of first estimating the forcing and adjustments (e.g. from RFMIP) and removing them from the amip experiment since the approach here only requires a single experiment (rather than pairs) which reduces the noise.

该试验还有一个额外的好处：通过与标准 amip 运行求差，可提供标准 AMIP 时段内模式相对于前工业化状态的瞬态有效辐射强迫和调整的详细信息。

The experiment has the additional benefit, by differencing with the standard amip run, of providing detailed information on the transient effective radiative forcing and adjustments in models relative to preindustrial for the standard AMIP period.

纳入 RFMIP 试验中所没有的 CFMIP 过程诊断量，还将使人们能够更深入地理解当前和未来气候中强迫与反馈差异背后的因素。

The inclusion of CFMIP process diagnostics not available in the RFMIP experiments will also enable a deeper understanding of the factors underlying forcing and feedback differences in the present and future climate.

2.5 用于理解区域气候对 CO2 强迫响应的时片试验。协调人：Rob Chadwick（Met Office）和 Hervé Douville（CNRM）

2.5 Timeslice experiments for understanding regional climate responses to CO2 forcing. Co-ordinators: Rob Chadwick (Met Office) and Hervé Douville (CNRM)

科学问题：

Science questions:

耦合模式中的区域气候响应（例如降水）如何由对不同方面 CO2 强迫和增温（均匀 SST 增温、SST 型增温、直接 CO2 效应、植物生理效应）的响应组合而产生？

How do regional climate responses (of e.g. precipitation) in a coupled model arise from the combination of responses to different aspects of CO2 forcing and warming (uniform SST warming, pattern SST warming, direct CO2 effect, plant physiological effect)?

强迫/增温的哪些方面对造成区域气候预估中的模式间不确定性最为重要？

Which aspects of forcing/warming are most important for causing inter-model uncertainty in regional climate projections?

区域预估中的模式间差异能否通过改进过程理解而归结为模式之间潜在的结构或分辨率差异？这是否有助于我们约束区域预估的范围？

Can inter-model differences in regional projections be related to underlying structural or resolution differences between models through improved process understanding, and could this help us to constrain the range of regional projections?

耦合模式的 SST 偏差对区域气候预估有何影响？

What impact do coupled model SST biases have on regional climate projections?

我们提议一组 6 个 20 年的仅大气时片试验，将每个模式 abrupt4xCO2 运行的区域响应分解为对强迫和增温各方面（均匀 SST 增温、SST 型变化、CO2 增加、植物生理效应）的单独响应。

We propose a set of 6 20-year atmosphere-only timeslice experiments to decompose the regional responses of each model's abrupt4xCO2 run into separate responses to each aspect of forcing and warming (uniform SST warming, pattern SST change, increased CO2, plant physiological effect).

除了使每个单独模式的区域响应得到更好理解之外，这组试验对于理解区域气候变化中模式不确定性的成因也应特别有用。

As well as allowing regional responses in each individual model to be better understood, this set of experiments should prove especially useful for understanding the causes of model uncertainty in regional climate change.

这些试验是：1) sstPi——与 amip 相同，但使用各模式自身控制运行第 101–120 年的逐月变化 SST 和海冰，而非观测场；

The experiments are: 1) sstPi – the same as amip but with monthly-varying SSTs and sea-ice from years 101-120 of each model’s own control run rather than observed fields;

2) sstPi4K——与 sstPi 相同，但 SST 均匀增加 4K；

2) sstPi4K – the same as sstPi but with SSTs uniformly increased by 4K;

3) sstPi4xCO2——与 sstPi 相同，但辐射方案所见的 CO2 翻两番；

3) sstPi4xCO2 – the same as sstPi but CO2 as seen by the radiation scheme is quadrupled;

4) sstPi4xCO2Veg——与 sstPi4xCO2 相同，但植物生理响应也能对增加的 CO2 作出响应；

4) sstPi4xCO2Veg – the same as sstPi4xCO2 but with the plant physiological response also able to respond to the increased CO2;

5) sstPiFuture——与 sstPi 相同，但取自每个模式自身 abrupt4xCO2 减 piControl 第 91–140 年的 SST 型距平的季节变化月平均气候态，被缩放为全球平均增加 4K 后施加；

5) sstPiFuture – the same as sstPi but a seasonally varying monthly mean climatology of the SST pattern anomaly taken from years 91-140 of each model's own abrupt4xCO2 minus piControl is scaled to have a global mean increase of 4K and applied;

6) sstPiTot——与 sstPiFuture 相同，但同时还施加含植物效应的 4xCO2。

6) sstPiTot – the same as sstPiFuture but also with 4xCO2 including the plant effect.

sstPiTot 用于确定时片试验能否在每个模式中充分重现耦合 abrupt4xCO2 响应，并随后构成使用其他试验进行分解的基础。

sstPiTot is used to establish whether a timeslice experiment can adequately recreate the coupled abrupt4xCO2 response in each model, and then forms the basis for a decomposition using the other experiments.

我们还提议一个额外的基于 amip 的试验 amipTot：与 sstPiTot 相同，但将来自 sstPiFuture 的 SST 型距平气候态改加到观测背景 SST 和海冰之上（与其他 amip 试验相同）。

We also propose an additional amip based experiment, amipTot: the same as sstPiTot but with the SST pattern anomaly climatology from sstPiFuture added instead to the observed background SSTs and seaice (as for other amip experiments).

amipTot 与 sstPiTot 的比较应有助于阐明 SST 偏差对每个模式区域气候响应的影响，以及这如何导致模式间不确定性。

Comparison of amipTot and sstPiTot should help to illuminate the impact of SST biases on regional climate responses in each model, and how this contributes to intermodel uncertainty.

2.6 用于理解云辐射效应在当前和扰动气候大尺度大气环流中作用的仅大气试验。协调人：Sandrine Bony（IPSL）和 Bjorn Stevens（MPI）。

2.6 Atmosphere-only experiments for understanding the role of cloud-radiative effects in the large-scale atmospheric circulation in current and perturbed climates. Co-ordinators: Sandrine Bony (IPSL) and Bjorn Stevens (MPI).

科学问题：

Science questions:

云辐射效应如何影响当今气候中大气总环流的结构、强度和变率？

How do cloud-radiative effects impact the structure, the strength and the variability of the general atmospheric circulation in the present-day climate?

云辐射反馈对气候变化中环流和降水响应差异的贡献有多大？

How much do cloud-radiative feedbacks contribute to the spread of circulation and precipitation responses in climate change?

我们能否识别出全球增暖气候响应中不依赖于云辐射反馈的稳健方面？

Can we identify robust aspects of the climate response to global warming that do not depend on cloud-radiative feedbacks?

人们日益认识到，云，特别是云辐射效应，在大气总环流（ITCZ、MJO、风暴轴、飓风）及其对全球增暖的响应中起着关键作用。

It is increasingly recognized that clouds, and cloud-radiative effects in particular, play a critical role in the general circulation of the atmosphere (ITCZ, MJO, storm tracks, hurricanes) and its response to global warming.

对这一作用更好的评估将极大地有助于解释模式偏差（云辐射性质的偏差对 ITCZ 结构的偏差、风暴轴位置和强度的偏差以及季节内变率的缺乏等有多大贡献）以及当前气候模拟和气候变化预估中的模式间差异（尤其是区域降水和极端事件的变化）。

A better assessment of this role would greatly help interpret model biases (how much do biases in cloud-radiative properties contribute to biases in the structure of the ITCZ, in the position and strength of the storm tracks, in the lack of intra-seasonal variability, etc) and to inter-model differences in simulations of the current climate and in climate change projections (especially changes in regional precipitation and extreme events).

更一般地说，更好地理解云如何与环流耦合，有望提高我们回答 WCRP“云、环流与气候敏感度”大挑战计划所提出的四个科学问题中两个问题的能力：是什么控制着风暴轴和热带雨带的位置、强度和变率？

More generally, a better understanding of how clouds couple to circulation is expected to improve our ability to answer two of the four science questions raised by the WCRP Grand Challenge on Clouds, Circulation and Climate Sensitivity: what controls the position, the strength, and the variability of the storm tracks and of the tropical rainbelts?

这些问题为 2012 年由欧洲联合体 EUCLIPSE 和 CFMIP 提出的“云开关 Klima 比较试验”（COOKIE）项目提供了科学动机。

These questions provided the scientific motivation for the Clouds On/Off Klima Intercomparison Experiment (COOKIE) project proposed by the european consortium EUCLIPSE and CFMIP in 2012.

COOKIE 试验已由 4 到 8 个气候模式运行（依试验而定），其内容是在以指定 SST 强迫的大气模式中关闭云辐射效应（辐射代码——且仅辐射代码——所见的云被人为地设为透明）。

The COOKIE experiments, which have been run by 4 to 8 climate models (depending on the experiment), consisted in switching off the cloud-radiative effects (clouds seen by the radiation code - and the radiation code only- were artificially made transparent) in an atmospheric model forced by prescribed SSTs.

通过这样做，大气环流可以感受到大气中缺少云辐射加热，但地表也可以感受到缺少云的遮蔽，从而导致海陆对比的变化。

By doing so, the atmospheric circulation could feel the lack of cloud-radiative heating within the atmosphere, but the land surface could also feel the lack of cloud shading, which led to changes in land-sea contrasts.

On 与 Off 试验之间的环流变化源于这两种效应，这在一定程度上模糊了在给定地表边界条件下大气云辐射效应与环流相互作用的机制。

The change in circulation between On and Off experiments was resulting from both effects, obscuring a bit the mechanisms through which the atmospheric cloud-radiative effects interact with the circulation for given surface boundary conditions.

由于长波（LW）云辐射效应主要在对流层内被感知（并占 LW+SW 云辐射加热的大部分），而短波（SW）效应主要在地表被感知，我们可以通过运行仅大气试验（其中云仅对 LW 辐射透明）来更好地分离对流层云辐射效应对环流的作用。

As the LW cloud-radiative effects are felt mostly within the troposphere (and represent most of the LW+SW cloud-radiative heating) while the SW effects are felt mostly at the surface, we could better isolate the role of tropospheric cloudradiative effects on the circulation by running atmosphere-only experiments in which clouds are made transparent to radiation only in the LW.

我们在层级 II 中提议一组简单试验，类似于 CMIP5/CFMIP2（以及 CMIP6 层级 1）的 amip、amip4K、aquaControl 和 aqua4K 试验，但其中云辐射效应在辐射代码的 LW 部分被关闭。

We propose in Tier II a set of simple experiments similar to the amip, amip4K, aquaControl and aqua4K experiments of CMIP5/CFMIP2 (and Tier 1 of CMIP6) but in which cloud-radiative effects are switched off in the LW part of the radiation code.

这些试验将被称为 offlwamip、offlwamip4K、offlwaquaControl 和 offlwaqua4K。

These experiments will be referred to as offlwamip, offlwamip4K, offlwaquaControl and offlwaqua4K.

对理想化（水行星）试验的分析将使我们能够评估在更真实（AMIP）配置中所发现影响的稳健性。

The analysis of idealized (aqua-planet) experiments will allow us to assess the robustness of the impacts found in more realistic (AMIP) configurations.

它还将有助于与大尺度动力学家（例如 DynVar）合作，使用简单的动力模式或理论来解释结果。

It will also facilitate the interpretation of the results using simple dynamical models or theories, in collaboration with large-scale dynamicists (e.g. DynVar).

对当今和全球更暖气候下 AMIP 与 offlwAMIP 试验模拟的模式间差异进行比较，将有助于识别差异的哪些方面取决于云辐射效应的表征，哪些方面不取决于此，从而更好地凸显其他差异来源。

The comparison of the inter-model spread of simulations between AMIP and offlwAMIP experiments for present-day and globally warmer climates will help identify which aspects of the spread depend on the representation of cloud-radiative effects, and which aspects do not, thus better highlighting other sources of spread.

未来正在考虑的其他 CFMIP 试验

Additional CFMIP experiments under consideration for the future

我们还提议将这些 CMIP6 试验作为在“云、环流与气候敏感度”大挑战计划背景下规划的进一步试验的基础。

We also propose to use these CMIP6 experiments as the foundation for further experiments planned in the context of the Grand Challenge on Clouds, Circulation and Climate Sensitivity.

例如，这些将包括评估不同物理过程对云反馈和区域环流/降水响应影响的敏感性试验，以及其他专门为检验所提出的云反馈机制而设计的试验。

These will include for example sensitivity experiments to assess the impacts of different physical processes on cloud feedbacks and regional circulation/precipitation responses, and others designed to test specifically proposed cloud feedback mechanisms.

进一步将水行星理想化的更多试验——（此句跨页，续见第 29 页）

Additional experiments further idealizing the aquaplanet

——（承第 28 页）框架进一步理想化为非旋转、旋转对称情形的更多试验也正在开发中。

framework to a non-rotating rotationally symmetric case are also under development.

这些将在未来作为额外的层级 II 试验提出，或由 CFMIP 在 CMIP6 之外协调。

These will be proposed as additional Tier II experiments at a future time, or coordinated by CFMIP outside of CMIP6.

5. 除非某项层级 1 试验与另一项已成熟的试验仅有细微差别，否则它必须已由不止一个模拟小组执行过。

5. Unless a Tier 1 experiment differs only slightly from another well-established experiment, it must already have been performed by more than one modeling group.

所有提议的层级 I 试验此前都已包含在 CMIP5 中，因此已经成熟并已由多个小组执行。

All of the proposed Tier I experiments were previously included in CMIP5 and so are well established and already performed by multiple groups.

6. 有足够数量的模拟中心（约 8 个）承诺执行 CFMIP 的全部层级 1 试验，并提供回答其至少一个科学问题所需的所有要求的诊断量。

6. A sufficient number of modelling centres (~8) are committed to performing all of CFMIP‘s Tier 1 experiments and providing all the requested diagnostics needed to answer at least one of its science questions.

迄今已有十四个模拟小组同意作为 CMIP6 的一部分参加 CFMIP，这意味着它们准备执行层级 I 试验。

Fourteen modeling groups have so far agreed to participate in CFMIP as part of CMIP6, implying that they are prepared to perform the Tier I experiments.

这些小组是 ACCESS（澳大利亚）、BCC（中国）、CanESM（加拿大）、CESM（美国）、CNRM（法国）、FGOALS（中国）、GFDL（美国）、IPSL-ESM（法国）、MIROC6-GCM（日本）、NICAM（日本）、MPI-ESM（德国）、MRI（日本）和 UKESM（英国）。

These are ACCESS (Australia), BCC (China), CanESM (Canada), CESM (USA), CNRM (France), FGOALS (China), GFDL (USA), IPSL-ESM (France), MIROC6-GCM (Japan) NICAM (Japan), MPI-ESM (Germany), MRI (Japan) and UKESM (United Kingdom).

7. 本 MIP 提出一份分析计划，说明它将如何使用所有提议的试验、任何相关观测以及特别要求的模式输出来评价模式并解决其科学问题。

7. The MIP presents an analysis plan describing how it will use all proposed experiments, any relevant observations, and specially requested model output to evaluate the models and address its science questions.

我们的分析计划概述如下。

Our analysis plan is outlined below.

我们承诺如为 CMIP5 所做的那样，为 CMIP6 数据需求的制定和数据分析作出贡献。

We commit to contributing to the creation of the CMIP6 data request and to analyzing the data, as we did for CMIP5.

这将包括就 CMIP6 中更新的 COSP 需求提出建议（见 COSP PMC 的提案），并进一步改进 CFMIP 诊断规范，涉及温度和湿度收支增量、3D 辐射通量、在 CFMIP 各试验中纳入气溶胶诊断量，以及在 cfSites 规范中增加更多地点。

This will include making proposals for an updated COSP request in CMIP6 (see the proposal from the COSP PMC), and also additional improvements to the CFMIP diagnostic specifications relating to temperature and humidity budget increments, 3D radiative fluxes, inclusion of aerosol diagnostics across CFMIP experiments, and the introduction of additional locations in the cfSites specification.

我们还承诺确定模式评价和改进过程理解所需的观测，并直接为将这些数据集作为 obs4MIPs 的一部分提供出来作出贡献。

We also commit to identifying observations needed for model evaluation and improved process understanding, and to contributing directly to making such datasets available as part of obs4MIPs.

例如，迄今为止 CFMIP 群体在通过 CFMIP-OBS 网站（见 http://climserv.ipsl.polytechnique.fr/cfmip-obs/）提供专为与 CMIP5 数据直接比较而设计的 CloudSat 和 CALIPSO 数据集版本方面发挥了核心作用，而这项工作的一部分最近涉及通过 ESG 发布这些数据并与 obs4MIPS 建立链接（例如参见 obs4MIPS 网站 https://www.earthsystemcog.org/projects/obs4mips/aboutus 上对 CFMIP-OBS 的引用）。

For example the CFMIP community has up to now played a central role in providing versions of CloudSat and CALIPSO datasets designed for direct comparison with CMIP5 data through the CFMIP-OBS website (see http://climserv.ipsl.polytechnique.fr/cfmip-obs/) and part of this work has recently involved publishing this data via the ESG and linking into obs4MIPS (see for example references to CFMIP-OBS on the obs4MIPS website at https://www.earthsystemcog.org/projects/obs4mips/aboutus).

这项工作将继续下去。

This work will continue.

CFMIP 的分析活动正在进行中，CFMIP 群体随时准备分析 CMIP6 数据。

CFMIP analysis activities are ongoing and the CFMIP community is ready to analyse CMIP6 data at any time.

我们希望模拟小组在完成 DECK 试验的同时或紧随其后执行所提议的 CFMIP/CMIP6 试验。

We would like modelling groups to perform the proposed CFMIP/CMIP6 experiments at the same time or shortly after their DECK experiments.

未包含在 CMIP6 中的后续 CFMIP 试验将建立在所提议的 DECK 和 CMIP6/CFMIP 试验之上，其中一些试验将在 CMIP6 DECK 试验开始产出数据后尽快启动。

Subsequent CFMIP experiments which are not included in CMIP6 will build on the proposed DECK and CMIP6/CFMIP experiments and some will start as soon as CMIP6 DECK experiments start to become available.

我们设想在 CMIP6 的整个周期内，开展一系列与 CFMIP 相关的比较计划，解决大挑战计划（GC）提出的不同问题。

We envisage a succession of CFMIP related intercomparisons addressing different questions arising from the GC spanning the duration of CMIP6.

我们承诺对所提议的试验进行科学分析、评价和利用，并已就这一活动的不同方面在 CFMIP 内部确定了牵头人。

We commit to scientifically analyze, evaluate and exploit the proposed experiments, and have identified leads within CFMIP for different aspects of this activity.

对所提议的 CMIP DECK 和 CMIP6 试验的评价/分析概述如下：

An overview of the proposed evaluation/analysis of the CMIP DECK and CMIP6 experiments follows:

CFMIP 将继续利用 CMIP DECK 和 CMIP6 试验来理解和评价气候模式中的云过程和云反馈。

CFMIP will continue to exploit the CMIP DECK and CMIP6 experiments to understand and evaluate cloud processes and cloud feedbacks in climate models.

上文在 CFMIP-2 背景下描述的广泛分析活动将在 CFMIP-3 中利用 CMIP DECK 和 CMIP6 试验继续进行，使 CFMIP-2 中发展的技术得以应用于越来越多的模式，包括目前正在开发的新一代模式——（此句跨页，续见第 30 页）

The wide range of analysis activities described above in the context of CFMIP-2 will be continued in CFMIP-3 using the CMIP DECK and CMIP6 experiments, allowing the techniques developed in CFMIP-2 to applied to an expanding number of models, including the new generation of models currently

——（承第 29 页）正在开发中的模式。

under development.

这些活动将包括使用更多模拟器评价云（见下文关于 COSP 的提案），以及使用过程输出（cfSites、收支倾向项等）考察云过程和云反馈/调整机制。

These activities will include evaluation of clouds using additional simulators (see proposal regarding COSP below), investigation of cloud processes and cloud feedback/adjustment mechanisms using process outputs (cfSites, budget tendency terms, etc).

在更多的 DECK 试验（例如 abupt4xCO2 和某些情景试验，另见下文关于 COSP 的提案）中纳入 COSP 和收支倾向项，将使 CFMIP 方法能够应用于更广泛的试验配置。

The inclusion of COSP and budget tendency terms in additional DECK experiments (e.g. abupt4xCO2 and some scenario experiments, also see proposal for COSP below) will enable the CFMIP approach to be applied to a wider range of experimental configurations.

（牵头协调人 Mark Webb）。

(Lead coordinator Mark Webb).

对 ±4% 太阳模式运行的分析将包括对全球和区域大气顶辐射通量、云类型（使用 ISCCP 和其他 COSP 模拟器）和降水特征的快速调整及更长时期响应的评价，以及将这些响应与 DECK abrupt4xCO2 试验中的响应进行比较。

Analysis of the +/-4% solar model runs would include an evaluation of both rapid adjustments and longer-term responses on global and regional top-of-atmosphere radiative fluxes, cloud types (using ISCCP and other COSP simulators) and precipitation characteristics, as well as comparison of these responses with responses in DECK abrupt4xCO2 experiments.

GeoMIP 和 SolarMIP 已对这些 CFMIP 试验表示出浓厚兴趣，预计将与 GeoMIP 和 SolarMIP 试验开展联合分析，其具体目标是确定仅太阳强迫突变试验和仅 CO2 突变试验的结果在多大程度上可用于预测两种强迫同时施加时会发生什么（如 GeoMIP 试验中所做的那样）

GeoMIP and SolarMIP have expressed a strong interest in these CFMIP experiments and joint analysis of these CFMIP experiments with GeoMIP and SolarMIP experiments is anticipated, specifically with the goal of determining to what degree results from abrupt solar forcing ONLY experiments and abrupt CO2 ONLY experiments can be used to predict what happens when both forcing are applied simultaneously, as done in the GeoMIP experiments

（牵头协调人 Chris Bretherton）。

(Lead coordinator Chris Bretherton).

对非线性气候过程的分析将主要涉及在相同时间尺度上比较 abrupt4xCO2、abrupt2xCO2 和 abrupt0.5xCO2 试验（Good et al., 2014）。

Analysis of nonlinear climate processes will primarily involve comparing the abrupt4xCO2, abrupt2xCO2 and abrupt0.5xCO2 experiments over the same timescale (Good et al., 2014).

（牵头协调人 Peter Good）。

(Lead coordinator Peter Good).

amipPiForcing 的分析已在 Andrews (2014) 中针对单个模式详细完成。

Analysis of amipPiForcing has already been done in detail for a single model in Andrews (2014).

我们提议以此作为多模式分析的起点。

We propose to use this has a starting point for a multi-model analysis.

（牵头协调人 Timothy Andrews）。

(Lead coordinator Timothy Andrews).

对时片和 amipTot 试验中区域响应和模式不确定性的概览分析，将由协调人与参与的模拟小组成员合作开展。

An overview analysis of regional responses and model uncertainty in the timeslice and amipTot experiments will be carried out by the co-ordinators, in collaboration with members of contributing modeling groups.

我们预计，对不同地区所起作用的过程的进一步详细分析，将由对特定地区有兴趣和专长的多个研究小组开展：例如，此前曾使用一组类似试验来考察 CCSM3 中西非季风的气候响应（Skinner et al. 2012）。

We anticipate that further detailed analysis on the processes at work in different regions will be carried out by a variety of research groups with interest and expertise in a particular region: for example a set of similar experiments has previously been used to examine the climate response of the West African monsoon in CCSM3 (Skinner et al. 2012).

时片和 amipTot 试验已经用 HadGEM2（Met Office）成功运行，目前正处于 CNRM 的规划阶段。

The timeslice and amipTot experiments have already been successfully run with HadGEM2 (Met Office), and are currently in the planning stage for CNRM.

（牵头协调人 Robin Chadwick）。

(Lead coordinator Robin Chadwick).

当与 amip4K 试验一起分析时，amipMinus4K 试验使人们能够利用 CFMIP 过程诊断量来理解 PMIP 试验中所注意到的气候对增温和降温响应中的不对称性。

When analyzed together with the amip4K experiment, the amipMinus4K experiment allows one to exploit the CFMIP process diagnostics to understand for asymmetries in the climate response to warming and cooling which have been noted in PMIP experiments.

这些不对称性可能来自中高纬度云的云相响应，或来自绝热云液态水路径响应反馈——后者在陆地区域很重要，并且由于 Clausius-Clapeyron 关系的非线性，预计在降温时会较弱。

These might arise from cloud phase responses in middle- and high-latitude clouds or from the adiabatic cloud liquid water path response feedback which is important over land regions and which would be expected to be weaker with cooling because of the non-linearity in the ClausiusClapeyron relation.

（牵头协调人 Mark Webb）。

(Lead coordinator Mark Webb).

8. 本 MIP 已完成 MIP 模板问卷。

8. The MIP has completed the MIP template questionnaire.

我们已完成此事。

We have done this.

9. 本 MIP 将就其试验设计向 CMIP6 特刊投稿一篇论文。

9. The MIP contributes a paper on its experimental design to the CMIP6 Special Issue.

我们同意这样做。

We agree to do this.

10. 本 MIP 考虑通过与模拟小组共同署名论文来报告结果。

10. The MIP considers reporting on the results by co-authoring a paper with the modelling groups.

我们同意这样做。

We agree to do this.

将为所提议的每组试验分别准备论文。

Separate papers will be prepared for each of the experiment groups proposed.

Any proposed contributions and recommendations for model diagnostics and performance metrics, observations/reanalysis data products, tools, code or scripts.

我们已在 CFMIP 诊断代码库（CFMIP Diagnostics Code Repository）提供性能指标与代码数据库，并在 CFMIP-OBS 站点提供一套用于与 CFMIP 输出对比的观测数据。

We have provided a database of performance metrics and codes at the CFMIP Diagnostics Code Repository and a set of observational data for comparison with CFMIP outputs at the CFMIP-OBS site.

两者均可通过 CFMIP 网站 http://www.cfmip.net 访问。

CFMIP 推荐的 CMIP6 DECK 试验与 CFMIP 试验输出。

CFMIP Recommended Outputs For CMIP6 DECK experiments and CFMIP experiments.

CFMIP 为 CMIP6 DECK 和 CFMIP 试验推荐一套诊断输出，其以 CFMIP-2 的输出为基础并做了若干修改。

CFMIP recommends a set of diagnostic outputs for the CMIP6 DECK and CFMIP experiments which are based on those from CFMIP-2, with some modifications.

详见随附电子表格 CMIP6DataRequestCompilationCFMIP_20150331.xls，下文给出摘要。

These are detailed in the accompanying spreadsheet CMIP6DataRequestCompilationCFMIP_20150331.xls, and are summarized below.

推荐内容分为两部分。

The recommendations are in two parts.

第一部分描述 CFMIP 过程诊断量相对 CMIP5 所请求内容的更新，涉及新增变量及其所请求的试验。

The first part describes updates to the CFMIP process diagnostics compared to those which were requested in CMIP5, in terms of additional variables and the experiments in which they are requested.

这套方案由 CFMIP 委员会起草，并在 2014 年 CFMIP 会议上报告后经各模式组批准。

This set was drawn up by the CFMIP committee and ratified by the modeling groups following a presentation at the 2014 CFMIP meeting.

第二部分描述由 COSP 项目管理委员会（PMC）起草的、针对 DECK 与 CMIP6 Historical 试验中 COSP 输出的推荐。

The second part describes recommendations for COSP outputs in the DECK and CMIP6 Historical experiments which were drawn up by the COSP Project Management Committee (PMC).

关于各 DECK 试验与 CFMIP 试验中分别请求哪些输出的摘要，请参见随附电子表格中的请求范围工作表（request scoping worksheet）。

Please refer to the request scoping worksheet in the accompanying spreadsheet for a summary of which outputs are requested in which DECK experiments CFMIP experiments.

参与 CFMIP 要求各模式组承诺执行全部 Tier I 试验，并提供足以回答至少一个科学问题的诊断输出。

For participation in CFMIP it is required that modeling groups commit to performing all of the Tier I experiments, and sufficient diagnostic outputs to answer at least one scientific question.

由于 CFMIP 的若干科学问题（如与降水响应相关的问题）除 CMIP5 标准 'Amon' 输出外不需要额外诊断量，模式组即使运行 Tier I 试验时不附带 CFMIP 模拟器或过程输出，也可具备参与 CFMIP 的资格。

Since a number of the science questions of CFMIP (e.g. those pertaining to precipitation responses) require no diagnostic outputs beyond the standard 'Amon' outputs from CMIP5, a modeling group may qualify for participation in CFMIP even if they run the Tier I experiments without CFMIP simulators or process outputs.

此类提交将主要在 CFMIP 的降水分析方面发挥作用。

Such a submission would be useful, in the main for the precipitation analysis aspects of CFMIP.

但我们强烈建议参与组在实际可行的范围内尽可能多地额外提交 COSP 与过程输出，以支持对 CMIP6 中 CFMIP 全部科学问题的研究。

However we strongly recommend that participating groups additionally submit as many of the COSP and process outputs as they are practically able to, to support investigations of the full range of scientific questions of CFMIP in CMIP6.

对 CMIP DECK、CMIP6 Historical 和 CMIP6 CFMIP 试验中 CFMIP 过程输出的拟议更新。

Proposed updates to CFMIP process outputs for the CMIP DECK, CMIP6 Historical and CMIP6 CFMIP experiments.

CFMIP 委员会
2015 年 3 月

CFMIP Committee
March, 2015

CMIP5/CFMIP2 的诊断请求在 CFMIP-2 提案文件 [Bony et al., 2009] 中做了总结与论证，并在 http://cmip-pcmdi.llnl.gov/cmip5/output_req.html 的 CMIP5 标准输出文档中以 Excel 电子表格形式做了详细记载（'CFMIP output' 工作表标明各表出现在哪些试验和哪些时段，cfMon、cfDay 等其他工作表标明各表中的变量）。

The diagnostic request for CMIP5/CFMIP2 is summarised and motivated in the CFMIP-2 proposal document [Bony et al., 2009], and documented in detail in the CMIP5 Standard Output documentation at http://cmip-pcmdi.llnl.gov/cmip5/output_req.html in excel spreadsheet format (Worksheet 'CFMIP output' indicates which tables appear in which experiments and for which periods, which other worksheets such as cfMon, cfDay etc indicate the variables in each table).

我们认为 CFMIP-2 诊断集基本合理，可作为 DECK、CMIP6 Historical 与 CMIP6 CFMIP 试验中过程诊断量的合适基础。

Our view is that the CFMIP-2 diagnostics set is fundamentally sound and forms a suitable basis for the process diagnostics in the DECK, CMIP6 Historical and CMIP6 CFMIP experiments.

因此，我们在随附电子表格中以相对 CMIP5/CFMIP-2 协议的变更形式提出本提案，其中包括一份请求范围工作表，标明哪些输出在哪些试验中被请求，涵盖 CMIP6 DECK + CMIP6 Historical 试验以及 CMIP6 内拟议的 CFMIP 试验。

Thus, we present this proposal as changes with respect to the CMIP5/CFMIP-2 protocol in the accompanying spreadsheet, which includes a request scoping worksheet indicating which outputs are requested in which experiments, including the CMIP6 DECK + CMIP6 Historical experiments and the CFMIP experiments proposed within CMIP6.

在以下各节中，我们逐项提出并论证所请求的具体变更。

In the sections below we present and motivate the specific requested changes.

本节引用了若干同行评审出版物。

In this section we cite a number of peer reviewed publications.

完整参考文献请见 http://www.cfmip.net → CFMIP Publications。

Please refer to http://www.cfmip.net -> CFMIP Publications for full references.

cfSites 输出：CMIP5 在 amip、amip4K、amipFuture 和 amip4xCO2 试验中请求了 120 个站点的 CFMIP cfSites 输出，并在 aquaplanet 试验中请求了沿格林尼治子午线的 73 个站点。

cfSites Outputs: The CFMIP cfSites outputs were requested in CMIP5 for 120 locations in the amip, amip4K, amipFuture and amip4xCO2 experiments, and for 73 locations along the Greenwich meridian in the aquaplanet experiments.

这些输出迄今已用于以实地测量评估模式（如 Nuijens et al.（已投稿）、Guichard et al.（准备中）、Neggers et al.（已投稿）），并用于考察短时间尺度（如日循环）上的云反馈（Webb et al. 2015）。

These outputs have so far been used to evaluate the models with in-situ measurements (e.g. Nuijens et al. (submitted), Guichard et al. (in prep), Neggers et al. (submitted) and to examine cloud feedbacks on short timescales such as over the diurnal cycle (Webb et al. 2015).

对 CMIP6，我们取消了 aquaplanet 试验和 amipFuture 中的 cfSites 输出，仅在 amip、amip4K 和 amip4xCO2 中保留。

For CMIP6 we have dispensed with the cfSites outputs in the aquaplanet experiments, and in amipFuture, retaining them in amip, amip4K and amip4xCO2 only.

应美国 CLIVAR ETOS 工作组的要求，鉴于这些岛屿即将开展的野外工作/新增探空观测，我们将阿森松岛和圣赫勒拿岛加入清单，使站点总数增加到 122 个。

At the request of the US CLIVAR ETOS WG we have added Ascension Island and St. Helena to the list in light of upcoming field work/additional radiosondes from these islands, increasing the total number of locations to 122.

温度和湿度倾向项：CFMIP-2 请求了云、温度和湿度倾向项。

Temperature and humidity tendency terms: CFMIP-2 requested cloud, temperature and humidity tendency terms.

在 CMIP6 中我们省略了云凝结物倾向项，因为 CMIP5 中保存的这些项没有产出任何出版物。

In CMIP6 we have omitted the cloud condensate tendency terms because no publications have arisen from those saved in CMIP5.

然而 CMIP5 的温度和湿度倾向项已被广泛使用。

The temperature and humidity tendency terms from CMIP5 have been widely used however.

温度和湿度倾向项已被证明有助于理解模式物理各组成部分在云反馈、调整和当今变率中的作用（Williams et al 2013、Webb and Lock 2013、Kamae and Watanabe 2012、Demoto et al 2013、Sherwood et al 2014、Ogura et al 2014、Brient et al.（已投稿）、Xavier et al.（已投稿））。

Temperature and humidity tendency terms have been demonstrably useful for understanding the roles of different parts of the model physics in cloud feedbacks, adjustments, and present-day variability (Williams et al 2013, Webb and Lock 2013, Kamae and Watanabe 2012, Demoto et al 2013, Sherwood et al 2014, Ogura et al 2014, Brient et al. (submitted), Xavier et al. (submitted)).

它们还被用于理解耦合模式中的区域增暖型态，如极地放大（如 Yoshimori et al 2013,2014）。

They have also been used to understand regional warming patterns such as polar amplification in coupled models (e.g. Yoshimori et al 2013,2014).

对 CMIP6，我们改进了温度和湿度倾向项的定义，并增加了晴空辐射加热率等附加项，以更精确地量化不同过程对云反馈和调整背后的温湿收支变化的贡献。

For CMIP6 we have improved the definitions of the temperature and humidity tendency terms, and added some additional terms such as clear-sky radiative heating rates to more precisely quantify the contributions of different processes to the temperature and humidity budget changes underlying cloud feedbacks and adjustments.

CMIP5 协议的一个不足是：由于缺乏过程诊断量，我们无法解释耦合模式试验中的物理反馈机制。

A shortcoming of the CMIP5 protocol was that we were unable to interpret the physical feedback mechanisms in coupled model experiments due to lack of process diagnostics.

为此，我们还请求在 DECK abrupt4xCO2 试验和工业革命前控制试验中输出这些收支项。

For this reason we are additionally requesting these budget terms in the DECK abrupt4xCO2 experiment and the preindustrial control.

新增每日诊断量：所谓"聚类"方法现在被普遍用于评估不同云型态（如层积云、信风积云、锋面云等）对当今云模拟偏差及云反馈模式间差异的贡献（如 Williams and Webb 2009、Tsushima et al., 2013、Tsushima et al.（已投稿））。

Additional daily diagnostics: So-called 'clustering' approaches are now commonly used for assessing the contributions of different cloud regimes (e.g. stratocumulus, trade cumulus, frontal clouds, etc) to present day biases in cloud simulations and to inter-model differences in cloud feedbacks (e.g. Williams and Webb 2009, Tsushima et al., 2013, Tsushima et al., submitted).

我们在 CFMIP 每日输出的标准包中增加了若干每日 2D 场，以便进一步研究与变化的水循环相关的云-气溶胶反馈（气溶胶含量和云顶有效半径/数浓度），并更清晰地诊断对流云与层状云的作用（对流与层状冰/凝结水路径，以及云顶有效半径/数浓度）。

We have added some additional daily 2D fields to the standard package of CFMIP daily outputs to allow further investigation of feedbacks between clouds and aerosols associated with the changing hydrological cycle (aerosol loadings and cloud top effective radii/number concentrations) and a clearer diagnosis of the roles of convective and stratiform clouds (convective vs stratiform ice and condensed water paths and cloud top effective radii/number concentrations).

对 CMIP/DECK、CMIP6 Historical 与 CMIP6 CFMIP 试验中 COSP 诊断量请求的提案

Proposal of request of COSP diagnostics for CMIP/DECK, CMIP6 Historical and CMIP6 CFMIP experiments

COSP 项目管理委员会
2015 年 3 月

COSP Project Management Committee
March, 2015

1 引言

1 Introduction

CMIP6 的初步设计已于近期发表 [Meehl et al., 2014]。

The initial design for CMIP6 has recently been published [Meehl et al., 2014].

其中包括一组 'DECK + CMIP6 Historical' 试验，供各模式组在开发新版本模式时运行：

It includes a set of 'DECK + CMIP6 Historical' experiments to be run by modelling groups whenever they develop a new model version:

AMIP（1979 年—至今）
工业革命前控制
CO2 每年增加 1% 直至 4xCO2
突变 4xCO2
CMIP6 Historical 运行

AMIP (1979-end)
Pre-industrial control
1% yr-1 CO2 increase up to 4xCO2
Abrupt 4xCO2
CMIP6 Historical run

这些试验被称为 CMIP 气候诊断、评估与表征（DECK）试验加 CMIP6 Historical 试验。

These experiments are called the CMIP Diagnostic, Evaluation and Characterization of Klima (DECK) plus CMIP6 Historical experiments.

本文档提出拟为 DECK + CMIP6 Historical 试验以及 CMIP6 CFMIP 试验请求的 COSP 诊断量清单提案。

In this document, we present the proposal of the list of COSP diagnostics to be requested to for the DECK + CMIP6 Historical experiments and additionally the CMIP6 CFMIP experiments.

本提案是 COSP 项目管理委员会（PMC）与 CFMIP 委员会讨论的成果。

This proposal is the outcome of discussions by the COSP Project Management Committee (PMC) and the CFMIP Committee.

CMIP5/CFMIP2 的 COSP 诊断请求在 CFMIP-2 提案文件 [Bony et al., 2009] 中做了总结与论证，并在 http://cmip-pcmdi.llnl.gov/cmip5/output_req.html 的 CMIP5 标准输出文档中以 Excel 电子表格形式做了详细记载（'CFMIP output' 工作表标明各表出现在哪些试验和哪些时段，cfMon、cfDay 等其他工作表标明各表中的变量）。

The COSP diagnostic request for CMIP5/CFMIP2 is summarised and motivated in the CFMIP-2 proposal document [Bony et al., 2009], and documented in detail in the CMIP5 Standard Output documentation at http://cmip-pcmdi.llnl.gov/cmip5/output_req.html in excel spreadsheet format (Worksheet 'CFMIP output' indicates which tables appear in which experiments and for which periods, which other worksheets such as cfMon, cfDay etc indicate the variables in each table).

我们认为 CFMIP-2 诊断集基本合理，经若干修改后可作为 DECK、CMIP6 Historical 与 CMIP6 CFMIP 试验 COSP 请求的合适基础。

Our view is that the CFMIP-2 diagnostics set fundamentally sound and forms a suitable basis for the COSP request for the DECK, CMIP6 Historical and CMIP6 CFMIP experiments, subject to some modifications.

因此，我们在随附电子表格中以相对 CMIP5/CFMIP-2 协议的变更形式提出本提案。

Thus, we present this proposal as changes with respect to the CMIP5/CFMIP-2 protocol in the accompanying spreadsheet.

请求范围工作表同样标明哪些输出在哪些试验中被请求。

The request scoping sheet also shows which outputs are requested in which experiments.

我们努力回应 CMIP5 调查中提出的关切：简化请求的技术难度（有时以增加数据量为代价），并将请求建立在已冻结、经过充分测试且已发布的 COSP 版本（v1.4）之上。

We have tried to address the concerns raised in the CMIP5 survey by simplifying the technical difficulty of the requests (sometimes at the expense of extra data) and basing the requests upon a frozen well-tested and already-released version of COSP (v1.4).

在以下各节中，我们逐项提出并论证所请求的具体变更。

In the sections below we present and motivate the specific requested changes.

2 拟议变更说明

2 Description of proposed changes

2.1 变更 #1：以完整 3D 场取代"幕帘"（curtain）数据，并删除 cfOff 表（由 Alejandro Bodas-Salcedo 提出）

2.1 Change #1: Replacement of curtain data by full 3D fields, and deletion of cfOff table (proposed by Alejandro Bodas-Salcedo)

在 CFMIP-2 中，沿 A-train 轨道生成数据（"幕帘"数据，表 cf3hr offline）需要大量后处理。

In CFMIP-2, the production of data along the A-train track ("curtain" data, table cf3hr offline) involved a substantial amount of post-processing.

第二步后处理需要对这些数据进行网格化和时间平均，以生成 cfOff 表中所请求的月平均值。

A second post-processing step required the gridding and time-averaging of these data to produce the monthly means requested in the cfOff table.

这对许多模式中心而言相当困难。

This proved quite difficult for many modelling centres.

尽管不来自 ESG 存档，此类数据已被多篇模式评估论文使用 [Bony et al., 2009; Bodas-Salcedo et al., 2008; Field et al., 2011; Williams et al., 2013]，这些论文将模式与 CloudSat 和 Calipso 的沿轨观测做了个例对比。

Although not from the ESG archive, this type of data has been used in several model evaluation papers [Bony et al., 2009; Bodas-Salcedo et al., 2008; Field et al., 2011; Williams et al., 2013] involving case-study comparison of models with along-track observations from CloudSat and Calipso.

我们相信，通过简化请求，各模式中心将更容易提供这些数据。

We believe that by simplifying the request, the modelling centres will find easier to contribute these data.

因此，我们提议放弃沿轨采样，即改为在标准经纬网格上请求全球完整场。

Hence, we propose to drop the orbital sampling, i.e. to request globally-complete fields on a standard lat/lon grid.

鉴于这一变更，由网格化的 3 小时数据计算月平均值变得简单，因此我们提议删除 cfOff 表。

Given this change, the calculation of monthly-averages from gridded 3-hourly data is trivial, and therefore we propose to delete the cfOff table.

2.2 变更 #2：新增 cfMonExtra 表。将 CloudSat 和 CALIPSO 的 CFAD 加入 cfMonExtra（由 Alejandro Bodas-Salcedo 和 Mark Webb 提出）

2.2 Change #2: New table cfMonExtra. Add CloudSat and CALIPSO CFADs to cfMonExtra (proposed by Alejandro Bodas-Salcedo and Mark Webb)

对 COSP v1.4 代码的优化意味着现在在模式内联（inline）运行 CloudSat 模拟器、进而运行更长时间已切实可行。

Optimisations to the code in COSP v1.4 mean that it is now practical to run the CloudSat simulator inline in models and so for longer periods.

我们提议引入新表 cfMonExtra，以纳入 AMIP DECK 试验中用于模式评估的月平均 COSP 诊断量；这些诊断量我们认为不适合耦合或气候变化试验。

We propose the introduction of a new table cfMonExtra for the inclusion of monthly mean COSP diagnostics used for model evaluation in the AMIP DECK experiment, but which we don't consider appropriate for coupled or climate change experiments.

在该新表中，我们纳入整个 AMIP 积分时段的 CloudSat 和 CALIPSO 云频率-高度图（CFAD）诊断量。

In this new table we include Cloud Frequency/Altitude Diagram (CFAD) diagnostics for CloudSat and CALIPSO for the entire AMIP integration.

CloudSat 和 CALIPSO 的 CFAD 已出现在多篇已发表研究中 [如 Nam et al., 2014; Franklin et al., 2013; Bodas-Salcedo et al., 2011; Bodas-Salcedo et al., 2012; Nam and Quaas, 2012; Nam and Quaas, 2013; Kay et al., 2012; Kodama et al., 2012; Marchand et al., 2009; Abel and Boutle, 2012]，将其作为月平均值纳入 AMIP DECK 试验后，分析人员获取它们的形式将比 CMIP5 当前请求的高频输出更为方便。

CFADs for CloudSat and CALIPSO have appeared in a number of published studies [e.g. Nam et al., 2014; Franklin et al., 2013; Bodas-Salcedo et al., 2011; Bodas-Salcedo et al., 2012; Nam and Quaas, 2012; Nam and Quaas, 2013; Kay et al., 2012; Kodama et al., 2012; Marchand et al., 2009; Abel and Boutle, 2012] and their inclusion as monthly means in the AMIP DECK experiment will make them available for analysts in a more convenient form than the higher frequency outputs currently requested in CMIP5.

2.3 变更 #3：在所有 DECK、CMIP6 Historical 与 CMIP6 CFMIP 试验中加入标准月平均 COSP 和每日 COSP 2D 输出（由 Mark Webb 和 Steve Klein 提出）

2.3 Change #3: Standard monthly COSP and daily COSP 2D outputs in all of the DECK, CMIP6 Historical and CMIP6 CFMIP Experiments (proposed by Mark Webb and Steve Klein)

许多标准月平均 COSP 和每日 COSP 2D 输出已被证明在 CMIP5 试验中很有价值，不仅用于云评估 [如 Franklin et al., 2013; Bodas-Salcedo et al., 2012; Nam and Quaas, 2013; Lacagnina and Selten, 2014; Bodas-Salcedo et al., 2014; Klein et al., 2013; Cesana and Chepfer, 2012; Tsushima et al., 2013]，还用于量化气候变化试验中不同云类型对云反馈和强迫调整的贡献 [如 Tsushima et al., 2013; Zelinka et al., 2012a; Zelinka et al., 2012a; Zelinka et al., 2013; Zelinka et al., 2014]。

Many of the standard monthly COSP and daily COSP 2D have been shown to be valuable in the CMIP5 experiments, not only for cloud evaluation [e.g. Franklin et al., 2013; Bodas-Salcedo et al., 2012; Nam and Quaas, 2013; Lacagnina and Selten, 2014; Bodas-Salcedo et al., 2014; Klein et al., 2013; Cesana and Chepfer, 2012; Tsushima et al., 2013] but also in quantifying the contributions of different cloud types to cloud feedbacks and forcing adjustments in climate change experiments [e.g. Tsushima et al., 2013; Zelinka et al., 2012a; Zelinka et al., 2012a; Zelinka et al., 2013; Zelinka et al., 2014].

我们提议将这些输出作为标准内容纳入所有 DECK、CMIP6 Historical 与 CMIP6 CFMIP 试验的整个运行时长，以支持云、云反馈和云调整的评估，并研究观测记录中的趋势。

We propose to include these in all of the DECK, CMIP6 Historical and CMIP6 CFMIP experiments as standard for the entire length of the runs, to support evaluation of cloud, cloud feedbacks and cloud adjustments and to investigate trends in the observational record.

2.4 变更 #4：将 PARASOL 反射率移至 cfMonExtra（由 Robert Pincus 提出）

2.4 Change #4: Move PARASOL reflectance to cfMonExtra (proposed by Robert Pincus)

PARASOL 的大气顶反射率测量曾是 CMIP5 标准请求的一部分。

Top-of-atmosphere reflectance measurements from PARASOL were part of the standard request for CMIP5.

它们已在一些应用中使用 [如 Nam et al. 2012]，但尚未得到广泛利用。

They have been used in some applications [e.g. Nam et al. 2012] but have not been widely exploited.

本提案旨在将它们从 cfMon 表移至 cfMonExtra 表，以减少请求它们的积分数量，并聚焦于模式评估应用。

The proposal is to move them from the cfMon to cfMonExtra tables to reduce the number of integrations for which they are requested and to focus on model evaluation applications.

2.5 变更 #5：将 MISR CTH-COD 加入 cfMonExtra。将 MISR CTH-COD 和 ISCCP CTP-OD 直方图加入 cf3hr（由 Roger Marchand 提出）

2.5 Change #5: Add MISR CTH-COD to cfMonExtra. Add MISR CTH-COD and ISCCP CTP-OD histograms to cf3hr (proposed by Roger Marchand)

ISCCP 生成的云顶高度（或云顶气压）与光学厚度直方图已广泛用于气候模式评估，常与现属 COSP 一部分的 ISCCP 模拟器结合使用。

Histograms of cloud-top-height (or cloud-top-pressure) and optical-depth produced by ISCCP have been widely used in the evaluation of climate models, often in combination with the ISCCP-simulator now part of COSP.

由于大气顶出射长波通量与云顶高度相关、出射短波通量与云光学厚度相关，这一框架提供了一种以与云辐射效应密切关联的方式评估模式云分布的方法。

Because top-of-atmosphere outgoing longwave fluxes are related to cloud-top-height and outgoing shortwave fluxes are related to cloud-optical-depth this framework provides a way to evaluate the distribution of model clouds in a way that is closely related to their radiative impact.

多角度成像光谱辐射计（MISR）的观测也在生成类似的云顶高度和光学厚度直方图。

Similar histograms of cloud-top-height and optical-depth are being produced from observations by the Multiangle Imaging Spectro-Radiometer (MISR).

虽然类似，但 MISR 数据集中的云顶高度是借助一种立体成像技术获得的，该技术纯属几何方法，且对 MISR 相机的定标不敏感。

While similar, the cloud-top-height in the MISR dataset is obtained using a stereoimaging technique that his purely geometric and insensitivity to the calibration of the MISR cameras.

该技术对低层和中层云的云顶高度反演更准确，对中层云与其他云的区分更可靠，而 ISCCP 对光学薄的高层云更敏感。

This technique provides more accurate retrievals of cloud-top-height for low-level and mid-level clouds, and more reliable discrimination of mid-level clouds from other clouds, while ISCCP provides greater sensitivity to optically-thin high-level clouds.

此外，ISCCP 与 MISR 直方图可以结合使用，将光学薄的高层云区分为多层云和单层云两类 [Marchand et al. 2010]。

In addition, ISCCP and MISR histograms can be combined to separate optically-thin high-level clouds into multi-layer and single-layer categories [Marchand et al. 2010].

因此，我们建议在气候模式评估中同时使用 ISCCP 与 MISR 观测及其仪器模拟器；目前正利用若干运行了 MISR 模拟器的 CFMIP5 模式开展此类分析 [Hillman et al. 2014]。

We therefore recommend using both ISCCP and MISR observations and instrument simulators in the evaluation of climate model, and such an analysis is underway using a few CFMIP5 models that have run the MISR simulator [Hillman et al. 2014].

虽然月数据适用于按月或更长时间尺度的广泛模式评估，但获取高频（3 小时一次）数据将能够分析月数据无法很好分辨的事件，包括日循环、马登-朱利安振荡（MJO）以及各种天气尺度状态或天气型，如锋面过境。

While monthly data are useful for the broad evaluation of models on monthly or longer time scales, the acquisition of high frequency (Three hourly) data will enable analysis of events that are not well resolved with monthly data, including the diurnal cycle, the Madden-Julian Oscillation (MJO) and various synoptic states or weather patterns, such as frontal passages.

我们认识到，与月平均值相比这意味着数据量的大幅增加，因此提议仅收集约 1 年时段的这种 3 小时数据。

We recognize that this represents a large increase in data-volume compared with monthly averages and propose collection of this three hourly data only for a period of about 1 year.

2.6 变更 #6：将 MODIS 云量（总、液态、冰相）加入 cfMonExtra（由 Robert Pincus 提出）

2.6 Change #6: Add MODIS cloud fractions (total, liquid, ice) to cfMonExtra (proposed by Robert Pincus)

液态相与冰相之间的分配对云的能量效应和水文效应具有显著影响。

The partitioning between liquid and ice phase has significant impacts on the energy and hydrologic impacts of clouds.

随着模式走向更精细地预测气溶胶分布（包括冰核化能力），在全球尺度上评估相态分配将变得更加重要。

As models move towards predicting more details of the aerosol distributions, including the ice nucleation ability, evaluation of the phase partitioning on the global scale will become more important.

迄今的评估主要基于主动和被动传感器的偏振测量 [如 Doutriaux-Boucher and Quaas, 2004; Komurcu et al., 2014]；下文还将请求来自 CALIPSO 传感器的、按高度分辨的相态分配估计。

Evaluation to date has been based primarily on polarization measurements from active and passive sensors [e.g. Doutriaux-Boucher and Quaas, 2004; Komurcu et al., 2014] and height-resolved partitioning estimates from the CALIPSO sensor are requested below.

CFMIP2 中没有 MODIS 模拟器的云相态估计，但凭借更大的地理采样覆盖和更长的时间记录，它可能成为有用的补充。

Cloud phase estimates from the MODIS simulator were not available in CFMIP2 but may prove a useful complement by virtue of greater geographic sampling and longer time records.

2.7 变更 #7：在 cfMonExtra、cfDayExtra、cf3hr 中加入按相态区分的 MODIS COT-粒子尺度直方图（由 Robert Pincus 提出）

2.7 Change #7: MODIS COT-particle size histograms by phase in cfMonExtra, cfDayExtra, cf3hr (proposed by Robert Pincus)

光学厚度与粒子尺度的联合分布为了解云内微物理过程提供了一个窗口 [Nakajima et al., 1991]，并受到气溶胶对云光学特性直接效应和部分间接效应的影响 [Han et al. 2002]。

The joint distribution of optical thickness and particle size provides a window on the microphysical processes within clouds [Nakajima et al., 1991] and is influenced by direct and some indirect effects of aerosols on cloud optical properties [Han et al. 2002].

随着模式走向更精细地预测气溶胶特性及云-气溶胶相互作用，对这些过程的评估变得更为紧迫。

As models move towards predicting more details of the aerosol properties and cloud-aerosol interactions the assessment of these processes becomes more pressing.

迄今，MODIS 反演的粒子尺度一直难以用于模式评估，原因在于 MODIS 模拟器未处理的观测伪影。

Estimate of particle size from MODIS have been difficult to use for model evaluation to date because of observational artefacts not treated by the MODIS simulator.

使用凝结水吸收更强的波段观测（如利用 3.7 µm 而非 2.1 µm 处的反射率）可以减少这些伪影。

These artefacts are reduced by the use of observations at wavelengths with greater absorption by condensed water (e.g. by exploiting reflectance at 3.7 µm instead of 2.1 µm).

CFMIP3 的 MODIS 模拟器及配套数据将使用 3.7 µm 处的测量来反演粒子尺度。

The MODIS simulator and accompanying data for CFMIP3 will use measurements at 3.7 µm to infer particle size.

这还将使 MODIS 模拟器的输出与 PATMOS-X 观测大体一致，正如 MODIS、MISR 和 ISCCP 模拟器的光学厚度分布彼此近乎等价一样。

This will also act to make output from the MODIS simulator roughly consistent with the PATMOS-X observations in the same way that distributions of optical thickness from the MODIS, MISR, and ISCCP simulators are nearly equivalent.

2.8 变更 #8：将 CALIPSO 冰相和液态 3D 云量加入 cfMonExtra（由 Hélène Chepfer 提出）

2.8 Change #8: add CALIPSO ice and liquid 3D cloud fractions to cfMonExtra (proposed by Hélène Chepfer)

与云相态反馈相关的云光学厚度变化可能主导未来气候预估中高纬度云的变化 [如 Senior and Mitchell, 1993]。

Changes in cloud optical depth associated with cloud phase feedbacks can dominate the changes in high-latitude clouds in future climate projections [e.g. Senior and Mitchell, 1993].

COSP 中的 CALIPSO 模拟器近期新增了云相态识别能力，并已生成一套与之匹配的观测数据集 [Cesana and Chepfer, 2013]。

Cloud phase identification capabilities have been recently added to the CALIPSO simulator in COSP, and a compatible observational dataset has been produced [Cesana and Chepfer, 2013].

我们提议将这些诊断量纳入 AMIP DECK 试验，以支持对云相态模拟的评估。

We propose to include these in the AMIP DECK experiment to support the evaluation of the simulation of cloud phase.

2.9 变更 #9：将 CALIPSO 总云量和 PARASOL 反射率加入 cfDayExtra（由 Hélène Chepfer 和 Dimitra Konsta 提出）

2.9 Change #9: CALIPSO total cloud fraction and PARASOL reflectance to cfDayExtra (proposed by Hélène Chepfer and Dimitra Konsta)

多传感器 A-train 观测（CALIPSO-GOCCP 与 MODIS、PARASOL）能够在瞬时时间尺度上、以高分辨率建立不同云变量之间的相关关系。

The multi-sensor A-train observations (CALIPSO-GOCCP and MODIS, PARASOL) allow to make the correlations between the different cloud variables at the instantaneous time scale, and at high resolution.

利用不同变量之间的高频关系可以进行面向过程的模式评估。

The use of the high-frequency relationships between different variables allows for process-oriented model evaluation.

这些诊断量将有助于检验模式中控制云反馈的关键云特性协同变化的真实性。

These diagnostics will help test the realism of the co-variation of key cloud properties that control cloud feedbacks in models.

Konsta 等人（2014）已在一项试点分析中使用了这些诊断量。

Konsta at al. (2014) have used these diagnostics in a pilot analysis.

3 使用卫星模拟器评估模式中云的相关参考文献（部分）
