nonlinMIP ｜ 非线性响应比较计划（CFMIP 附文）

nonlinMIP 对比项目：物理基础、实验设计与分析原则

The nonlinMIP intercomparison project: physical basis, experimental design and analysis principles

P. Good、T. Andrews、N. Bouttes、R. Chadwick、J. M. Gregory、J. A. Lowe

P. Good1, T. Andrews1, N. Bouttes2, R. Chadwick1, J. M. Gregory2,1, J. A. Lowe1

[1] 英国埃克塞特，英国气象局哈德利中心

[1]{ Met Office Hadley Centre, Exeter, United Kingdom}

[2] NCAS-Climate，英国雷丁，雷丁大学

[2]{ NCAS-Climate, University of Reading, Reading, United Kingdom}

通信作者：P. Good（peter.good@metoffice.gov.uk）

Correspondence to: P. Good (peter.good@metoffice.gov.uk)

摘要

Abstract

nonlinMIP 旨在量化并理解 CO2 强迫下区域尺度的非线性气候响应（即 CO2 强迫加倍并不会使响应加倍的机制）。

nonlinMIP aims to quantify and understand, at regional scales, climate responses that are non-linear under CO2 forcing (mechanisms for which doubling the CO2 forcing does not double the response).

非线性响应在区域尺度上可能很大，这对理解相关机制以及 GCM 模拟技术（例如能量平衡模型和型态标度方法）具有重要意义。

Non-linear responses can be large at regional scales, with important implications for understanding mechanisms and for GCM emulation techniques (e.g. energy balance models and pattern-scaling methods).

然而，这些过程很难用传统实验进行探究，这也解释了它们为何在以往研究中很少受到关注。

However, these processes are hard to explore using traditional experiments, explaining why they have had little attention in previous studies.

一些单模式研究已经确立了新的分析原则和一些物理机制。

Some single model studies have established novel analysis principles and some physical mechanisms.

现在需要在一系列模式中探究这些机制的稳健性与不确定性。

There is now a need to explore robustness and uncertainty in such mechanisms across a range of models.

nonlinMIP 通过一组简单而规模较小的 CO2 强迫实验来应对这一问题；这些实验能够清晰分离线性与非线性机制，并具有良好的信噪比，同时可以明确追溯到现实的瞬变情景。

nonlinMIP addresses this using a simple, small set of CO2-forced experiments that are able to separate linear and non-linear mechanisms cleanly, with good signal/noise – while being demonstrably traceable to realistic transient scenarios.

该设计建立在 CMIP5 和 CMIP6 DECK 方案之上，核心是一组 abruptCO2 实验，并配有一个先升高后降低的实验，用于检验其对渐变强迫情景的可追溯性。

The design builds on the CMIP5 and CMIP6 DECK protocols, and is centred around a suite of abruptCO2 experiments, with a ramp-upramp-down experiment to test traceability to gradual forcing scenarios.

本文先概述 nonlinMIP 背后的基本物理原理，以及如何建立从 abruptCO2 到渐变强迫实验的可追溯性，随后详细说明实验设计，最后介绍一些分析原则。

Here we outline the basic physical principles behind nonlinMIP, and the method of establishing traceability from abruptCO2 to gradual forcing experiments, before detailing the experimental design and finally some analysis principles.

关于将 abruptCO2 追溯到瞬变实验的讨论，也适用于 CMIP5 和 CMIP6 DECK 方案中的 abrupt4xCO2 实验。

The discussion on traceability of abruptCO2 to transient experiments is also relevant to the abrupt4xCO2 experiment in the CMIP5 and CMIP6 DECK protocols.

5　引言

5 Introduction

气候影响评估要求在区域尺度上理解 GCM 预测中的气候变化物理机制。

Climate impacts assessments require, at regional scales, understanding of physical mechanisms of climate change in GCM projections.

还需要能够用快速、简化的气候模型来模拟 GCM 的行为，从而覆盖远多于直接用 GCM 评估的、具有政策相关性的情景范围。

Also required is the ability to emulate (using fast simplified climate models) GCM behaviour for a much larger range of policy-relevant scenarios than may be evaluated using GCMs directly.

这两个要求可以合并成一个问题：什么是最简单的概念框架，既具有定量预测能力，又能捕捉 GCM 情景预测背后的关键机制？

These two requirements may be combined into a single question: what is the simplest conceptual framework that has quantitative predictive power and captures the key mechanisms behind GCM scenario projections?

通常，务实的做法是作出某种形式的线性假设。

Often, a pragmatic choice has been to assume some form of linearity.

在全球能量平衡研究中，线性通常表现为假设气候反馈参数保持不变。

In studies of the global energy balance, linearity is often assumed in the form of a constant climate feedback parameter.

这个参数可以用来量化不同模式中的反馈（例如 Zelinka et al., 2013），也可以在模拟方法中为全球能量平衡模型设定参数（例如 Huntingford and Cox, 2000）。

This parameter may be used to quantify feedbacks in different models (e.g. Zelinka et al., 2013) or, in emulation methods, to parameterise global energy balance models (e.g. Huntingford and Cox, 2000).

在理解或模拟气候变化的区域型态时，人们通常假设区域气候变化大致与全球平均变暖成正比。

In understanding or emulating regional patterns of climate change, it is often assumed that regional climate change is roughly proportional to global mean warming.

在模拟工作中，这称为“型态标度”（pattern scaling）（Mitchell, 2003；Santer et al., 1990；Tebaldi and Arblaster, 2014），但在理解机制时也可能明确或隐含地采用这一假设。

In emulation work, this is termed 'pattern scaling' (Mitchell, 2003;Santer et al., 1990;Tebaldi and Arblaster, 2014), but this assumption may also be applied either explicitly or implicitly in understanding mechanisms.

有时，人们会量化全球变暖每增加 1 K 所对应的变化型态；但更常见的是，只针对单一强迫情景的单一时期研究物理机制（这隐含地假设所得认识也适用于其他时期或情景）。

Sometimes, patterns of change per K of global warming are quantified; often, physical mechanisms are studied for a single period of a single forcing scenario (implicitly assuming that the understanding is relevant for other periods or scenarios).

虽然这些近似在某些情况下似乎效果良好，但越来越多的证据揭示出这类假设存在显著局限。

While these approximations appear to work well under some circumstances, significant limitations are increasingly being revealed in such assumptions.

这些局限有两类：不同的响应时间尺度，以及非线性响应。

These are of two types: different timescales of response, and non-linear responses.

在讨论这一点时，一个复杂之处在于存在不同的线性假设。

In discussing this, a complication arises in that different linearity assumptions exist.

下文将“线性”定义为“符合线性系统理论”，即响应对模式强迫呈线性（也就是说，强迫加倍会使响应加倍；这不同于假设两个响应彼此呈线性关系——正如型态标度所采用的假设）。

Henceforth we define 'linear' as meaning 'consistent with linear systems theory' - i.e. responses that are linear in model forcing (i.e. where doubling the forcing doubles the response; this is different from assuming that pairs of responses are linearly related to each other – as in pattern scaling).

即使在一个线性系统中（响应对强迫呈线性），两个系统输出之间的关系（例如全球平均温度与区域海表温度——SST——之间的关系）一般也会是非线性的。

Even in a linear system (where responses are linear in forcing), the relationship between two system outputs (e.g. between global-mean temperature and regional sea surface temperature - SST) will in general be non-linear.

这是由于不同地点和/或变量具有不同的响应时间尺度。

This is due to different timescales of response in different locations and/or variables.

例子包括：由于与深层海洋相连而出现的滞后表层海洋变暖（Chadwick et al., 2013；Held et al., 2010；Williams et al., 2008；Manabe et al., 1990；Andrews and Ringer, 2014），以及降水对强迫的直接响应（Andrews et al., 2010；Allen and Ingram, 2002；Mitchell et al., 1987）。

Examples include lagged surface ocean warming due to a connection with the deeper ocean (Chadwick et al., 2013;Held et al., 2010;Williams et al., 2008;Manabe et al., 1990;Andrews and Ringer, 2014) or the direct response of precipitation to forcings (Andrews et al., 2010;Allen and Ingram, 2002;Mitchell et al., 1987).

因此，型态标度的一个（通常不成立的）假设是，区域气候与全球平均温度在相同的时间尺度上响应。

One (generally false) assumption of pattern scaling, then, is that regional climate responds over the same timescale as global-mean temperature.

在理解和预测减缓以及地球工程情景（或极长时间尺度）下的行为时，不同的响应时间尺度尤其重要。

Different timescales of response are especially important in understanding and predicting behaviour under mitigation and geoengineering scenarios (or over very long timescales).

非线性系统响应（例如 Schaller et al., 2013）比线性系统响应更难量化、理解和预测。

Non-linear system responses (e.g. Schaller et al., 2013) are more complex to quantify, understand and predict than those of linear systems.

有些例子早已为人所知，例如积雪/海冰退缩导致反馈发生变化（Colman and McAvaney, 2009；Jonko et al., 2013），或大西洋经向翻转环流发生变化。

Some examples have been known for some time, such as changing feedbacks through retreating snow/sea-ice (Colman and McAvaney, 2009;Jonko et al., 2013), or the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation.

近来，在两个大气表述不同的哈德利中心气候模式中，区域降水变化的空间型态显示出显著的非线性降水响应（Good et al., 2012；Chadwick and Good, 2013）。

More recently, substantial non-linear precipitation responses have been demonstrated in spatial patterns of regional precipitation change in two Hadley Centre climate models with different atmospheric formulations (Good et al., 2012;Chadwick and Good, 2013).

这主要是由于一对已知的稳健伪线性机制同时发生变化（Chadwick and Good, 2013）。

This is largely due to simultaneous changes in pairs of known robust pseudo-linear mechanisms (Chadwick and Good, 2013).

在理想化地球工程情景下，海洋吸热、海平面上升和区域气候型态的响应也已显示出非线性；当强迫减小时与强迫增加时，会出现不同的行为（Bouttes et al., 2013；Schaller et al., 2014）。

Non-linearity has also been demonstrated in the response under idealised geoengineering scenarios, of ocean heat uptake, sealevel rise, and regional climate pattterns, with different behaviour found when forcings are decreasing than when they are increasing (Bouttes et al., 2013;Schaller et al., 2014).

对这些机制的区域尺度研究受到了通常所分析的 GCM 实验类型的限制。

Investigation of these mechanisms at regional scales has been constrained by the type of GCM experiment typically analysed.

以往大多数分析（例如 Solomon et al., 2007）使用的是强迫瞬变实验结果，其中强迫在整个实验过程中稳步变化。

Most previous analyses (e.g. Solomon et al., 2007) have used results from transient forcing experiments, where forcing changes steadily through the experiment.

这种做法有三个主要问题。

There are three main problems with this approach.

第一，不同响应时间尺度的信息被掩盖了。

First, information about different timescales of response is masked.

这是因为在瞬变强迫实验的任意给定时刻，GCM 响应都是不同响应时间尺度的混合（Good et al., 2013；Held et al., 2010；Li and Jarvis, 2009），既包括短时间尺度响应（例如来自前几年强迫变化的海洋混合层响应），也包括长时间尺度行为（包括对数十年至数百年前强迫变化的深层海洋响应）。

This is because the GCM response at any given time in a transient forcing experiment is a mixture of different timescales of response (Good et al., 2013;Held et al., 2010;Li and Jarvis, 2009), including short-timescale responses (e.g. ocean mixed layer response from forcing change over the previous few years) through long-timescale behaviour (including deeper ocean responses from forcing changes multiple decades to centuries earlier).

第二，在瞬变强迫实验中，非线性行为很难与线性机制分离。

Secondly, in transient forcing experiments, non-linear behaviour is hard to separate from linear mechanisms.

例如，在 CO2 每年增加 1%、持续 140 年的实验（“1pctCO2”）中，我们可能发现第 70 年（2xCO2）与第 140 年（4xCO2）的空间型态不同。

For example, in an experiment where CO2 is increased by 1% per year for 140 years ('1pctCO2'), we might find different spatial patterns at year 70 (at 2xCO2) than at year 140 (at 4xCO2).

这可能是由非线性机制造成的（因为强迫水平不同，相关气候状态也不同）。

This could be due to nonlinear mechanisms (due to the different forcing level and associated different climate state).

第三，在这类实验中，区域气候变化的信噪比可能相对较差。

Thirdly, signal/noise ratios of regional climate change can be relatively poor in such experiments.

这三个问题可以通过使用理想化的 abruptCO2 GCM 实验来处理（Forster et al., 2012；Zelinka et al., 2013；Jonko et al., 2013；Good et al., 2013；Good et al., 2012；Chadwick and Good, 2013；Chadwick et al., 2013；Bouttes et al., 2013；Gregory et al., 2004）：即 CO2 强迫突然改变，随后保持不变的实验。

These three issues may be addressed by the use of idealised abruptCO2 GCM experiments (Forster et al., 2012;Zelinka et al., 2013;Jonko et al., 2013;Good et al., 2013;Good et al., 2012;Chadwick and Good, 2013;Chadwick et al., 2013;Bouttes et al., 2013;Gregory et al., 2004): an experiment where CO2 forcing is abruptly changed, then held constant.

在 abrupt CO2 实验中，不同时间尺度的响应彼此分离。

In abrupt CO2 experiments, responses over different timescales are separated from each other.

此外，可以直接比较不同强迫水平下的响应，例如在相同时间尺度上比较 abrupt2xCO2 和 abrupt4xCO2 实验中的响应——两者的强迫时间历程完全相同，只有强迫幅度更大的 abrupt4xCO2 除外。

Further, responses at different forcing levels may be directly compared, e.g. by comparing the response in abrupt2xCO2 and abrupt4xCO2 experiments over the same timescale - both have identical forcing time histories, apart from the larger forcing magnitude in abrupt4xCO2.

第三，可以实现较高的信噪比：在初始海洋混合层调整之后，可以对 100 年或更长时期取平均（此类实验中的变化是渐进的）。

Thirdly, high signal/noise is possible: averages may be taken over periods of 100 years or more (after the initial ocean mixed layer adjustment, change is gradual in such experiments).

近期研究（Good et al., 2011；Good et al., 2012；Good et al., 2013；Zelinka et al., 2013）已经确立，这些实验包含可定量追溯到更具政策相关性的瞬变实验的全球和区域尺度信息；等价地说，它们构成了快速简化气候模型预测的基础，而这些预测可以追溯到 GCM。

Recent work (Good et al., 2011;Good et al., 2012;Good et al., 2013;Zelinka et al., 2013) has established that these experiments contain global and regional-scale information quantitatively traceable to more policy-relevant transient experiments - and equivalently, that they form the basis for fast simple climate model projections traceable to the GCMs.

因此，CMIP5 的 abrupt4xCO2 实验得到了广泛使用，包括量化 GCM 的强迫与反馈行为（Gregory et al., 2004；Zelinka et al., 2013），以及可追溯地模拟 GCM 对全球平均温度和吸热的预测（Good et al., 2013；Stott et al., 2013）。

The CMIP5 abrupt4xCO2 experiments have thus been used widely: including quantifying GCM forcing and feedback behaviour (Gregory et al., 2004;Zelinka et al., 2013), and for traceable emulation of GCM projections of global-mean temperature and heat uptake (Good et al., 2013;Stott et al., 2013).

abrupt4xCO2 也是 CMIP6 DECK 方案的一部分（Meehl et al., 2014）。

Abrupt4xCO2 is also part of the CMIP6 DECK protocol (Meehl et al., 2014).

6　将 abruptCO2 与渐变强迫情景联系起来：阶跃响应模型

6 Relating abruptCO2 to gradual forcing scenarios: the step-response model

在使用高度理想化的 abruptCO2 实验时，必须确定其与更现实的渐变强迫实验之间的物理相关性（可追溯性）。

In using the highly-idealised abruptCO2 experiments, it is essential that their physical relevance (traceability) to more realistic gradual forcing experiments is determined.

有些 GCM 可能会对突发的强迫变化作出不现实的响应。

Some GCMs could respond unrealistically to the abrupt forcing change.

这里的一个关键工具是阶跃响应模型（如下所述）。

A key tool here is the step-response model (described below).

这种响应函数方法旨在利用 GCM 对 abruptCO2 实验的响应，预测 GCM 对任意给定瞬变强迫实验的响应。

This response-function method aims to predict the GCM response to any given transient-forcing experiment, using the GCM response to an abruptCO2 experiment.

作为可追溯性评估的一部分，可以将这一预测与 GCM 瞬变强迫模拟进行比较（第 5 节将详细讨论）。

Such a prediction may be compared with the GCM transient-forcing simulation, as part of a traceability assessment (discussed in detail in section 5).

一旦对 abruptCO2 实验能够追溯到瞬变强迫情景建立了一定信心，阶跃响应模型还可发挥其他作用：探究从 abruptCO2 实验获得的物理认识对不同强迫情景的含义；帮助分离线性与非线性机制（第 5 节）；并有可能作为 GCM 模拟的基础。

Once some confidence is established in traceability of the abruptCO2 experiments to transient-forcing scenarios, the stepresponse model has other roles: to explore the implications, for different forcing scenarios, of physical understanding gleaned from abruptCO2 experiments; to help separate linear and nonlinear mechanisms (section 5); and potentially as a basis for GCM emulation.

下面对该方法的描述也用于说明线性系统理论的假设。

The method description below also serves to illustrate the assumptions of linear system theory.

阶跃响应模型将情景实验中辐射强迫的演变表示为一系列辐射强迫阶跃变化（每年年初发生一次阶跃变化）。

The step-response model represents the evolution of radiative forcing in a scenario experiment by a series of step changes in radiative forcing (with one step taken at the beginning of each year).

该方法作出两个线性假设。

The method makes two linear assumptions.

第一，每个年度强迫阶跃的响应，是根据辐射强迫变化的幅度，对 CO2 阶跃实验中的响应进行线性缩放来估计的。

First, the response to each annual forcing step is estimated by linearly scaling the response in a CO2 step experiment according to the magnitude of radiative forcing change.

第二，情景实验第 i 年的响应 yᵢ，被估计为此前所有年度辐射强迫变化所产生响应的总和（示意图见 Good et al., 2013 的图 1）：

Second, the response yi at year i of a scenario experiment is estimated as a sum of responses to all previous annual forcing changes (see Figure 1 of Good et al., 2013 for an illustration):

yᵢ = Σⱼ₌₀ⁱ wᵢ₋ⱼ xⱼ　(1a)

y_i = ∑_{j=0}^{i} w_{i-j} x_j (1a)

其中，xⱼ 是 CO2 阶跃实验第 j 年同一变量的响应。

where xj is the response of the same variable in year j of the CO2 step experiment.

wᵢ₋ⱼ 将阶跃实验的响应（xⱼ）缩小，以匹配情景从第 i 年到第 j 年的年度辐射强迫阶跃变化（记为 Δᵢ₋ⱼF）：

w_{i-j} scales down the response from the step experiment (xj) to match the annual step change in radiative forcing from year i to year j of the scenario (denoted Δ_{i-j}F):

wᵢ₋ⱼ = Δᵢ₋ⱼF / ΔₛF　(1b)

w_{i-j} = Δ_{i-j}F / Δ_sF (1b)

其中，ΔₛF 是 CO2 阶跃实验中的辐射强迫变化。

where ΔsF is the radiative forcing change in the CO2 step experiment.

所有量都相对于恒定强迫控制实验表示为异常值。

All quantities are expressed as anomalies with respect to a constant-forcing control experiment.

原则上，这种方法可以应用于任何空间尺度和任何满足这些假设的变量（例如 Chadwick et al., 2013）。

This approach can in principle be applied at any spatial scale for any variable for which the assumptions are plausible (e.g. Chadwick et al., 2013).

7　线性与非线性机制，以及 abruptCO2 实验的相关性

7 Linear and non-linear mechanisms, and the relevance of abruptCO2 experiments

这里结合实例进一步讨论线性与非线性机制的区别、它们何时重要，以及 abruptCO2 实验的相关性。

Here we discuss further, with examples, the distinction between linear and nonlinear mechanisms, when they are important, and the relevance of abruptCO2 experiments.

7.1 线性机制：不同的响应时间尺度

7.1 Linear mechanisms: different timescales of response

即使在一个线性系统中，全球变暖每增加 1 K 所对应的区域气候变化也会在情景模拟过程中演变。

Even in a linear system, regional climate change per K of global warming will evolve during a scenario simulation.

这是因为气候系统的不同部分对强迫变化具有不同的响应时间尺度。

This happens because different parts of the climate system have different timescales of response to forcing change.

这可能是由于有效热容量不同所致。

This may be due to different effective heat capacities.

例如，海洋混合层的响应远快于深层海洋，这仅仅是因为其水柱更薄（Li and Jarvis, 2009）。

For example, the ocean mixed layer responds much faster than the deeper ocean, simply due to a thinner column of water (Li and Jarvis, 2009).

然而，海洋表面的某些区域（例如南大洋和东南副热带太平洋）表现出滞后变暖，这是由于它们通过上升流或混合与深层海洋的联系更强（例如 Manabe et al., 1990；Williams et al., 2008）。

However, some areas of the ocean surface (e.g. the Southern Ocean and south-east subtropical Pacific) show lagged warming, due to a greater connection (via upwelling or mixing) with the deeper ocean (e.g. Manabe et al., 1990;Williams et al., 2008).

海洋环流和植被的动力学也可能具有自身固有的时间尺度（例如，植被变化可能滞后于全球变暖数年至数百年，Jones et al., 2009）。

The dynamics of the ocean circulation and vegetation may also have their own inherent timescales (e.g. vegetation change may lag global warming by years to hundreds of years, Jones et al., 2009).

在另一个极端，某些 CO2 强迫响应比全球变暖快得多，例如全球平均降水对强迫的直接响应（Allen and Ingram, 2002；例如 Andrews et al., 2010；Mitchell et al., 1987）以及植被对 CO2 的生理响应（Field et al., 1995）。

At the other extreme, some responses to CO2 forcing are much faster than global warming: such as the direct response of global mean precipitation to forcings (Allen and Ingram, 2002;e.g. Andrews et al., 2010;Mitchell et al., 1987) and the physiological response of vegetation to CO2 (Field et al., 1995).

在线性系统中，全球变暖每增加 1 K 所对应的变化型态对强迫历史很敏感。

In a linear system, patterns of change per K of global warming are sensitive to the forcing history.

例如，图 1 示意了一个强迫先逐渐增强、随后稳定下来的情景。

For example in Figure 1, a scenario is illustrated where forcing is ramped up, then stabilized.

其中突出显示了三个时期；由于强迫历史不同，它们在全球变暖每增加 1 K 时可能具有不同的变化型态：在最左侧的时点，较快的响应相对更重要；而在右侧，较慢的响应已经有了一些时间追赶上来。

Three periods are highlighted, which may have different patterns of change per K of global warming, due to different forcing histories: at the leftmost point, faster responses will be relatively more important, whereas at the right, the slower responses have had some time to catch up.

海平面上升的图 2 对此作了说明。

This is illustrated in Figure 2 for sea-level rise.

蓝色曲线显示，对于 RCP2.6，全球平均变暖在 2050 年之后停止，而海平面上升在整个世纪大致以相同速率继续。

The blue curves show that for RCP2.6, global-mean warming ceases after 2050, while sea-level rise continues at roughly the same rate throughout the century.

这主要是因为深层海洋吸热远慢于海洋混合层变暖。

This is largely because deep ocean heat uptake is much slower than ocean mixed-layer warming.

按照设计，abruptCO2 实验将 GCM 对强迫变化的不同响应时间尺度彼此分离。

By design, abruptCO2 experiments separate different timescales of GCM response to forcing change.

例如，Gregory et al. (2004) 用这一点估计 GCM 的辐射强迫和反馈参数：将辐射通量异常绘制为全球平均变暖的函数，可以分离“快”响应和“慢”响应（见例如图 3）。

This is used, for example, (Gregory et al., 2004) to estimate radiative forcing and feedback parameters for GCMs: plotting radiative flux anomalies against global mean warming can separate 'fast' and 'slow' responses (see e.g. Figure 3).

7.2 非线性响应

7.2 Non-linear responses

非线性机制的产生有多种原因。

Nonlinear mechanisms arise for a variety of reasons.

不过，将它们描述为依赖状态的反馈通常很有用。

Often, however, it is useful to describe them as state-dependent feedbacks.

例如，在积雪深度较高或较低时，雪—反照率反馈会变小。

For example, the snow-albedo feedback becomes small at high or low snow depth.

有时，把非线性机制看作两种性质同时发生变化可能更合适。

Sometimes, nonlinear mechanisms may be better viewed as simultaneous changes in pairs of properties.

例如，对流降水大体上是水汽含量与动力学的乘积（Chadwick and Good, 2013；Chadwick et al., 2012）。

For example, convective precipitation is broadly a product of moisture content and dynamics (Chadwick and Good, 2013;Chadwick et al., 2012).

水汽含量和大气动力学都会响应 CO2 强迫，因此一般可以预期对流降水对 CO2 强迫呈现非线性响应。

Both moisture content and atmospheric dynamics respond to CO2 forcing, so in general we might expect convective precipitation to have a nonlinear response to CO2 forcing.

当然，还存在更复杂的非线性响应，例如大西洋经向翻转环流。

Of course, more complex nonlinear responses exist, such as for the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation.

与线性机制不同，非线性机制对强迫幅度很敏感。

In contrast to linear mechanisms, nonlinear mechanisms are sensitive to the magnitude of forcing.

例如，由于非线性机制，图 4 中突出显示的两个点可能具有不同的全球变暖每增加 1 K 时的变化型态。

For example, the two points highlighted in Figure 4 may have different patterns of change per K of global warming, due to nonlinear mechanisms.

图 5 给出了一个例子：由于积雪和冰面减少，且剩余积雪和冰面位于太阳入射较低的区域，反照率反馈会随着全球温度升高而减弱（Colman and McAvaney, 2009）。

An example is given in Figure 5, which shows the albedo feedback declining with increased global temperature, due to declining snow and ice cover, and the remaining snow and ice being in areas of lower solar insolation (Colman and McAvaney, 2009).

abruptCO2 实验可以用来分离非线性机制与线性机制。

AbruptCO2 experiments may be used to separate nonlinear from linear mechanisms.

可以通过在不同 abruptCO2 实验中比较相同时间尺度上的响应来实现这一点。

This can be done by comparing the responses at the same timescale in different different abruptCO2 experiments.

“加倍差异”（doubling difference）被定义为衡量对第一次和第二次 CO2 加倍的响应之差。

A 'doubling difference' is defined, measuring the difference in response to the first and second CO2 doublings.

在当前大多数简化气候模型中（例如 Meinshausen et al., 2011），假设每次后续 CO2 加倍产生的辐射强迫都相同（因为强迫对 log[CO2] 近似呈线性，Myhre et al., 1998）。

In most current simple climate models (e.g. Meinshausen et al., 2011), the radiative forcing from each successive CO2 doubling is assumed identical (because forcing is approximately linear in log[CO2], Myhre et al., 1998).

在这一假设下，线性系统在任何地方的加倍差异都应为零。

With this assumption, a linear system would have zero doubling difference everywhere.

因此，加倍差异被用作非线性的度量。

Therefore, the doubling difference is used as a measure of nonlinearity.

应比较哪些 abruptCO2 实验以及比较哪个时间尺度，将在第 5 节讨论。

The question of which abruptCO2 experiments to compare, and over which timescale, is discussed in section 5.

在一些 GCM 中，已有研究显示每次 CO2 加倍对应的强迫会随 CO2 改变而变化（Colman and McAvaney, 2009；Jonko et al., 2013）。

In some GCMs, the forcing per CO2 doubling has been shown to vary with CO2 (Colman and McAvaney, 2009;Jonko et al., 2013).

然而，这种变化取决于所使用的强迫具体定义（Jonko et al., 2013）。

However, this variation depends on the specific definition of forcing used (Jonko et al., 2013).

目前，我们将其纳入非线性的定义。

Currently this is folded into our definition of nonlinearity.

如果未来能够得到这种强迫变化的稳健定义，就可以用它消除成对 abruptCO2 实验之间的强迫差异，从而计算“调整后的加倍差异”。

If a robust definition of this forcing variation becomes available in future, it could be used to scale out any difference in forcing between pairs of abruptCO2 experiments, to calculate an 'adjusted doubling difference'.

作为例子，图 7 映射了 HadGEM2-ES 海洋上空降水对 abrupt2xCO2 和 abrupt4xCO2 的响应，以及加倍差异（取自 Chadwick and Good）。

As an example, Figure 7 maps the response to abrupt2xCO2 and abrupt4xCO2, and the doubling difference, for precipitation in HadGEM2-ES over the ocean (taken from Chadwick and Good).

这些非线性很大——其幅度与 abrupt2xCO2 的响应相当，尽管空间型态不同。

The nonlinearities are large - comparable in magnitude to the responses to abrupt2xCO2, albeit with a different spatial pattern.

8　实验设计

8 Experimental design

nonlinMIP 由一组 abruptCO2 实验（主要工具）和一个 CO2 强迫瞬变实验组成。

nonlinMIP is composed of a set of abruptCO2 experiments (the primary tools), plus a CO2-forced transient experiment.

这些实验建立在 CMIP5 和 CMIP6 DECK 方案之上（这些方案所要求的运行见表 1）。

These build on the CMIP5 and CMIP6 DECK protocols (the required runs from these are detailed in Table 1).

nonlinMIP 的附加运行（表 2）被分为三个优先级。

The additional nonlinMIP runs (Table 2) are assigned three priority levels.

参与有三种选项：1）只进行“必需”模拟；2）进行全部“高优先级”模拟及“必需”模拟；或者最好是 3）进行全部模拟。

Three options for participation are: 1) only the ‘essential’ simulation; 2) all ‘high priority’ plus the ‘essential’ simulations; or, preferably, 3) all simulations.

在所有情况下，表 1 中的实验都是必需的。

The experiments in Table 1 are required in all cases.

除 abrupt4xto1x 外，所有实验都必须从工业化前控制实验的同一年初始化（见表 2）。

All experiments must be initialized from the same year of a pre-industrial control experiment, except for abrupt4xto1x (see Table 2).

第 5 节概述了一个典型的分析流程。

A typical analysis procedure is outlined in section 5.

nonlinMIP 设计目前限于 CO2 强迫，尽管相同原则也可以应用于其他强迫。

The nonlinMIP design is presently limited to CO2 forcing, although the same principles could be applied to other forcings.

9　基本分析原则

9 Basic analysis principles

本节概述分析 nonlinMIP 结果背后的一般原则。

This section outlines the general principles behind analysis of nonlinMIP results.

首要思想是找出阶跃响应模型（第 2 节）失效的位置：由于阶跃响应模型基于线性假设，这就相当于检测非线性响应。

The primary idea is to find where the stepresponse model (section 2) breaks: since the step-response model is based on a linear assumption, this amounts to detecting non-linear responses.

目的是集中后续分析。

The aim is to focus subsequent analysis.

如果发现关注量中的非线性很小，那么分析可以集中于单个 abruptCO2 实验中的不同响应时间尺度：线性意味着，在有用的 CO2 浓度范围内，物理响应可以由单个 abruptCO2 实验捕捉。

If non-linearities in a quantity of interest are found to be small, then analysis may focus on understanding different timescales of response from a single abruptCO2 experiment: linearity means that the physical response (over a useful range of CO2 concentrations) is captured by a single abruptCO2 experiment.

这代表了相当大的简化。

This represents a considerable simplification.

另一方面，如果发现非线性很重要，重点就转向理解不同 abruptCO2 实验中的不同响应。

If, on the other hand, non-linearities are found to be important, the focus shifts to understanding the different responses in different abruptCO2 experiments.

应重点关注哪些 abruptCO2 实验以及哪些时间尺度，将在下文讨论。

The choice of which abruptCO2 experiments to focus on, and over which timescales, is discussed below.

9.1 第一步：检验 abrupt4xCO2 对瞬变强迫实验中接近 4xCO2 的响应的基本可追溯性

9.1 First step: check basic traceability of abrupt4xCO2 to the transient-forced response near 4xCO2

这是为了确认 abruptCO2 实验在所关注变量中包含现实的物理响应（此前已针对一系列 CMIP5 模式的全球平均温度和吸热（Good et al., 2013），以及 HadCM3 的其他全球平均量（Good et al., 2011）开展过这项工作）。

This is to confirm that the abruptCO2 experiments contain realistic physical responses in the variables of interest (as previously done for global-mean temperature and heat uptake for a range of CMIP5 models (Good et al., 2013), and for other global-mean quantities for HadCM3 (Good et al., 2011).

这也排除了最病态的非线性（例如，如果某个 GCM 对突发 CO2 变化的响应不现实）。

This also, rules out the most pathological non-linearities (e.g. if the response to an abrupt CO2 change in a given GCM was unrealistic).

首先应使用 abrupt4xCO2 响应运行线性阶跃响应模型，以预测 1pctCO2 实验第 140 年附近（即接近 4xCO2）的响应。

The linear step-response model should first be used with the abrupt4xCO2 response, to predict the response near year 140 of the 1pctCO2 experiment (i.e. near 4xCO2).

随后将这一预测与 GCM 的实际 1pctCO2 结果进行比较。

This prediction is then compared with the actual GCM 1pctCO2 result.

首先应对全球平均温度进行这项工作：一系列 CMIP5 模式已经完成了这一评估（Good et al., 2013；见图 8），从而可以了解预期的准确程度。

This should first be done for global mean temperature: this assessment has been performed for a range of CMIP5 models (Good et al., 2013; see Figure 8), giving an idea of the level of accuracy expected.

如果 abruptCO2 响应从根本上不现实，那么它很可能会在全球温度变化中显现出来。

If the abruptCO2 response is fundamentally unrealistic, it is likely to show up in the global temperature change.

随后可以对变暖的空间型态重复这一方法，再对所关注的量重复。

This approach may then be repeated for spatial patterns of warming, and then for the quantities of interest.

这里使用 abrupt4xCO2，是因为它比 abrupt2xCO2 具有更大的信噪比，同时又代表了业务照常情景在 2100 年附近的强迫水平。

Abrupt4xCO2 is used here as it has larger signal/noise than abrupt2xCO2, yet is representative of forcing levels in a business-as-usual scenario by 2100.

不过，也可以使用 abrupt2xCO2 重复这些检验——但应与 1pctCO2 实验第 70 年的结果比较（即在 2xCO2 时）。

However, the tests may also be repeated using abrupt2xCO2 – but compared with year 70 of the 1pctCO2 experiment (i.e. at 2xCO2).

9.2 第二步：检测非线性响应

9.2 Second step: detecting nonlinear responses

在对 abruptCO2 的物理响应建立了一定程度的信心之后，第二步是寻找非线性响应。

Having established some level of confidence in the abruptCO2 physical response, the second step is to look for nonlinear responses.

这首先包括重复上述第一步中的检验，但要针对 1pctCO2 和 1pctCO2 先升高后降低实验的不同部分，并为阶跃响应模型使用不同的 abruptCO2 实验。

This first involves repeating the tests from step 1 above, but for different parts of the 1pctCO2 and 1pctCO2 ramp-down experiments, and using different abruptCO2 experiments for the step-response model.

图 9 给出了一个例子（但使用的是不同的瞬变强迫实验）。

An example is given in Figure 9 (but for different transient-forcing experiments).

它显示了 HadCM3 GCM 中全球平均降水的结果（Good et al., 2012）。

This shows results for global-mean precipitation in the HadCM3 GCM (Good et al., 2012).

这里，使用 abrupt4xCO2 的阶跃响应模型预测（红色曲线）只有在瞬变强迫实验接近 4xCO2 时才有效。

Here, the step-response model prediction using abrupt4xCO2 (red curves) only works where a transient-forced experiment is near to 4xCO2.

同样，使用 abrupt2xCO2 的预测（蓝色曲线）只有在接近 2xCO2 时才有效。

Similarly, the prediction using abrupt2xCO2 (blue curves) works only near 2xCO2.

在其他情况下，可以看到相当大的误差，而且使用 abrupt2xCO2 和 abrupt4xCO2 得到的预测彼此差异很大。

Otherwise, quite large errors are seen, and the predictions with abrupt2xCO2 and abrupt4xCO2 are quite different from each other.

这意味着该 GCM 的降水响应存在很大的非线性，并且可以通过比较 abrupt2xCO2 和 abrupt4xCO2 实验中的响应来研究这些非线性。

This implies that there are large non-linearities in the precipitation response in this GCM, and that they may be studied by comparing the responses in the abrupt2xCO2 and abrupt4xCO2 experiments.

在识别出某种非线性响应，并确定了两个或更多可供比较的 abruptCO2 实验之后（前例为 abrupt2xCO2 和 abrupt4xCO2），可以通过在相同时间尺度上比较不同 abruptCO2 实验中的响应来详细研究非线性机制（例如使用加倍差异，如图 6、7 所示）。

Having identified some non-linear response, and highlighted two or more abruptCO2 experiments to compare (in the previous example, abrupt2xCO2 and abrupt4xCO2), the non-linear mechanisms may be studied in detail by comparing the responses in the different abruptCO2 experiments over the same timescale (e.g. via the doubling difference, as in Figures 6,7).

这使得非线性机制能够与线性机制分离（Good et al., 2012；Chadwick and Good, 2013），而在瞬变强迫实验中无法做到这一点。

This allows (Good et al., 2012;Chadwick and Good, 2013) non-linear mechanisms to be separated from linear mechanisms (not possible in a transient-forcing experiment).

10　结论

10 Conclusions

本文概述了 nonlinMIP 设计背后的基本物理原理，以及建立从 abruptCO2 到渐变强迫实验的可追溯性的方法，随后详细说明实验设计，最后介绍了一些适用于大多数基于该数据集开展研究的一般分析原则。

This paper outlines the basic physical principles behind the nonlinMIP design, and the method of establishing traceability from abruptCO2 to gradual forcing experiments, before detailing the experimental design and finally some general analysis principles that should apply to most studies based on this dataset.

 MIP 目标及简要概述*

 Goal of the MIP and a brief overview*

DAMIP 的主要目标是促进更准确地估计人为和自然强迫变化对观测到的全球变暖的贡献；促进更准确地估计这些强迫对观测到的全球和区域其他气候变量变化的贡献；为估计历史排放如何已经改变并正在改变当代气候风险作出贡献；以及促进和改进受观测约束的未来气候变化预测。

The primary goals of DAMIP are to facilitate improved estimation of the contribution of anthropogenic and natural forcing changes to observed global warming; to facilitate improved estimation of the contribution of those forcings to observed global and regional changes in other climate variables; to contribute to the estimation of how historical emissions have altered and are altering contemporary climate risk; and to facilitate and improve observationally-constrained projections of future climate change.

检测与归因研究通常需要无强迫控制模拟，以及包含所有主要人为和自然强迫的历史模拟。

Detection and attribution studies typically require unforced control simulations and historical simulations including all major anthropogenic and natural forcings.

这类模拟将作为 DECK 和 CMIP6 历史模拟的一部分开展（下文将 CMIP6 历史模拟称为 histALL）。

Such simulations will be carried out as part of the DECK and the CMIP6 historical simulation (hereafter we referred to the CMIP6 historical simulation as histALL).

此外，这类研究还需要使用单独强迫或强迫子集进行的额外模拟。

In addition such studies require additional simulations with individual forcings or subsets of forcings.

我们提议将这类分离强迫实验中的一部分作为 CMIP6 的检测与归因模式比较计划（DAMIP）实验。

We propose some such separated forcing experiments as Detection and Attribution MIP (DAMIP) for CMIP6.

结合参与 CMIP6 的模式所开展的 histALL 与分离强迫实验，将有助于模式评估、更好地理解历史气候变化，以及推导受观测约束的未来气候变化预测。

Combinations of histALL and separated forcing experiments from models participating in CMIP6 will be useful for model evaluation, better understanding of historical climate changes, and for deriving observational constraints on future climate change projections.

 所提议实验概述*

 An overview of the proposed experiments*

我们提议开展使用单独强迫或强迫子集的若干历史实验。

We propose some historical experiments using individual forcings or subsets of forcings.

对于 ESM，这些实验由 CO2 浓度驱动。

These experiments are CO2-concentration driven for ESMs.

这些模拟应与 histALL 模拟同时开始，并至少持续到 2020 年。

These simulations should start at the same time as the histALL simulations and continue to at least 2020.

在这些模拟结束之前，应使用与 histALL 模拟相同的强迫；此后应使用 SSP2-4.5 模拟（ScenarioMIP 的层级 1）中的强迫。

Forcings identical to those in the histALL simulations should be used up to the end of those simulations, followed by forcings from the SSP2-4.5 simulation (Tier 1 of ScenarioMIP).

多成员集合对于分离受强迫响应与内部变率至关重要。

Multi-member ensembles are vital for the separation of forced responses and internal variability.

我们要求每个实验至少有 3 个具有不同初始条件的集合成员，并建议无力承担所有所要求运行的建模团队先开展层级 1 模拟的至少 3 成员集合。

We require at least 3 ensemble members with different initial conditions for each experiment, and recommend that modeling groups which cannot afford to do this for all requested runs start by carrying out at least 3-member ensembles of the Tier 1 simulations.

我们还要求在 SSP2-4.5 下开展 3 个使用单独强迫、持续至 2100 年的延伸实验：仅变化充分混合温室气体；仅变化平流层臭氧；以及仅变化人为气溶胶。

We also request three extension experiments with individual forcings up to 2100 under SSP2-4.5: well-mixed GHG changes only; stratospheric ozone changes only; and anthropogenic aerosol changes only.

这些实验的最小集合规模为 1。

The minimum ensemble size of these is one.

我们还建议建模团队开展 500 年或更长的 piControl 运行，以便稳健地估计内部变率。

We also recommend modelling groups to perform a 500-year or longer piControl run to allow robust estimates of internal variability.

我们为 DAMIP/CMIP6 提议 4 个层级 1 实验。

We propose four Tier 1 experiments for DAMIP/CMIP6.

第一个实验是将 histALL（CMIP6 历史模拟）的集合规模扩大到至少 3 个成员。

The first one is the enlargement of the ensemble size of histALL (the CMIP6 historical simulation) to at least three members.

另外 3 个层级 1 实验是仅自然强迫（histNAT）、仅温室气体（histGHG）和仅气溶胶（histAER）集合。

The other three Tier 1 experiments are Natural-only (histNAT), GHG-only (histGHG) and Aerosols-only (histAER) ensembles.

这里，“XXX-only”表示 XXX 这一因子像 histALL 运行中一样变化，但其他条件按照 piControl 实验的设置施加并保持不变。

Here, “XXX-only” mean that the agent XXX changes as in the histALL runs, but the other conditions are imposed and kept constant as in the piControl experiments.

我们要求强迫因子必须严格按照 histALL 模拟中的方式施加。

We require that forcing agents are perturbed exactly as in the histALL simulations:

例如，在 histGHG 模拟中，应规定与 histALL 模拟相同的充分混合温室气体浓度。

For example in the histGHG simulations the same well-mixed GHG concentrations are prescribed as in the histALL simulations.

我们要求建模团队报告每次运行所使用的排放和边界条件集合。

We request modelling groups to report what sets of emissions and boundary conditions are used in each run.

提议开展 3 个层级 2 实验：将仅温室气体实验延伸至 2100 年（ssp245GHG）、仅平流层臭氧实验（histSOZ），以及将仅平流层臭氧实验延伸至 2100 年（ssp245SOZ）。

Three Tier 2 experiments are proposed: the extension of GHG-only up to 2100 (ssp245GHG), Stratospheric-Ozone-only (histSOZ) and the extension of Stratospheric-Ozone-only to 2100 (ssp245SOZ).

层级 3 实验是仅火山强迫（histVLC）、仅太阳强迫（histSOL）、将仅气溶胶实验延伸至 2100 年（ssp245AER）、使用气溶胶替代估计的 histALL（histALL/estAER2），以及使用自然强迫替代估计的 histALL（histALL/estNAT2）。

Tier 3 experiments are Volcanic-only (histVLC), Solar-only (histSOL), the extension of Aerosol-only up to 2100 (ssp245AER), histALL with alternate estimates of aerosols (histALL/estAER2) and histALL with alternate estimates of NAT forcings (histALL/estNAT2).

DAMIP 和 DCPP 都提议开展 histALL 模拟的初始条件集合。

Both DAMIP and DCPP propose an initial condition ensemble of histALL simulations.

DAMIP 的 histALL、histNAT、histGHG、histAER、ssp245GHG 和 ssp245AER，与 RFMIP-ERF 提议的用于估计辐射强迫的瞬变 AGCM 实验密切对应。

histALL, histNAT, histGHG, histAER, ssp245GHG and ssp245AER of DAMIP correspond closely to transient AGCM experiments for estimates of radiative forcing proposed in RFMIP-ERF.

结合 DAMIP 与 RFMIP-Historical 模拟，可以将气溶胶响应的不确定性分离为两部分：一部分与模拟给定气溶胶分布所导致的气候响应有关，另一部分是基于规定的气溶胶前体排放的总体不确定性。

Combinations of DAMIP and RFMIP-Historical simulations will allow uncertainties in the aerosol response to be separated into those associated with simulating the climate response to a given distribution of aerosols, and the full uncertainty based on specified aerosol precursor emissions.

DAMIP 还共同支持 LUMIP 的“全部减去土地利用（LND_noLULCC_hist）”模拟。

DAMIP also co-sponsors "ALL minus land-use (LND_noLULCC_hist)" simulations of LUMIP.

AerChemMIP 的两个实验与 DAMIP 的 histGHG 密切相关：一个与 histGHG 类似，但允许臭氧变化；另一个包含 GHG 和气溶胶的历史变化。

Two AerChemMIP experiments are closely related to histGHG of DAMIP: One is similar to histGHG except that ozone is allowed to vary, and a second includes historical changes in both GHGs and aerosols.

DAMIP 的 histALL 和 histNAT 运行将用于 GMMIP 的诊断。

histALL and histNAT runs from DAMIP will be used in diagnoses of GMMIP.

histVLC 运行对 GeoMIP 和 VolMIP 都有用。

histVLC runs are useful for GeoMIP and VolMIP.

结合 ScenarioMIP 的 SSP2-4.5 运行以及 DAMIP 的 ssp245GHG、ssp245SOZ 和 ssp245AER，将能够研究不同强迫因子导致的未来气候响应，并为未来预测提供受观测约束的条件。

Combinations of SSP2-4.5 runs of ScenarioMIP and ssp245GHG, ssp245SOZ and ssp245AER of DAMIP will allow the investigation of future climate responses to different forcing agents and observational constraints on future projections.

 对 CMIP DECK 和 CMIP6 实验所提议的评估/分析概述*

 An overview of the proposed evaluation/analysis of the CMIP DECK and CMIP6 experiments*

预计将开展若干关于人为和自然强迫影响历史气候变化的检测与归因分析。

A number of detection and attribution analyses of anthropogenic and natural forcing influences on historical climate changes are anticipated.

预计这些分析将涉及从全球到区域尺度的温度、水文循环、大气环流、海洋性质、冰冻圈变量、极端指数和其他变量的历史变化。

These analyses are expected to address historical changes in temperature, the hydrological cycle, atmospheric circulation, ocean properties, cryospheric variables, extreme indices and other variables, from global to regional scales.

将 DAMIP 实验在 CMIP5 中截至 2005 年的时段延长至 2020 年，对于理解近期气候变暖停滞的原因，以及提高对降水等高噪声变量变化进行检测与归因的信噪比至关重要。

The extension of DAMIP experiments from 2005 in CMIP5 to 2020 is essential to understand reasons for the recent hiatus of climate warming and improve signal-to-noise ratio for detection and attribution of changes in high-noise variables such as precipitation.

DAMIP 实验对于未来气候变化预测、气候敏感度、TCR 和 TCRE 的观测约束也很重要。

The DAMIP experiments are also important for observational constraints on future climate change projections, climate sensitivity, TCR and TCRE.

利用 DAMIP 和 RFMIP 实验的组合，我们可以比较不同强迫因子在单位辐射强迫下的瞬变气候响应。

Using combinations of experiments from DAMIP and RFMIP, we can compare transient climate responses per unit radiative forcing across different forcing factors.

预计 DAMIP 模拟分析将构成下一次 IPCC 评估报告中气候变化检测与归因评估的基础。

It is anticipated that analyses of DAMIP simulations will form the basis of the assessment of the detection and attribution of climate change in the next IPCC assessment report.

基于 DAMIP 模拟的受观测约束估计也可能为该报告中的未来气候预测作出重大贡献。

Observationally-constrained estimates based on DAMIP simulations may also provide a major contribution to projections of future climate in this report.

 拟议时间安排*

 Proposed timing *

在建模中心完成 piControl（我们建议开展 500 年或更长的模拟）、histALL（CMIP6 历史模拟）和 SSP2-4.5（ScenarioMIP 层级 1）实验之后。

After modelling centers perform piControl (we recommend 500-year or longer simulations), histALL (the CMIP6 historical simulation) and SSP2-4.5 (ScenarioMIP Tier 1) experiments.

o 该实验所要解决的科学问题和/或空白

o the science question and/or gap being addressed with this experiment

结合 histALL、histNAT 和 histGHG，可以将观测到的气候变化归因于 GHG、其他人为因子和自然强迫的贡献。

Combinations of histALL, histNAT and histGHG will allow us to attribute observed climate changes to contributions from GHG, the other anthropogenic factors and natural forcing.

由于更高的信噪比对于检测与归因分析至关重要，我们要求所有历史实验至少有 3 个成员。

Because better signal to noise ratio is vital to D&A analyses, we request at least 3 members for all historical experiments.

更多的模拟还将为气候风险分析提供大得多的极端事件样本。

Larger numbers of simulations also provide much larger samples of extreme events for climate risk analysis.

o 与其他 MIP 可能产生的协同效应

o possible synergies with other MIPs

 这一实验将使所有分析历史气候变化和当前气候态的研究人员受益。

 This experiment will benefit all researchers who analyze historical climate changes, and the present climatology.

 DCPP：DCPP 提议开展一个延伸至 2030 年的 histALL 十成员集合。

 DCPP: DCPP proposes a 10 member ensemble of histALL up to 2030.

 RFMIP-ERF：结合 RFMIP-ERF 估计的辐射强迫与 DAMIP（histALL、histNAT、histGHG、histAER、ssp245GHG 和 ssp245AER）的瞬变气候响应，我们可以研究反馈和调整如何随强迫因子变化。

 RFMIP-ERF: Combining radiative forcing estimated from RFMIP-ERF and transient climate responses from DAMIP (histALL, histNAT, histGHG, histAER, ssp245GHG and ssp245AER), we can investigate how feedbacks and adjustments vary with forcing factors.

 RFMIP-Historical：DAMIP（histALL、histNAT、histAER）与 RFMIP-Historical 的组合，将能够把基于规定气溶胶演变的气候响应不确定性，与针对规定气溶胶前体排放的气候响应总体不确定性分离开来。

 RFMIP-Historical: Combinations of DAMIP (histALL, histNAT, histAER) and RFMIP-Historical will allow us to separate uncertainties in climate response based on specified aerosol evolution from the overall uncertainties in climate response to specified aerosol precursor emissions.

 GMMIP：DAMIP 的 histALL 和 histNAT 运行将用于 GMMIP 的诊断。

 GMMIP: histALL and histNAT runs from DAMIP will be used in diagnoses of GMMIP.

 ScenarioMIP: Combinations of histALL, histNAT, histGHG, histAER, ssp245GHG, ssp245AER of DAMIP and SSP2-4.5 of ScenarioMIP allow observational-constraints of uncertainties in future projections.

（1.1）

(1.1)

仅自然强迫运行（histNAT）

Natural-only run (histNAT)

o 实验设计

o the experimental design

仅由自然强迫因子驱动的历史模拟（即太阳辐照度变化和火山活动），与 histALL 完全相同。

 Historical simulations forced by natural forcing agents only (i.e., solar irradiance change and volcanic activity), exactly as in histALL.

o 该实验所要解决的科学问题和/或空白

o the science question and/or gap being addressed with this experiment

histALL 和 histNAT 模拟将使我们能够把观测到的变化归因于人为和自然影响。

histALL and histNAT simulations will allow us to attribute observed changes to anthropogenic and natural influences.

histALL、histNAT 和 histGHG 模拟将使我们能够把观测到的气候变化归因于 GHG、其他人为因子和自然强迫的贡献。

histALL, histNAT and histGHG simulations will allow us to attribute observed climate changes to contributions from GHG, the other anthropogenic factors and natural forcing.

更好地理解自然强迫对气候的作用，是多个 SPARC 活动（尤其是 Solaris/HEPPA 和 SSIRC）的主要目标之一。

To better understand the role of natural forcings for climate is among the key aims of several SPARC activities (in particular Solaris/HEPPA and SSIRC).

在这方面，仅自然强迫实验（histNAT、histVLC 和 histSOL）对 SPARC 很有用。

In this respect the experiments with natural forcing only (histNAT, histVLC and histSOL) are useful for SPARC.

 C20C+ Detection and Attribution Project: The event attribution project of C20C+ will make use of the histNAT and histALL simulations to estimate boundary SST conditions for their AGCM simulations of the hypothetical counterfactual world without human influences.

 RFMIP-ERF：结合 RFMIP-ERF 估计的辐射强迫与 DAMIP（histALL、histNAT、histGHG、histAER、ssp245GHG 和 ssp245AER）的瞬变气候响应，我们可以研究反馈和调整如何随强迫因子变化。

 RFMIP-Historical：DAMIP（histALL、histNAT、histAER）与 RFMIP-Historical 的组合，将能够把基于规定气溶胶演变的气候响应不确定性，与针对规定气溶胶前体排放的气候响应总体不确定性分离开来。

 RFMIP-Historical: Combinations of DAMIP (histALL, histNAT, histAER) and RFMIP-Historical will allow us to separate uncertainties in climate response based on specified aerosol evolution from the overall uncertainties in climate response to specified aerosol precursor emissions.

 VolMIP: VolMIP proposes both historical and mechanism based simulations with a focus on volcanic eruptions.

 GMMIP：DAMIP 的 histALL 和 histNAT 运行将用于 GMMIP 的诊断。

 GMMIP: histALL and histNAT runs from DAMIP will be used in diagnoses of GMMIP

 ScenarioMIP：DAMIP 的 histALL、histNAT、histGHG、histAER、ssp245GHG、ssp245AER 与 ScenarioMIP 的 SSP2-4.5 相结合，可以为未来预测中的不确定性提供观测约束。

 ScenarioMIP: Combinations of histALL, histNAT, histGHG, histAER, ssp245GHG, ssp245AER of DAMIP and SSP2-4.5 of ScenarioMIP allow observational-constraints of uncertainties in future projections.

o 该实验对（A）气候模拟界、（B）综合评估建模（IAM）界、（C）影响、适应与脆弱性（IAV）界以及（D）政策制定者的潜在益处

o potential benefits of the experiment to (A) climate modeling community, (B) Integrated Assessment Modelling (IAM) community, (C) Impacts Adaptation and Vulnerability (IAV) community, and (D) policy makers.

CMIP5 中的 histALL、histGHG 和 histNAT 对 IPCC AR5 得出以下结论至关重要：“1951 年至 2010 年全球平均地表温度的观测增幅中，超过一半极有可能是由观测到的人为温室气体浓度增加所致”。

histALL, histGHG and histNAT in CMIP5 were vital for IPCC AR5 to conclude “more than half of the observed increase in global mean surface temperature from 1951 to 2010 is very likely due to the observed anthropogenic increase in greenhouse gas concentrations”.

DAMIP/CMIP6 中使用新模式开展的这些实验具有更新的强迫、更长的模拟时段和更大的集合规模，将促进更稳健的归因评估，并更好地理解观测到的气候变化。

The updated forcings, longer simulations, and larger ensemble sizes of these experiments using new models in DAMIP/CMIP6 will facilitate even more robust attribution assessments and a better understanding of observed climate changes.

histALL 和 histNAT 将用于近期极端天气和气候事件的事件归因分析，也可用于影响评估的检测与归因分析。

histALL and histNAT will be used for event attribution analyses of recent extreme weather and climate events, and can be used for D&A analyses of impact assessments.

这些归因研究将为讨论减缓和适应政策提供关键信息。

Those attribution studies will provide essential information for discussion of mitigation and adaptation policies.

（1.2）

(1.2)

仅充分混合温室气体运行（histGHG）

well-mixed GHG-only run (histGHG)

o 实验设计

o the experimental design

仅由充分混合温室气体变化驱动的历史模拟，方式与 histALL 模拟相同。

 Historical simulations forced by well mixed greenhouse gas changes only, as in the histALL simulations.

采用互动式化学方案的模式，应关闭化学过程，或在其辐射方案中使用平流层和对流层臭氧的工业化前气候态。

Models with interactive chemistry schemes should either turn off the chemistry or use a preindustrial climatology of stratospheric and tropospheric ozone in their radiation schemes.

这将确保所有这些模拟中的臭氧保持固定，并使带有和不带耦合化学过程的模式所模拟的响应具有可比性。

This will ensure that ozone is fixed in all these simulations, and simulated responses in models with and without coupled chemistry are comparable.

o 该实验所要解决的科学问题和/或空白

o the science question and/or gap being addressed with this experiment

 histALL、histNAT 和 histGHG 的组合将能够量化可归因于 GHG 变化、其他人为强迫和自然强迫的气候变化。

 Combinations of histALL, histNAT and histGHG will allow the quantification of climate change attributable to GHG changes, other anthropogenic forcings and natural forcings.

 可结合 DECK 中的 1PCTCO2 模拟估计受观测约束的 TCR 和 TCRE。

 Allows observationally-constrained TCR and TCRE to be estimated together the 1PCTCO2 simulation in the DECK.

o 与其他 MIP 可能产生的协同效应

o possible synergies with other MIPs

 C4MIP：与 GHG 浓度变化相关的碳通量变化。

 C4MIP: Carbon flux changes related to the GHG concentration changes.

 RFMIP-ERF：结合 RFMIP-ERF 估计的辐射强迫与 DAMIP（histALL、histNAT、histGHG、histAER、ssp245GHG 和 ssp245AER）的瞬变气候响应，我们可以研究反馈和调整如何随强迫因子变化。

 RFMIP-ERF: Combining radiative forcing estimated from RFMIP-ERF and transient climate responses from DAMIP (histALL, histNAT, histGHG, histAER, ssp245GHG and ssp245AER), we can investigate how feedbacks and adjustments vary with forcing factors.

 AerChemMIP：AerChemMIP 的两个实验（实验 1.1.1/1.1.2）与 DAMIP 的 histGHG 模拟密切相关。

 AerChemMIP: Two experiments of AerChemMIP (Experiment 1.1.1/1.1.2) are closely related to the histGHG simulation of DAMIP.

 ScenarioMIP：histALL、histNAT、histGHG、histAER、ssp245GHG、ssp245AER 与 SSP2-4.5 相结合，可以为未来预测中的不确定性提供观测约束。

 ScenarioMIP: Combinations of histALL, histNAT, histGHG, histAER, ssp245GHG, ssp245AER and SSP2-4.5 allow observational-constraints of uncertainties in future projections.

o 该实验对（A）气候模拟界、（B）综合评估建模（IAM）界、（C）影响、适应与脆弱性（IAV）界以及（D）政策制定者的潜在益处

o potential benefits of the experiment to (A) climate modeling community, (B) Integrated Assessment Modelling (IAM) community, (C) Impacts Adaptation and Vulnerability (IAV) community, and (D) policy makers.

DAMIP/CMIP6 中的 histALL、histGHG 和 histNAT 将比基于 CMIP5 的结果促进更稳健的归因评估，并更好地理解气候变化。

histALL, histGHG and histNAT in DAMIP/CMIP6 will facilitate more robust attribution assessments and a better understanding of climate changes than those based on CMIP5.

此外，histGHG 和 ssp245GHG 可用于推导受观测约束的未来气候预测、气候敏感度、TCR 和 TCRE。

Furthermore, histGHG and ssp245GHG can be used to derive observationally constrained future climate projections, climate sensitivity, TCR and TCRE.

受观测约束的预测将为讨论减缓和适应政策提供有用信息。

Observationally-constrained projections will provide useful information to inform discussion of mitigation and adaptation policies.

（1.3）仅人为气溶胶运行（histAER/histAERchem）

(1.3) Anthropogenic-Aerosols-only runs (histAER/histAERchem)

针对 histAER 提议了两种实验设计——请选择其中一种。

Two experimental designs are proposed for histAER - Please select one of them.

如果你希望同时开展这一实验及其在 RFMIP-ERF 中的对应模拟，请采用相同的设置。

If you like to perform both this experiment and the corresponding simulation in RFMIP-ERF, please apply the same setup.

（1.3a）仅人为气溶胶运行（histAER）

(1.3a) Anthropogenic-Aerosols-only runs (histAER)

o 实验设计

o the experimental design

 仅由人为气溶胶浓度，或仅由气溶胶及气溶胶前体排放驱动的历史模拟，设置与 histALL 模拟相同（硫酸盐、黑碳、有机碳、氨、NOx 和 VOC）。

 Historical simulations forced by anthropogenic aerosol concentrations only or aerosol and aerosol precursor emissions only as in the histALL simulation (sulfate, black carbon, organic carbon, ammonia, NOx and VOCs).

 （1.3a）仅适用于 GHG 浓度变化不影响气溶胶、且气溶胶前体变化不影响臭氧的模式。

 (1.3a) is only for models in which changes in GHG concentrations do not affect aerosols and changes in aerosol precursors do not affect ozone.

此外，对于确实存在这些相互作用、但无法实施（1.3b）的模式，也应开展这一实验。

In addition models in which these interactions do occur, but for which (1.3b) cannot be implemented, should carry out this experiment.

（1.3b）仅人为气溶胶运行（histAERchem）

(1.3b) Anthropogenic-Aerosols-only runs (histAERchem)

o 实验设计

o the experimental design

 仅由气溶胶及气溶胶前体排放驱动的历史模拟，设置与 histALL 模拟相同（硫酸盐、黑碳、有机碳、氨、NOx 和 VOC）。

 Historical simulations forced by aerosol and aerosol precursor emissions only as in the histALL simulation (sulfate, black carbon, organic carbon, ammonia, NOx and VOCs).

 充分混合 GHG、气溶胶前体和臭氧前体的变化按照 histALL 运行规定。

 Changes in well-mixed-GHGs, aerosol precursors and ozone precursors are prescribed as in histALL runs.

然而，在辐射方案中，使用 piControl 运行的充分混合 GHG 浓度和臭氧气候态。

However, in the radiation scheme, the concentrations of well-mixed-GHGs and the ozone climatology from the piControl runs are used.

这一过程将能够模拟与 histALL 运行一致的气溶胶负荷，并模拟其对气候的影响。

This procedure will allow the simulation of aerosol burdens consistent with histALL runs, and the simulation of their influences on climate.

 （1.3b）仅适用于 GHG 浓度变化会影响气溶胶，或气溶胶前体变化会影响臭氧的模式。

 (1.3b) is only for models in which changes in GHG concentrations affect aerosols or changes in aerosol precursors affect ozone.

o 该实验所要解决的科学问题和/或空白

o the science question and/or gap being addressed with this experiment

气溶胶是历史和未来气候模拟中不确定性的一个关键来源，也是 TCR 和 ECS 约束具有高不确定性的首要原因。

Aerosols are a key source of uncertainty in historical and future climate simulations and the prime reason for high uncertainty in TCR and ECS constraints.

结合 histNAT 和 histALL 模拟，这些模拟将使我们能够把观测到的气候变化归因于自然强迫、气溶胶以及“GHG+臭氧+土地利用变化”的贡献。

Together with the histNAT and histALL simulations, these simulations will allow us to attribute observed climate changes to contributions from natural forcings, aerosols and “GHG+ozone+land-use change”.

由于气溶胶响应更加不确定、将被直接模拟，这种方法很可能会使可归因变暖的估计受到更严格的约束。

This approach will likely result in more tightly constrained estimates of attributable warming since the aerosol response, which is more uncertain, will be directly simulated.

o 与其他 MIP 可能产生的协同效应

o possible synergies with other MIPs

 RFMIP-ERF：结合 RFMIP-ERF 估计的辐射强迫与 DAMIP（histALL、histNAT、histGHG、histAER、ssp245GHG 和 ssp245AER）的瞬变气候响应，我们可以研究反馈和调整如何随强迫因子变化。

 RFMIP-ERF: Combining radiative forcing estimated from RFMIP-ERF and transient climate responses from DAMIP (histALL, histNAT, histGHG, histAER, ssp245GHG and ssp245AER), we can investigate how feedbacks and adjustments vary with forcing factors.

 RFMIP-Historical：DAMIP（histALL、histNAT、histAER）与 RFMIP-Historical 的组合，将能够把基于规定气溶胶演变的气候响应不确定性，与针对规定气溶胶前体排放的气候响应总体不确定性分离开来。

 RFMIP-Historical: Combinations of DAMIP (histALL, histNAT, histAER) and RFMIP-Historical will allow us to separate uncertainties in climate response based on specified aerosol evolution from the overall uncertainties in climate response to specified aerosol precursor emissions.

 ScenarioMIP：DAMIP 的 histALL、histNAT、histGHG、histAER、ssp245GHG、ssp245AER 与 ScenarioMIP 的 SSP2-4.5 相结合，可以为未来预测中的不确定性提供观测约束。

 ScenarioMIP: Combinations of histALL, histNAT, histGHG, histAER, ssp245GHG, ssp245AER of DAMIP and SSP2-4.5 of ScenarioMIP allow observational-constraints of uncertainties in future projections.

 AerChemMIP：histAER 和 AerChemMIP 的实验有助于理解对 NTCF 的气候响应。

 AerChemMIP: histAER and the experiments of AerChemMIP are useful to understand climate responses to NTCF.

o 该实验对（A）气候模拟界、（B）综合评估建模（IAM）界、（C）影响、适应与脆弱性（IAV）界以及（D）政策制定者的潜在益处

o potential benefits of the experiment to (A) climate modeling community, (B) Integrated Assessment Modelling (IAM) community, (C) Impacts Adaptation and Vulnerability (IAV) community, and (D) policy makers.

气溶胶是历史和未来气候模拟中不确定性的主要来源。

Aerosols are large uncertainty sources for historical and future climate simulations.

histAER 和 ssp245AER 实验将使气候模拟界进一步理解气溶胶对气候的影响。

The histAER and ssp245AER experiments will allow the climate modelling community to further understand aerosol impacts on climate.

由于水文循环和短波辐射对气溶胶敏感，histAER 和 ssp245AER 可能有助于开展有关水资源可获得性和短波辐射输入的影响研究。

Because the hydrological cycle and shortwave radiation are sensitive to aerosols, histAER and ssp245AER may be useful for impact studies regarding water availability and shortwave radiation inputs.

更好地理解气溶胶对气候的影响，对于制定控制气溶胶排放的政策也很重要。

A better understating of aerosol influence on climate is also important for policies controlling aerosol emissions.

层级 2 实验

Tier 2 experiments

（2.1）仅充分混合温室气体运行的延伸（ssp245GHG）

(2.1) Extension of well-mixed GHG-only run (ssp245GHG)

o 实验设计

o the experimental design

 使用 SSP2-4.5 浓度将 histGHG 运行延伸至 2100 年。

 extensions of histGHG runs up to 2100 using the SSP2-4.5 concentrations.

与 histGHG 一样，采用互动式化学方案的模式应关闭化学方案运行，或在辐射方案中使用臭氧的工业化前气候态。

As in histGHG, models with interactive chemistry schemes should either run with the chemistry scheme turned off or use a preindustrial climatology of ozone in the radiation scheme.

o 该实验所要解决的科学问题和/或空白

o the science question and/or gap being addressed with this experiment

histALL、histGHG、histNAT、ssp245GHG 和 SSP2-4.5（ScenarioMIP）的组合，将使我们能够估计受观测历史变化约束的未来温度变化。

Combinations of histALL, histGHG, histNAT, ssp245GHG and SSP2-4.5 (ScenarioMIP) will allow us to make estimates of future temperature changes that are constrained by observed historical changes.

气溶胶和 GHG 的模拟未来响应，将根据历史模拟中气溶胶和 GHG 响应为最佳拟合观测而必须乘以的缩放因子进行缩放。

Simulated future responses to aerosols and GHG are scaled based on the scaling factors by which the historical simulated responses to aerosols and GHG must be multiplied to best fit observations.

o 与其他 MIP 可能产生的协同效应

o possible synergies with other MIPs

 RFMIP-ERF：结合 RFMIP-ERF 估计的辐射强迫与 DAMIP（histALL、histNAT、histGHG、histAER、ssp245GHG 和 ssp245AER）的瞬变气候响应，我们可以研究反馈和调整如何随强迫因子变化。

 RFMIP-ERF: Combining radiative forcing estimated from RFMIP-ERF and transient climate responses from DAMIP (histALL, histNAT, histGHG, histAER, ssp245GHG and ssp245AER), we can investigate how feedbacks and adjustments vary with forcing factors.

 ScenarioMIP：可以分离 GHG 与其他人为强迫因子的未来气候变化信号。DAMIP 的 histALL、histNAT、histGHG、histAER、ssp245GHG、ssp245AER 与 ScenarioMIP 的 SSP2-4.5 相结合，可以为未来预测中的不确定性提供观测约束。

 ScenarioMIP: Allows the separation of future climate change signals of GHG and the other anthropogenic forcing factors. Combinations of histALL, histNAT, histGHG, histAER, ssp245GHG, ssp245AER of DAMIP and SSP2-4.5 of ScenarioMIP allow observational-constraints of uncertainties in future projections.

o 该实验对（A）气候模拟界、（B）综合评估建模（IAM）界、（C）影响、适应与脆弱性（IAV）界以及（D）政策制定者的潜在益处

o potential benefits of the experiment to (A) climate modeling community, (B) Integrated Assessment Modelling (IAM) community, (C) Impacts Adaptation and Vulnerability (IAV) community, and (D) policy makers.

histGHG 和 ssp245GHG 模拟可用于获得受观测约束的未来气候预测、气候敏感度、TCR 和 TCRE，这些结果是气候模拟、综合评估建模、影响适应与脆弱性以及政策制定者等广泛群体所关注的。

The histGHG and ssp245GHG simulations can be used to obtain observationally constrained future climate projections, climate sensitivity, TCR and TCRE that wide communities of CM, IAM, IAV and policy makers are interested in.

（2.2）仅平流层臭氧实验（histSOZ）

(2.2) Stratospheric-Ozone-only (histSOZ)

o 实验设计

o the experimental design

由平流层臭氧浓度变化驱动的历史模拟。

 Historical simulations forced by changes in stratospheric ozone concentrations.

在带耦合化学过程的模式中，应关闭化学方案，并规定 histALL 模拟的模拟集合平均月平均三维平流层臭氧浓度。

 In models with coupled chemistry, the chemistry scheme should be turned off, and the simulated ensemble mean monthly mean 3D stratospheric ozone concentrations from the histALL simulations should be prescribed.

对流层臭氧应固定为 piControl 的三维长期月平均值，并使用该 piControl 气候态中的 100 ppbv 臭氧浓度值来区分对流层与平流层。

Tropospheric ozone should be fixed at 3D long-term monthly mean piControl values, with a value of 100 ppbv ozone concentration in this piControl climatology used to separate the troposphere from the stratosphere.

在不带耦合化学过程的模式中，应规定 histALL 中规定的相同平流层臭氧。

 In models without coupled chemistry the same stratospheric ozone prescribed in histALL should be prescribed.

平流层臭氧浓度将由 CCMI 提供。

Stratospheric ozone concentrations will be provided by CCMI.

o 该实验所要解决的科学问题和/或空白

o the science question and/or gap being addressed with this experiment

平流层臭氧变化导致平流层温度发生了很大变化，也导致南半球环流发生变化，并伴随相关的气候影响。

Stratospheric ozone changes have driven large changes in stratospheric temperature, and are also responsible for driving circulation changes in the Southern Hemisphere, with associated climate impacts.

只有少数 CMIP5 模式开展了历史臭氧模拟。

Only a few CMIP5 models carried out historical ozone simulations.

更大的多模式集合将使我们能够更稳健地识别臭氧对平流层、对流层环流与气候、南大洋以及相关碳循环方面的影响，这种识别既可在模式中进行，也可能在观测中进行。

A larger multi-model ensemble will allow us to more robustly identify in models and perhaps also in observations the influence of ozone on the stratosphere, the tropospheric circulation and climate, and the Southern Ocean and associated carbon cycle aspects.

o 与其他 MIP 可能产生的协同效应

o possible synergies with other MIPs

 AerChemMIP：与 AerChemMIP 的仅 ODS 模拟进行比较，将能够把 ODS 的净气候效应与平流层臭氧变化的净气候效应进行比较，这是 WMO/UNEP 臭氧评估所关注的一个关键问题。

 AerChemMIP: Comparison with the ODS-only simulation of AerChemMIP will allow the net climate effects of ODSs to compared with the net climate effects of stratospheric ozone changes, a key issue of concern for the WMO/UNEP Ozone Assessment.

o 该实验对（A）气候模拟界、（B）综合评估建模（IAM）界、（C）影响、适应与脆弱性（IAV）界、（D）政策制定者以及（E）臭氧研究与政策界的潜在益处

o potential benefits of the experiment to (A) climate modeling community, (B) Integrated Assessment Modelling (IAM) community, (C) Impacts Adaptation and Vulnerability (IAV) community, (D) policy makers, and (E) Ozone research and policy community.

这些模拟将与（E）最为相关，因为它们将能够直接评估过去臭氧变化对气候的影响。

These simulations will be of most relevance to (E) since they will allow the climate impacts of past ozone changes to be directly assessed.

（2.3）仅平流层臭氧实验的延伸（ssp245SOZ/ssp245SOZchem）

(2.3) Extension of Stratospheric-Ozone-only run (ssp245SOZ/ssp245SOZchem)

o 实验设计

o the experimental design

使用 SSP2-4.5 情景将 histSOZ 延伸至 2100 年。

Extensions of histSOZ up to 2100 using the SSP2-4.5 scenario.

o 该实验所要解决的科学问题和/或空白

o the science question and/or gap being addressed with this experiment

这些模拟将能够评估未来平流层臭氧变化对未来气候变化的贡献，例如包括对未来南半球大气环流变化、海洋环流变化以及碳循环影响的贡献。

These simulations will allow the contribution of future stratospheric ozone changes to future climate change to be evaluated, including for example contributions to future Southern Hemisphere atmospheric circulation change, oceanic circulation changes, and carbon cycle impacts.

这些模拟将与未来的 WMO/UNEP 臭氧评估相关。

These simulations will be relevant to future WMO/UNEP Ozone Assessments.

o 与其他 MIP 可能产生的协同效应

o possible synergies with other MIPs

WGCM 冰冻圈气候组（Cryosphere CG）：仅臭氧实验与冰冻圈气候组（南极）尤为相关。

WGCM Cryosphere CG: Ozone-only experiments are particularly relevant for the Cryosphere CG (Antarctic).

o 该实验对（A）气候模拟界、（B）综合评估建模（IAM）界、（C）影响、适应与脆弱性（IAV）界、（D）政策制定者以及（E）臭氧研究与政策界的潜在益处

o potential benefits of the experiment to (A) climate modeling community, (B) Integrated Assessment Modelling (IAM) community, (C) Impacts Adaptation and Vulnerability (IAV) community, (D) policy makers, and (E) Ozone research and policy community.

这些模拟将与（E）最为相关，因为它们将能够直接评估未来平流层臭氧变化对气候的影响。

These simulations will be of most relevance to (E) since they will allow the climate impacts of future stratospheric ozone changes to be directly assessed.

层级 3 实验

Tier 3 experiments

（3.1）仅火山运行（histVLC）

(3.1) Volcanic-only run (histVLC)

o 实验设计

o the experimental design

由与 histALL 相同的火山强迫驱动的历史模拟

Historical simulations forced by volcanic forcing as in histALL

o 该实验所要解决的科学问题和/或空白

o the science question and/or gap being addressed with this experiment

histNAT、histVLC 和 histSOL 使我们能够研究火山和太阳对气候的影响，并检验可加性。

histNAT, histVLC and histSOL allow us to investigate volcanic and solar influences on climate and to check additivity.

CMIP5 集合倾向于高估历史火山响应。

The CMIP5 ensemble tended to overestimate the historical volcanic response.

histVLC 将用于更好地理解火山强迫和响应中的误差。

histVLC will be used for better understanding errors in the volcanic forcing and responses.

更好地理解自然强迫对气候的作用是若干 SPARC 活动（尤其是 Solaris/HEPPA 和 SSIRC）的关键目标之一。

To better understand the role of natural forcings for climate is among the key aims of several SPARC activities (in particular Solaris/HEPPA and SSIRC).

在这方面，仅含自然强迫的实验（histNAT、histVLC 和 histSOL）对 SPARC 有用。

In this respect the experiments with natural forcing only (histNAT, histVLC, and histSOL) are useful for SPARC.

o 与其他 MIP 可能产生的协同效应

o possible synergies with other MIPs

GeoMIP 与 VolMIP：利用 histVLC 可以对照观测验证模式的火山响应，而 GeoMIP 实验则无法做到。

GeoMIP & VolMIP: The volcanic response of models can be validated against observations using histVLC, whereas GeoMIP experiments cannot.

因此，histVLC 实验将为解释 GeoMIP 实验中各模式对平流层气溶胶的模拟响应提供有用的背景。

Thus histVLC experiments will provide useful context for interpreting simulated responses to stratospheric aerosol across models in the GeoMIP experiment.

虽然 VolMIP 包括对单次喷发的模拟，但它不包括对历史喷发的瞬态响应的模拟，从而能够更好地对照观测验证长期瞬态效应，而其重点在于 19 世纪的喷发。

While VolMIP includes simulations of individual eruptions it does not include simulations of the transient response to historical eruptions, allowing better validation of long-term transient effects against observations, and its focus is on 19th century eruptions.

o 该实验对（A）气候模拟界、（B）综合评估建模（IAM）界、（C）影响、适应与脆弱性（IAV）界以及（D）政策制定者的潜在益处

o potential benefits of the experiment to (A) climate modeling community, (B) Integrated Assessment Modelling (IAM) community, (C) Impacts Adaptation and Vulnerability (IAV) community, and (D) policy makers.

太阳辐射管理最近引起了气候模拟、IAM、IAV 和政策制定者等广泛群体的兴趣。

Solar radiation management has recently attracted interest from the wide communities of climate model, IAM, IAV and policy makers.

histVLC 实验可用于对照观测验证模式对平流层气溶胶注入的响应。

The histVLC experiment can be used for the validation of model responses to stratospheric aerosol injections against observations.

Historical simulations forced by solar forcing as in histALL

评估仅太阳效应，分离太阳和火山效应，并提供额外输出以阐明辐射、臭氧（交互式或规定式）以及平流层动力过程对太阳信号的重要性。

Assess solar-only effects, separate solar and volcanic effects, additional output to clarify importance of radiation, ozone (interactive or prescribed) and stratospheric dynamics for solar signals.

为评估太阳活动周期对预测的贡献，可以使用 SolarMIP 模拟来估计太阳强迫的离散度，并与 DCPP 的 A 部分进行比较（为此希望提供额外输出，见下文）

To assess solar cycle contribution to prediction, SolarMIP runs could be used to estimate solar forcing spread and compare with Component A of DCPP (for which additional output is desirable, see below)

o potential benefits of the experiment to (A) climate modeling community, (B) Integrated Assessment Modelling (IAM) community, (C) Impacts Adaptation and Vulnerability (IAV) community, and (D) policy makers.

主要是 A，较小程度上是 B 和 D。

Primarily A, to a lesser extent B and D.

Combinations of histALL, histAER, histNAT, ssp245AER and SSP2-4.5 (ScenarioMIP) will allow us to make estimates of future temperature changes that are constrained by observed historical changes.

结合 RFMIP-ERF 估计的辐射强迫与 DAMIP（histALL、histNAT、histGHG、histAER、ssp245GHG 和 ssp245AER）的瞬变气候响应，我们可以研究反馈和调整如何随强迫因子变化。

Combining radiative forcing estimated from RFMIP-ERF and transient climate responses from DAMIP (histALL, histNAT, histGHG, histAER, ssp245GHG and ssp245AER), we can investigate how feedbacks and adjustments vary with forcing factors.

o possible synergies with other MIPs

RFMIP-ERF：结合 RFMIP-ERF 估计的辐射强迫与 DAMIP（histALL、histNAT、histGHG、histAER、ssp245GHG 和 ssp245AER）的瞬变气候响应，我们可以研究反馈和调整如何随强迫因子变化。

RFMIP-ERF: Combining radiative forcing estimated from RFMIP-ERF and transient climate responses from DAMIP (histALL, histNAT, histGHG, histAER, ssp245GHG and ssp245AER), we can investigate how feedbacks and adjustments vary with forcing factors.

ScenarioMIP 与 AerChemMIP：可以分离气溶胶与其他人为强迫因子的未来气候变化信号。

DAMIP 的 histALL、histNAT、histGHG、histAER、ssp245GHG、ssp245AER 与 ScenarioMIP 的 SSP2-4.5 相结合，可以为未来预测中的不确定性提供观测约束。

Combinations of histALL, histNAT, histGHG, histAER, ssp245GHG, ssp245AER of DAMIP and SSP2-4.5 of ScenarioMIP allow observational-constraints of uncertainties in future projections.

o 该实验对（A）气候模拟界、（B）综合评估建模（IAM）界、（C）影响、适应与脆弱性（IAV）界以及（D）政策制定者的潜在益处

o potential benefits of the experiment to (A) climate modeling community, (B) Integrated Assessment Modelling (IAM) community, (C) Impacts Adaptation and Vulnerability (IAV) community, and (D) policy makers.

气溶胶是历史和未来气候模拟的巨大不确定性来源。

Aerosols are large uncertainty sources for historical and future climate simulations.

histAER 和 ssp245AER 实验将使气候模拟界能够进一步理解气溶胶对气候的影响。

The histAER and ssp245AER experiments will allow the climate modelling community to further understand aerosol impacts on climate.

由于水文循环和短波辐射对气溶胶敏感，histAER 和 ssp245AER 可能对有关水资源可用性和短波辐射输入的影响研究有用。

Because the hydrological cycle and shortwave radiation are sensitive to aerosols, histAER and ssp245AER may be useful for impact studies regarding water availability and shortwave radiation inputs.

更好地理解气溶胶对气候的影响对于控制气溶胶排放的政策也很重要。

A better understating of aerosol influence on climate is also important for policies controlling aerosol emissions.

（3.4）采用人为气溶胶排放/浓度替代估计的 histALL（histALL/estAER2；注：计划通过使用 ESGF 中的子实验字段来区分其与原始 histALL 提交的区别，尚待该字段在 CMIP6 中标准化）

(3.4) histALL with alternate estimates of anthropogenic aerosol emissions/concentrations (histALL/estAER2; Note distinction from original histALL submission is planned through use of the subexperiment field in the ESGF, pending standardisation of this field across CMIP6)

o 实验设计

o the experimental design

与 histALL 相同，但采用人为气溶胶排放或浓度变化的不同估计来强迫。

Same as histALL but forced with a different estimate of variations in anthropogenic aerosol emissions or concentrations.

我们正在与 CMIP6 的气溶胶排放/浓度工作组讨论，这些额外的历史排放/浓度情景的生产能否与标准的 CMIP6 历史估计并行开展。

We are discussing with the aerosol emissions/concentrations groups for CMIP6 about the possibility that the production of these additional historical emission/concentration scenarios can be produced in parallel with the standard historical CMIP6 estimate.

o 该实验所要解决的科学问题和/或空白

o the science question and/or gap being addressed with this experiment

该实验将使我们能够对气溶胶强迫中的不确定性进行采样，从而在可归因气候变化估计中计入这一不确定性来源。

This experiment will allow us to sample over uncertainties in aerosol forcing, and hence account for this source of uncertainty in estimates of attributable climate changes.

o 与其他 MIP 可能产生的协同效应

o possible synergies with other MIPs

C20C+ 检测与归因计划：C20C+ 的事件归因计划将利用 histALL/estAER2 以及 histNAT 和 histNAT/estNAT2 模拟，为其模拟无人为影响的假设反事实世界的 AGCM 模拟估计边界 SST 条件。

C20C+ Detection and Attribution Project: The event attribution project of C20C+ will make use of the histALL/estAER2 with the histNAT and histNAT/estNAT2 simulations to estimate boundary SST conditions for their AGCM simulations of the hypothetical counterfactual world without human influences.

o potential benefits of the experiment to (A) climate modeling community, (B) Integrated Assessment Modelling (IAM) community, (C) Impacts Adaptation and Vulnerability (IAV) community, and (D) policy makers.

该子实验将帮助我们研究过去气候变化对我们理解驱动这些变化的因素时存在的不确定性的敏感度。

This subexperiment will help us to investigate the sensitivity of past climate change to uncertainties in our understanding of what has been driving these changes.

尤其是，检验对历史气溶胶强迫不确定性的敏感度，将使我们更好地理解未来温室气体变暖的观测约束；就 A、C 和 D 而言，其意义在于能够对特定排放情景下未来气候变化预测中的不确定性做出更可信的估计。

In particular, testing the sensitivity to uncertainty in historical aerosol forcing will provide better understanding of the observational constraints of future greenhouse gas warming, with relevance to A, C, and D in terms of more confident estimates of uncertainty in predictions of future climate change under specified emissions scenarios.

（3.5）采用太阳和火山强迫替代估计的 histALL（histALL/estNAT2；注：计划通过使用 ESGF 中的子实验字段来区分其与原始 histALL 提交的区别，尚待该字段在 CMIP6 中标准化）

(3.5) histALL with alternate estimates of solar and volcanic forcing (histALL/estNAT2; Note distinction from original histALL submission is planned through use of the subexperiment field in the ESGF, pending standardisation of this field across CMIP6)

o the experimental design

与 histALL 相同，但采用太阳和火山强迫的第二套估计。

Same as histALL but with second estimates of solar and volcanic forcing.

我们正在与 CMIP6 的太阳和火山强迫工作组讨论，这些额外的历史强迫情景的生产能否与标准的 CMIP6 历史估计并行开展。

We are discussing with the solar and volcanic forcing groups for CMIP6 about the possibility that the production of these additional historical forcing scenarios can be produced in parallel with the standard historical CMIP6 estimates.

o 该实验所要解决的科学问题和/或空白

o the science question and/or gap being addressed with this experiment

该实验将使我们能够对自然强迫中的不确定性进行采样，从而在可归因温度变化估计中计入这一不确定性来源。

This experiment will allow us to sample over uncertainties in natural forcings, and hence account for this source of uncertainty in estimates of attributable temperature changes.

该实验还将使我们能够研究自然强迫不确定性对模拟年代际温度趋势的贡献，例如火山强迫的不确定性对过去二十年模拟温度趋势中的不确定性的贡献。

This experiment will also allow us to investigate the contribution of natural forcing uncertainties to simulated decadal temperature trends, such as for example the contribution of uncertainties in volcanic forcing to uncertainites in simulated temperature trends over the past two decades.

C20C+ 检测与归因计划：C20C+ 的事件归因计划将利用 histALL/estAER2 以及 histNAT 和 histNAT/estNAT2 模拟，为其模拟无人为影响的假设反事实世界的 AGCM 模拟估计边界 SST 条件。

C20C+ Detection and Attribution Project: The event attribution project of C20C+ will make use of the histALL/estAER2 with the histNAT and histNAT/estNAT2 simulations to estimate boundary SST conditions for their AGCM simulations of the hypothetical counterfactual world without human influences.

o 该实验对（A）气候模拟界、（B）综合评估建模（IAM）界、（C）影响、适应与脆弱性（IAV）界以及（D）政策制定者的潜在益处

o potential benefits of the experiment to (A) climate modeling community, (B) Integrated Assessment Modelling (IAM) community, (C) Impacts Adaptation and Vulnerability (IAV) community, and (D) policy makers.

归因研究的一个主要目标是区分历史气候变化中人为强迫与自然强迫所起作用的量级。

A primary goal of attribution studies is to distinguish the magnitude of the role of anthropogenic forcing against natural forcing in historical climate change.

有了这一估计，我们将能够理解这些估计对我们在认识过去自然强迫方面存在的局限的敏感度；就 D 而言，其意义在于理解对过去气候变化中人为作用的置信程度。

With this estimate we will be able to understand the sensitivity of these estimates to limits in our understanding of past natural forcings, with relevance for D in terms of understanding the confidence in the anthropogenic role in past climate change.

为保持 CMIP6 与以往 MIP 的一致性，我们将 histALL、histGHG 和 histNAT 置于层级 1。

To keep consistency between CMIP6 and the previous MIPs, we have histALL, histGHG and histNAT in Tier 1.

对 CMIP5 集合的分析表明，气溶胶仍然是检测与归因分析中最大的不确定性来源。

The analysis of the CMIP5 ensemble has highlighted that aerosols remain the largest source of uncertainty in D&A analyses.

因此，我们也将 histAER 列为高优先级，这将使气溶胶响应能够被直接估计，并减小回归系数中的不确定性。

Therefore we also propose histAER in the high priority, which will allow the aerosol response to be directly estimated and reduce uncertainties in regression coefficients.

histALL、histNAT、histGHG 和 histAER 与 RFMIP 和 AerChemMIP 的某些实验密切相关。

histALL, histNAT, histGHG and histAER correspond closely to some experiments of RFMIP and AerChemMIP.

ssp245GHG 模拟将用于对未来预测的观测约束，这将引起广泛群体的兴趣。

The ssp245GHG simulations will be used for observational constraints of future projections, which will attract interest from wide communities.

CCMI 和 AerChemMIP 要求将 histSOZ 和 ssp245SOZ 列为更高的优先级。

CCMI and AerChemMIP requested that histSOZ and ssp245SOZ be higher priority.

因此，我们也将 ssp245GHG、histSOZ 和 ssp245SOZ 置于层级 2。

Therefore we also place ssp245GHG, histSOZ and ssp245SOZ in Tier 2.

CMIP6 认可 MIP 归档的所有模式输出预计将在与 CMIP 输出相同的条款下提供。

All model output archived by CMIP6-Endorsed MIPs is expected to be made available under the same terms as CMIP output.

Most modeling groups currently release their CMIP data for unrestricted use.
