DCPP (Decadal Climate Prediction Project) ｜ 年代际气候预测计划（上）

年代际气候预测计划（DCPP）

The Decadal Climate Prediction Project (DCPP)

MIP 名称：年代际气候预测计划（DCPP）

Name of MIP: The Decadal Climate Prediction Project (DCPP)

MIP 联合主席：George Boer（george.boer@ec.gc.ca）、Doug Smith（doug.smith@metoffice.gov.uk）

Co-chairs of MIP: George Boer (george.boer@ec.gc.ca), Doug Smith (doug.smith@metoffice.gov.uk)

科学指导委员会成员：DCPP 小组由以下成员组成：

Members of the Scientific Steering Committee: The DCPP Panel consists of:

George Boer <George.Boer@ec.gc.ca>；Christophe Cassou <cassou@cerfacs.fr>；Francisco Doblas-Reyes <francisco.doblas-reyes@ic3.cat>；Gokhan Danabasoglu <gokhan@ucar.edu>；Ben Kirtman <bkirtman@rsmas.miami.edu>；Yochanan Kushnir <kushnir@ldeo.columbia.edu>；Kimoto Masahide <kimoto@aori.u-tokyo.ac.jp>；Jerry Meehl <meehl@ucar.edu>；Rym Msadek <rym.msadek@noaa.gov>；Wolfgang Mueller <wolfgang.mueller@mpimet.mpg.de>；Doug Smith <doug.smith@metoffice.gov.uk>；Karl Taylor <taylor13@llnl.gov>；Francis Zwiers <fwzwiers@uvic.ca>

George Boer <George.Boer@ec.gc.ca>, Christophe Cassou <cassou@cerfacs.fr>, Francisco Doblas-Reyes <francisco.doblas-reyes@ic3.cat>, Gokhan Danabasoglu <gokhan@ucar.edu>, Ben Kirtman <bkirtman@rsmas.miami.edu>, Yochanan Kushnir <kushnir@ldeo.columbia.edu>, Kimoto Masahide <kimoto@aori.u-tokyo.ac.jp>, Jerry Meehl <meehl@ucar.edu>, Rym Msadek <rym.msadek@noaa.gov>, Wolfgang Mueller <wolfgang.mueller@mpimet.mpg.de>, Doug Smith <doug.smith@metoffice.gov.uk>, Karl Taylor <taylor13@llnl.gov>, Francis Zwiers <fwzwiers@uvic.ca>

网站链接：DCPP 材料可见 http://www.wcrp‐climate.org/dcp‐overview 和 http://dcpp.pacificclimate.org/。

Link to website. DCPP material is available at (http://www.wcrp‐climate.org/dcp‐overview) and at (http://dcpp.pacificclimate.org/).

目标与概述：

Goals and overview:

CMIP 的年代际回报试验组成部分将借鉴其他协调试验的范例，作为一个由协议驱动的多模式、多国项目，并将数据生产和数据共享作为不可分割的组成部分。

The decadal hindcast component of CMIP will follow the example of other coordinated experiments as a protocol-driven multi-model multi-national project with data production and data sharing as integral components.

年代际预测组成部分的目标包括：

The Goals of the decadal prediction component of CMIP include:

促进年代际预测的科学研究与实践（预测时间尺度最长可达并包括 10 年）。

the promotion of the science and practice of decadal prediction (forecasts on timescales up to and including 10 years)

提供可能有助于 IPCC 第一工作组第六次评估报告（AR6）以及其他气候预测与演变研究和报告的信息。

the provision of information potentially useful for the IPCC WG1 AR6 assessment report and other studies and reports on climate prediction and evolution

生产并保留多年、多模式的年代际回报试验和预报数据集合，以支持气候科学并服务于全球气候服务框架。

the production and retention of a multi-year multi-model collection of decadal hindcast and forecast data in support of climate science and of use to the Global Framework for Climate Services

DCPP 的科学方面包括：

Scientific aspects of the DCPP include:

以系统视角考察年代际预测（数据；分析；初始条件；集合生成；模式与预报生产；后处理和评估）。

a system view (data; analyses; initial conditions; ensemble generation; models and forecast production; post processing and assessment) of decadal prediction

研究广泛问题（例如，可预报性的来源与上限、当前在年代际预测方面的能力、潜在应用等）。

investigation of broad questions (e.g. sources and limits of predictability, current abilities with respect to decadal prediction, potential applications, …)

提供用于比较模式改进和预测质量改进的基准。

provision of benchmarks against which to compare improvements in models and prediction quality

在回报试验和预报集合中提供有关过程与机制的信息，例如“停滞期”、气候跃迁、AMOC 等。

information on processes and mechanisms of interest, e.g., the hiatus, climate shifts, AMOC etc., in a collection of hindcasts and forecasts

实践方面包括：

Practical aspects include:

根据商定的试验结构和时间表协调工作，以促进研究、相互比较、多模式方法和应用，并为研究方向提供依据。

the coordination of efforts based on agreed experimental structures and timelines in order to promote research, intercomparison, multimodel approaches, applications, and to provide justification for research directions

促进基础设施建设，尤其是建立多用途的年代际回报试验和预报数据档案，以服务广泛的科学与应用问题，并使国家和国际气候预测及气候服务机构受益。

a contribution to the development of infrastructure, in particular a multi-purpose data archive of decadal hindcasts and forecasts useful for a broad range of scientific and application questions and of benefit to national and international climate prediction and climate services organizations

参考文献与出版物：

References and Publications:

许多年代际预测论文已发表，它们涉及 CMIP5 的年代际组成部分以及其他年代际预测结果。

Many decadal prediction papers have been published referring to the decadal component of CMIP5 and to other decadal prediction results.

AR5 第 11 章也提供了相关信息和相应参考文献。

Chapter 11 of the AR5 also gives information and pertinent references.

DCPP 计划为 GMD 的 CMIP6 专刊撰写一篇关于 DCPP 试验设计的论文，并将考虑与建模小组合作撰写一组受限的论文，介绍基本的多模式结果。

The DCPP intends to contribute a paper on the DCPP experimental design to the GMD CMIP6 special issue and will also consider a restricted set of co-authored papers with modeling groups giving basic multi-model results.

拟议试验概述：DCPP 组织为三个组成部分：

Overview of the proposed experiments: The DCPP is organized into three Components:

回报试验：与季节预测和气候模拟群体合作，设计并组织 CMIP6 的协调年代际预测（回报试验）组成部分。

Hindcasts: the design and organization of a coordinated decadal prediction (hindcast) component of CMIP6 in conjunction with the seasonal prediction and climate modelling communities

预报：持续开展试验性的准业务化年代际气候预报生产，以支持从年度到年代际的多模式预报及其应用。

Forecasts: the ongoing production of experimental quasi-operational decadal climate predictions in support of multi-model annual to decadal forecasting and the application of the forecasts

可预报性、机制与案例研究：组织和协调年代际气候可预报性研究，以及对特定气候跃迁和变化的案例研究，包括研究决定这些行为的机制。

Predictability, mechanisms, and case studies: the organization and coordination of decadal climate predictability studies and of case studies of particular climate shifts and variations including the study of the mechanisms that determine these behaviours

每个组成部分都在随附材料中作了详细说明。

Each component is explained in detail in the accompanying material

CMIP DECK 和 CMIP6 试验的拟议评估/分析概述：

Overview of the proposed evaluation/analysis of CMIP DECK and CMIP6 experiments:

DCPP 的独特之处在于，它汇集了来自多个群体的研究人员：这些群体分别专长于季节到年际预测（由 WGSIP 代表）、气候模拟（由 WGCM 代表）以及总体上的年代际变率与可预报性（由 CLIVAR 代表）。

The DCPP is unique in bringing together researchers from communities with expertise in seasonal to interannual prediction (as represented by WGSIP), climate simulation (as represented by WGCM), and decadal variability and predictability in general (as represented by CLIVAR).

所使用的模式和采用的方法，在不同程度上体现了这些群体的特殊兴趣与能力。

The models used, and approaches taken, represent to varying degrees the special interests and abilities of these communities.

对于气候模式，控制试验和敏感性试验是气候变化模拟的必要背景。

For climate models, control and sensitivity experiments are a necessary backdrop to climate change simulations.

DCPP 使用的大多数模式也将参与 CMIP6 的其他方面，并且已经完成 DECK 和 20 世纪气候变化积分，以及其他模拟和 MIP 积分。

Most models used in the DCPP will also participate in other aspects of CMIP6 and will have performed DECK and 20th century climate change integrations as well as other simulations and MIP integrations.

为这些研究保留的数据为许多不同方面的 DCPP 相关研究提供了背景。

The data retained for these studies provides a background for DCPP-related studies of many different aspects of decadal prediction.

因此，DCPP 强烈鼓励参与 DECK 试验。

The DCPP therefore strongly encourages participation in the DECK experiments.

不过，对于初始化气候预测，人们认识到，使用基于观测的信息进行初始化和验证是关键，也为理解模式和系统行为提供了另一种视角。

However, it is recognized that for initialized climate prediction, initialization and verification using observation-based information is key and provides an alternative vantage point for understanding model and system behavior.

来自预报群体的 DCPP 参与者，与来自气候模拟群体的参与者相比，可能较少强调理想化试验。

DCPP participants from the forecasting community may place less emphasis on idealized experiments compared to participants from the climate simulation community.

然而，这些预报模式通常与用于气候模拟的模式版本密切相关，而这些模式版本已有 DECK 模拟结果。

These forecasting models are, nevertheless, usually closely related to model versions which are used for climate simulation and for which the results of DECK simulations are available.

预报方面鼓励重视模式初始化的方法、预报集合的生成，尤其是根据观测评估结果。

The forecasting aspect encourages emphasis on methods of initializing models, generating ensembles of forecasts and, especially, on assessing results against observations.

这两种方法为理解和预测受强迫驱动的气候变化与内部生成的气候变化提供了互补视角。

The two approaches represent complementary views for the understanding and prediction of forced and internally generated climate variations.

DCPP 已制定一套分层的保留数据，以协助评估和分析。

A tiered set of retained data for the DCPP has been developed to assist in evaluation and analysis.

这套数据旨在涵盖用于验证和研究的最低限度预报与分析变量集合，但绝不意在限制各小组为其 DCPP 积分保留的数据量。

It is intended to encompass a minimum set of forecast and analysis variables for verification and investigation but is not intended in any way to restrict the amount of data that groups retain for their DCPP integrations.

特别是，这些数据旨在支持计算：

In particular, these data are intended to permit the calculation of:

与预报有关的平均值和变率统计量。

means and variability statistics pertaining to the forecasts

单模式和多模式的可预报性与技巧度量。

individual and multi-model predictability and skill measures

有关大气和海洋结构及其演变的信息。

information on atmospheric and oceanic structures and their evolution

有关系统收支和平衡的基本信息。

basic information on system budgets and balances

其他特殊用途数据包括：

Additional special purpose data include:

更高频率的数据（用于极端事件、风暴活动等分析）。

higher frequency data (for analysis of extremes, storminess etc.)

支持其他 MIP 的数据（见“MIP 连接表”）。

data in support of other MIPs (see the “MIP connection table”)

我们认为，DCPP 相对于 CMIP5 年代际预测组成部分代表了重要的演进式进步。

We believe that the DCPP represents an important evolutionary advance from the CMIP5 decadal prediction component.

DCPP 处理了一系列广泛但相互关联的科学问题，主要包括：系统在年代际时间尺度上的可预报能力、目前可获得的技巧、控制长时间尺度变率的机制，以及持续生产对科学和应用都可能有益的预报。

The DCPP addresses a broad but integrated range of scientific issues broadly characterized as the ability of the system to be predicted on decadal timescales, the currently available skill, the mechanisms that control long timescale variability, and the ongoing production of forecasts of potential benefit for both science and applications.

拟议时间安排：

Proposed timing:

年代际气候预测计划（DCPP）

The Decadal Climate Prediction Project (DCPP)

“年代际预测”一词涵盖年度、多年度到年代际时间尺度的预测。

The term “decadal prediction” encompasses predictions on annual, multi-annual to decadal timescales.

利用当前一代气候模式开展可预报性研究和回顾性预报（回报试验），来研究在这些时间尺度上作出有技巧预报的可能性以及实现这种预报的能力。

The possibility of making skilful forecasts on these timescales and the ability to do so is investigated by means of predictability studies and retrospective predictions (hindcasts) made using the current generation of climate models.

对相关气候参数进行有技巧的年代际预测，是 WCRP“提供区域气候信息”大挑战的一项关键交付成果（http://www.wcrp-climate.org/index.php/gc-regionalclimate）。

Skilful decadal prediction of relevant climate parameters is a Key Deliverable of the WCRP’s Grand Challenge of providing Regional Climate Information (http://www.wcrp-climate.org/index.php/gc-regionalclimate).

DCPP 由三个组成部分构成。

The DCPP consists of three Components.

邀请各小组参加其中任意一个或全部组成部分，每个组成部分都分别进行了“分层”。

Groups are invited to participate in any or all of the Components, each of which are separately “tiered”.

DCPP 组成部分 A

DCPP Component A

多年、多模式年代际回报试验

A multi-year multi-model decadal hindcast experiment

预计并非所有小组都会参加所有试验或所有层级。

It is not expected that all groups will participate in all experiments or tiers.

CMIP 的年代际回报试验组成部分借鉴其他协调试验的范例，作为一个由协议驱动的多模式、多国项目，并将数据生产和数据共享作为不可分割的组成部分。

The decadal hindcast component of CMIP follows the example of other coordinated experiments as a protocol-driven multi-model multi-national project with data production and data sharing as integral components.

年代际预测组成部分的目标包括：

The Goals of the decadal prediction component of CMIP include:

促进年代际预测的科学研究与实践（预测时间尺度最长可达并包括 10 年）。

the promotion of the science and practice of decadal prediction (forecasts on timescales up to and including 10 years)

提供可能有助于 IPCC 第一工作组第六次评估报告（AR6）以及其他气候预测与演变研究和报告的信息。

the provision of information potentially useful for the IPCC WG1 AR6 assessment report and other studies and reports on climate prediction and evolution

生产并保留多年、多模式的年代际回报试验数据集合，以支持气候科学并服务于全球气候服务框架（GFCS）。

the production and retention of a multi-year multi-model collection of decadal hindcast data in support of climate science and of use to the Global Framework for Climate Services (GFCS)

DCPP 组成部分 A 可贡献的科学方面包括：

Scientific aspects of the DCPP to which Component A can contribute include:

以系统视角考察年代际预测（数据；分析；初始条件；集合生成；模式与预报生产；后处理和评估）。

a system view (data; analyses; initial conditions; ensemble generation; models and forecast production; post processing and assessment) of decadal prediction

研究广泛问题（例如，可预报性的来源与上限、当前在年代际预测方面的能力、潜在应用等）。

investigation of broad questions (e.g. sources and limits of predictability, current abilities with respect to decadal prediction, potential applications, …)

提供用于比较模式改进和预测质量改进的基准。

provision of benchmarks against which to compare improvements in models and prediction quality

在回报试验集合中提供有关所关注过程与机制的信息（例如，“停滞期”、气候跃迁、AMOC 等）。

information on processes and mechanisms of interest (e.g., the hiatus, climate shifts, AMOC etc.) in a collection of hindcasts

组成部分 A 的实践方面包括：

Practical aspects of Component A include:

根据商定的试验结构和时间表协调工作，以促进研究、相互比较、多模式方法和应用，并为研究方向提供依据。

the coordination of efforts based on agreed experimental structures and timelines in order to promote research, intercomparison, multimodel approaches, applications, and to provide justification for research directions

促进基础设施建设，尤其是建立多用途的年代际回报试验数据档案，以服务广泛的科学与应用问题，并使国家和国际气候预测及气候服务机构受益。

a contribution to the development of infrastructure, in particular a multi-purpose data archive of decadal hindcasts useful for a broad range of scientific and application questions and of benefit to national and international climate prediction and climate services organizations

组成部分 A 的基本要素包括：

The basic elements of Component A are:

一套协调的多模式、多成员回顾性预报集合，每年从 1960 年至今进行初始化。

a coordinated set of multi-model multi-member ensembles of retrospective forecasts initialized each year from 1960 to the present

一个相关的数据集层级，其结果通常可供科学和应用群体获取和使用。

an associated hierarchy of data sets of results generally and readily available to the scientific and applications communities

组成部分 A 的咨询与时间安排：

Consultation and timing for Component A:

组成部分 A 的拟议时间安排总体遵循 CMIP6 所概述的安排（第 11 张幻灯片）。尤其是，历史强迫和未来情景信息的可获得性是 DCPP 时间安排的关键。

The proposed timing for Component A generally follows that outlined for CMIP6 (slide 11). In particular, the availability of historical forcing and future scenario information are key to DCPP timing.

下面列出了拟议的组成部分 A 年代际预测组成部分的详细信息。

Details of the proposed Component A decadal prediction component are listed below.

DCPP 组成部分 A 回报试验协议

DCPP Component A hindcast protocols

该方法类似于 CMIP5 的“Near-term Decadal”组成部分（Taylor et al., 2009, dated 22 January, 2011，以及位于 (http://cmippcmdi.llnl.gov/cmip5/experiment_design.html) 的《试验设计增补》），但存在重要差异。

The approach parallels that of the “Near-term Decadal” component of CMIP5 (Taylor et al., 2009, dated 22 January, 2011, together with the Experiment Design Addendum at (http://cmippcmdi.llnl.gov/cmip5/experiment_design.html) although with important differences.

请注意，在整个回报试验时段内，要求每年而不是每 5 年生成一次回报试验。

Note the call for hindcasts to be produced every year, rather than every 5 years, over the hindcast period

解释性说明

Explanatory comments

表 1 列出了 DCPP 组成部分 A 的主要试验。

Table 1 lists the main DCPP Component A experiments.

层级 1 回报试验与相应的 CMIP5 年代际预测试验相似，预报期间使用的规定强迫与层级 2 历史气候模拟（对应 CMIP6/历史模拟）所使用的规定强迫相同。

The Tier 1 hindcast experiment parallels the corresponding CMIP5 decadal prediction experiment in using the same specified forcing during the forecasts as is used for the Tier 2 historical climate simulations (which correspond to the CMIP6/historical simulations).

对历史强迫和情景强迫的规定，会相对于预报引入一些来自未来的信息，并可能导致历史预报技巧度量略有高估。

The specification of historical and scenario forcing introduces some information from the future with respect to the forecast and may lead to slightly overestimated historical forecast skill measures.

预计主要影响来自预报期间发生的火山爆发等短期辐射强迫的规定。

The main effect is expected to be due to the specification of short term radiative forcings such as volcanoes which occur during a forecast.

其他强迫，例如与温室气体和气溶胶排放和/或浓度有关的强迫，在预报的五年或十年期间变化相对缓慢，因此对结果影响很小。

Other forcings, such as those associated with greenhouse gas and aerosol emissions and/or concentrations, vary comparatively slowly over the five or ten year period of a forecast so affect the results very little.

使用规定强迫的好处包括：各模式之间使用共同值；便于在模式内处理；能够记录相对于 CMIP5 回报试验的改进；能够通过比较使用相同强迫的预报和模拟来估计初始化的影响；以及能够从包含这些强迫、因而更适合用于未来年代际预报的回报试验中估计漂移订正。

The benefits of using specified forcings include the use of common values across models, the ease of treatment within models, the possibility of documenting improvements with respect to CMIP5 hindcasts, the ability to estimate the effects of initialization by comparing forecasts and simulations which use the same forcings, and the estimation of drift corrections from hindcasts which include the forcings and so are more suitable for the purpose of future decadal forecasts.

组成部分 A 从 CMIP5 年代际组成部分获得的经验中受益并在其基础上发展。

Component A benefits from and builds on the experience gained from the decadal component of CMIP5.

DCPP 组成部分 A 要求每年而不是每 5 年开展回报试验，这将提高结果的统计稳定性，允许采用更复杂的漂移处理，更清楚地划分技巧水平，并促进改进预报的评估、组合和校准。

The DCPP Component A calls for hindcasts every year, rather than every 5 years which will improve the statistical stability of results, allow more sophisticated drift treatments, more clearly delineate skill levels, and foster improved assessment, combination, and calibration of the forecasts.

广泛参与组成部分 A 有可能根据模式中气候组成部分的纳入与初始化、模式分辨率（包括模式顶界），以及初始化和集合生成方法，对结果进行分层。

Broad participation in Component A will potentially allow stratification of results according to the inclusion and initialization of climate components in the models, of model resolutions including model tops, and of methods of initialization and ensemble generation.

DCPP 组成部分 A 也提供了研究太阳影响气候的机会。

DCPP component A also provides an opportunity to study solar effects on climate.

不过，要利用这一机会，各小组应使用正确的臭氧强迫时间序列，因为这对太阳变化的影响十分重要。

In order to take advantage of this, however, groups should use the correct ozone forcing timeseries which is important for the impact of solar variations.

表 2 列出了若资源允许则值得开展的其他试验。

Table 2 lists additional experiments which are of interest if resources permit.

层级 3 试验增加集合规模，以量化预期收益并为未来预报应用提供指导。

The Tier 3 experiment increases the ensemble size in order to quantify the expected benefits and as a guide to future forecast applications.

预计很少有小组（如果有的话）会开展层级 4 试验，因为这些试验需要额外投入大量资源。

It is not expected that many, if any, groups will undertake the Tier 4 experiments which require an additional large commitment of resources.

开展这些试验有助于量化在预报期间规定强迫的影响；列入这些试验是为了完整性，也为了在所需资源变得可用时能够开展。

These experiments are of interest in order to quantify the effects of specifying forcing during the forecast period and are included for completeness and in case the needed resources become available.

DECK 和 DECK/历史模拟。

DECK and DECK/historical simulations.

DCPP 的独特之处在于，它汇集了既专长于季节到年际预测、又专长于气候模拟的群体中的研究人员。

The DCPP is unique in bringing together researchers from communities with expertise in seasonal to interannual prediction as well as climate simulation.

对于气候模式，控制试验和敏感性试验是气候变化模拟的背景，DCPP 使用的大多数模式也将参与 CMIP6 的其他方面，并且已经完成 DECK 和 20 世纪气候变化积分。

For climate models, control and sensitivity experiments are a backdrop to climate change simulations and most models used in the DCPP will also participate in other aspects of CMIP6 and will have performed DECK and 20th century climate change integrations.

DCPP 强烈鼓励参与者开展 DECK 模拟，但也认识到这对所有小组而言可能不可行（例如，拟使用高分辨率模式进行预报的小组）。

The DCPP strongly encourages participants to perform the DECK simulations but recognizes that this may not be feasible for all groups (those proposing to use high resolution models for prediction for instance).

DECK 要求并不意味着应在这些特殊情况下阻止小组参与 DCPP。

It is not intended that the DECK requirements should bar DCPP participation in these special cases.

数据保留。

Data retention.

有关 DCPP 对 CMIP6 数据请求的输入，请参见文件 DCPP_CMIP6DataRequestCompilationTemplate.xlsx。

See the file (DCPP_CMIP6DataRequestCompilationTemplate.xlsx) for DCPP input to the CMIP6 Data Request.

这些请求适用于所有层级。

These requests apply to all Tiers.

数据将通过地球系统网格（ESG）提供，并与 CMIP5 保持平行，但协议按照 WGCM 基础设施小组（WIP）的规定作出更改。

Data are to be served via the Earth System Grid (ESG) and to parallel CMIP5 although with changes to protocols as specified by the WGCM Infrastructure Panel (WIP).

目前，用于动力降尺度的 6 小时一次年代际预测数据不被视为优先事项。

At this time, 6-hourly decadal prediction data for dynamical downscaling are not considered a priority.

希望与 WIP 合作，在各 MIP 之间制定一套协调的“基础”或“通用”分层数据表，同时制定与各个 MIP 相关联的“MIP 专用”数据表。

The hope is that, in conjunction with the WIP, a coordinated set of “basic” or “common” tiered data tables can be developed across MIPs together with “MIP specific” tables associated with individual MIPs.

DCPP 组成部分 B

DCPP Component B

实时多模式年代际预报试验

Experimental real-time multi-model decadal predictions

CMIP 的实时年代际预测组成部分将借鉴其他协调试验的范例，作为一个由协议驱动的多模式、多国项目，并将数据生产和数据共享作为不可分割的组成部分。

The real-time decadal prediction component of CMIP will follow the example of other coordinated experiments as a protocol-driven multi-model multi-national project with data production and data sharing as integral components.

它将建立在季节预报已经采用的 WMO 结构之上。

It will build on the WMO structure already in place for seasonal forecasts.

预报和验证统计量将通过 WMO 指定的“牵头中心”在网上提供，并通过 ESGF 镜像。

Forecasts and verification statistics will be made available via the web at WMO designated “Lead Centres” and mirrored via the ESGF.

牵头中心将从指定的“贡献中心”收集预报和验证数据。

Lead Centres will collect forecast and verification data from designated “Contributing Centres”.

牵头中心将制作包含不确定性的多模式预报，并保存贡献中心以往实时预报的档案，同时随着验证观测资料可用而开展性能评估。

Lead Centres will produce a multi-model forecast together with uncertainties, and maintain an archive of previous real-time forecasts from Contributing Centres along with an assessment of performance as verifying observations become available.

目标

Goals

通过生成实时多模式年代际预报，促进年代际预测的科学研究与实践。

the promotion of the science and practice of decadal prediction by generating real-time multi-model decadal predictions

持续生产并保留多年、多模式的年代际预报数据，以支持全球气候服务框架（GFCS）。

the production and retention of ongoing multi-year multi-model decadal forecast data in support of the Global Framework for Climate Services (GFCS)

提供可能有助于 IPCC 第一工作组第六次评估报告（AR6）以及其他气候预测与演变研究和报告的信息。

the provision of information potentially useful for the IPCC WG1 AR6 assessment report and other studies and reports on climate prediction and evolution

科学方面

Scientific aspects

评估对关键变量的年代际预报，包括温度、降水、平均海平面气压、AMO、PDO、北极海冰、NAO 和热带风暴。

assess decadal predictions of key variables including temperature, precipitation, mean sea level pressure, the AMO, PDO, Arctic sea ice, the NAO, and tropical storms

评估不确定性并生成共识预报。

assess uncertainties and generate a consensus forecast

使人们能够评估相关气候预报的、具有社会意义的影响。

permit the assessment decadal predictions of associated climate impacts of societal relevance

实践方面

Practical aspects

根据下述协议所规定的商定试验结构和时间表协调工作。

the coordination of efforts based on agreed experimental structures and timelines as specified in the protocol below

促进基础设施建设，尤其是建立正在进行的年代际预报多用途数据档案，以服务广泛的科学与应用问题，并使国家和国际气候预测及气候服务机构受益。

the contribution to the development of infrastructure, in particular a multi-purpose data archive of ongoing decadal forecasts useful for a broad range of scientific and application questions and of benefit to national and international climate prediction and climate services organizations

基本要素

The basic elements

一套持续协调的多模式、多成员实时预报集合，每年更新。

an ongoing coordinated set of multi-model multi-member ensembles of real-time forecasts updated each year.

一个相关的数据集层级，其结果通常可供科学和应用群体获取和使用。

an associated hierarchy of data sets of results generally and readily available to the scientific and applications communities

说明性评论

Explanatory comment

组成部分B的实时年代际预报目前正基于CMIP5及其他模式和回报数据集进行制作。

Component B real-time decadal forecasts are currently being produced based on CMIP5 and other models and hindcast data sets.

其意图是：这些模式产生的预报将随着组成部分A结果的产出而得到扩充和/或被其取代。

The intent is that the forecasts produced by these models will be augmented and/or replaced by Component A results as they become available.

DCPP组成部分C：可预报性、机制与个例研究

DCPP Component C: Predictability, Mechanisms and Case Studies

气候系统在多个时间尺度上发生变化，可用基于物理的模型和统计模型加以研究。

The climate system varies on multiple timescales which may be studied using physically based and statistical models.

诊断研究考察从长期观测序列和/或模式模拟中间接推断出的气候系统行为。

Diagnostic studies investigate climate system behaviour inferred indirectly from a long series of observations and/or model simulations.

预测研究考察当初始条件或模式特性（如物理参数化、数值方案或强迫）被扰动时模式的行为。

Prognostic studies investigate the behaviour of models when initial conditions or model features such as physical parameterizations, numerics or forcings are perturbed.

所涉机制备受关注，因为它们支撑着系统的固有可预报性，并决定着预报技巧。

The mechanisms involved are of great interest as they underpin the inherent predictability of the system and as they govern forecast skill.

基于模式的可预报性研究常被称为"完美模式"研究，其含义是：就计算机代码而言，人们对被模拟的气候系统拥有完备的认识。

Predictability studies based on models are often referred to as “perfect model” studies in the sense that one has perfect knowledge of the modelled climate system in terms of the computer code.

然而，它们仅在模式与实际系统足够相似的程度上代表"可实现的可预报性"，因此研究其适用性也很重要。

However, they represent “attainable predictability” only to the extent that the model is sufficiently similar to the real system and it is important also to study their applicability.

可预报性研究旨在指明哪些区域和时间尺度上可能做出有技巧的预报，也可用于研究所涉物理机制与过程的各个方面。

Predictability studies are intended to give an indication of the regions and timescales for which skilful forecasts may be possible and may also be used to study aspects of the physical mechanisms and processes involved.

可预报性信息既可从年代际预测集合的输出中推断，也可从独立的可预报性试验中获得。

Predictability information can be inferred from the output of ensembles of decadal predictions as well as from independent predictability experiments.

个例研究是针对某一特定气候事件及其相关机制和影响开展的回报研究。

Case studies are hindcasts which focus on a particular climatic event and the mechanisms and impacts involved.

它们通常是对已观测事件进行的回报研究，但也可包括模式积分中的特定类型事件（例如模式中大西洋经向翻转环流的变化及与之相关的北大西洋海表温度的变化）。

These are typically hindcast studies of an observed event although they can include particular kinds of events in model integrations (variations of AMOC and the associated variation of N Atlantic SSTs in models are an example).

对特定事件（如增暖停滞、气候突变、极端年份等）可预报的技巧，以及对支持（或可能妨碍）有技巧预测的机制的研究，都是关注点。

Studies of the skill with which a particular event (e.g. the hiatus, climate shift, an extreme year, etc.) can be forecast and the mechanisms which support (or perhaps make difficult) a skilful prediction are all of interest.

DCPP与CLIVAR正提议就数量有限的机制/可预报性/个例研究开展协调的多模式研究，这些研究被认为对学界具有广泛意义。

The DCPP and CLIVAR are proposing coordinated multi-model investigations of a restricted number of mechanism/predictability/case studies believed to be of broad interest to the community.

目前组成部分C聚焦于两个研究领域，即：

Two research areas are the current foci of Component C. They are:

Hiatus+：研究全球平均温度（及其他变量）长时间尺度变化的起源、机制与可预报性，包括增暖加速与变冷两类时期，并聚焦于当前的"增暖停滞"。

Hiatus+: an investigation of the origin, mechanisms and predictability of long timescale variations in global mean temperature (and other variables) including periods of both enhanced warming and cooling with a focus on the current “hiatus”

火山与预测：研究火山喷发对年代际预测及可预报性的影响与后果。

Volcanoes and prediction: an investigation of the influence and consequences of volcanic eruptions on decadal prediction and predictability

所提议试验的描述见下文。

A description of the proposed experiments is found below.

表1所提议的试验旨在揭示模式如何响应施加于热带太平洋和北大西洋的简单外加强迫。

The proposed experiments in Table 1 are intended to discover how models respond to simple imposed forcings in the tropical Pacific and in the North Atlantic.

核心问题是：模式对强迫响应的一致性，以及外加强迫经由何种途径在整个海洋和大气中表现出来，特别是这如何揭示模式行为及其与全球温度变化减缓或加速、与区域气候距平之间可能存在的机制联系。

The questions at issue are the consistency of models’ responses to the forcings and the pathways through which the imposed forcings are expressed throughout the ocean and atmosphere, especially as this illuminates model behaviour and possible mechanistic links to retarded and accelerated global temperature variations and regional climate anomalies.

换言之，我们能在多大程度上把全球平均温度的调制归因于海洋变化，东太平洋和北大西洋各自扮演什么角色，又能在多大程度上把区域尺度的年代际气候距平归因于大西洋多年代际变率（AMV）和太平洋年代际变率（IPV）？

In other words, to what extent can we attribute modulations of global mean temperatures to ocean variations, what are the respective roles of the Eastern Pacific and North Atlantic, and to what extent can we attribute decadal climate anomalies at regional scale to the AMV and IPV.

AMV事件是否是IPV变化的先兆（反之亦然），其中起作用的机制又是什么？

Are AMV events a precursor of IPV shifts and vice versa and what are the mechanisms at play?

表2所提议的试验研究20世纪90年代中期副极地环流增暖的可预报性及其对气候变率的影响。

The proposed experiments in Table 2 investigate the predictability of the mid-1990s warming of the subpolar gyre, and its impact on climate variability.

表3所提议的试验旨在认识火山对过去以及潜在未来年代际预测的影响。

The proposed experiments in Table 3 are directed toward an understanding of the effects of volcanoes on past and potentially on future decadal predictions.

平流层气溶胶负荷引起的辐射效应，以及随之而来的动力效应和/或耦合动力模态，都是关注点。

Radiative effects arising from the aerosol loading in the stratosphere, together with subsequent dynamical effects and/or coupled dynamical modes, are of interest.

欢迎参与者开展其感兴趣的尽可能多的组成部分C试验。

Participants are invited to undertake as many of the Component C experiments as are of interest to them.

组成部分C试验方案的更多细节请参见本节末尾的"说明"。

Please see the Notes at the end of the section for additional details of the Component C experimental protocol.
