说明

Notes

试验C1.1遵循Kosaka和Xie（2013）的设计，即在耦合模式模拟中将观测的海表温度距平施加于热带太平洋区域。

Experiment C1.1 follows the design of Kosaka and Xie (2013) in which observed SST anomalies are imposed in the tropical Pacific region in coupled model simulations.

结果将与标准的历史模拟相比较，以推断热带太平洋海表温度的影响。具体而言：

The results will be compared to the standard historical simulations to infer the impact of the tropical Pacific SSTs. In particular:

– 观测的逐月海表温度距平（基准期1950–2014年）（将提供）叠加在由历史模拟计算的同期模式气候态上，以避免模式漂移。

- Observed monthly SST anomalies (base period 1950-2014) (to be supplied) are superimposed on the model climatology over the same period computed from historical simulations in order to avoid model drift..

– 海表温度信号的施加方式可以是改变地表通量，也可以直接对海表温度进行恢复。

- The SST signal is imposed either by altering surface fluxes or by restoring the SST directly.

建议恢复系数取相当于50米混合层的40 Wm⁻²K⁻¹。

A restoring coefficient equivalent to 40 Wm-2K-1 for a 50m mixed layer is recommended.

为使冲击最小，恢复系数应在环绕恢复区域的8°缓冲区内递减至零。

To minimise shocks, the restoring coefficient should decrease to zero over an 8o buffer zone bounding the restored region.

存在海冰时不进行恢复。

No restoring if sea ice present.

在恢复区域之外，模式自由演变，从而使气候系统得以完全响应。

Outside of the restoring region the model evolves freely allowing full climate system response.

– 为了对海洋初始状态的不确定性进行采样，建议（如有可能）通过从不同的历史模拟中取初始条件来生成集合成员。

- In order to sample uncertainties in the ocean initial state it is recommended that, if possible, ensemble members are generated by taking initial conditions from different historical simulations.

否则，可通过扰动大气条件来生成集合。

Otherwise, ensembles may be generated by perturbing atmospheric conditions.

– 试验应覆盖1950至2014年时段，但如有可能，宜从1920年开始。

- Experiments should cover the period from 1950 to 2014, but starting from 1920 is desirable if possible.

外部强迫同历史模拟。

External forcings as for historical simulations.

试验C1.2沿用试验C1.1，但使用北大西洋而非热带太平洋的观测海表温度距平。

Experiment C1.2 follows experiment C1.1 but uses observed SST anomalies in the North Atlantic rather than the tropical Pacific.

试验表明，大西洋的海表温度恢复可能导致大西洋经向翻转环流（AMOC）出现不利响应，进而引起其他区域（包括南大西洋）海表温度的变化，从而掩盖结果。

Tests have shown that SST restoring in the Atlantic may lead to an undesirable response of the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC) and hence of SSTs in other regions (including the south Atlantic) which can obscure the results.

建议各组监测这一潜在响应，必要时采取措施使其最小化。

It is recommended that groups monitor this potential response and take steps to minimise it if necessary.

使AMOC响应最小化的一种方法是施加额外的盐度恢复，使上层海洋密度保持不变。

One way to minimise the AMOC response is to apply additional salinity restoring such that the upper ocean density remains unchanged.

另一种方法是在混合层以下对温度和盐度进行三维恢复。

Another approach is to perform 3D restoring of temperature and salinity below the mixed layer.

有证据表明，模式中大气对北大西洋海表温度响应的信噪比相对较弱，因此如有可能，请增加集合成员（最多25个）。

There is evidence that the signal to noise of the atmospheric response to North Atlantic SST is comparatively weak in models and additional ensemble members (up to 25) are requested if possible.

试验C1.3和C1.4沿用试验C1.2，但将海表温度距平分别施加于副极地和副热带区域，以评估两者的相对重要性。

Experiments C1.3 and C1.4 follow experiment C1.2 but apply the SST anomalies in the subpolar and subtropical regions separately in order to assess their relative importance.

试验C1.5–1.7与试验C1.2类似，但使用理想化的海表温度型（将提供）。

Experiments C1.5-1.7 are similar to experiment C1.2 but use an idealised SST pattern (which will be supplied).

该型由观测与耦合模式历史模拟集合平均值之差导出（Ting等，2009），是对非强迫内部变率的估计。

This pattern is derived from the difference between observations and the ensemble mean of coupled model historical simulations (Ting et al 2009) and is an estimate of unforced internal variability.

尽管该估计并不完美——因为模式对外部因子（如人为气溶胶）的响应可能不完全正确——但这些试验仍能提供气候对北大西洋海表温度变化响应的信息。

Although this estimate is not perfect, since the modelled response to external factors such as anthropogenic aerosols may not be entirely correct, the experiments nevertheless provide information on the climate response to North Atlantic SST variations.

结果基于模式控制积分而非历史模拟，因此可在更新后的CMIP6强迫可用之前开展。

Results are based on model control integrations rather than historical simulations and therefore may be performed before the updated CMIP6 forcings become available.

【参考文献边界说明】以下两条文献条目按原样保留，不作翻译：

[References boundary note] The following two reference entries are kept as-is, untranslated:

Kosaka, K. and S-P. Xie (2013) Recent global-warming hiatus tied to equatorial Pacific surface cooling, Nature, 501, 403–407

Kosaka, K. and S-P. Xie (2013) Recent global-warming hiatus tied to equatorial Pacific surface cooling, Nature, 501, 403–407

Ting M, Kushnir Y, Seager R, Li C (2009) Forced and internal twentieth-century SST in the North Atlantic, J Clim 22: 1469-1881, doi: 10.1175/2008JCLI2561.1

Ting M, Kushnir Y, Seager R, Li C (2009) Forced and internal twentieth-century SST in the North Atlantic, J Clim 22: 1469-1881, doi: 10.1175/2008JCLI2561.1

年代际气候预测计划（DCPP）

The Decadal Climate Prediction Project (DCPP)

以下逐条回应邮件中的各个问题和意见。

We respond below to the various questions and comments in the email.

Aspen研讨会在审查各项活动和细化组成部分C的细节方面非常成功。

The Aspen Workshop was very successful in reviewing activities and in improving the details of Component C.

我们相信DCPP是对CMIP6的重要贡献，现尝试回应您在下方提出的各点：

We believe that the DCPP is an important contribution to CMIP6 and attempt to respond to the points you raise below:

1. "也许可以让组成部分A的第1层完全脱离DECK和CMIP6历史模拟运行。DCPP是否考虑调换组成部分A中各层的顺序？"

1. "It is probably possible to run Component A Tier 1 completely disconnected of the DECK and the CMIP6 Historical Simulation. Would DCPP consider switching round the Tiers in Component A?"

我们认为，交换组成部分A第1层与第2层的顺序并不妥当。

It would not be appropriate to exchange Component A Tier 1 and Tier 2 in our view.

第1层是DCPP的基本"预测/可预报性"试验，没有它，我们对自身开展年代际预测能力的了解将十分有限。

Tier 1 is the basic "prediction/predictability" experiment of the DCPP without which we would learn very little about our capability to make decadal predictions.

我们同意它并不直接依赖DECK和CMIP6历史模拟，但我们相信几乎所有组都会执行DECK试验。

We agree that it is not directly dependent on the DECK and CMIP6/historical, although we believe that substantially all groups will perform the DECK experiments.

然而，我们也认为，年代际预测为审视模式和系统行为提供了另一种补充途径，它与传统上属于CMIP的历史/未来模拟方法相辅相成。

However, we also argue that decadal prediction provides an additional and alternative way of viewing model and system behaviour that compliments the historical/future simulation approach that has traditionally been part of CMIP.

组成部分A第1层的"预测"（而非模拟）试验为研究和理解气候变异带来了新的可能，比模拟中能做到的更直接、更具时间依赖性。

The Component A Tier 1 "prediction" (rather than simulation) experiment brings new possibilities for investigating and understanding climate variation which are more direct and time-dependent than is possible in simulations.

观测与预测之间紧密而直接的联系尤为重要。

The strong and direct connection between observations and predictions is particularly pertinent.

2. "顺带一提，您可能已看到，我们向模式组发出了一封相关邮件……在入门卡模拟负担过重的特殊情况下……可在逐模式的基础上对此政策给予例外……"

2. "As a side note, you might have seen, we have sent out a related email to the model groups ... in the special case where the burden of the entry card simulations are prohibitive...an exception to this policy can be granted on a model to model basis..."

据我们所知，几乎所有组成部分A的参与者都将同时执行DECK和CMIP6历史模拟。

As far as we are aware, virtually all Component A participants will perform both DECK and CMIP6/historical simulations.

可能有一两个潜在参与组（例如使用高分辨率模式的组）没有资源承担全部DECK模拟。

It may be the case that one or two potentially participating groups, with high resolution models for instance, will not have the resources to undertake all of the DECK simulations.

我们认为，将此类组排除在组成部分A之外是错误的，因为它们可能被证明比低分辨率模式更能刻画支配短期气候变率的物理过程，从而获得更高技巧。

It would, in our view, be a mistake to exclude such groups from participating in Component A since they may prove to be better able to represent the physical processes governing short term climate variability and thereby to attain higher skill, than lower resolution models.

例如，考察分辨率会带来什么差异，无疑很有意义。

It would certainly be of interest to see what difference resolution would make for instance.

我们担心，如果DECK要求过于僵化，将因阻碍参与组成部分A而对DCPP产生不利影响（您会记得例如在Offenbach的讨论）。

We are concerned that if the DECK requirements are too rigid it will have a detrimental impact on the DCPP by preventing participation in Component A (you will recall the discussion in Offenbach for example).

对此我们的回应是：敦促遵守DECK要求，但指出它在所有情况下并非一项硬性要求。

Our response to this is to urge DECK compliance but indicate that it is not a rigid requirement under all circumstances..

3. "关于组成部分A第2层，不清楚为何没有提及CMIP6历史模拟的额外集合成员……"

3. "For Tier 2 of Component A it is unclear why there is no mentioning of additional ensemble members of the CMIP6 Historical Simulation ....."

组成部分A第2层要求的正是这一点，即10个历史模拟的集合（延伸至2030年，以与2020年初始化的年代际预测相重叠）。

Component A Tier 2 calls for exactly this, namely an ensemble of 10 historical simulations (which are extended to 2030 to overlap with decadal predictions initialized in 2020).

与CMIP6历史模拟的联系已在"说明性评论"中提及，并已加入表1第2层的标题。

The connection with the CMIP6/historical simulations is mentioned in the Explanatory comments and has been added to the Table 1, Tier 2 heading.

4. "试验电子表格"

4. "Experiment Spreadsheet"

请参阅附件中更新的电子表格。

Please see the updated Spreadsheet, attached.

5. "试验设计。每个试验的科学依据都很清楚，但需要在GMD论文中进一步具体化……"

5. "Experiment Design. The science rationale for each experiment is clear, but need to be further specified in the GMD paper....."

在Aspen研讨会（会上细节得到了广泛讨论并商定）之后，我们已准备了扩充的"说明"，作为组成部分C描述的一部分。

Following the Aspen Workshop, where details were extensively discussed and agreed upon, we have prepared expanded "Notes" as part of the Component C description.

当然，我们也将在GMD论文中提供依据和细节。

We will, of course, provide rationales and details also in the GMD paper.

6. "组成部分B只有在组成部分A已运行的情况下才有意义（即组成部分A应作为组成部分B的入门卡）。"

6. "Component B only makes sense if Component A has been run (i.e., Component A should be an entry card for Component B)."

如项目描述所述，组成部分B的实时年代际预报目前正基于CMIP5模式和回报数据集制作。

As noted in the project description, Component B real-time decadal forecasts are currently being produced based on CMIP5 models and hindcast data sets.

其意图是：随着组成部分A结果逐步产出，这些模式产生的预报将得到扩充，并最终被取代。

The intent is that the forecasts produced by these models will be augmented, and subsequently replaced, by Component A results as they become available.

这样，实时年代际预报活动将以自然的方式演变和改进。

In this way the real-time decadal forecasting activity will evolve and improve in a natural way.

如组成部分B描述所指出的，正在开展探索性工作，使组成部分B与WMO已建立的季节预报体系相衔接。

As indicated in the description of Component B, there are exploratory efforts to align Component B with the WMO structure already in place for seasonal forecasts.

其最终意图是服务于应用和全球气候服务框架（GFCS）。

The intent is ultimately to contribute to applications and the GFCS.

组成部分B的显著之处在于它同时推动科学与应用。

Component B is notable in that it promotes both science and applications.

7. "……提案中并不总是清楚说明这一新工作将如何建立在CMIP5的成果之上，以及有何不同或改进……"

7. "... it is not always clear in the proposal how this new effort will build on achievements from CMIP5 and what is different or better....."

该意见中提到的各点都切中要害，在我们看来，它们已隐含于DCPP和组成部分A的前言之中。

All of the points mentioned in this comment are pertinent and, it seemed to us, to be implicit in the preamble to the DCPP and Component A.

我们已在组成部分A的"说明"中对此作了扩展。

We have expanded on this in the Component A Notes.

8. "数据需求：DCPP应建议其数据清单也从CMIP6历史模拟中收集……"

8. "Data request: DCPP should recommend that their list of data should also be collected from the CMIP6 Historical Simulation..."

我们一贯如此打算，现已在"数据保留"一节中明确指出：数据需求适用于"所有层"。

We always intended this to be the case and now state it explicitly under "Data retention" that the data request applies to “all Tiers”.

数据处理是CMIP6基础设施的一个重要方面，我们正急切等待有关其处理方式的更多信息。

The treatment of data is a major CMIP6 infrastructure feature and we are anxiously awaiting more information on how this will be handled.

9. "科学分析计划：该科学分析计划相当笼统……"

9. "Scientific analysis plan: The scientific analysis plan is rather general ....".

DCPP是一个相对较新的研究领域，且发展迅速。

The DCPP is a comparatively new area of research and is evolving rapidly.

核心的宏观问题是：有技巧的年代际预测在多大程度上是可能的，当前已有技巧的全球分布格局如何，以及所涉机制的识别。

The broad questions at issue are the extent to which skillful decadal predictions are possible, the global patterns of currently available skill, and the identification of the mechanisms involved.

每个组成部分都针对这些宏观问题中的一个或多个。

Each of the Components is directed toward one or more of these broad questions.

DCPP的主要产出之一将是一个数据集，它将鼓励（尤其是更广泛的诊断学界）对年代际预测所关注的一系列问题（如初始化方法、集合生成、模式漂移与偏差等）进行分析。

One of the main outputs of the DCPP will be a data set which will encourage analysis, especially by the broader diagnostics community, of the array of questions that are of interest to decadal prediction (e.g. methods of initialization, ensemble generation, model drift and bias, etc. etc.).

我们知道，如果DCPP数据易于获取，将会催生许多多样而新颖、富有意义的分析。

If DCPP data is readily available we know it will encourage many diverse and novel analyses of interest.

我们认为现阶段限制或引导这些分析并无益处，宁愿依靠科学（自由）事业来挖掘DCPP成果。

We do not feel it would be profitable, at this stage, to restrict or direct these analyses, and we would rather count on scientific (free) enterprise to exploit DCPP results.

10. "尚不清楚DCPP是否愿意向GMD的CMIP6专刊投稿……"

10. "It was not clear if DCPP is willing to contribute an article to the GMD CMIP6 special issue...."

我们也不太确定这一点应出现在文件中的何处。

We were not entirely clear as to where in the document this should appear.

现已在申请的"参考文献与出版物"一节中明确提及。

This is now mentioned explicitly under the “References and Publications” section of the application.

11. "……也请回应Martin Juckes关于编制数据需求所需信息的任何请求……"

11. "... please also respond to any requests from Martin Juckes concerning information needed to prepare the data request...."

我们已回应Juckes的请求，并随时准备回应后续事宜。

We have responded to Juckes' requests and stand ready to respond to follow up.

CMIP6背书的"标准3"对模式组、也对CMIP本身都是一项重大责任。

The CMIP6 endorsement "Criterion 3" represents a major responsibility for modelling groups but also for CMIP.

我们最近与ESGF和WIP网站的互动并不令人乐观，我们正等待对数据保留与分发等关键技术环节的进一步澄清。

Our recent interactions with the ESGF and WIP websites have not been promising and we await further clarification of the critical technical aspects around data retention and distribution.

12. 感谢专家组提供如此详细的意见和反馈。

12. We thank the Panel for providing such detailed comments and feedback.

我们很高兴专家组认为DCPP提案切题且具科学价值，并希望这些对您的意见和提问的回应有所帮助。

We are pleased that the Panel finds the DCPP proposal pertinent and scientifically interesting and hope that these responses to your comments and queries are helpful.

此致敬礼

Best regards

GJB与DS

GJB and DS

FAFMIP (Flux-Anomaly-Forced MIP) ｜ 通量异常强迫模式比较计划（一）

通量异常强迫模式比较计划（FAFMIP）

Flux-anomaly-forced model intercomparison experiment (FAFMIP)

指导委员会

Steering committee

Jonathan Gregory（主席，j.m.gregory@reading.ac.uk）、Detlef Stammer（detlef.stammer@zmaw.de）、Stephen Griffies（stephen.griffies@noaa.gov）

Jonathan Gregory (chair, j.m.gregory@reading.ac.uk), Detlef Stammer (detlef.stammer@zmaw.de), Stephen Griffies (stephen.griffies@noaa.gov)

目标与实验概述

Goals and overview of experiments

FAFMIP 的提出是为了支持 WCRP 关于海平面上升及其区域影响的大挑战。

FAFMIP is proposed in support of the WCRP Grand Challenge on sea level rise and regional impacts.

与更早几代 AOGCM 一样，CMIP5 大气—海洋耦合环流模式（AOGCM）对区域海平面变化的预估存在很大的分歧，原因在于各模式对区域海洋密度和环流变化的模拟各不相同，尤其是在高纬度和北大西洋地区（Yin, 2012, 10.1029/2012GL052947; Bouttes et al., 2012, 10.1029/2012GL054207; IPCC AR5 WG1 第 13 章, Church et al., 2013; Slangen et al, 2014, 10.1007/s10584-014-1080-9）。

Projections of regional sea level change by CMIP5 AOGCMs, like earlier AOGCM generations, show a substantial spread due to the different models' differing simulations of regional ocean density and circulation changes, especially in high latitudes and the North Atlantic (Yin, 2012, 10.1029/2012GL052947; Bouttes et al., 2012, 10.1029/2012GL054207; IPCC AR5 WG1 chapter 13, Church et al., 2013; Slangen et al, 2014, 10.1007/s10584-014-1080-9).

此前有分析将多个 CMIP5 模式的通量扰动施加到同一个 AOGCM 上，结果表明海平面预估分歧的相当大一部分（但并非全部）来自各 AOGCM 对动量（风应力）、热量和淡水表面通量变化预估的差异（Bouttes et al., 2012, 上文已引; Bouttes et al., 2014, 10.1007/s00382-013-1973-8; Bouttes and Gregory, 2014, 10.1088/1748-9326/9/3/034004）。

By applying flux perturbations from a range of CMIP5 models to the same AOGCM, previous analyses have shown that a substantial fraction, but not all, of the diversity of sea level projections arises from the spread in AOGCM projections of changes in surface fluxes of momentum (windstress), heat and freshwater (Bouttes et al., 2012, cited above; Bouttes et al., 2014, 10.1007/s00382-013-1973-8; Bouttes and Gregory, 2014, 10.1088/1748-9326/9/3/034004).

在 FAFMIP 实验中，将向海洋施加一组给定的表面通量扰动。

In the FAFMIP experiments, a prescribed set of surface flux perturbations will be applied to the ocean.

这些扰动取自 1pctCO2 情景下 CMIP5 AOGCM 模拟的 CO2 加倍时的集合平均变化，因此它们代表预估的人为气候变化。（注：原文 "at time time" 疑为笔误。）

These perturbations will be obtained from the ensemble-mean changes simulated at time time of doubled CO2 by CMIP5 AOGCMs under the 1pctCO2 scenario, so they are representative of projected anthropogenic climate change.

实验的目标是：

The aims of the experiments are:

在给定相同表面通量扰动的情况下，量化各模式所模拟的、由海洋密度和环流变化引起的海平面变化地理分布格局的差异。

to quantify the difference in the geographical patterns of sea level change due to ocean density and circulation change simulated by the models, when given common surface flux perturbations.

提供关于海洋对气候变化响应的热吸收效率及其在海洋内部分布的信息；AOGCM 在这些现象上的分歧导致了它们在瞬态气候响应以及热膨胀引起的全球平均海平面上升上的分歧。

to provide information about the efficiency and interior distribution of ocean heat uptake in response to climate change; the AOGCM spread in these phenomena contributes to their spread in transient climate response and global mean sea level rise due to thermal expansion.

提供关于大西洋经向翻转环流（AMOC）对给定浮力强迫的敏感性的信息——这里采用的是 CO2 强迫所预期的那种性质的浮力强迫，而非以往 AMOC 模式比较中所用的理想化淡水强迫；AMOC 的变化与区域和全球海平面上升以及区域气候变化都有关联。

to provide information about the sensitivity of the Atlantic meridional overturning circulation (AMOC) to prescribed buoyancy forcing of the character expected for CO2 forcing, rather than idealised freshwater forcing such as has been used in previous AMOC intercomparisons; change in the AMOC is of relevance to both regional and global sea level rise, as well as to regional climate change.

FAFMIP 实验旨在增进对物理过程的理解。

The FAFMIP experiments are aimed at increased physical understanding.

这些实验本身并非与政策相关的情景，但全球和区域海平面及 AMOC 变化预估中的不确定性显然与政策高度相关。

They are not themselves policy-relevant scenarios, but obviously the uncertainties in projection of global and regional sea level and AMOC change are of great policy relevance.

指导委员会承诺确保撰写一篇关于 FAFMIP 设计的论文，并鼓励所有参与者合作撰写一篇关于实验结果的论文。

The steering committee undertakes to ensure that a paper on the FAFMIP design will be prepared, and all participants will be encouraged to collaborate in producing a paper on the results.

截至撰写本文时（2015 年 5 月 20 日），有十个研究组计划开展 FAFMIP 实验（ACCESS、CanESM、CNRM/CERFACS、GFDL、GISS、IPSL、MIROC6、MPI、MRI、UKESM）。

At the time of writing (20 May 2015) there are ten groups who plan to run FAFMIP experiments (ACCESS, CanESM, CNRM/CERFACS, GFDL, GISS, IPSL, MIROC6, MPI, MRI, UKESM).

实验设计（见 http://www.met.reading.ac.uk/~jonathan/FAFMIP）

Design of experiments (see http://www.met.reading.ac.uk/~jonathan/FAFMIP)

所有实验都将在 AOGCM 计算出的表面通量之上叠加异常（类似于通量订正）。

All the experiments will add anomalies to the surface fluxes computed by the AOGCM (like a flux adjustment).

通量本身不会被替换，因为这样做通常会导致很大的气候漂移和潜在的不稳定性，而且在技术上比叠加异常通量更为复杂。

The fluxes themselves will not be replaced because this would typically cause a very large climate drift and possible instability, and is technically more complicated than adding an anomalous flux.

表面通量异常是（经度、纬度、一年中的时间）的函数，并且在整个实验期间保持不变；实验时长拟定为 70 年（如果无法负担 70 年，较短的实验仍然有用）。

The surface flux anomalies are a function of (longitude, latitude, time of year) and constant throughout the experiments, which are proposed to be 70 years long (but shorter experiments would still be useful if 70 years cannot be afforded).

实验将从标准的 CMIP DECK 工业革命前控制试验分支出来，并通过与之比较来进行分析。

The experiments will branch from and be analysed by comparison with the standard CMIP DECK pre-industrial control.

所有实验均采用工业革命前的大气条件。

All the experiments have pre-industrial atmospheric conditions.

共有三个第一层级（tier-1）实验，按重要性从高到低排列。

There are three tier-1 experiments, most important first.

粗体字为实验名称。

The bold word is the name of the experiment.

stressFAF：施加表面纬向和经向风应力扰动。

stressFAF: Impose a perturbation in surface zonal and meridional windstress.

我们首先提议该实验，因为在 CMIP5 情景实验中，风应力变化似乎对海平面的影响最大。

We propose this experiment first because the windstress change appears to have the largest effect on sea level in CMIP5 scenario experiments.

除了与海平面的相关性之外，该实验还涉及涡旋饱和现象（绕极环流对风应力变化相对不敏感），这一点在涡分辨模式中尤其值得关注；同时该实验也可用于研究风应力变化对将绕极深层水向南极大陆架平流输送的影响——在那里它可能影响冰架融化，进而通过冰盖动力学效应引起海平面上升（这是大挑战的另一个方面）。

In addition to its relevance to sea level, this experiment will also be of interest regarding the phenomenon of eddy saturation (relative insensitivity of the circumpolar circulation to windstress change), especially in eddy-resolving models, and to study the influence of windstress change on advecting circumpolar deep water towards the Antarctic continental shelf, where it could affect ice-shelf melting and hence sea-level rise through the effect on ice-sheet dynamics (a different aspect of the Grand Challenge).

扰动施加于风应力而不是大气中的风速，因为风应力才是海洋所感受到的通量。

The perturbation is made to windstress, rather than to wind speed in the atmosphere, because windstress is the flux experienced by the ocean.

除了风应力之外，AOGCM 通常还使用其他风速诊断量向海洋提供湍流混合能量。

AOGCMs typically use other diagnostics of wind speed to supply turbulent mixing energy to the ocean in addition to windstress.

目前拟定的设计中暂不包含对这些量的扰动。

Perturbing these quantities is not included in the proposed design at present.

heatFAF：施加表面热通量扰动；其对海平面变化格局的影响的重要性位居第二。

heatFAF: Impose a perturbation in surface heat flux, which is second in importance in its influence on patterns of sea level change.

此前的分析还发现它是 AMOC 变化的主要影响因素。（注：原文 "a previous analyses" 疑为笔误。）

It has also been found in a previous analyses to be the main influence on AMOC change.

在 AOGCM 中施加热通量扰动并非易事，因为它会改变海表温度（SST），而 SST 又会反过来影响大气模式计算出的表面热通量，从而趋于抵消该扰动。

In an AOGCM, imposing a heat flux perturbation is not straightforward, because it alters the SST, which affects the surface heat flux calculated by the atmosphere model and tends to cancel out the perturbation.

在本实验和 allFAF 实验中，我们提议使用被动示踪物来避免这一反馈（见网站上的文档）。

In this experiment and in the allFAF experiment, we propose to use a passive tracer to avoid this feedback (see documents on website).

这种设计使我们能够区分外加热量的效应与对照实验中热量含量再分布的效应。

The design allows us to distinguish the effects of added heat and redistribution of the control heat content.

waterFAF：施加表面淡水通量扰动（包括径流变化的贡献）。

waterFAF: Impose a perturbation in the surface freshwater flux (including the contribution from runoff change).

这是影响力最小的表面通量。

This is the least influential surface flux.

共有两个第二层级（tier-2）实验。

There are two tier-2 experiments.

passiveheat：以与 heatFAF 实验中表面热通量扰动相同的速率添加被动示踪物的表面通量。

passiveheat: Add a surface flux of passive tracer at the same rate as the surface heat flux perturbation in the heatFAF experiment.

该通量将被加到被动温度示踪物的顶层。

This flux will be added to the top layer of a passive temperature tracer.

将该实验与 heatFAF 实验进行比较，可以评估海洋平流对表面热通量反馈的影响（参见 Winton et al., 2013, 10.1175/JCLI-D-12-00296.1）。

Comparison of this experiment with the heatFAF experiment will allow the effect of ocean advection on surface heat flux feedback to be assessed (cf. Winton et al., 2013, 10.1175/JCLI-D-12-00296.1).

allFAF：在 allFAF 实验中，风应力、热量和淡水的异常通量被同时施加，其中热量采用与 heatFAF 实验相同的被动示踪物方法。

allFAF: In the allFAF experiment, the anomalous fluxes of windstress, heat and water are simultaneously applied, using the passive-tracer method for heat as in the heatFAF experiment.

诊断量

Diagnostics

无需更改标准 CMIP 诊断量集合或 CF、CMOR、ESG 规范。

No changes to the standard CMIP set of diagnostics or CF, CMOR or ESG are required.

海平面变化的分析将主要使用 zos、zostoga、thetao 和 so。

The analysis of sea level change will mainly use zos, zostoga, thetao and so.

海洋热吸收效率的分析将使用 thetao。

Analyses of ocean heat uptake efficiency will use thetao.

AMOC 的分析将使用 msftmyz、msftyyz、uo 和 vo。

Analyses of the AMOC will use msftmyz, msftyyz, uo and vo.

强烈建议实现三维海洋诊断量，用于输出各物理过程（平流、扩散等）引起的月平均温度和盐度倾向（∂T/∂t 和 ∂S/∂t）。

It is strongly recommended that 3D ocean diagnostics should be implemented for monthly-mean temperature and salinity tendencies (∂T/∂t and ∂S/∂t) due to the various physical processes which modify the state (advection, diffusion, etc.).

这些诊断量已被纳入 CLIVAR 海洋模式发展小组（Ocean Model Development Panel）关于 CMIP6 海洋模式输出的建议的表 2.9 中，供包括 DECK 在内的所有 CMIP6 实验使用，其中特别指出了它们对 FAFMIP 的用途。

These diagnostics have been included in Table 2.9 of the recommendations from the CLIVAR Ocean Model Development Panel committee on CMIP6 ocean model output for use in all CMIP6 experiments, including DECK for instance, but their usefulness for FAFMIP is particularly noted there.

如果未能为所有实验提交 ∂/∂t 诊断量，则对 FAFMIP 而言，特别要求提交与 FAFMIP 实验时段平行的 DECK piControl 部分，以及 DECK 理想化气候变化实验 abrupt4xCO2 和 1pctCO2 的这些诊断量。

If the ∂/∂t diagnostics are not submitted for all experiments, for FAFMIP they are particularly requested for the portion of the DECK piControl which is parallel to the FAFMIP experiments, and for the DECK idealised climate change experiments abrupt4xCO2 and 1pctCO2.

拟定时间表

Proposed timing

输入场将于 2015 年 6 月底之前准备好，此后任何感兴趣的研究组都可以开展实验。

The input fields will be prepared by the end of June 2015 and experiments can be done thereafter by any interested groups.

目前有三个研究组正在测试过渡版本。

Interim versions are currently being tested by three groups.

GeoMIP (Geoengineering MIP) ｜ 地球工程模式比较计划（上）

Storelvmo 与 Herger（2014）发现，卷云疏化对净云强迫和地表温度的大部分影响来自热带以外的卷云播撒；将热带也纳入播撒区域只会带来有限的额外效应。

Storelvmo and Herger (2014) found that the majority of the cirrus thinning effects on net cloud forcing and surface temperatures are due to cirrus seeding outside of the tropics; including the tropics in the regions that are seeded caused a modest additional effect.

然而，为了不在被改变的卷云区域引入人为边界，卷云将在所有纬度上被修改。

However, so as not to introduce artificial boundaries in the regions where cirrus clouds are altered, cirrus clouds will be modified at all latitudes.

G7cirrus 的设计（图 6）与以往的 GeoMIP 实验相仿。

The design of G7cirrus (Figure 6) is comparable to previous GeoMIP experiments.

在 ScenarioMIP 第一层级高强迫情景的背景下，卷云播撒将于 2020 年开始，并持续到 2100 年。

Against a background of the ScenarioMIP Tier 1 high forcing scenario, cirrus seeding will begin in 2020 and continue through the year 2100.

本实验的目标是以恒定量播撒卷云，使 2020‐2029 年这十年的全球平均温度降至 1970‐1979 年十年间的水平（按历史模拟计算），从而抵消约 1.0 W m‐2 的辐射强迫。

The goal of this experiment is to seed cirrus by a constant amount that reduces average global mean temperature in the decade 2020‐2029 to that of the decade 1970‐1979 (as calculated in a historical run), offsetting a radiative forcing of approximately 1.0 W m‐2.

选择 1970‐1979 这十年，是为了避开 1982 年埃尔奇琼火山喷发、1991 年皮纳图博火山喷发，以及 1982 年和 1998 年异常强烈的厄尔尼诺事件的气候影响。

The decade 1970‐1979 was chosen to avoid the climate effects of the 1982 El Chichón eruption, the 1991 Mount Pinatubo eruption, and the unusually large El Niño events in 1982 and 1998.

与 G6sulfur 或 G6solar 不同，G7cirrus 并不要求将净辐射强迫从一个 ScenarioMIP 第一层级情景恢复到另一个情景，因为目前尚不清楚卷云播撒能达到何种强迫水平。

Unlike G6sulfur or G6solar, G7cirrus does not propose to return net radiative forcing from one ScenarioMIP Tier 1 scenario to another, as it is yet unclear what levels of forcing could be achieved through cirrus seeding.

由于 G7cirrus 的目标是模拟降温，因此最好在变暖的气候背景下运行。

Because the goal of G7cirrus is to simulate cooling, it is best run against a background of a warming climate.

然而，这将妨碍通过大气模式比较计划（AMIP）型模拟（其海表温度固定在当今值）对强迫敏感性进行诊断。

However, this prevents diagnoses of the sensitivity to forcing from Atmosphere Model Intercomparison Project (AMIP)‐style simulations, in which sea surface temperatures are fixed at present‐day values.

鉴于此类模拟在提供辐射强迫补充信息方面的价值，我们建议同时开展时间切片模拟（第 3.1 节），将其海表温度固定在与所提议情景更相关的时段对应的值，而非当今值。

Because of the usefulness of these sorts of simulations in providing complementary information about radiative forcing, we recommend timeslice simulations (Section 3.1) also be performed, where sea surface temperatures are fixed at values corresponding to time periods more relevant to the proposed scenario than present day values.

有必要重申，卷云过程目前认识不足，在气候模式中的表征也很差。

It is important to reiterate that cirrus cloud processes are poorly understood and poorly represented in climate models.

例如，CMIP5 模式中观测与模拟的冰水路径对比显示，模式偏差达 2‐10 倍（Li et al., 2012）。

As an example, comparisons between observed and modeled ice water path in CMIP5 models reveal model biases of a factor of 2‐10 (Li et al., 2012).

尽管如此，初步结果和近期研究均表明，G7cirrus 将揭示各模式响应之间的共性。

Nevertheless, preliminary results and recent studies indicate that G7cirrus will reveal commonalities among model responses.

因此，除了提供关于卷云疏化潜力与局限性的相关信息外，探究结果中的模式间差异还能揭示模式偏差的来源，直接回应 CMIP6 的核心科学问题之一。

Therefore, in addition to providing relevant information about the potentials and limitations of cirrus thinning, exploring inter‐model differences in the results can reveal sources of model biases, directly addressing one of the core scientific questions in CMIP6.

3. GeoMIP6 中的第二层级实验

3. Tier 2 Experiments in GeoMIP6

除了四个第一层级实验外，我们另提议一组实验，以辅助诊断气候模式的响应。

In addition to the four Tier 1 experiments, we propose another set of experiments that will aid in diagnosing climate model response.

3.1. 时间切片模拟

3.1. Timeslice Simulations

分别计算快速调整与反馈响应（也分别称为快响应与慢响应）可以揭示基本的气候行为。

Separately calculating the rapid adjustments and the feedback response (also called the fast and slow responses, respectively) can reveal fundamental climate behavior.

这一点已被证明对地球工程模拟特别有用（Tilmes et al., 2013; Kravitz et al., 2013b; Huneeus et al., 2014）。

This has been shown to be particularly useful for geoengineering simulations (Tilmes et al., 2013; Kravitz et al., 2013b; Huneeus et al., 2014).

因此，我们要求所有参与的模式组为每一个第一层级实验开展时间切片模拟（如 Cubasch et al., 1995），以辅助诊断本文所提议情景的辐射强迫。

As such, we are requesting that all participating modeling groups conduct timeslice simulations (e.g., Cubasch et al., 1995) for each of the Tier 1 experiments to aid in diagnosing radiative forcing for the scenarios proposed here.

这些模拟将提供关于气候系统如何响应辐射强迫的关键信息，以及气候响应和模式偏差对气溶胶与云微物理性质变化的相对敏感性，从而直接回应 CMIP6 若干核心科学问题。

These simulations will provide key information about how the climate system response to radiative forcing, as well as the relative sensitivities of climate responses and model biases to changes in aerosol and cloud microphysical properties, thus directly addressing several of the core science questions in CMIP6.

这些时间切片实验涉及为期 10 年的固定海表温度（SST）模拟；这与辐射通量扰动模拟类似（Haywood et al., 2009）。

These timeslice experiments involve fixed sea surface temperature (SST) simulations for a period of 10 years; these are similar to Radiative Flux Perturbation simulations (Haywood et al., 2009).

在这些模拟中，SST、海冰以及所有边界条件（温室气体浓度、气溶胶和其他气候强迫因子）均须在整个 10 年模拟期内按恒定气候态给定。

In these simulations, SSTs, sea ice, and all boundary conditions (greenhouse gas concentrations, aerosols, and other climate forcing agents) are to be prescribed at a constant climatology for the entire 10‐year simulation.

在多数时间切片模拟中，会施加一个外部强迫。

In most of the timeslice simulations, an external forcing is applied.

对于该强迫，气候态取自相应的地球工程实验。

For this forcing, the climatology is derived from the appropriate geoengineering experiment.

对于所有其他边界条件，气候态则取自相应的参考情景，即未施加地球工程的情景。

For all the other boundary conditions, the climatologies are derived from the appropriate reference scenarios, in which no geoengineering is applied.

每个第一层级实验将配有两个时间切片模拟，一个在耦合模拟开始时，一个在结束时。

Each Tier 1 experiment will have two associated timeslice simulations, one at the beginning of the coupled simulation and one at the end.

时间切片模拟的详细描述见表 2。

The timeslice simulations are described in more detail in Table 2.

3.2. G4‐指定平流层气溶胶实验（G4SSA）

3.2. G4‐Specified Stratospheric Aerosol experiment (G4SSA)

使用预报性平流层硫酸盐气溶胶进行地球工程模拟存在若干问题，因为所得到的气溶胶分布差异会对地球工程的气候影响产生显著作用，从而在模式之间造成很大的响应差异。

There are several issues in simulations of geoengineering with prognostic stratospheric sulfate aerosols, as differences in the resulting aerosol distribution can have prominent effects on the climate impacts of geoengineering and thus can produce large differences in the response between the models.

为消除模式间的这一差异，Tilmes 等（2014a）为化学气候模式（CCM）设计了一个名为 G4SSA 的实验。

To remove this difference between the models, Tilmes et al. (2014a) have designed an experiment for chemistry climate models (CCMs) called G4SSA.

该实验的设计使所有模式都采用相同的指定平流层硫分布，从而可以评估气溶胶‐化学与气候相互作用的不同表征方式所对应的气候响应范围。

This experiment is designed so that all models would use the same prescribed stratospheric sulfur distribution, allowing for assessments of the range of climate responses for different representations of aerosol‐chemistry and climate interactions.

该实验与化学气候模式计划（CCMI）中的其他实验相关联。

This experiment is connected to the other experiments in the Chemistry Climate Model Initiative (CCMI).

该实验设计借鉴了 GeoMIP 实验 G4。

The experiment design takes inspiration from GeoMIP experiment G4.

在 RCP6.0 的背景下，将以每年 8 Tg SO2 的速率向模式中注入一层平流层气溶胶。

Against a background of RCP6.0, a layer of stratospheric aerosols will be injected into the model at a rate of 8 Tg SO2 per year.

不再让各模式自行计算其气溶胶分布，而是向所有模式提供表面积密度及其他气溶胶参数的分布。

Instead of allowing the models to calculate their aerosol distributions, a distribution of surface area density and other aerosol parameters will be provided to all models.

所述分布还可以按比例缩放，以适用于其他情景，如 ScenarioMIP 情景（这与实验 G6sulfur 相关）。

The described distribution can also be scaled so as to apply to other scenarios, such as the ScenarioMIP scenarios (this is relevant for Experiment G6sulfur).

我们将在网站 https://www2.acd.ucar.edu/gcm/geomip‐g4‐specified‐stratospheric‐aerosol‐data‐set 提供与该气溶胶分布一致的气溶胶光学厚度和臭氧浓度时间序列。

We will provide time series of aerosol optical depth and ozone concentration that are consistent with the aerosol distribution at the website https://www2.acd.ucar.edu/gcm/geomip‐g4‐specified‐stratospheric‐aerosol‐data‐set.

尽管 G4SSA 是为 CCM 开发的，从大气环流模式（GCM）或地球系统模式（ESM）获取结果同样有价值，因此将其纳入 GeoMIP6。

Although G4SSA was developed for CCMs, it would be useful to obtain results from general circulation models (GCMs) or Earth system models (ESMs) as well, hence the inclusion in GeoMIP6.

这两类模式对大气的处理方式差异很大，包括平流层化学、气溶胶微物理以及准两年振荡的表征。

These two classes of models have very different treatments of the atmosphere, including stratospheric chemistry, aerosol microphysics, and representation of the quasi‐biennial oscillation.

比较这两组模式的结果将揭示气候模式对平流层气溶胶地球工程响应背后的一些机制，并为确定哪些物理过程的模式表征需要改进提供指引。

Comparing results from these two groups would reveal some of the mechanisms behind the climate model response to stratospheric aerosol geoengineering, as well as provide a guideline for identifying which model representations of physical processes need improvement.

3.3 超调情景：G6sulfurExt 和 G6solarExt

3.3 Overshoot Scenarios: G6sulfurExt and G6solarExt

ScenarioMIP 包含一个超调情景（Boucher et al., 2012）。

ScenarioMIP includes an overshoot scenario (Boucher et al., 2012).

在该实验中，从 ScenarioMIP 第一层级最高强迫情景出发，自 2100 年起大幅减排，将使净人为排放从最高强迫情景的水平线性降至最低强迫情景的水平。

In this experiment, beginning from the ScenarioMIP Tier 1 highest forcing scenario, aggressive emissions reductions beginning in the year 2100 would linearly reduce net anthropogenic emissions from those of the highest forcing scenario to those of the lowest forcing scenario.

对该情景的分析将提供关于模拟地球系统响应中任何潜在滞后的信息，并可对潜在的临界点或不可逆变化发出警示。

Analysis of this scenario will provide information on any potential hystereses in the simulated Earth system response and could provide warnings about potential tipping points or irreversible changes.

由于减排发生在 22 世纪和 23 世纪，超调情景将是第一层级高强迫情景延伸至 2300 年的延续。

As emissions reductions occur over the 22nd and 23rd centuries, the overshoot scenario would be an extension of the Tier 1 high forcing scenario through the year 2300.

值得指出的是，22 世纪和 23 世纪期间强迫的下降并非线性，且强迫水平将高于最低强迫情景。

It is worth noting that the decline in forcing over the 22nd and 23rd centuries will not be linear, and the forcing level would be higher than in the lowest forcing scenario.

实际强迫的细节将由 ScenarioMIP 的协调人提供。

Details on the actual forcing will be provided by the coordinators of ScenarioMIP.

这里我们提议对 G6sulfur 和 G6solar 进行与 ScenarioMIP 超调情景平行的扩展；这些模拟与 Wigley（2006）所描述的模拟类似。

Here we propose extensions of G6sulfur and G6solar that parallel the ScenarioMIP overshoot scenario; these simulations are similar to those described by Wigley (2006).

这些拟议扩展的一般原则是：凡净强迫量值大于 ScenarioMIP 第一层级中等强迫情景时，就使用地球工程来降低净强迫。

The general principle behind these proposed extensions is that, at any time that the net forcing is greater in magnitude than that of the ScenarioMIP Tier 1 medium forcing scenario, geoengineering is used to reduce the net forcing.

这将实际上造成一种情形：地球工程的强度在模拟开始时（2100 年之前，即超调情景开始之前）逐步加大。

This would effectively result in a situation in which the magnitude of geoengineering is ramped up at the beginning of the simulation (before 2100, when the overshoot scenario starts).

随后，一旦减排使强迫充分低于高强迫情景的水平、使地球工程不再为达成强迫目标所需，其强度将在模拟临近结束时逐步调降。

It is then ramped down near the end of the simulation once emissions reductions have sufficiently reduced the forcing from the level in the high forcing scenario, such that geoengineering would no longer be required to meet the forcing objective.

该情景将阐明地球工程在多大程度上有助于防止气候发生不可逆变化并避免临界点。

This scenario will illuminate the extent to which geoengineering may help in preventing irreversible changes in the climate and avoiding tipping points.

4. GeoMIP 试验台

4. The GeoMIP Testbed

GeoMIP 的一项新功能被称为 GeoMIP 试验台。

A new feature of GeoMIP is termed the GeoMIP Testbed.

这是一组由个别团队提出的、有潜在价值的地球工程研究实验。

This is a set of experiments that are potentially useful geoengineering studies that have been proposed by individual groups.

其思路是：每个团队都了解本领域的关键问题，因而最适合设计一个能最好地解决这些问题的模拟。

The idea is that each group understands the key problems in its own sector and is thus uniquely posed to design a simulation that would best address those problems.

该模拟设计随后将由个别模式进行审查，再决定是否应由整个模式套件来开展这一模拟。

That simulation design would then be vetted by individual models before a decision would be made as to whether the simulation should be undertaken by the full model suite.

4.1. G6sulfur_limits

4.1. G6sulfur_limits

实验 G6sulfur 旨在通过模拟平流层硫酸盐气溶胶注入，将高排放情景的辐射强迫降低到中等排放情景的水平。

Experiment G6sulfur is designed to reduce radiative forcing in a high emissions scenario to that of a moderate emissions scenario via simulating stratospheric sulfate aerosol injection.

该实验将有助于评估地球工程作为应对气候变化组合方案一部分的有效性。

This experiment would be useful in assessing the effectiveness of geoengineering as part of a portfolio of responses to climate change.

然而，该实验并未涉及平流层硫酸盐气溶胶注入的可行性或极限。

However, this experiment does not address feasibility or limits of stratospheric sulfate aerosol injection.

如第 2.2 节所述，平流层 SO2 注入量的增加会使颗粒发生碰并并更快沉降。

As was stated in Section 2.2, increasing amounts of stratospheric SO2 injection would cause particles to coagulate and fall out more rapidly.

因此，注入量与所产生辐射强迫之间的关系预计呈次线性。

Therefore, the relationship between the amount of injection and the resulting radiative forcing is projected to be sublinear.

这一问题引出一个很自然的问题：平流层硫酸盐气溶胶注入所能实现的辐射强迫极限是多少？

This problem prompts a natural question: What is the limit of achievable radiative forcing from stratospheric sulfate aerosol injection?

解决这一问题的自然的第一步，是采用与 G6sulfur 类似的设置。

A natural first step in addressing this problem would involve a similar setup to that of G6sulfur.

在 ScenarioMIP 第一层级高强迫情景的背景下，向平流层注入足量的硫酸盐气溶胶前体物，将人为辐射强迫从高强迫情景的水平降低到低强迫情景的水平。

Against a background of the ScenarioMIP Tier 1 high forcing scenario, sulfate aerosol precursors would be injected into the stratosphere in sufficient amounts to reduce anthropogenic radiative forcing from the levels in the high forcing scenario to levels in the low forcing scenario.

由于低强迫情景是 ScenarioMIP 第一层级实验，所有 GeoMIP 参与者很可能都会开展该实验，额外的模拟只需较少准备即可完成。

As the low forcing scenario is a ScenarioMIP Tier 1 experiment, it would likely be conducted by all GeoMIP participants, and the extra simulations would be done with relatively little preparation.

图 7 展示了实现给定辐射强迫量所需的平流层气溶胶注入量；这些模拟在 ECHAM‐HAM（Stier et al., 2005; Niemeier et al., 2011）中进行，这是一个耦合了模拟硫酸盐气溶胶物理演变与颗粒增长的气溶胶微物理模式的大气环流模式。

Figure 7 shows the required amount of stratospheric aerosol injection to achieve given amounts of radiative forcing; these simulations were performed in ECHAM‐HAM (Stier et al., 2005; Niemeier et al., 2011), a general circulation model coupled to an aerosol microphysical model that simulates the physical evolution and particle growth of sulfate aerosols.

注入量与辐射强迫之间的次线性关系得到了清晰的展示。

The sublinear relationship between injection amount and radiative forcing is clearly illustrated.

2100 年 RCP8.5 与 RCP2.6 之间的差值为 5.9 Wm‐2，约等于工业化前 CO2 浓度增至三倍所对应的辐射强迫；当这些情景最终确定后，这一差值将与 ScenarioMIP 第一层级高强迫情景和第一层级低强迫情景之间预期的强迫差相近。

The difference between RCP8.5 and RCP2.6 in the year 2100 is 5.9 Wm‐2, or the approximate radiative forcing of a tripling of the preindustrial CO2 concentration; this difference is similar to the expected difference in forcing between the ScenarioMIP Tier 1 high forcing scenario and the Tier 1 low forcing scenario, when those scenarios are finalized.

由图 7 的结果外推，实现这一辐射强迫需要每年注入 40‐50 Tg S（80‐100 Tg SO2）。

Extrapolating from the results of Figure 7, achieving this radiative forcing would require an injection of 40‐50 Tg S (80‐100 Tg SO2) per year.

这一注入速率相当于每年发生四到五次 1991 年皮纳图博火山喷发。

This injection rate is equivalent to four to five 1991 Mount Pinatubo eruptions per year.

评估此类情景气候影响的一些工作已经展开（Niemeier and Timmreck, submitted）。

Some efforts to evaluate the climate effects of such a scenario are already underway (Niemeier and Timmreck, submitted).

4.2. GeoSulfur10、GeoSulfur20、GeoSulfur50

4.2. GeoSulfur10, GeoSulfur20, GeoSulfur50

量化平流层气溶胶地球工程效应的另一种方式，是开展一系列实验，对平流层硫酸盐气溶胶的假定注入速率加以约束。

A different way of quantifying the effects of stratospheric aerosol geoengineering is to perform a series of experiments in which the hypothetical rate of injection of stratospheric sulfate aerosols is constrained.

这样的模拟非常适合确定各模式对固定 SO2 注入量的响应范围，凸显模式的多样性。

Such a simulation would be well suited to ascertain the range of model responses to a fixed amount of SO2 injection, highlighting model diversity.

在 ScenarioMIP 第一层级高强迫情景的背景下，各模式组将采用与实验 G4 类似的设置（Kravitz et al., 2011a），每年向平流层低层注入 10、20 或 50 Tg 二氧化硫。

Against a background of the ScenarioMIP Tier 1 high forcing scenario, the modeling groups will inject 10, 20, or 50 Tg of sulfur dioxide per year into the lower stratosphere, in a similar setup to Experiment G4 (Kravitz et al., 2011a).

4.3. GeoLandAlbedo

4.3. GeoLandAlbedo

实验 G1ocean‐albedo 曾通过以恒定倍乘因子增大海洋反照率来模拟海洋云增白的效应（Kravitz et al., 2013）。

Experiment G1ocean‐albedo has simulated the effects of marine cloud brightening by increasing ocean albedo by a constant multiplication factor (Kravitz et al., 2013).

然而，GeoMIP 尚未探索面向太阳辐射管理的陆基途径。

However, GeoMIP has not yet explored land‐based approaches towards solar radiation management.

这类途径可以在区域尺度上方便地实施，因为人类活动已经控制着相当一部分陆地表面积的反照率。

Such approaches could readily be implemented on the regional scale, as human activities already control the albedo of a significant fraction of the land surface.

因此，我们提议一个替代实验：在 CMIP5 abrupt4xCO2 实验的背景下，提高陆地表面反照率。

We therefore propose an alternative experiment in which the land surface albedo is increased, against a background of the CMIP5 abrupt4xCO2 experiment.

在 GeoLandAlbedo 实验中，所有城市和农业区域的陆地表面反照率将统一提高 0.1。

Under experiment GeoLandAlbedo, the land surface albedo would be increased by a uniform amount of 0.1 across all urban and agricultural areas.

这一增量代表了实践中所能达到的大规模反照率增幅的合理估计（Lobell et al., 2006; Lenton and Vaughan, 2009; Davin et al., 2014）。

Such an increment represents a reasonable estimate of the maximum large‐scale albedo increase that could be achieved in practice (Lobell et al., 2006; Lenton and Vaughan, 2009; Davin et al., 2014).

GeoLandAlbedo 实验的目标不是实现全球能量平衡，而是确定陆地表面反照率的变化在多大程度上能在区域尺度上抵消温室气体增加的影响。

The aim of experiment GeoLandAlbedo would not be to achieve global energy balance, but rather to determine the extent to which land surface albedo changes could offset the effects of increasing greenhouse gases on a regional basis.

在某种程度上，这一问题的不同方面已有所探索。

To some degree, different aspects of this problem have been explored.

Irvine 等（2011）确定，不同类型的表面反照率地球工程均无法抵消 CO2 浓度加倍所产生的辐射强迫，且这类尝试的不良副作用可能很大。

Irvine et al. (2011) determined that different types of surface albedo geoengineering were incapable of offsetting the radiative forcing from a doubling of the CO2 concentration, and the adverse side effects of such attempts could be large.

仅专注于生物工程作物以提高作物冠层反照率（Ridgwell et al., 2009）可能引起局地降温效应（Doughty et al., 2011），但全球影响可能很小（Singarayer et al., 2009; Singarayer and Davies‐Barnard, 2012）。

Focusing only on bio‐engineering crops to increase crop canopy albedo (Ridgwell et al., 2009) could cause local cooling effects (Doughty et al., 2011) but would likely have a small global impact (Singarayer et al., 2009; Singarayer and Davies‐Barnard, 2012).

以往所有关于陆基反照率提升的研究都是使用单一模式进行的，因此这种特定地球工程方法有效性的稳健性及其副作用尚未经过检验。

All of the previous studies on terrestrial‐based albedo increases were conducted with single models, so the robustness of the effectiveness of this particular method of geoengineering, as well as the side effects, have not yet been tested.

鉴于陆面过程建模涉及广泛的结构性和参数不确定性，评估陆基地球工程响应的范围尤为重要。

Assessing the range of responses to terrestrial‐based geoengineering is especially important, given the wide range of structural and parametric uncertainties associated with modeling land surface processes.

5. 结论

5. Conclusions

本文提出的气候模式实验设计标志着在 GeoMIP 中纳入更广泛视角的协同努力的开始。

The climate model experiment designs presented here mark the beginning of a concerted effort to include broader perspectives within GeoMIP.

建议将所有实验至少延长至 80 年，以获得对极端事件和变率模态变化的更稳健估计；特别令人感兴趣的是，G1ext 能取得哪些无法通过分析实验 G1 获得的结果，尤其是在极端事件（Curry et al., 2014）和气候变率模态（Gabriel and Robock, 2015）方面。

The extension of all experiments to at least 80 years is recommended to obtain more robust estimates of changes in extremes and modes of variability; it will be particularly interesting to discover what results can be obtained from G1ext that could not be obtained through analyses of Experiment G1, particularly in relation to extreme events (Curry et al., 2014) and modes of climate variability (Gabriel and Robock, 2015).

两个 G6 实验的设计旨在为与气候变化情景设计者的潜在对话打开大门。

The two G6 experiments were designed to open the door toward possible conversations with designers of climate change scenarios.

我们已经开始探索与 ScenarioMIP 的潜在协同，我们的核心模拟正是基于后者。

We have begun to explore potential synergies with ScenarioMIP, on which our core simulations are based.

实验 G7cirrus 是对卷云疏化这一新想法的首次模式比较，旨在为地球工程和卷云微物理表征两个方向开辟研究途径。

Experiment G7cirrus is the first model intercomparison of the new idea of cirrus thinning and is designed to open avenues of investigation in both geoengineering and cirrus cloud microphysical representations.

G4SSA 的设计旨在探索大气环流模式与 CCM 之间的共性与差异，有望凸显那些不仅对表征气溶胶对大气化学的影响、而且对其对动力和气候的影响都很重要的过程。

G4SSA was designed to explore commonalities and differences between general circulation models and CCMs, potentially highlighting processes that are important in representing the effects of aerosols not only on atmospheric chemistry, but also on dynamics and climate.

地球工程有可能在所有尺度上影响气候系统，因此通过纳入研究这些不同系统的群体的需求，我们可以把 GeoMIP 的用途扩展到更广泛的科学家、决策者和其他利益相关方。

Geoengineering has the potential to impact climate systems at all scales, so by incorporating requirements from communities studying these different systems, we can broaden the usefulness of GeoMIP to a wider variety of scientists, policy makers, and other stakeholders.

GeoMIP 试验台是这一努力的关键组成部分。

The GeoMIP Testbed is a key part of this effort.

在这一新框架下，各个群体可以提出并检验旨在解决本领域问题的实验，为是否需要整个 GeoMIP 群体开展模拟提供宝贵的信息。

Under this new framework, individual communities can propose and test experiments that are designed to address problems in their sectors, providing invaluable information as to whether simulations by the full GeoMIP community are warranted.

尽管如此，GeoMIP 仍存在一些关键空白，可为未来的实验设计提供路线图。

Nevertheless, there remain some key gaps in GeoMIP that can provide a roadmap for future experiment design.

一个值得注意的领域是影响评估。

One notable area is in impacts assessment.

GeoMIP 相当擅长计算特定地球工程情景的预期气候效应，但将这些效应转化为对人类的影响仅在有限的一组研究中得到探索（如 Xia et al., 2014）。

GeoMIP is quite adept at calculating expected climate effects from particular geoengineering scenarios, but translating those effects into impacts on people has only been explored in a limited set of studies (e.g., Xia et al., 2014).

与影响评估群体的互动是 GeoMIP 未来方向中最高优先事项之一。

Interaction with the impacts assessment communities is one of the highest priorities for future directions of GeoMIP.

这尤其适用于对发展中国家的影响，其中许多国家受气候变化影响最大，因而也可能受地球工程影响最大。

This is particularly applicable for effects on developing countries, many of which will be most affected by climate change, and thus might also be most affected by geoengineering.

另一个值得注意的空白是地球工程对碳循环反馈的影响。

Another notable gap is the effect of geoengineering on carbon cycle feedbacks.

中等复杂度 ESM 的研究表明，地球工程可能对全球碳循环产生深远影响，例如通过增强陆地碳汇（Keller et al., 2014）。

Studies with intermediate complexity ESMs suggest that geoengineering could have a profound effect on the global carbon cycle through, for example, an enhancement of the land carbon sink (Keller et al., 2014).

虽然可以从本文提议的实验中了解碳循环对地球工程响应的大量信息，但并非所有实验中的大气碳浓度都能自由演化。

While much can be learned about the response of the carbon cycle to geoengineering from the experiments proposed in this article, the atmospheric carbon concentration does not evolve freely in all experiments.

以排放为驱动、允许大气 CO2 浓度自由演化的多模式研究，将为了解 SRM 对这一重要反馈的影响提供宝贵的见解（例如耦合碳循环气候模式比较计划，即 C4MIP；Friedlingstein et al., 2006）。

Multi‐model studies driven by emissions which allow the atmospheric CO2 concentration to evolve freely would provide valuable insights into the effect of SRM on this important feedback (e.g., the Coupled Carbon Cycle Climate Model Intercomparison Project, or C4MIP; Friedlingstein et al., 2006).

尽管我们预期这一新的气候模式实验套件将有助于解决地球工程物理科学中的许多不确定性，但仍将留下许多关键问题。

Although we expect that this new suite of climate model experiments will be useful in addressing many uncertainties in the physical science of geoengineering, there will remain many key questions.

这些实验设计是理想化的，并不代表若社会决定部署地球工程时现实世界中的做法。

These experiment designs are idealized and are not representative of how geoengineering might be done in the real world, if society were to decide to deploy it.

这些设计也不包含可行性研究；所设计的一些策略在现实世界中可能比其他策略更容易实施。

These designs also do not include studies of feasibility; some of the designed strategies might be more easily implemented in the real world than others.

此外，虽然物理科学研究对于获取地球工程效应与影响的信息是必要的，但它们只是与自然科学和社会科学相关的众多关切中的一个方面，而这些关切对于就地球工程作出明智决策至关重要（如 Robock, 2014）。

Moreover, while physical science studies are necessary for gaining information about the effects and impacts of geoengineering, they are only one aspect among a multitude of concerns, relating to both natural and social sciences, that are crucial for making informed decisions about geoengineering (e.g., Robock, 2014).

致谢。我们感谢 Thorsten Mauritsen 和 Erich Roeckner 对 G7cirrus 方案提出的意见。

图 1. G1ext 实验示意图。

Figure 1. Schematic of experiment G1ext.

该实验从工业化前控制试验启动。

The experiment is started from a preindustrial control run.

CO2 浓度自工业化前水平瞬时增至 4 倍，并在 100 年内由太阳辐照度的降低来平衡。

The instantaneous quadrupling of the CO2 concentration from its preindustrial value is balanced by a reduction in solar irradiance for 100 years.

图 2. G6sulfur 与 G6solar 实验示意图。

Figure 2. Schematic of experiments G6sulfur and G6solar.

修正后：在 ScenarioMIP Tier 1 高强迫情景的背景下，将以随时间变化的量值实施地球工程，使净人为辐射强迫回到 ScenarioMIP Tier 1 中等强迫情景的水平。

Against a background of the ScenarioMIP Tier 1 high forcing scenario, geoengineering will be conducted at time‐varying amounts to return net anthropogenic radiative forcing to the levels of the ScenarioMIP Tier 1 medium forcing scenario.

修正原因：time-varying amounts 改译为“随时间变化的量值”，更贴合原文 amounts 一词。

地球工程将通过平流层气溶胶注入（G6sulfur）或太阳辐照度降低（G6solar）来实现。

Geoengineering will be accomplished by stratospheric aerosol injection (G6sulfur) or solar irradiance reduction (G6solar).

图 3. 降低卷云光学厚度 (τ) 的检验模拟，如第 2.4 节所述。

Figure 3. Test simulations of reducing cirrus cloud optical depth (τ) as described in Section 2.4.

τ 被乘以一个因子 ε < 1（x 轴）。

τ was scaled by a factor ε < 1 (x‐axis).

该缩放所引起的地表气温变化量（y 轴）按 4 年平均值计量；0 表示 RCP8.5 模拟中 2020–2023 年的全球平均地表气温。

The amount of surface air temperature change due to this scaling (y‐axis) was measured over a 4 year average; 0 indicates the global mean surface air temperature over years 2020‐2023 in an RCP8.5 simulation.

所有模拟均使用 GISS ModelE2 (Schmidt et al., 2014) 完成。

All simulations were performed using GISS ModelE2 (Schmidt et al., 2014).

图 4. 在 NorESM1-ME 中改变卷云冰晶沉降速度所产生影响的敏感性研究。

Figure 4. A sensitivity study of the effects of changing cirrus ice crystal sedimentation velocity in NorESM1‐ME.

vfx2、vfx4 和 vfx8 分别表示沉降速度提高 2 倍、4 倍和 8 倍。

vfx2, vfx4, and vfx8 indicate an increase in the sedimentation velocity by 2, 4, and 8 times, respectively.

y 轴表示全球平均温度变化随年份（x 轴）的变化；差值相对于 RCP8.5 情景下 2050–2055 年的平均值计算。

y‐axis shows the global mean temperature change as a function of year (x‐axis); differences are calculated with respect to an average over years 2050‐2055 under an RCP8.5 scenario.

图 5. 卷云冰晶下落速度增至 8 倍时，NorESM1-ME 相对湿度差值的纬向平均年平均值（%）。

Figure 5. Zonally averaged annual mean of the difference in relative humidity (%) from NorESM1‐ME for an octupling of the cirrus ice crystal fall speed.

差值以 RCP8.5 为背景，按 2050–2055 年的平均值计算。

Differences are calculated as an average over years 2050‐2055 against a background of RCP8.5.

图 6. G7cirrus 实验示意图。

Figure 6. Schematic of experiment G7cirrus.

以 ScenarioMIP Tier 1 高强迫情景为背景情景，卷云播撒的参数化表示将使净强迫降低一个恒定值。

Against a background scenario of the ScenarioMIP Tier 1 high forcing scenario, a representation of cirrus cloud seeding will reduce net forcing by a constant amount.

该模拟将从 2020 年开始，并持续进行 80 年。

This simulation will begin in 2020 and will be conducted for 80 years.

图 7. 本图显示在 ECHAM5-HAM（一种包含硫酸盐气溶胶微物理演化处理的大气环流模式）中，抵消给定水平的大气顶净辐射通量失衡（y 轴）所需的每年平流层注入量（x 轴）。

Figure 7. This figure shows the amount of annual stratospheric injection (x‐axis) required to offset a given level of TOA net radiative flux imbalance (y‐axis) in ECHAM5‐HAM, an atmospheric general circulation model with a treatment of the microphysical evolution of sulfate aerosols.

在 RCP8.5 背景下维持大气顶净辐射通量失衡的 2020 年水平，需要在 2100 年注入约 70 Tg(S)/年（基于对上述数值的外推）。

Maintaining 2020 values of net TOA radiative flux imbalance against a background of RCP8.5 requires an injection of approximately 70 Tg(S)/year in 2100 (based on extrapolation of the above values).

所有数值均按向赤道上空一个网格单元注入 SO2 计算；其他注入策略要达到相同的辐射强迫，可能需要不同的注入速率。

All values were calculated for injection of SO2 into one grid box over the equator; other injection strategies would likely require a different injection rate to achieve the same radiative forcing.

GMMIP 的目标：
全球季风的降水与大气环流变化因其影响着世界三分之二以上的人口，而具有重大的科学与社会意义。季风出现在世界多个地区。对未来几十年季风降水变化的预测关系到重大的社会关切，对基础设施建设规划、水资源管理和可持续经济发展至关重要。

Goal of GMMIP:
Changes in the precipitation and atmospheric circulation in the global monsoons are of great scientific and societal importance owing to their impacts on more than two-thirds of the world’s population. Monsoons occur in various regions around the world. Prediction of the monsoon rainfall change in the coming decades is of deep societal concern and vital for infrastructural planning, water resource management, and sustainable economic development.

世界上主要的季风系统包括亚洲-澳大利亚季风、非洲季风和美洲季风。每个季风系统在变率方面通常都有其独特而具体的特征。同时，质量守恒所要求的全球辐散环流中的联系，将各个区域季风在随季节演变的过程中相互联结。在年际到多年代际时间尺度上，有证据表明北半球（NH）与南半球（SH）的季风降水呈现一致的变化，受 ENSO 和大气下边界其他全球气候变率模态的驱动。

The dominant monsoon systems in the world include the Asian-Australian, African, and the American monsoons. Each monsoon system generally has its own unique and specific characteristics in terms of variability. At the same time, the connections in the global divergent circulation necessitated by mass conservation link the various regional monsoons as they evolve through the season. On interannual-to-multidecadal time scales, there is evidence that monsoon precipitation in the Northern Hemisphere (NH) and Southern Hemisphere (SH) varies coherently, driven by ENSO and other global modes of climate variability at the lower boundary of the atmosphere.

季风面积与降水强度的变化共同导致了自 20 世纪 50 年代以来全球陆地季风降水累积量的总体减弱趋势。

The combination of changes in monsoon area and rainfall intensity has led to an overall weakening trend of global land monsoon rainfall accumulation since the 1950s.

这一减弱趋势主要由非洲季风和南亚季风主导，原因是降水强度和季风覆盖范围均呈显著减弱趋势。然而，自 20 世纪 80 年代开始，北半球全球季风降水呈现上升趋势。

This decreasing tendency is dominated by the African and South Asian monsoons, due to the significant decreasing tendencies of both rainfall intensity and monsoon coverage. Beginning in the 1980s, however, the NH global monsoon precipitation has shown an upward trend.

理解全球季风降水变化的机制，并识别自然与人为强迫因子的作用，一直是季风研究界的核心关注点。

Understanding the mechanisms of precipitation changes in the global monsoons and identifying the roles of natural and anthropogenic forcing agents have been foci of the monsoon research community.

虽然所有季风都是大尺度的跨赤道翻转环流，但不同区域季风的特征之间存在重大差异，这是因为地形不同所致。这一点在亚洲地区最为明显，原因是青藏高原（TIP）/喜马拉雅山脉的存在。

While all monsoons are large-scale cross-equatorial overturning circulations, major differences between characteristics of the different regional monsoons arise because of the different orography. This is most apparent for the Asia region, due to the TIP/Himalaya.

气候模式是研究气候变率与气候变化的有用工具。然而，当前最先进的气候模式在季风区的表现非常差，亟需大幅改进。

Climate models are useful tools in climate variability and climate change studies. However, the performance of the current state-of-the-art climate models is very poor and needs to be greatly improved over the monsoon domains.

全球季风模式比较计划（以下简称 GMMIP）旨在通过开展多模式比较，加深我们对全球季风系统物理过程的理解，并更好地模拟全球季风的平均态、年际变率和长期变化。

The Global Monsoons Model Inter-comparison Project (hereafter GMMIP) aims to improve our understanding of physical processes in global monsoon systems and to better simulate the mean state, interannual variability and long-term change of global monsoons by performing multi-model inter-comparisons.

内部变率（IPO——太平洋年代际振荡，AMO——大西洋多年代际振荡）与外部人为强迫对 20 世纪和 21 世纪全球季风历史演变的贡献也将得到研究。

The contributions of internal variability (IPO-Interdecadal Pacific Oscillation, AMO-Atlantic Multidecadal Oscillation) and external anthropogenic forcing to the historical evolution of global monsoons in the 20th and 21st century will be addressed.

主要科学问题：
1）内部过程与外部强迫对驱动 20 世纪全球季风历史演变的相对贡献分别是什么？

Primary Science Questions:
1) What are the relative contributions of internal processes and external forcing that are driving the 20th century historical evolution of global monsoons?

2）大气-海洋相互作用在多大程度上、以何种方式影响年际变率和可预报性？

2) To what extent and how does the atmopshere-ocean interaction contribute to the interannual variability and predictability?

3）欧亚大陆地形，尤其是喜马拉雅山脉/青藏高原，对区域/全球季风有何影响？

3) What are the effects of Eurasian orography, in particular the Himalaya/Tibetan Plateau, on the regional/global monsoons?

4）发展高分辨率模式、改进模式动力与物理过程，能在多大程度上帮助可靠地模拟季风降水及其变率与变化？

4) How well can developing high-resolution models and improving model dynamics and physics help to reliably simulate monsoon precipitation and its variability and change?

通过聚焦解决这四个问题，我们期望加深对模式再现季风平均态及其自然变率能力、以及对自然与人为强迫响应能力的理解，这最终将有助于减少模式不确定性、提高模式在预估季风未来变化方面的可信度。这些协调试验也将有助于推进我们对季风变化的物理理解与预测。

By focusing on addressing these four questions we expect to deepen our understanding of models’ capability in reproducing the monsoon mean state and its natural variability as well as the forced response to natural and anthropogenic forcing, which ultimately will help to reduce model uncertainty and improve the credibility of models in projecting future changes in the monsoon. The coordinated experiments will also help advance our physical understanding and prediction of monsoon changes.

由于当前模式中物理参数化存在不确定性，解决这些问题的最佳途径是采用多模式框架。CMIP6 为推进季风模拟与理解提供了良好机遇。GMMIP 将为 WCRP 五大科学挑战中的四项做出贡献，即：区域气候信息、水资源可利用性、气候极端事件，以及云、环流与气候敏感度。

Due to the uncertainties in the physical parameterizations in current models, the best way to address these questions is through a multi-model framework. CMIP6 provides a good opportunity for advancement of monsoon modeling and understanding. GMMIP will contribute to four of the five grand challenges of the WCRP, viz. Regional Climate Information, Water Availability, Climate Extremes, and Clouds, Circulation and Climate Sensitivity.

拟议试验：
GMMIP 的主要试验将分为层级1（Tier 1）和层级2（Tier 2），并在层级3（Tier 3）中设有更多可选设想。GMMIP 的全部试验汇总于表 1。层级1试验将是扩展的 AMIP（大气模式比较计划）运行，这是参与 GMMIP 的入门条件。

Proposed Experiments:
The main experiments of GMMIP will be divided into Tier 1 and Tier 2, with further optional ideas in Tier 3. The total experiments of GMMIP are summarized in Table 1. The Tier-1 experiments will be extended AMIP runs. This is the entry card for GMMIP.

层级2 HIST-IPO 运行是 20 世纪历史气候模拟的"起搏器"运行，包含所有强迫，海表温度（SST）恢复到模式气候态加上太平洋年代际振荡（IPO；Power et al. 1999；Folland et al. 2002）域（20°S-20°N，175°E-75°W）热带瓣区的观测历史异常：内区（15°S-15°N，180°-80°W）权重=1，从内区到外区的缓冲带（纬向和经向范围均为 5°）内权重线性减小至零。

The Tier-2 HIST-IPO run is Pacemaker 20th century historical climate simulation that includes all forcing, and the sea surface temperature (SST) restored to the model climatology plus observational historical anomaly in the tropical lobe of the Interdecadal Pacific Oscillation (IPO; Power et al. 1999; Folland et al. 2002) domain (20°S-20°N, 175°E-75°W): the weight=1 in the inner box (15°S-15°N, 180°-80°W), linearly reduced to zero in the buffer zone (zonal and meridional ranges are both 5°) from the inner to outer box.

层级2 HIST-AMO 运行是 20 世纪历史气候模拟的"起搏器"运行，包含所有强迫，SST 恢复到模式气候态加上大西洋多年代际振荡（AMO；Enfield et al. 2001；Trenberth and Shea 2006）域（0°-70°N，70°W-0°）的观测历史异常：内区（5°N-65°N，65°W-5°W）权重=1，从内区到外区的缓冲带（纬向和经向范围均为 5°）内权重线性减小至零。

The Tier-2 HIST-AMO run is Pacemaker 20th century historical climate simulation that includes all forcing, and the SST restored to the model climatology plus observational historical anomaly in the Atlantic Multidecadal Oscillation (AMO; Enfield et al. 2001; Trenberth and Shea 2006) domain (0°-70°N, 70°W-0°): the weight=1 in the inner box (5°N-65°N, 65°W-5°W), linearly reduced to zero in the buffer zone (zonal and meridional ranges are both 5°) from the inner to outer box.

在层级3 DTIP 试验中，遵循 Boos 和 Kuang（2011, 2013）以及 Wu 等人（2007, 2012）的做法，将模式中青藏高原（以下简称 TIP）（20-60°N，25-120°E）的地形削平至某一高度（例如 500m），地表属性保持不变。积分的其他设置与标准 DECK AMIP 运行相同。该试验代表相对于标准 DECK AMIP 运行对 TIP 热力与动力强迫的扰动。

In Tier-3 DTIP run, following Boos and Kuang (2011, 2013) and Wu et al. (2007, 2012), the topography of the Tibetan Plateau(hereafter TIP) (20-60oN, 25-120oE) in the model is modified by leveling off the TIP to a certain height (e.g. 500m), with the surface properties unchanged. Other settings of the integration are the same as the standard DECK AMIP run. This experiment represents perturbations to both thermal and mechanical forcing of the TIP with respect to the standard DECK AMIP run.

在层级3 DTIP-DSH 试验中，不允许 TIP 上 500m 以上高程处的地表感热通量加热大气，即将大气热力学方程中的垂直扩散加热项设为零（Wu et al. 2012）。积分的其他设置与标准 DECK AMIP 运行相同。标准 DECK AMIP 运行与 DTIP-DSH 之间的差异被认为代表了仅去除 TIP 热力强迫的效应，因此 DTIP-DSH 的环流型反映了动力强迫的影响。

In Tier-3 DTIP-DSH run, the surface sensible heat flux at elevations above 500m over the TIP is not allowed to heat the atmosphere, i.e., the vertical diffusive heating term in the atmospheric thermodynamic equation is set to zero (Wu et al. 2012).Other settings of the integration are the same as the standard DECK AMIP run. The differences between the standard DECK AMIP run and the DTIP-DSH are considered to represent the removal of TIP thermal forcing only and thus the circulation pattern of DTIP-DSH reflects the impacts of mechanical forcing.

GMMIP 试验的分析说明：
GMMIP 的分析包括四项任务：

Description of the analysis of GMMIP experiments:
There are four tasks in the analysis of GMMIP:

1）任务1：20 世纪的全球季风变化
2）任务2：欧亚大陆地形对区域/全球季风的作用（喜马拉雅/青藏高原试验）
3）任务3：全球季风降水的年际变率
4）任务4：全球季风的高分辨率模拟

1) Task-1: The global monsoons changes in the 20th century
2) Task-2: The role of Eurasian orography on the regional/global monsoons (Himalaya/Tibetan Plateau experiment)
3) Task-3: Interannual variability of global monsoon precipitations
4) Task-4: High resolution modeling of global monsoons

四项任务的分析将使用 GMMIP 试验、DAMIP（检测与归因模式比较计划）试验、HighResMIP 试验、CMIP6 历史模拟以及 DECK 的 AMIP 试验的输出。

The analysis of fours tasks will use the outputs of GMMIP experiments, DAMIP (Detection and Attribution MIP) experiments, HighResMIP experiments, the CMIP6 Historical Simulation, and the AMIP experiments of DECK.

与 DECK 和 CMIP6 历史模拟的联系：
DECK 模拟将作为参与 CMIP6 认可比较计划的入门条件。DECK 试验包括：

Connection with DECK and CMIP6 Historical Simulation
The DECK simulations will serve as an entry card for the CMIP6-Endorsed MIPS. The DECK experiments are:

• 突增 4XCO2

• Switch-on 4XCO2

原译"• 瞬时 4XCO2"改为"• 突增 4XCO2"，与 DECK 突增强迫术语一致（见 13-gmmip.part05.html）。

具有标准 CMIP6 分辨率的 AMIP DECK 模拟将用于 GMMIP 的分析。GMMIP 的层级1 AGCM 试验将指定与 1850-2014 年历史模拟（即 CMIP6 历史模拟）一致的具体强迫。

The AMIP DECK simulation with the standard CMIP6 resolution will be used in the analysis of GMMIP. The Tier-1 AGCM experiment of GMMIP will specify the specific forcings which are consistent with the historical simulation from 1850-2014, viz. the CMIP6 Historical Simulation.

与其他 MIP 的联系：

Connection with other MIPs

DAMIP（检测与归因模式比较计划）：
DAMIP 的 histALL（扩大 DECK 中历史全强迫运行的集合规模）、histNAT（仅自然强迫的历史运行）、histGHG（仅充分混合温室气体强迫的历史运行）和 histAER 试验（仅人为气溶胶强迫的历史运行）将用于 GMMIP 任务1 的分析。

DAMIP (Detection and Attribution MIP):
The histALL (enlarging ensemble size of historical ALL foring runs in DECK), histNAT (Historical natural-only run), histGHG (Historical well-mixed GHG-only run), histAER experiments (Historical anthropogenic-Aerosols-only run) of DAMIP will be used in the analysis of Task-1 of GMMIP.

histALL、histNAT 和 histGHG 的组合将使我们能够在温室气体、其他人为因子和自然强迫贡献的背景下，理解观测到的 20 世纪全球季风降水与环流变化。这些外部强迫的贡献将与 IPO 和 AMO 等内部变率模态的贡献进行比较。

Combinations of histALL, histNAT and histGHG will allow us to understand the observed the 20th century global monsoon precipitation and circulation changes in the context of contributions from GHG, the other anthropogenic factors and natural forcing. The contributions of these external forcings will be compared to those from internal variability modes such as IPO and AMO.

HighResMIP：
HighResMIP 的层级1试验是 AMIP 运行，但在中纬度采用最少 25-50 km 的高分辨率，并配有标准分辨率配置（1950-2014），将用于 GMMIP 任务4 的分析，该任务旨在检验高分辨率模式在再现全球季风平均态和逐年变率方面的表现。

HighResMIP:
The Tier-1 experiments of HighResMIP, which are AMIP runs but with minimum 25-50 km at mid-latitudes for high resolution and a standard resolution configuration (1950-2014), will be used in the analysis of Task-4 of GMMIP, which aims to examine the performance of high-resolution models in reproducing both the mean state and year-to-year variability of global monsoons.

HighResMIP 的层级2试验是耦合运行，由使用固定 1950 年代强迫的历史运行与对照运行成对组成，将用于 GMMIP 任务3 的分析，该任务旨在理解海气相互作用过程在改进季风平均态和逐年变率中的作用。

The Tier-2 experiments of HighResMIP, which are coupled runs consisting of pairs of both historic runs and control runs using fixed 1950s forcing, will be used in the analysis of Task-3 of GMMIP, which aims to understand the role of air-sea interaction process in the improvement of monsoon mean state and year-by-year variability.

WCRP 科学挑战：
GMMIP 将通过以下方式回应 WCRP 的科学挑战：

WCRP Grand Challenges:
GMMIP will address the grand challenges of the WCRP in the following way:

区域气候信息（排名 1）
GMMIP 将增进我们对全球季风区 20 世纪气候变化的理解。外部人为强迫（温室气体、气溶胶）、自然强迫和内部变率模态（IPO、AMO）的贡献将被识别。这些将为人口密集的全球季风区提供有用的气候预测/预估信息。

Regional Climate Information (rank 1)
GMMIP will improve our understanding of the 20th climate changes in global monsoon domains. The contributions of external anthropogenic forcings (GHG, aerosol), natural forcing, and internal variability modes (IPO, AMO) will be indentified. These would provide useful information for climate prediction/projections in the highly populated global monsoon domains.

水资源可利用性（排名 2）
全球季风区的水资源深受季风异常活动的影响。理解 GMMIP 提出的季风变率机制，将促进季风预测/预估的改进，并为决策者在水资源可利用性相关的决策中提供有用信息。

Water Availability (rank 2)
The water resources in global monsoon domains are greatly affected by the anomalous activities of monsoons. Understanding the mechanisms of monsoon variability as posed by GMMIP will lead to improvement of monsoon prediction/projection and provide useful information for policymakers in water availability-related decision making.

气候极端事件（排名 2）
特大干旱和洪涝等极端事件在全球季风区频繁发生。

Climate Extremes (rank 2)
Extreme events such as mega-droughts and flooding have been frequently occurred in global monsoon domains.

GMMIP 有望找出改进全球季风区气候极端事件模拟/预测的有用途径。

GMMIP is hopefully to identify the useful ways of improving the simulation/prediction of climate extremes in global monsoon domains.

云、环流与气候敏感度（排名 2）
对季风环流和云的合理模拟是成功模拟季风降水的前提。通过比较高分辨率与常规分辨率气候模式的表现，以及有无海气相互作用过程的模拟，GMMIP 的实施将在减少模式偏差和改进模式表现的意义上，把季风环流与季风降水联系起来。

Clouds, Circulation and Climate Sensitivity (rank 2).
A reasonable simulation of monsoon circulation and clouds is a prerequisite for a successful simulation of monsoon precipitation. By comparing the performances of climate models with high and normal resolutions, model simulations with/without air-sea interaction processes, the implementation of GMMIP will link the monsoon circulations to monsoon precipitation in the context of reducing model bias and improving model performances.

GEWEX 与 CLIVAR
季风一直是 GEWEX 和 CLIVAR 的研究重点。GMMIP 中列出的科学问题最初由 CLIVAR 亚洲-澳大利亚季风工作组、GEWEX/CLIVAR 季风工作组和 CLIVAR/C20C+ 项目提出。CLIVAR 研究机遇老虎团队关于"气候系统的年代际变率及其可预报性"、以及关于"季风系统的季节内、季节和年际变率与可预报性"的报告也强调了这些问题。

GEWEX and CLIVAR
Monsoon has been a research focus of GEWEX and CLIVAR. The scientific questions listed in GMMIP were originally identified by the CLIVAR Asian-Australian monsoon panel, the GEWEX/CLIVAR Monsoons Panel, and CLIVAR/C20C+ project. The questions have also been highlighted by the reports of CLIVAR Research Opportunities Tiger Team on “Decadal Variability in the Climate System and its Predictability”, and CLIVAR Research Opportunities Tiger Team on “Intra-seasonal, Seasonal and Interannual Variability and Predictability of Monsoon Systems”.

参与方式：
参与 GMMIP 是自愿和开放的。GMMIP 将由一个由气候诊断、气候变化归因和气候模拟界积极参与的代表组成的小型工作组协调。该工作组将尽可能广泛地吸纳科学界成员的投入与参与。

Participation:
Participation in GMMIP is voluntary and open. GMMIP will be coordinated by a small working group composed of engaged representatives from climate diagnosis, climate change attribution and climate modeling communities. This working group will engage the broadest degree of input and involvement from members of the scientific community.

GMMIP 科学指导委员会（SSC）将由来自 CLIVAR 与 GEWEX 季风工作组、相关项目和全球季风界的代表组成。SSC 将为 GMMIP 的分析提供意见和建议，重点关注提案中列出的科学问题。

The Scientific Steering Committee (SSC) of GMMIP will be composed of representatives from CLIVAR & GEWEX monsoon panels, relevant projects and the global monsoon community. The SSC will provide comments and instructions for the analysis of GMMIP with focus on the scientific questions listed in the proposal.

附录：GMMIP 四项任务科学目标的说明

Appendix: Description of the scientific objectives of four tasks of GMMIP

任务1：20 世纪的全球季风变化
全球季风在 20 世纪呈现出多年代际变化。理解全球季风变化的机制、识别自然与人为强迫因子的贡献，一直是季风研究界的核心关注点。任务1 旨在通过开展覆盖 1870 年至 2013 年时段的耦合、非耦合和部分耦合运行，揭示全球海洋强迫对季风降水变化的作用，并识别自然与人为强迫（温室气体和气溶胶）的相对贡献。

TASK-1: The global monsoons changes in the 20th century
The global monsoons have shown multi-decadal changes in the 20th century. Understanding the mechanisms of global monsoon changes and identifying the contributions of natural and anthropogenic forcing agents have been foci of the monsoon research community. TASK-1 aims to reveal the role of forcing from the global oceans on monsoon precipitation change, and identify the relative contributions of natural and anthropogenic forcing (greenhouse gases and aerosols) by performing coupled, uncoupled, and partly coupled runs that cover the period from 1870 to 2013.

任务2：欧亚大陆地形对区域/全球季风的作用（喜马拉雅/青藏高原试验）
虽然季风一般是大尺度翻转环流，但区域季风特征之间的明显差异源于不同的地形。这一点在亚洲地区最为明显，原因是青藏-伊朗高原（TIP）的存在。大尺度地形对亚洲夏季风的影响包括动力强迫和热力强迫两方面。关于地形效应，人们提出了多种机制；然而，界定决定这些效应的主导因子及其影响强度的总体范式仍存在争议。任务2 的目标是提供当前模式在模拟季风与青藏-伊朗高原（TIP，20-60°N、25-120°E 的高地）关系方面表现的基准，以推动对 TIP 对季风系统热力与动力效应的进一步研究。特别是将研究 TIP 热力强迫与地形动力强迫对亚洲季风的相对贡献。该任务将研究范围从 TIP 扩展到包括非洲、北美洲和南美洲高地在内的其他高地。

TASK-2: The role of Eurasian orography on the regional/global monsoons (Himalaya/Tibetan Plateau experiment)
Although monsoons are generally large-scale overturning circulations, apparent differences between characteristics of regional monsoons arise because of the different orography. This is most apparent for the Asia region, due to the existence of Tibetan – Iranian Plateau (TIP). The influence of the large-scale orography on the Asian summer monsoon includes both mechanical and thermal forcing. Various mechanisms have been suggested concerning the topographic effects; however, an overarching paradigm delineating the dominant factors determining these effects and the strength of impacts remains debated. The goals of TASK-2 are to provide a benchmark of current model behavior in simulating the relationship of the monsoon to the Tibetan-Iranian Plateau (TIP, the highlands in 20-60oN, 25-120oE) so as to stimulate further research on the thermodynamical and dynamical effects of the TIP on the monsoon system. In particular the relative contributions of thermal and orographic mechanical forcing by the TIP to the Asian monsoon will be addressed. The task extends the studies from the TIP to other highlands including highlands in Africa, N. America and S. America.

任务3：全球季风降水的年际变率
给定 SST 的 AGCM 模拟在模拟全球季风区夏季降水方面通常技巧较低，尤其是在亚洲-西太平洋夏季季风区。这可以部分归因于排除了海气耦合过程。有观点认为，在真实世界中，季风区的海气相互作用表现为"季风驱动海洋"，但在 AMIP 模拟中，相互作用机制在构造上则是"海洋驱动季风"（Wang et al. 2005）。任务3 旨在理解海气相互作用过程在驱动全球季风年际变率中的作用。

TASK-3: Interannual variability of global monsoon precipitations
AGCM simulations with specified SST generally have low skill in simulating the summer precipitation over global monsoon domains, especially the Asian-western Pacific summer monsoon domain. This can be partly attributed to the exclusion of air-sea coupled processes. It is argued that in the real world the air-sea interaction in monsoon domains appears as “monsoon-driving-ocean”, but in an AMIP simulation, the interaction mechanism is “ocean-driving-monsoon” by construction (Wang et al. 2005). The TASK-3 aims to understand the air-sea interaction process in driving the interannual variability of global monsoons.

任务4：全球季风的高分辨率模拟
季风雨带的最大宽度通常为 200 km。低分辨率或中等分辨率的气候模式通常无法真实再现季风降水的平均态和变率。这在一定程度上归因于模式分辨率。任务4 旨在检验高分辨率模式在再现全球季风平均态和逐年变率方面的表现。将使用高分辨率雨量计观测和卫星降水产品来评估模式的表现。

TASK-4: High resolution modeling of global monsoons
The monsoon rainbands are usually at a maximum width of 200 km. Climate models with low or moderate resolutions are generally unable to realistically reproduce the mean state and variability of monsoon precipitation. This is partly due to the model resolution. The TASK-4 aims to examine the performance of high-resolution models in reproducing both the mean state and year-to-year variability of global monsoons. High resolution rain-gauge observations and satellite precipitation products will be used to gauge models’ performances.

HighResMIP (High Resolution MIP) ｜ 高分辨率模式比较计划
