网站：http://www.wcrp-climate.org/index.php/modelling-wgcm-mip-catalogue/modelling-wgcm-mips/429wgcm-hiresmip；https://dev.knmi.nl/projects/highresmip/wiki

Websites http://www.wcrp-climate.org/index.php/modelling-wgcm-mip-catalogue/modelling-wgcm-mips/429wgcm-hiresmip https://dev.knmi.nl/projects/highresmip/wiki

HighResMIP 的目标

Goal of HighResMIP

我们希望首次在一个采用物理气候系统并施加约束气溶胶强迫的简化框架内，评估以“天气分辨”级别的全球模式分辨率（约 25 千米或更细）改进重要气候过程表征的稳健性。

For the first time, we want to assess the robustness of improvements in the representation of important climate processes with "weather-resolving" global model resolutions (~25km or finer), within a simplified framework using the physical climate system with constrained aerosol forcing.

近期使用全球高分辨率气候模式所做的模拟，与 CMIP3 和 CMIP5 归档中模式的输出相比，已经证明了提高分辨率带来的附加价值。

Recent simulations with global high-resolution climate models have demonstrated the added value of enhanced resolution compared to the output from models in the CMIP3 and CMIP5 archive.

它们在模拟大尺度环流的若干方面表现出显著改进，例如厄尔尼诺—南方涛动（ENSO）（Shaffrey et al 2009）、热带不稳定波（Roberts et al 2009）、湾流及其对大气的影响（Chassignet and Marshall 2008; Kuwano-Yoshida et al 2010）、全球水循环（Demory et al. 2014）、温带气旋与风暴路径（Hodges et al. 2011）以及欧亚—大西洋阻塞（Jung et al 2012）。

They showed significant improvement in the simulation of aspects of the large scale circulation such as such as El Niño Southern Oscillation (ENSO) (Shaffrey et al 2009), Tropical Instability Waves (Roberts et al 2009), the Gulf Stream and its influence on the atmosphere (Chassignet and Marshall 2008; Kuwano-Yoshida et al 2010), the global water cycle (Demory et al. 2014), extra-tropical cyclones and storm tracks (Hodges et al. 2011) and Euro-Atlantic blocking (Jung et al 2012).

此外，提高分辨率还能更真实地模拟可能造成严重影响的小尺度现象，如热带气旋（Zhao et al. 2009）、热带—温带相互作用（Haarsma et al. 2013）和极地低压。

In addition, the increased resolution enables more realistic simulation of small scale phenomena with potentially severe impacts such as tropical cyclones (Zhao et al. 2009), tropical-extratropical interactions (Haarsma et al. 2013) and polar lows.

对分辨率提高敏感的其他现象还有海洋混合、海冰动力过程和季风。

Other phenomena that are sensitive to increasing resolution are ocean mixing, sea-ice dynamics and monsoons.

气候模拟的改进也带来了对极端事件（如热浪、干旱和洪水）更好的表征。

The improved simulation of climate also results in better representation of extreme events such as heat waves, droughts and floods.

由于需要大量多世纪尺度的模拟（其中包括约束不佳的地球系统过程与反馈），CMIP 中的模式分辨率进展一直非常缓慢。

The requirement for a multitude of multi-centennial simulations, including poorly constrained Earth System processes and feedbacks, has meant that model resolution within CMIP has progressed very slowly.

在 CMIP3 中，典型分辨率为大气 250 千米、海洋 1.5°；而七年多之后的 CMIP5，这一数值仅分别提高到 150 千米和 1°。

In CMIP3 the typical resolution was 250km in the atmosphere and 1.5° in the ocean, while more than seven years later in CMIP5 this had only increased to 150km and 1° respectively.

到目前为止，高分辨率模拟仅在少数研究中心开展过，缺乏整体协调。

Until now high-resolution simulations have been performed at only a few research centers without overall coordination.

由于这些模拟需要庞大的计算机资源，若能以协调一致的方式开展这些试验，就能产生协同效应，从而能够（在每套模式集合成员数量有限的情况下）构建具有共同积分时段、强迫和边界条件的多模式集合。

Due to the large computer resources needed for these simulations, synergy will be gained if these runs are done in a coordinated way, which enables the construction of a multi-model ensemble (since ensemble size for each model will be limited) with common integration periods, forcing and boundary conditions.

CMIP3 和 CMIP5 数据库为这一方法的成功提供了出色的范例。

The CMIP3 and CMIP5 data bases provide outstanding examples of the success of this approach.

在季节和年代际预测中，多模式平均已被证明往往优于单个模式。

The multi-model mean has proven often to be superior to individual models in seasonal and decadal forecasting.

此外，通过分析模式间离散度并尝试将其归因于模式构建方式，也获得了重要的科学认识。

Moreover, significant scientific understanding has been gained from analyzing the inter-model spread and attempting to attribute to model formulation.

HighResMIP 的首要目标是：在模式水平分辨率提高时（尽可能在不同分辨率下对模式只做极少甚至不做其他改动），研究多模式集合中气候过程表征变化的稳健性。

The primary goal of HighResMIP is to investigate the robustness across a multi-model ensemble of changes to the representation of climate processes as model horizontal resolution is increased (with, as far as possible, few if any other changes to the model at different resolutions).

具体而言，HighResMIP 针对 CMIP6 最优先的宽泛科学问题是“系统性模式偏差的起源与后果是什么”，它将通过过程层面的评估，专注于理解模式误差（应用于平均态、变率和遥相关），而非气候敏感度。

Specifically the top priority CMIP6 broad question for HighResMIP is "What are the origins and consequences of systematic model biases", which will focus on understanding model error (applied to mean state, variability and teleconnections), via process-level assessment, rather than on climate sensitivity.

这影响了我们对拟议模拟的选择：这些模拟侧重于对近期过去和未来几十年的采样，因为在这段时间尺度上，气候变率是比气候敏感度更重要的因素。

This has motivated our choices in terms of proposed simulations, which emphasize sampling the recent past and the next few decades where climate variability is the more important factor than climate sensitivity.

从过程的角度看，分析的重点将放在大气涡旋上，包括热带和温带气旋。

From the point of view of processes, a focus will be on the analysis of atmospheric eddies, including tropical and extra-tropical cyclones.

尤其有价值的是北大西洋海盆中飓风（以及高分辨率下正在显现的过程）的变率。

Of particular value is the variability of hurricanes (and emerging process at high-resolution) in the North Atlantic basin.

HighResMIP 将协调高分辨率模拟界的各项工作。

HighResMIP will coordinate the efforts in the high-resolution modeling community.

基于过程评估、并力求将模式性能归因于正在显现的物理气候过程（不含地球系统反馈的复杂性）以及模式物理过程对分辨率的敏感性而开展的联合分析，将进一步凸显提高分辨率对模拟气候的影响。

Joint analysis, based on process-based assessment and seeking to attribute model performance to emerging physical climate processes (without the complications of Earth System feedbacks) and sensitivity of model physics to model resolution, will further highlight the impact of enhanced resolution on the simulated climate.

由于分辨率对气候模拟具有广泛影响，HighResMIP 将为 WCRP 的全部五项重大挑战（grand challenges）做出贡献，因此这类分析可能开始揭示在何种分辨率下特定过程能被稳健地表征。

As a result of the widespread impact of resolution on the simulation of the climate, HighResMIP will contribute to all of the five grand challenges of the WCRP, and hence such analysis may begin to reveal at what resolution particular processes can be robustly represented.

按照 CMIP6 的要求，HighResMIP 将向 GMD 的 CMIP6 专刊投稿一篇论文。

HighResMIP will contribute an article to the GMD CMIP6 special issue as required by CMIP6.

此外，HighResMIP 还将与其他模拟组合作撰写一篇综合论文，重点关注模拟试验之间交叉利用的潜力。

In addition HighResMIP will contribute to a synthesis paper in collaboration with the other modeling groups, focusing on the potential for cross-exploitation of simulations.

表 I 中的欧洲机构正在参与欧洲 H2020 项目 PRIMAVERA，该项目负责协调高分辨率试验的模拟与分析。

The European institutes in Table I are participating in the European H2020 project PRIMAVERA that coordinates the simulation and analyses of high-resolution runs.

如果 HighResMIP 获得认可，它们将遵循该协议。

If HighResMIP is endorsed they will follow that protocol.

目前，以下模拟中心计划向 HighResMIP 贡献 Tier 1（第一层级）模拟：EC-Earth 联盟（KNMI、IC3、SMHI）；英国气象局（Met. Office）；CMCC，意大利；GFDL，美国；CNRM，法国；MRI，日本；MPI，德国；AWI，德国；CPTEC，巴西；IAP，中国；JAMSTEC，日本；NICAM，日本；BCC，中国。

Presently the following modelling centers plan to contribute Tier 1 simulations to HighResMIP: - EC-Earth consortium, (KNMI, IC3, SMHI) - Met. Office, UK - CMCC, Italy - GFDL, USA - CNRM, France - MRI, Japan - MPI, Germany - AWI, Germany - CPTEC, Brazil - IAP, China - JAMSTEC, Japan - NICAM, Japan - BCC, China

此外，目前因计算机资源有限而无法开展 HighResMIP 模拟的机构——如澳大利亚气候系统科学卓越研究中心（ARC Centre of Excellence for Climate System Science）——已表示对分析 HighResMIP 模拟结果有浓厚兴趣。

In addition institutes that are not able to undertake the HighResMIP simulations currently due to limited computer resources, such as the ARC Centre of Excellence for Climate System Science (Australia) have expressed their strong interest in analyzing the HighResMIP simulations.

Table I: European institutes, together with the models and the resolutions that are committed to HighResMIP (note that the eddy resolving 1/10-1/12˚ ocean may be used for a small subset of simulations).

拟议试验

Proposed Experiments

主要试验将分为 Tier 1、Tier 2 和 Tier 3 三个层级。

The main experiments will be divided between Tier 1, 2 and 3.

Tier 1（第一层级）试验将是历史时段 AMIP（大气模式比较计划）试验。

The Tier 1 experiments will be historical AMIP runs.

已有少数机构完成过高分辨率 AMIP 试验并发表了结果。

A few institutes have already performed high resolution AMIP runs and published their results.

这些试验不会带来高得难以承受的技术困难，相当数量的机构都有能力提交一套协调一致的试验。

These runs will not impose such prohibitively large technical difficulties and it is feasible for a considerable number of institutes to deliver a coordinated and coherent set of experiments.

将 AMIP 试验限定在历史时段，也使这些试验对数值天气预报（NWP）中心具有吸引力，并降低了核心模拟的成本。

Restricting the AMIP runs to the historical period make these runs also interesting for NWP centers and reduces the cost of the core simulations.

对于耦合试验，情况则有些不同。

For the coupled experiments the situation is somewhat different.

尽管少数机构已经开展过高分辨率耦合模拟，但仍然存在一些问题，例如偏差和模式启动（spin-up）。

Although a few institutes already have carried out high resolution coupled simulations, there still remain issues with for instance biases and spin-up.

由于这些问题以及所需的大量计算机资源，只有少数机构有能力承担这些耦合模拟，因此它们将放在 Tier 2（第二层级）中进行。

Due to these issues and the large amount of computer resources needed, only a limited number of institutes will be able to afford these coupled simulations, and hence they will be done in Tier 2.

未来时段的 AMIP 模拟将在 Tier 3（第三层级）中进行。

Future AMIP simulations will be done in Tier 3.

这需要构建与 HighResMIP 模式提高后的分辨率相匹配的 SST 和海冰数据集。

This requires the construction of SST and sea-ice data sets that match the increased resolution of the HighResMIP models.

尽管未来时段覆盖整个本世纪，但出于计算方面的原因，模拟可以限制到本世纪中叶。

Although the future period covers the entire present century, the simulations can for computational reasons be restricted to mid-century.

标准 CMIP6 分辨率试验

Standard CMIP6 resolution experiments

为评估提高分辨率的影响，Tier 1、2 和 3 中的试验将以标准 CMIP6 分辨率重复进行。

To evaluate the impact of increased resolution the experiments in Tier 1, 2 and 3will be repeated with the standard CMIP6 resolution.

标准分辨率试验的试验设置与设计与高分辨率试验完全相同。

The experimental set-up and design of the standard resolution experiments will be exactly the same as for the high-resolution runs.

这使得 HighResMIP 模拟可用于研究分辨率影响的敏感性研究。

This enables the use of HighResMIP simulations for sensitivity studies investigating the impact of resolution.

Tier 1（第一层级）：AMIP 试验

Tier 1 AMIP runs

分辨率：高分辨率在中纬度最低 25-50 千米，另加一个标准分辨率配置。

Resolution: minimum 25-50 km at mid-latitudes for high resolution + a standard resolution configuration.

这一分辨率显著高于 CMIP5 所用分辨率。

This resolution is significantly higher than used in CMIP5.

在这一分辨率下，数十年到百年尺度的积分目前已可行。

Multi-decadal to century integrations for this resolution are now feasible.

积分时段：近代 1950-2014 年

Period of integration: Near Past 1950-2014

这一时段比始于 1979 年的 DECK AMIP 试验更长。

This period is longer that the DECK AMIP run that starts in 1979.

这主要是受许多研究组工作的推动：他们在多年代际时间尺度上考察气候变率，涉及 AMO、PDO 等气候模态的不同位相，并改进对 ENSO 遥相关的采样。

This is motivated primarily by work in many groups looking at climate variability over multi-decadal timescales with different phases of climate modes such as AMO, PDO, as well as improved sampling of ENSO teleconnections.

更长的时段还将提高评估标准分辨率与更高分辨率模拟之间变率差异的稳健性，并且对遥相关统计（例如 Rowell et al, 2013）也很重要。

The longer period will also improve the robustness of assessing the difference in variability between standard and higher resolution simulations, as well as being important for statistics of teleconnections (e.g. Rowell et al, 2013).

较长的积分时段（与较短时段上的积分集合相比）还将使对模式响应已知变率模态及其位相的能力的评估稳健得多——当我们考虑全球变暖信号叠加未来自然变率的影响时，这显然是气候风险中的一个重大问题。

The longer period of integration (as compared to ensembles of integrations over a shorter period) will also give a much more robust assessment of the ability of models to respond to known modes and their phases of variability, which is clearly a big issue for climate risk when we consider the effect of the global warming signal in addition to future natural variability.

虽然从 1870 年开始有助于与 GMMIP 更好地比较，但对许多研究组而言成本过高。

Starting from 1870 though valuable to better compare with GMMIP, would not be affordable for many groups.

此外，用于评估模式变率与过程的更早时段观测/再分析数据的质量也存疑。

In addition, the quality of observational/reanalysis datasets to the earlier period, to assess the modelled variability and processes, must be in question.

强迫：历史温室气体和气溶胶（自然的和人为的）。

Forcing: Historical green house gases and aerosols, natural and anthropogenic.

对于 SST 和海冰，将使用 ¼° 逐日 HadISST 数据集（Rayner et al, in prep.）。

For SST and sea-ice a ¼ degree daily HadISST data set will be used (Rayner et al, in prep.)

最少积分次数：1 次

Minimum number of integrations: 1

任何可承受的集合成员数量，对于严格估计内部变率而言都太低。

Any manageable number is too low for a rigorous estimate of the internal variability.

然而，由于高分辨率协议的目标是在尽可能高的分辨率下进行模拟，集合成员数量必须保持在较低水平。

However, because the aim of the high-res protocol is to perform simulations at the highest possible resolution, the ensemble size has to be kept low.

通过采用许多机构共同遵循的严格统一协议，有效的多模式集合将大得多，从而能够比以往更广泛地采样分辨率影响在多模式间的稳健性。

By using a strictly common protocol that is followed by many institutes, the effective multi-model ensemble will be much larger, enabling a much wider sampling than previously of the multi-model robustness of resolution impacts.

此外，如果模式被证明具有可移植性，且另有计算机资源可用，集合成员数量还可以增加（与欧洲 PRACE 超级计算基础设施的讨论已在开展）。

In addition, if models can be proven to be portable, the ensemble size could be increased if other computer resources are available (discussions are already underway with the European PRACE supercomputing infrastructure).

一些中心或许能够生成大得多的集合，从而能更稳健地估计内部变率。

Some centers may be able to produce much larger ensembles, enabling a more robust estimate of internal variability.

Tier 2（第二层级）：耦合试验

Tier 2 Coupled runs

耦合试验将由成对的试验组成：情景试验（对过去时段而言即历史试验），以及作为对照的、使用固定 1950 年代强迫的控制试验。

The coupled runs will consist of pairs of both scenario (historic for the past) runs and, for comparison, control runs using fixed 1950s forcings.

这将使人们能够在评估气候变化信号之外，还评估模式漂移。

This will allow an evaluation of the model drift in addition to the climate change signal.

耦合模拟也旨在解决与 AMIP 模拟相似的问题，即在平均态和变率两方面的模式偏差问题。

The coupled simulations are also aimed to address questions of model bias in both mean state and variability similar to the AMIP simulations.

以往研究中有许多例子（如 Scaife et al, 2011）表明，与受强迫的大气模拟相比，这些偏差在耦合背景下变得明显得多。

There are many examples from previous studies (e.g. Scaife et al, 2011) where these biases become much more evident in the coupled context compared to the forced atmosphere simulations.

分辨率：大气与 AMIP 试验相同，海洋约 0.25°。

Resolution: Atmosphere same as AMIP-runs. Ocean ~0.25 degree.

这使得海洋（与不允许涡旋的模式相比）能够具有一定的变率，尤其是在热带地区；并且已有研究表明，这会改变海气相互作用的强度（Kirtman et al, 2012）。

This enables the ocean to have some variability (compared to non-eddy permitting models), particularly in the tropics, and has been shown to change the strength of atmosphere-ocean interactions (Kirtman et al, 2012).

积分时段：1950-2050 年

Period of integration: 1950-2050

选择过去时段是为了能够与 Tier 1 的 AMIP 模拟进行比较。

The past period is chosen to be able to compare with the Tier 1 AMIP simulations.

未来的截止日期是在两方面之间折中的结果：一方面是有足够多的中心在计算上可以承受（约 100 年积分），另一方面是科学上的相关性。

The future end-date is based on a compromise between what is computationally affordable by a sufficient number of centers (~100 years of integration) and what is scientifically relevant.

此外，这一时段包含若干个地表增暖速率较低的阶段，多模式多分辨率集合或许能对此提供一些认识。

In addition, this period contains several phases where the surface warming rate is lower, and the multi-model multi-resolution ensemble may give some insight into this.

我们再次强调，在这些耦合模拟中我们关注的是模式误差（偏差、气候过程和变率），而非气候敏感度。

We again emphasize our interest in model error (bias, climate processes and variability) rather than climate sensitivity within these coupled simulations.

当然，HighResMIP 中（至少在初期）可能实现的集合成员数量不足以充分处理内部变率，但它将构成一组重要的基线模拟，我们可以从中开始学习，并且它应当对其他许多 CMIP6 的 MIP（如 DCCP、GMMIP、CORDEX、CFMIP）有用。

Of course the number of ensemble members that will be possible, at least initially, in HighResMIP will not be sufficient to fully address internal variability, but it will form an important baseline set of simulations from which we can begin to learn, and should be useful for many of the other CMIP6 MIPs (e.g. DCCP, GMMIP, CORDEX, CFMIP).

强迫：CMIP6 情景

Forcing: CMIP6 scenario's

CMIP6 情景涵盖从中端到高端的情景范围。

CMIP6 scenarios that span the range from middle to high end scenarios.

对于历史时段，将包含全部自然的和人为的强迫。

For the historical period all forcings, natural and anthropogenic, will be included.

为减少模式间不确定性，模拟应尽可能使用相同的气溶胶强迫。

To reduce the inter-model uncertainty the simulations should have the same aerosol forcing as far as possible.

由于不同研究组在气溶胶模拟上采用的方法各不相同，这是一项具有挑战性的任务。

Due to the different approaches of aerosol modelling in different groups this is a challenging task.

为在模式之间实现最佳比较，应优先使用气溶胶浓度，而非排放。

For optimal comparison between the models aerosol concentrations would be preferable and not emissions.

在与 RFMIP 成员的讨论中，似乎有两项时间尺度不同、正在推进的进展可以利用：

In discussion with RFMIP members there seem to be two upcoming developments with different timescales that could be used:

1. 一种在模式辐射代码中指定人为气溶胶光学厚度和云有效半径相对变化的方法，按排放量进行缩放，外加由各模式按其自身方式模拟或指定的自然气溶胶。

1. A method to prescribe anthropogenic optical depth and relative changes in cloud effective radius within the model radiation code, scaled according to emissions, in addition to natural aerosols as modelled or prescribed by each model natively.

这应当意味着所有模式看到非常相似的气溶胶强迫。

This should mean that all models see very similar aerosol forcing.

这是一项推进程度很高的拟议协议。

This is a well advanced proposed protocol.

2. 主要气溶胶物种质量混合比的时间变化数据集，模式随后可以将其分配到不同的模态上，并允许采用其他模式参数化方案。

2. Time-varying dataset of mass mixing ratios for the main aerosol species, which models can then distribute over different modes and allows for other model parameterizations.

这项工作仍在进行中，但可能需要在 2015 年底至 2016 年初前后获得排放数据集。

This work is ongoing but may need datasets on emissions due late 2015-early 2016.

其他可能性包括：

Other possibilities include:

a. 各模拟中心使用由其标准分辨率 DECK 模拟导出的气溶胶浓度，并在标准分辨率和高分辨率下使用相同的浓度。

a. Each modeling centre to use aerosol concentrations derived from their DECK simulation at standard resolution, the same concentrations to be used at both standard and high resolution

b. 各模式按 DECK 中的方式使用气溶胶排放。

b. Models to use aerosol emissions as in the DECK.

不过，气溶胶强迫的选择将是协议的一项强烈建议，而非硬性规定。

However, the aerosol forcing choice will be a strong recommendation, rather than a specification, of the protocol.

与标准 CMIP6 DECK 类似，各研究组可以选择使用气溶胶排放或指定浓度。

Similar as for the standard CMIP6 DECK, groups can choose to use aerosol emissions or prescribed concentrations

拟议强迫数据集与策略的全部细节可在 WCRP 网站找到（http://www.wcrp-climate.org/index.php/modelling-wgcm-mip-catalogue/429-wgcm-hiresmip）。

The full details of the forcing datasets and strategy proposed can be found from the WCRP website (http://www.wcrp-climate.org/index.php/modelling-wgcm-mip-catalogue/429-wgcm-hiresmip)..

最少积分次数：控制强迫和历史强迫各 1 次

Minimum number of integrations: 1 for each of control and historic forcings

理想情况下，每种强迫的集合数量应为 3 个左右模拟，以帮助评估模式漂移并改进对内部变率的采样，但这会很快在计算上变得非常繁重。

Ideally the ensemble number would be of order 3 simulations for each forcing, to help in evaluating model drift and enabling an improved sampling of internal variability, but this will quickly become very onerous on computing.

耦合：海洋与大气之间至少每日耦合一次，最好更频繁，如 3 小时或 1 小时一次。

Coupling: Minimal daily coupling between ocean and atmosphere. Preferably more frequent, 3hr or 1hr.

海气相互作用发生在所有时间尺度上。

Ocean-atmosphere interaction occurs on all time scales.

采用 3 小时或 1 小时耦合频率，可以分辨日变化时间尺度。

With 3hr or 1hr the diurnal time scale can be resolved.

初始状态：由于计算机资源有限，无法以与 DECK 试验相同的方式获得已平衡的海洋初始状态。

Initial state: Due to limited computer resources an equilibrated initial ocean state in the same way as the DECK experiments is not feasible.

关于耦合模式初始化方法的讨论正在进行中。

Discussions of methods for initializing the coupled models are ongoing.

当前拟议的方法是使用 1950 年 EN3 海洋分析场作为海洋初始条件，然后运行耦合模式（使用 1950 年代的固定强迫），直到满足某些收敛判据（例如上层海洋漂移或大气顶辐射平衡），届时历史试验由此分支出去，而 1950 年代控制试验继续运行。

The current proposed methodology is to use the 1950 EN3 ocean analysis as the ocean initial condition, and then run the coupled model (with 1950's fixed forcing) until some criteria of convergence is satisfied (e.g. upper ocean drift or Top of Atmosphere radiation balance), at which point the historic run will be branched off, with the control 1950's run continuing.

因此，相关的是这两组模拟之间的差异，这应当能消除漂移的主要部分。

Hence it is the difference between these two simulations that is relevant, and this should remove the main part of the drift.

鉴于积分向未来延伸的时间相对较短，深海的完全收敛对于 HighResMIP 的主要科学目标而言并非必不可少。

Given the relatively short period into the future of the integrations, full convergence of the deep ocean is not essential for the main scientific goals of HighResMIP.

对此还有其他替代方案，包括在 1950 年取用标准分辨率 DECK 历史模拟中的海洋状态——但这些方案本身也有问题，例如如何用更高分辨率的海洋初始化一个一致的状态。

There are alternatives to this, including using the ocean state from the DECK historic simulation at standard resolution at 1950 – but these provide their own problems, such as how to initialize a consistent state with a higher resolution ocean.

将标准分辨率海洋插值到更高分辨率是相当不能令人满意的，因为低分辨率造成的任何偏差都会被固化其中。

Interpolating the standard resolution ocean to higher resolution is rather unsatisfactory, since any biases due to the low resolution will be baked in.

Tier 3（第三层级）：AMIP 试验

Tier 3 AMIP runs

积分时段：2015-2050（2100）年

Period of integration: 2015-2050 (2100)

与 Tier 1 相同，但将积分时段延伸至未来时段（至少到 2050 年，并可选择继续到 2100 年）。

As Tier 1 but extending the integration period to the future period (at least 2050, with an option to continue to 2100).

为了与 Tier 2 的耦合积分进行比较，并由于计算机资源有限，模拟可以限制到 2050 年。

For comparison with the coupled integrations in Tier 2 and due to limited computer resources the simulations can be restricted to 2050.

关于时间切片以及获得更强的信噪比——组内的讨论将继续进行，以决定什么可能是合适的、并且对 DECK 试验最有用/最具可比性的。

As regards time-slice, and having a stronger signal to noise – the discussion within the group will continue to decide what may be appropriate and most useful/comparable with the DECK experiments

强迫：

Forcing:

使用与 Tier 2 耦合试验相同的情景和气溶胶浓度。

Same scenario and aerosol concentration as for the coupled runs in Tier 2.

在与 HadISST 数据集开发组磋商后，目前正在开发一种将基于 HadISST 的 SST 强迫从 2014 年延伸至 2050 年的方法。

In consultation with the HadISST dataset development group, a method of extending the HadISST-based SST forcing from 2014-2050 is currently being developed.

这将涉及：寻找过去一个主要气候模态位相与 2014 年相似的时段，使用距平框架将其叠加到 2014 年的 SST 强迫上，然后对数据集重新定趋势，并施加较新 HadISST 工作中使用的逐日 ¼° 变率。

This will involve finding a period in the past with similar phases of the major climate modes as 2014, use an anomaly framework to add this to the SST forcing at 2014, and then retrend the dataset and impose the daily, ¼ degree variability as used in more recent HadISST work.

海冰强迫随后将基于这一 SST。

The sea-ice forcing will then be based on this SST.

这比尝试使用耦合模式输出的集合要简单得多，从而得到一个简化但现实的潜在未来情景。

This is a much simpler procedure than attempting to use an ensemble of coupled model outputs, leading to a simplified but realistic potential future scenario.

尽管这些模拟在 DECK 中没有对应项，但我们认为它们有许多用途，尤其是考虑到它们相对于耦合模拟的主要优势：偏差通常远没有那么显著，并且运行多个集合更便宜，从而可以提取信噪比。

Although these simulations do not have an equivalent in the DECK, we consider that they have many uses, particularly given their main advantage over coupled simulations in that the biases are usually much less pronounced, and it is cheaper to run multiple ensembles and hence extract the signal-to-noise.

各种科学问题包括：

Various science questions include:

1. 它们可能有助于更好地估计当前正在发生的极端事件变化（例如与水循环相关的），并有可能为区域气候适应以及时间跨度约 30 年的基础设施投资等其他气候输出用户提供信息。

1. They may allow for a better estimation of the now occurring changes in extreme events (for instance related to the hydrological cycle), and will potentially be useful for informing regional climate adaptation and other users of climate output such as infrastructure investments that have a time horizon of 30 years or so.

2. 有几项关于极端事件变化的检测与归因研究，将受益于拥有截至 2050 年的试验；并且对于这一较短的时段，所选择的确切气候情景并不是那么重要的因素。

2. There are several studies regarding detection and attribution of changes of extreme that would benefit from having experiments up to 2050 and for this shorter-term period the exact climate scenario chosen is not such a significant factor.

尽管任何单一模式的集合规模都会很小，但它可以随时间推移不断扩充，而多分辨率多模式集合可以作为一个起点。

Although the ensemble size of any one model will be small, it can be added to over time, and the multi-resolution multi-model ensemble can be a starting point.

3. 同样的情况也适用于信号出现时间研究：许多研究表明信号出现时间（ToE）在现在或未来几十年内（当然取决于变量和区域）——例如 Hawkins and Sutton (2012)。

3. The same thing applies to the time of emergence studies: many studies show time of emergence (ToE) now or in the next few decades (depending on the variable and regions of course) – e.g. Hawkins and Sutton (2012).

也有建议认为，如果考察极端/强事件而非平均量，ToE 可能更容易确定。

There are also suggestions that ToE can be easier to determine if one looks at extreme/intense events rather than mean quantities.

认为高分辨率模拟有助于在与降水相关的事件上实现这一点，似乎是合理的假设。

It seems reasonable to assume that having high-resolution simulations could help to achieve this for precipitation-related events.

这些模拟的另一个潜在用途是：仅为受强迫响应（使用 SST 受强迫响应的最佳估计以及 RCP/SSP 辐射强迫）的近期年代际预测提供基线。

Another potential use of these simulations is to give a baseline for near-term decadal predictions of the forced response only (using the best estimate of the SST forced response and the RCP/SSP radiative forcing).

随后可以将其与同样包含海洋变率及其影响的耦合年代际预测（或统计模拟）相结合。

This can then be combined with coupled decadal predictions (or statistical modelling) which also include the ocean variability and its influence.

例如参见 Hoerling et al (2011)，这是用低分辨率模式进行此类尝试的首次尝试。

See for instance Hoerling et al (2011) as a first attempt to do this with low-resolution models.

与 DECK 的关联

Connection with DECK

DECK 模拟将作为 CMIP6 认可 MIP 的入场券。

The DECK simulations will serve as an entry card for the CMIP6-Endorsed MIPS.

DECK 试验是：AMIP 模拟；工业革命前控制模拟；CO2 浓度每年增加 1%；突然启用 4×CO2。（注：此列表跨页，前半部分位于第 142 页，后半部分位于第 143 页。）

The DECK experiments are: AMIP simulations; Pre-industrial control simulations; 1%/yr increase in CO2 concentration; Switch-on 4XCO2. (Note: this list spans the page break between pages 142 and 143.)

使用 HighResMIP 所用标准模式分辨率完成 DECK 模拟，将作为 HighResMIP 的入场券。

Completion of the DECK simulations using the standard model resolution used in HighResMIP will serve as the entry card for HighResMIP.

对于 Tier 2，以标准 CMIP6 分辨率进行的另外三个 DECK 耦合模拟将作为入场券。

For Tier 2 the other three coupled simulations of DECK with the standard CMIP6 resolution will serve as an entry card.

这同样适用于 CMIP6 Historical 模拟，它由 1850-2014 年的历史模拟组成，使用与 CMIP6 一致的具体强迫。

This applies also to the CMIP6 Historical simulation which consists of a historical simulation from 1850-2014 using specific forcings consistent with CMIP6.

对于高分辨率模拟而言，DECK 在计算机资源上过于昂贵，但 HighResMIP 内部标准分辨率模拟与 DECK 模拟之间的比较本身将具有信息价值。

For the high-resolution simulations the DECK is too expensive in computer resources, but the comparison between the standard resolution simulations within HighResMIP and the DECK simulations will be informative in themselves.

其前提是，更高分辨率的模式可以被视为一项敏感性研究，尤其是因为目前任何研究组都负担不起在足够高的分辨率下运行一整套 DECK 模拟以获得有意义的响应。

The premise is that the higher resolution model can be treated as a sensitivity study, particularly since it is not currently affordable by any group to run a full set of DECK simulations at a sufficiently high resolution to give a meaningful response.

HighResMIP 的意义在于，分辨率的这一重大提升可以开始厘清 CMIP3 和 CMIP5 活动遗留的一些未解决的气候科学问题，并弥合“科学上有趣”与“在年代际时间尺度上对社会和决策者有用”之间的鸿沟。

The relevance of HighResMIP is that the significant step in resolution can begin to clarify some of the outstanding climate science questions remaining from CMIP3 and CMIP5 exercises, and also to bridge the gap of what is scientifically interesting and what is useful for the society and decision makers on decadal timescales.

据信，这些益处将超过缺少 DECK 模拟的代价。

It is assumed that these benefits will outweigh the lack of DECK simulations.

与其他 MIP 的关联

Connection with other MIPS

GMMIP：全球季风

GMMIP for global monsoons.

已知西非季风、印度季风（尤其是通过季风低压）以及可能还有东亚季风的季风气流和降水对模式分辨率具有敏感性。

There is known sensitivity to monsoon flow and rainfall with model resolution in the West African monsoon, Indian monsoon (particularly via monsoon depressions) and possibly East Asian monsoon.

正如 GMMIP 所述，季风雨带的最大宽度通常为 200 千米。

As stated in GMMIP the monsoon rainbands are usually at a maximum width of 200 km.

低分辨率或中等分辨率的气候模式通常无法以正确的原因真实地再现季风降水的平均态和变率。

Climate models with low or moderate resolutions are generally unable to realistically reproduce the mean state and variability of monsoon precipitation for the right reasons.

这在一定程度上是模式分辨率造成的。

This is partly due to the model resolution.

HighResMIP 的 Tier 1 AMIP 试验将用于 GMMIP 的 Task-4，以考察高分辨率模式在再现全球季风的平均态和年际变率两方面的性能。

The Tier 1 AMIP runs of HighResMIP will be used in Task-4 of GMMIP to examine the performance of high-resolution models in reproducing both the mean state and year-to-year variability of global monsoons.

SensMIP：参数敏感性

SensMIP for parameter sensitivity

目前尚不清楚 SensMIP 与 HighResMIP 的试验设计在多大程度上相互重叠或互补。

It is unclear how much the experimental design in SensMIP and HighResMIP overlap or complement each other.

多模式高分辨率集合可以给出模式的一个不确定性/变率轴，而相应的参数敏感性研究将探索另一个轴；但 SensMIP 中拟议改变的参数数量有限，可能限制它在这里的用途。

The multi-model high resolution ensemble could give one axis of uncertainty/variability from models, while a corresponding parameter sensitivity study would explore a different axis, but the limited number of parameters proposed to change in SensMIP may limit its use here.

CORDEX 和 GGDEX：降尺度

CORDEX and GGDEX for downscaling

将寻求与它们的合作。

Collaboration with these will be sought.

HighResMIP 可以为降尺度提供边界条件，并为云分辨模拟提供推动力。

HighResMIP can provide boundary conditions for downscaling and provide the stimulus to cloud resolving simulations.

OMIP：海洋分析与初始状态

OMIP for ocean analysis and initial state

将研究 OMIP 能否为耦合试验提供已平衡的海洋初始条件，并交流诊断/分析技术，以理解不同分辨率下海洋环流的变化。

It will be investigated if OMIP can provide the equilibrated ocean initial conditions for the coupled runs and exchange diagnostic/analysis techniques to understand ocean circulation changes at different resolutions.

重大挑战（Grand Challenges）

Grand Challenges

HighResMIP 将以如下方式应对 WCRP 的重大挑战。

HighResMIP will address the grand challenges of the WCRP in the following way

云、环流与气候敏感度（第 1 位）

Clouds, Circulation and Climate Sensitivity (Rank 1)

HighResMIP 将以多种不同方式应对这一重大挑战。

HighResMIP will address this Grand Challenge in many different ways.

将研究提高分辨率对水汽载荷、云的形成、环流特征和气候敏感度的敏感性。

The sensitivity of increasing resolution on water vapor loading, cloud formation, circulation characteristics and climate sensitivity will be investigated.

为提高我们认识的稳健性，不同分辨率下的多模式集合，加上时段更长的 AMIP 积分，将使我们能够：

To improve the robustness of our understanding, the multi-model ensemble at different resolutions, together with the longer period AMIP integrations, will allow us to:

(i) 将对流层环流与 SST、陆面特性变化型联系起来，并理解云过程在自然变率中的作用；

(i) link tropospheric circulation to changing patterns of SSTs, land-surface properties, and understanding the role of cloud processes in natural variability

(ii) 考察我们对降水型态认识的广度和限度；

(ii) examine the extent and limits of our understanding of patterns of precipitation

(iii) 考察模式偏差（如湿度）随分辨率的变化，因为有一些迹象表明这些偏差可能与气候敏感度有关。

(iii) examine changes in model biases (such as humidity) with resolution, since there are some indications that these may be linked to climate sensitivity

提高分辨率尤其会影响小尺度过程，例如云的形成。

Increasing resolution affects in particular small scale process such as the formation of clouds.

尽管在 HighResMIP 的分辨率下云的形成仍必须参数化，但云形成的动力约束条件——如上升和下沉运动的位置与强度以及水汽的可用性——对分辨率是敏感的。

Although the formation of clouds has still to be parameterized in the resolution of HighResMIP the dynamical constraints for the formation of clouds, such as the location and magnitude of upwards and downwards motion, as well as moisture availability, are sensitive to resolution.

这也适用于环流对云形成的响应。

This also applies to the response of the circulation to cloud formation.

变化气候中的冰冻圈（第 5 位）

Cryosphere in a Changing Climate (Rank 5)

由于在 Tier 1 试验中海冰分布是指定的，因此对这一重大挑战的贡献有限。

Because in the Tier 1 experiments the sea-ice distribution is prescribed the contribution to this grand challenge is limited.

其主要影响将体现在降雪的分布以及随后积雪的积累和融化上，这些过程影响陆面水文。

Its main impact will be on the distribution of snow fall and subsequent accumulation and melting of snowpack that affect land surface hydrology.

例如，随着分辨率的提高，强烈极地系统（如伴随充沛降雪的深厚极地低压）的出现将得到更好的表征。

For instance the occurrence of intense polar systems, such as deep polar-lows that are accompanied by abundant snowfall will be better represented with increasing resolution.

在 Tier 2 耦合模拟中，历史模拟将影响海冰的增长和海气热通量——这些过程受小尺度过程的强烈影响。

In the Tier 2 coupled simulations the historic simulation will affect the growth of sea-ice and the air-sea heat flux, processes that are strongly affected by small scale processes.

在这里，我们可以研究模式分辨率对北极海冰变率的影响，以及可能对中纬度环流产生的影响。

Here we can study the effect of model resolution on Arctic sea-ice variability, and possible influences on mid-latitude circulation.

理解和预测天气与气候极端事件（第 3 位）

Understanding and Predicting Weather and Climate Extremes (Rank 3)

HighResMIP 与这一重大挑战密切相关。

HighResMIP is strongly related to this grand challenge.

提高气候模式的分辨率将使我们更接近天气与气候无缝隙预测的终极目标。

Increasing resolution of climate models will bring us closer to the ultimate goal of seamless prediction of weather and climate.

极端事件大多发生在小的时间与空间尺度上，并由这些尺度上的过程驱动，而标准 CMIP6 气候模式无法很好地分辨这些过程。

Extremes mostly occur and are driven by processes on small temporal and spatial scales that are not well resolved by standard CMIP6 climate models.

由于大尺度与小尺度空间尺度之间的非线性相互作用，以及表征全球遥相关型的重要性，动力降尺度只能部分解决这一问题。

Dynamical down scaling only partially resolves this due to the nonlinear interaction between large and small spatial scales and the importance of representing global teleconnection patterns.

我们的目标是增进对全球变率模态（如 ENSO、NAO、PDO）与区域气候年代际变率及极端事件之间相互作用的理解。

We aim to improve our understanding of the interaction between global modes of variability (e.g. ENSO, NAO, PDO) and regional climate inter-decadal variability and extremes.

区域气候信息（第 4 位）

Regional Climate Information (Rank 4)

区域气候信息侧重于更小尺度和极端事件，这些与利益相关方和适应策略相关。

Regional climate information focuses on smaller scales and extreme events, which are relevant for stakeholders and adaptation strategies.

这需要高分辨率模拟来提供可靠的信息。

This requires high resolution modeling to provide reliable information.

近期的高分辨率模拟研究（Di Luca et al. 2012; Bacmeister et al. 2013）以及 CMIP3 与 CMIP5 结果的比较（Watterson et al. 2014）已经证明了提高分辨率对区域气候信息的附加价值。

Recent high resolution modeling studies (Di Luca et al. 2012; Bacmeister et al. 2013) and comparisons of CMIP3 and CMIP5 results (Watterson et al. 2014) have demonstrated the added value of increased resolution for regional climate information.

HighResMIP 的模式输出还可供区域气候模拟界使用，用于比较动力降尺度与全球高分辨率两种方法，并供云分辨区域模式进一步降尺度。

Model outputs from HighResMIP could also be used by the regional climate modeling community for comparison of dynamical downscaling and global high resolution approaches and for further downscaling by cloud resolving regional models.

海平面上升与区域影响（第 6 位）

Sea-Level Rise and Regional Impacts (Rank 6)

对于 Tier 1 模拟，对这一重大挑战没有贡献。

For Tier 1 simulations there is no contribution to this grand challenge.

对于 Tier 2，贡献有限，但存在做出重大贡献的潜力。

For Tier 2 the contribution is limited although there is the potential for large contribution.

例如，如果深水形成和经向翻转环流（MOC）的响应被证明对分辨率高度敏感，那么就会对区域海平面上升产生相当大的影响。

If for instance the deep water formation and MOC response appears to be highly sensitive to resolution than there is a considerable impact on regional sea level rise.

此外，在高分辨率下分辨地形效应，应当会对与政策制定和规划相关的海平面上升区域细节产生深远影响。

In addition resolving the topographic effect at high-resolution should have profound impacts on regional details about the sea level rise that are relevant for policy making and planning.

水资源可用性的变化（第 2 位）

Changes in Water Availability (Rank 2)

HighResMIP 与这一重大挑战高度相关。

HighResMIP is very relevant to this grand challenge.

分辨率通过改变降水的陆/海分布来影响水循环。

Resolution affects the hydrological cycle by modifying the land/sea partitioning of precipitation.

提高分辨率总体上会增加陆地上的水汽辐合（Demory et al. 2014），尽管在区域尺度上这一趋势可能反转，例如由于风暴路径位置的变化，欧洲冬季就属于这种情况（Van Haren et al. 2014）。

Increasing resolution in general increases the moisture convergence over land (Demory et al. 2014) although regionally this can be reversed such for instance in Europe during the winter due to changes in the position of the storm track (Van Haren et al. 2014).

此外，极端降水事件的模拟对提高分辨率高度敏感。

In addition simulation of extreme precipitation events are highly sensitive to increasing resolution.

这些结果在多模式集合中的稳健性如何？

How robust are these results across the multi-model ensemble?

更高分辨率的模式能否帮助人们认识全球降水数据集与能量收支数据集之间的不一致？

Can higher resolution models help to give insight into inconsistencies between global precipitation and energy balance datasets?

生物圈强迫与反馈（第 7 位）

Biospheric forcings and feedbacks (Rank 7)

由于生物圈未被显式模拟，因此与这一合作主题没有直接联系。

There is no direct link to this collaboration theme as the biosphere is not explicitly modelled.

由于生物圈的响应关键取决于对物理环境的准确模拟，因此存在开展衍生研究的潜力，例如通过解读关于植被生产力的诊断信息。

Because the response of the biosphere depends critically on the accurate simulation of the physical environment there is potential for spin-off studies, for instance by interpreting diagnostic information about vegetation production.

水的再循环是生物圈强迫与反馈的一个重要方面，而植被对干旱的响应方式取决于它们在水的再循环中的作用——鉴于所涉过程的尺度很小，这一点受模式分辨率的强烈影响。

Recycling of water is an important aspect of biospheric forcings and feedbacks, and the way that vegetation responds to drying depends on their role in recycling water - given the small scales of the involved processes this is strongly affected by model resolution.

GEWEX

GEWEX

HighResMIP 契合 GEWEX 的研究重点：“建立能量与水收支的精确全球模式表述，并证明其变率及对气候强迫响应的可预测性”。

HighResMIP fits in the GEWEX research focus of "Develop accurate global model formulation of the energy and water budget and demonstrate predictability of their variability and response to climate forcing".

能量与水收支的精确模拟，对发生在小空间尺度上的能量转换、相变以及输送的充分模拟十分敏感。

Accurate modeling of the energy and water budget is sensitive to the adequate simulation of the energy conversions and phase transitions as well as the transport that occur on small spatial scales.

拟议评估与分析概述

Overview of the proposed evaluation and analysis

分析将聚焦于提高分辨率对气候模拟的影响。

The analysis will focus on the impact of increasing resolution on the simulation of the climate.

将研究在不同 HighResMIP 模式中提高分辨率对这些现象模拟影响的稳健性，并评估它们对全球变暖的响应。

The robustness of the impact of increasing resolution on the simulation of these phenomena among the different HighResMIP models will be investigated and their response to global warming assessed.

HighResMIP 简单试验设计的主要优势之一，是它能够支撑广泛的过程分析——包含 1-2 个模式的模拟活动（如 UPSCALE（Mizielinski et al. 2014）和 Athena（Kinter et al. 2013））已经拥有数量极多、十分活跃的相关分析项目和富有洞见的论文。

One of the primary strengths of the simple experimental design for HighResMIP is that it enables a wide range of process-based analysis –simulation campaigns which included 1-2 models such as UPSCALE (Mizielinski et al. 2014) and Athena (Kinter et al. 2013) already have an extremely active number of analysis projects associated with them and insightful papers.

提高分辨率将能够更好地模拟区域气候。

The increased resolution will enable a better simulation of regional climates.

因此，分析也将关注区域气候，例如拉丁美洲。

The analysis will therefore also have a focus on regional climate such as for instance Latin America.

HighResMIP 的分析结果将与 CMIP6 DECK 试验进行比较。

The results of the analysis of HighResMIP will be compared with the CMIP6 DECK experiments.

其试验设计、数据格式和文档将尽可能遵循 DECK 试验。

Their experimental design, data format and documentation will follow the DECK experiments as far as possible.

高分辨率模式数据的存储与分发是一个具有挑战性的问题，需要在 HighResMIP 内部进一步讨论。

The storage and distribution of the high resolution model data is a challenging issue that requires further discussion within HighResMIP.

在 PRIMAVERA 中，JASMIN 平台（STFC/CEDA，英国）将用于数据交换，并作为共同的分析平台。

In PRIMAVERA the JASMIN platform (STFC/CEDA, UK) will be used for data exchange and as a common analysis platform.

由于 HighResMIP 的分辨率接近真实模拟天气所需的尺度，将存储逐日和次日尺度的数据，以便研究天气现象，包括与季风和热带气候相关的现象。

Because the resolution of HighResMIP approaches the scales necessary for realistic simulation of weather, daily and sub-daily data will be stored to allow the investigation of weather phenomena including those related to monsoons and tropical climate.

HighResMIP 的输出数据将符合全部 CMIP 要求。

HighResMIP output data will conform to all the CMIP requirements.

然而，鉴于 HighResMIP 的数据量，将不可能在一个 ESGF 节点上传输和存储所有必需的输出数据（事实上，这样的数据量也将阻碍把多模式数据下载到各个中心进行分析），因此需要一种不同的方法来应对。

However, given the data volumes from HighResMIP, it will not be possible to transmit and store all the required output data on an ESGF node (and indeed the volumes will mitigate against downloading multi-model data to individual centres for analysis), and hence a different methodology is needed to cope.

计划与其他国际数据中心进行讨论，以进一步推动协作分析。

Discussions with other international data centres are planned to further enable collaborative analysis.

欧洲哥白尼数据气候存储（Copernicus Data Climate Store）也可能为数据存储与共享提供有用的未来途径，这一点将予以探索。

The European Copernicus Data Climate Store may also provide useful future avenues for data storage and sharing, which will be explored.

一个有用的方法或许是在 ESGF 上提供空间和/或时间上粗化处理的模式输出，这将使人们能够进行与 DECK 模拟比较的初步分析，并指出哪些分析途径可能需要全模式分辨率输出，而其余数据量则仍可管理。

One useful approach may be to provide spatially and/or temporally coarsened model output on the ESGF, which would enable initial analysis compared to DECK simulations, and indicate which avenues of analysis may require full model resolution output, which remaining manageable volumes.

这样，它还可以供 ESGF 上的任何自动化评估工具使用。

It would then also be available for any automated assessment tools on the ESGF.

这一点将与 HighResMIP 合作伙伴进一步讨论。

This will be further discussed with the HighResMIP partners.

拟议时间安排

Proposed timing

试验开始：2016 年初

Start of the experiments: Beginning of 2016

试验结束：无固定日期。

End of the experiments: No fixed date.

ISMIP6 (Ice Sheet MIP for CMIP6) ｜ 冰盖模式比较计划

CMIP6 冰盖模式比较计划（ISMIP6）

Ice Sheet Model Intercomparison Project for CMIP6 (ISMIP6)

CMIP6 认可模式比较计划（MIP）申请表

Application for CMIP6-Endorsed MIPs

修订日期：2015 年 6 月 10 日

Revision Date: 10 June 2015

该 MIP 包含两个相互独立的部分：第一部分仅使用大气-海洋环流模式（AOGCM）的诊断输出来强迫独立的格陵兰和南极冰盖模式，第二部分则涉及耦合的 AOGCM-冰盖模式，并聚焦于格陵兰。对前者的认可并不意味着对后者的贡献。

This MIP has two independent parts. The first uses only AOGCM diagnostic output to force standalone models of the Greenland and Antarctic ice sheets, while the second involves coupled AOGCM-ice sheet model and is focused on Greenland. Endorsement of the former does not imply a contribution to the latter.

MIP 的申请提案应包含以下信息：

Proposals from MIPs should include the following information:

* 用于确定某 MIP 是否应获得 CMIP6 认可的初步信息。

* Preliminary information used to determine whether a MIP should be endorsed for CMIP6 or not.

** 必须随后提供的信息（且需在专家组确定哪些实验（如有）将纳入官方 CMIP6 套件之前提供）。

** Information that must be provided later (and before the panel can determine which experiments, if any, will be incorporated in the official CMIP6 suite).

MIP 目标及简要概述*

Goal of the MIP and a brief overview*

ISMIP6 的首要目标是：通过在气候变化情景下改进对格陵兰和南极冰盖演化的预估，来改进海平面上升的预估，并量化相关不确定性（包括气候强迫的不确定性和冰盖响应的不确定性两方面）。

The primary goal of ISMIP6 is to improve projections of sea level rise via improved projections of the evolution of the Greenland and Antarctic ice sheets under a changing climate, along with a quantification of associated uncertainties (associated with both uncertainty in climate forcing and in the response of the ice sheets).

如图 1 所示，这一目标要求：评估冰盖上空及其周边区域的 AOGCM 气候；分析由 CMIP AOGCM 输出"离线"强迫的独立模式（以及可能情况下的耦合冰盖-AOGCM 模式）所模拟的冰盖响应；并开展针对冰盖物理、动力学和数值实现相关不确定性的独立冰盖模式实验。

As depicted in Figure 1, this goal requires an evaluation of AOGCM climate over and surrounding the ice sheets; analysis of simulated ice-sheet response from standalone models forced "offline" with CMIP AOGCM outputs and, where possible, with coupled ice sheet-AOGCM models; and experiments with standalone ice sheet models targeted at exploring the uncertainty associated with ice sheets physics, dynamics and numerical implementation.

其次要目标是研究冰盖与气候之间的反馈作用，以深入了解冰盖质量损失加剧对区域和全球海平面的影响，以及由此引起的海洋淡水化对耦合海洋-大气环流的影响。

A secondary goal is to investigate the role of feedbacks between ice sheets and climate in order to gain insight into the impact of increased mass loss from the ice sheets on regional and global sea level, and of the implied ocean freshening on the coupled ocean-atmosphere circulation.

图 1：ISMIP6 工作概览。

Figure 1: Overview of the ISMIP6 effort.

ISMIP6 与世界气候研究计划（WCRP）的"冰冻圈变化"与"区域海平面上升"两项大挑战（Grand Challenges）直接相关。

ISMIP6 is directly related to the WCRP Grand Challenges on 'Changes in the Cryosphere' and 'Regional Sea-level Rise'.

关于前者的白皮书指出，需要"集中力量发展冰盖模式，特别强调冰盖动力学在海平面上升速率中的作用"，而 ISMIP6 正处于理想的位置来兑现这一点：它将 WCRP 气候与冰冻圈（CliC）计划及其他渠道所获得的、基于过程的改进认识，与未来冰盖物质收支的预估联系起来。

A white paper on the former identifies the need for "a focused effort on developing ice sheet models, with specific emphasis on the role of ice sheet dynamics on the rate of the sea-level rise", which ISMIP6 is ideally placed to deliver by linking the improved process-based understanding achieved within the WCRP Climate and Cryosphere (CliC) project, and elsewhere, to projections of future ice-sheet mass budget.

而关于后者的白皮书则指出了若干与我们所提议的活动密切相关的开放问题，包括需要理解海洋对高纬度淡水强迫的响应以及冰盖动力学的影响。

While a white paper on the latter identifies several open issues that strongly relate to our proposed activity, including the need to understand the ocean's response to high latitude freshwater forcing and the impact of ice sheet dynamics.

ISMIP6 主要聚焦于 CMIP6 的科学问题"地球系统如何响应强迫？"，并提供了令人振奋的机会，将 CMIP 目前对地球系统的定义扩展到（首次）纳入冰盖。

ISMIP6 is primarily focused on the CMIP6 scientific question "How does the Earth System respond to forcing?" and offers the exciting opportunity of widening the current CMIP definition of Earth System to include (for the first time) the ice sheets.

对独立集合模拟的重视还将有助于阐明冰盖物质收支及其对全球海平面影响方面的问题："在考虑气候变率、可预测性和情景不确定性的情况下，我们如何评估未来的气候变化？"

The emphasis on standalone, ensemble modeling will also shed light on the question "How can we assess future climate changes given climate variability, predictability and uncertainties in scenario" for the mass budget of the ice sheets and its impact of global sea level.

ISMIP6 是 CliC 计划的一项针对性活动。

ISMIP6 is a targeted activity of the CliC project.

截至撰写之时（2015 年 5 月 31 日），ISMIP6 已收到 11 个模式组的参与意向（CanESM、CESM、CNRM、EC-Earth、GFDL、GISS、INM、IPSL、MIROC-ESM、MPI-ESM 和 UKESM）。

At the time of writing (31st May 2015), ISMIP6 has received an expression of interest from eleven modeling groups (CanESM, CESM, CNRM, EC-Earth, GFDL, GISS, INM, IPSL, MIROC-ESM, MPI-ESM, and UKESM).

我们将通过同行评审的出版物和/或报告来通报 ISMIP6 取得的成果，并将邀请模式组成为共同作者。

We will report on the results obtained from ISMIP6 via peer review publications and/or presentations, and modeling groups will be invited to become co-authors.

拟议实验概览*

An overview of the proposed experiments*

ISMIP6 的总体框架旨在提供冰盖对海平面上升贡献的预估。

The overall framework for ISMIP6 is designed to deliver projections of the ice sheet contribution to sea level rise.

结合 CliC 针对性活动 GlacierMIP 以及热膨胀预估（已存在于 CMIP 框架内），这将使海平面成为 CMIP 能够提供例行 IPCC 式预估的变量家族的一员。

Together with the CliC targeted activity GlacierMIP and projections of thermal expansion (that already sit within the CMIP framework), this will allow sea level to become part of the family of variables for which CMIP can provide routine IPCC-style projections.

如表 1 所总结，拟议实验将同时利用并扩充 CMIP6-DECK、Historical、ScenarioMIP 和 PMIP 实验。

The proposed experiments will both use and augment the CMIP6-DECK, Historical, ScenarioMIP and PMIP experiments, as summarized in Table 1.

ISMIP6 将使用标准的 CMIP AGCM 和 AOGCM 实验来分析冰盖上空及其周边区域的气候，并将其作为独立冰盖模式（ISM）预估的强迫。

ISMIP6 will use the standard CMIP AGCM and AOCGM experiments for analysis of the climate over and surrounding the ice sheets, and as forcing for the standalone ice sheet models (ISM) projections.

还将利用 ISM 开展额外的敏感性实验，以研究这些预估中源于冰盖模式本身的不确定性。

Additional sensitivity experiments will be performed with the ISMs to investigate the uncertainty associated with these projections arising from ice sheet models.

关键产出将是冰盖对海平面贡献的过去与未来估计值的集合。

The key output will be an ensemble of past and future estimates of ice sheet contribution to sea level.

为处理交互式冰盖所引入的反馈，我们提议用耦合的 AOGCM-ISM 重复少数选定的 DECK 实验，其中冰盖是 AOGCM 的一个交互式分量。

To address the feedbacks introduced by interactive ice sheets, we propose that a small number of selected DECK experiments are repeated with coupled AOGCM-ISM, where the ice sheet is an interactive component of the AOGCM.

我们对现有 AOGCM 状况的评估是：包含交互式格陵兰冰盖的耦合模式有望在 CMIP6 中现实可行；然而纳入南极冰盖仍然具有挑战性（因为其对气候强迫的响应更为复杂，且与南大洋模拟相关的问题尚未解决）。

Our assessment of the state of existing AOGCMs is that coupled models including an interactive Greenland ice sheet can realistically be expected for CMIP6, however including the Antarctic ice sheet remains challenging (because of the greater complexity of its response to climate forcing, and the issues associated with simulations of the Southern Ocean).

正是出于这些原因，ISMIP6 在海平面预估方面高度依赖由 CMIP6 气候模式离线驱动的独立冰盖模式。

It is for these reasons that ISMIP6 heavily relies on standalone ice sheet models driven offline by CMIP6 climate models for projections of sea level.

**These types of experiments, where the ice sheet is an interactive component of the AOGCM, have been recently run as part as the European COMBINE effort (https://www.combine-project.eu/) by three modeling groups: IPSL, MIP-I, and DMI.

拟议的对 CMIP DECK 与 CMIP6 实验的评估/分析概览*

An overview of the proposed evaluation/analysis of the CMIP DECK and CMIP6 experiments*

ISMIP6 的首要目标是通过对集合模拟的评估，分析冰盖对海平面贡献的历史与未来估计值及其相关不确定性。

The primary goal of ISMIP6 is an analysis of the historical and future estimates of ice sheet contribution to sea level, and associated uncertainty, via evaluation of the ensemble simulations.

为评估将动力冰盖耦合到 AOGCM 所引入的反馈，我们将比较含与不含动力冰盖模式的 AOGCM 模拟结果，以及被 AOGCM 离线强迫与完全耦合到 AOGCM 的冰盖模拟结果。

For evaluating the feedbacks introduced by coupling dynamic ice sheets to AOGCM, we will compare the results of simulations of AOGCM with and without dynamic ice sheet models, and of ice sheet forced by offline with AOGCM and fully coupled to AOGCM.

因此，这一目标还要求通过与现场、航空和卫星观测的比较，对地球系统的三个分量进行评估和分析：

This goal therefore also requires that three components of the Earth system are evaluated and analyzed by comparing to in situ, airborne and satellite observations:

1）冰盖动力学。将在海岸沿接地线定义通量断面（flux gates），在那里可以使用由观测表面流速估算的输运量。

1) The ice sheet dynamics. Flux gates will be defined along grounding lines at the coast, where estimated transports derived from observed surface velocities may be employed.

耦合系统能够评估冰盖对海平面上升的总贡献，并可与 GRACE 数据（可获取 2003 年至今）进行比对。

The coupled system allows for an assessment of the total ice sheet contribution to sea level rise, which may be evaluated against GRACE data (available for 2003-present).

模式性能还可以结合 ERS-1 和 ERS-2（1992 年至今）及 ICESat（2003-2009）观测到的表面高程变化，以及冰流速、接地线和冰锋位置进行评估。

Model performance may also be assessed with observed changes in surface elevation from ERS-1 and ERS-2 (1992-present) and ICESat (2003-2009), along with ice velocities, ground line and ice front locations.

2）冰盖上空的大气和表面状况（表面辐射通量与湍流通量、反照率、温度、表面物质平衡）。

2) The atmosphere and surface conditions over the ice sheets (surface radiative and turbulent fluxes, albedo, temperature, surface mass balance).

该分量可分为两部分：由 AOGCM 生成的气候强迫，以及冰盖表面的过程（AOGCM 不一定能充分模拟，但将用于独立冰盖模式，如 SMB 和反照率演变）。

This component may be divided into two parts: climate forcing that would be generated by an AOGCM and processes at the ice sheet surface (that may or may not be adequately simulated by an AOGCM but will be used in standalone ice-sheet models, such as SMB and albedo evolution).

对包括温度在内的大气状态变量的评估，可利用已建成的自动气象站网以及南极点和 Summit 站的表面辐射收支观测站的观测资料。

The evaluation of atmospheric state variables including temperature can make use of observations from established automatic weather station networks and surface radiation budget observatories at South Pole and Summit.

表面温度和反照率还可以利用 AVHRR（1982 年至今）和 MODIS（2000 年至今）的遥感数据进行评估。

Surface temperature and albedo may also be evaluated with remote sensing values from AVHRR (1982-present) and MODIS (2000-present).

模拟的积累量可在格陵兰 K 断面（K-transect）沿线的现场站点以及分布于两座冰盖上的浅冰芯处进行评估。

Simulated accumulation may be evaluated at in situ locations along the K-transect for Greenland, and with shallow ice cores distributed across both ice sheets.

还建议与区域气候模式输出及大气再分析资料进行比较，作为质量检验。

A comparison with regional climate model output and atmospheric reanalyses is also suggested as a quality test.

3）冰盖周围的海洋（海面高度、海洋温度、海洋引起的融化速率、风应力、冰盖边缘可获取范围内的水文特性、海冰覆盖）。

3) The ocean around the ice sheets (sea surface height, ocean, temperature, ocean induced melting rates, wind stress, hydrographic properties at the margins of the ice sheets to the extent available, sea-ice cover).

该分量也可分为两部分：由 AOGCM 生成的海洋强迫，以及冰盖边界处的过程（AOGCM 不一定能刻画，但也将纳入独立冰盖模式，如冰架融化）。

This component may also be divided into two parts: ocean forcing that would be generated by an AOGCM and processes at the ice sheet boundary (that may or may not be captured within an AOGCM but will also be included in standalone ice-sheet models, such as ice-shelf melt).

一个关键问题是验证冰盖所受的海洋热强迫，其重点可能放在深层温度演变，特别是 AOGCM 对南大洋的模拟上。

A key concern will be the validation of ocean thermal forcing of the ice sheets, which is likely to focus on evolving temperature at depth and, in particular, AOGCM simulation of the Southern Ocean.

拟议时间安排*

Proposed timing*

将立即开始利用 CMIP5 档案分析冰盖上空及其周边区域的大气与海洋气候，以评估其质量以及表面物质平衡和温度中隐含的变化。

The analysis of atmospheric and oceanic climate over and surrounding the ice sheets from the CMIP5 archive will begin immediately in order to assess the quality and implied change in surface mass balance and temperatures.

对 CMIP6 数据的分析将持续进行，并紧随 CMIP6 的模拟阶段展开。

Analysis of the CMIP6 data would be ongoing and follow the simulation phase of CMIP6.

ISMIP6 在 2014 年 7 月的一次研讨会上启动了独立冰盖实验的设计，因此这些实验的进一步完善和数据准备工作将在 2015 年年中完成。

ISMIP6 started the design of the standalone ice sheet experiments during a workshop in July 2014, therefore further refining these experiments and data preparation would be completed by mid 2015.

CliC 正在资助一场于 2015 年夏季举行的 ISMIP6 研讨会。

CliC is sponsoring an ISMIP6 workshop in summer 2015.

海平面预估及由冰盖引起的海平面不确定性的量化工作将于 2015 年年中启动，并与 CMIP6 同步推进。

The sea level projections and quantification of the uncertainty in sea level due to ice sheets would begin mid 2015, and continue in tandem with CMIP6.

对预估模拟和敏感性实验的分析将持续进行，以识别不确定性的主要来源。

Analysis of the projection simulations and sensitivity experiments would be ongoing in order to identify the dominant sources of uncertainty.

AOGCM-ISM 模拟的运行将在 CMIP6 周期的后期进行。

The runs for the AOGCM-ISM simulations would occur towards the end of the CMIP6 cycle.

针对拟纳入 CMIP6 的每一项实验**

For each proposed experiment to be included in CMIP6**

o 实验设计；o 该实验所要解决的科学问题和/或空白；o 与其他 MIP 可能存在的协同效应；o 该实验对（A）气候模式研究群体、（B）综合评估模式（IAM）群体、（C）影响、适应与脆弱性（IAV）群体以及（D）政策制定者的潜在益处。

o the experimental design; o the science question and/or gap being addressed with this experiment; o possible synergies with other MIPs; o potential benefits of the experiment to (A) climate modeling community, (B) Integrated Assessment Modelling (IAM) community, (C) Impacts Adaptation and Vulnerability (IAV) community, and (D) policy makers.

如图 1 和表 1 所总结，ISMIP6 的实验设计包含三类不同的模式工作：1）来自 DECK、CMIP6 Historical 和 ScenarioMIP 模拟的标准 AGCM-AOGCM 实验（因此所有参与 CMIP6 的气候模式都将被纳入 ISMIP6，无需气候模式中心"额外工作"）；2）独立冰盖模式的模拟；以及 3）在可行情况下的耦合 AOGCM-ISM 模拟。

As summarized in Figure 1 and Table 1, the experimental design for ISMIP6, consist of three different types of modeling efforts: 1) standard AGCM-AOGCM experiments from the DECK, CMIP6 Historical and ScenarioMIP simulations (therefore all climate models participating in CMIP6 will be included in ISMIP6 without "extra work" from the climate modeling centers), 2) simulations with standalone ice sheet models, and 3) simulations with coupled AOGCM-ISMs when possible.

ISMIP6 实验设计的详细细节将在 CMIP6 特刊的一篇论文中提供。

The detailed specifics for the ISMIP6 experiment design will be provided in a paper for the CMIP6 Special Issue.

总之，提出以下实验设计：

In summary, the following experimental design is proposed:

1）使用冰盖上空及其周边区域选定的标准 AGCM 与 AOGCM CMIP6 实验：

1) Use of selected standard AGCM & AOGCM CMIP6 experiments over and surrounding ice sheets:

• amip：可评估冰盖上空的 AGCM 气候，特别是表面物质平衡（SMB：降水、蒸发与表面径流的组合）。

• amip: Allows the evaluation of AGCM climate over ice sheets, in particular surface mass balance (SMB: the combination of precipitation, evaporation and surface runoff).

• Abrupt4xCO2：可研究冰盖上空及其周边区域 AOGCM 气候的响应时间尺度。

• Abrupt4xCO2: Allows the investigation of response timescale of AOGCM climate over and surrounding the ice sheets.

• historical：可评估 CMIP6 历史时期（1850-2014）冰盖上空及其周边区域的 AOGCM 气候。

• historical: Allows the evaluation of AOGCM climate over and surrounding the ice sheets for the CMIP6 historical period (1850-2014).

• ssp5-8.5：标准的 ScenarioMIP SSP5-8.5 模拟，从 2015 年开始，如可能延续至 2300 年。该实验将评估冰盖范围和地形固定条件下 SMB 的预估变化。

• ssp5-8.5: standard ScenarioMIP SSP5-8.5 simulation starting from 2015 but continued to year 2300 if possible. The experiment would assess projected changes in SMB with fixed ice sheet extent and topography.

• lastInterglacial：末次间冰期的标准 PMIP 模拟。

• lastInterglacial: standard PMIP simulation for Last Interglacial.

• piControl 和 1pctCo2：将用于评估在 AOGCM 中引入动力冰盖的影响。对于参加 AOGCM-ISM 实验的模式组，实验时长在 AOGCM 与 AOGCM-ISM 模拟中需要保持一致。

• piControl and 1pctCo2: Will be used to assess the impacts of introducing dynamic ice sheets in AOGCM. For modeling groups taking part in the AOGCM-ISM experiments, the duration of the experiment need to be the same for both AOGCM and AOGCM-ISM simulations.

注：我们将从现有的 CMIP5 输出入手，并在 CMIP6 输出可用后重复该分析。

Note: we would start with the existing CMIP5 output and repeat the analysis when CMIP6 output is available.

这些实验的输出将用于评估源于气候强迫的海平面不确定性，并用于驱动独立冰盖模式。

The output from these experiments will be used to assess the uncertainty in sea level arising from climate forcing and to drive the standalone ice sheet models.

2）独立冰盖模式实验：

2) Standalone ice sheet models experiments:

• piControlforcedism：ISM 控制实验，恒定强迫，用于评估模式漂移。

• piControlforcedism: ISM control, Constant forcing, needed to evaluate model drift.

• amipforcedism：近几十年的模拟，用于理解观测记录完好的冰盖变化。ISM 将由标准 AMIP DECK 模拟得到的 SMB 距平以及海洋模式的冰架底部融化或温度距平来驱动。

• amipforcedism: simulation for the last few decades to understand the well observed record of ice sheet changes. ISM would be driven by SMB anomalies obtained from the standard AMIP DECK simulations, and ice shelf basal melting or temperature anomalies from ocean models.

• historicalforcedism：历史时期的模拟，用于理解冰盖对 20 世纪全球平均海平面上升（GMSLR）的贡献，由标准 CMIP6 Historical 模拟的输出强迫。

• historicalforcedism: simulation for the historical period to understand the ice sheet contribution to 20th century GMSLR, forced by outputs obtained from the standard CMIP6 Historical simulation.

amipforcedism 与 historicalforcedism 的结果可能不同，其比较将有助于了解偏差、气候变率与气候变化之间的相对重要性。

The results of amipforcedism and historicalforcedism are likely to differ, and the comparison will provide some insight into the relative importance of biases, climate variability and climate change.

• 1pctCo2forcedism：由 DECK 输出中"每年 1% 的 CO₂ 增至四倍"强迫的模拟：用于与 AOGCM-ISM 实验比较，以评估冰盖反馈。

• 1pctCo2forcedism: simulation forced by 1% yr CO2 to quadrupling C02 obtained from DECK output: for comparison with the AOGCM-ISM experiment in order to evaluate ice sheet feedback.

• ssp5-8.5forcedism：21 世纪（取决于 ScenarioMIP，也可能到 23 世纪）的模拟，用于给出最接近现实的冰盖对海平面预估的贡献。ISM 将由 SMB 距平（含冰盖高程变化的调整）以及由标准 SSP5-8.5 ScenarioMIP 模拟导出的冰架物质平衡或温度距平来驱动。

• ssp5-8.5forcedism: simulation for the 21st century (and maybe up to the 23rd century depending on ScenarioMIP) for the most realistic ice sheet contribution to sea level projections. ISM would be driven by SMB anomalies (with adjustments for ice sheet elevation change) and ice shelf mass balance or temperatures anomalies derived from the standard SSP5-8.5 ScenarioMIP simulation.

• lastInterglacialforcedism：末次间冰期（约 135-115 千年 BP）格陵兰冰盖演化的模拟。气候强迫源自 PMIP 末次间冰期实验以及 PMIP 的其他时间切片和瞬变实验（视可用性而定）。

• lastInterglacialforcedism: simulation of the Greenland ice sheet evolution for the Last Interglacial period (~135-115 kyr BP). Climatic forcing derived from PMIP Last Interglacial and other PMIP time slice and transient experiments (as available).

• 将设计额外的 ISM 实验，以评估海平面预估中源于冰盖模式的不确定性。

• Additional ISM experiments would be designed to assess the uncertainty in sea level projections due to ice sheet models.

这些实验将探索 ice2sea 和 SeaRISE 工作中识别的模式偏差与不确定性，包括冰盖初始化、认识不足的底部条件以及次网格尺度过程。

These experiments would explore the model biases and uncertainties identified in the ice2sea and SeaRISE efforts, which include ice sheet initialization, poorly known basal conditions and subgrid-scale processes.

此外，ISMIP6 还将研究诸如"需要多少过剩的海洋热通量才能触发海洋冰盖不稳定性？"等问题，以阐明南极冰盖潜在崩塌的可能性。

In addition, ISMIP6 would investigate questions such as "How much excess oceanic heat flux is required to trigger marine ice sheet instability?" to shed light on the potential collapse of the Antarctic ice sheet.

注：沿用 ice2sea 和 SeaRISE 工作中采用的方法，由 DECK 实验导出的距平将被叠加到 ISM 控制运行所用的强迫之上。

Note: Following the approach taken in the ice2sea and SeaRISE efforts, the anomalies derived from the DECK experiments would be added to the forcing used in the ISM control runs.

AGCM/AOGCM 输出在大多数情况下不适合直接强迫独立 ISM，主要原因是空间分辨率不同。

The AGCM/AOGCM output is in most cases not suitable to directly force standalone ISMs, mainly due to differences in spatial resolution.

需要一套降尺度程序（细节稍后说明）来生成表面物质平衡和冰架底部物质平衡，用于驱动 ISM。

A downscaling procedure (to be later specified) will be necessary to produce surface mass balance and for ice shelves basal mass balance, used to drive the ISMs.

模式组可以决定对格陵兰和南极冰盖都开展实验，或只专注于其中一座冰盖。这些实验面向冰盖研究群体，我们预计将有 10-15 个冰盖模式参与。

Modeling groups could decide to carry out the experiments for both the Greenland and Antarctic ice sheets, or to focus on one ice sheet. These experiments are targeted at the ice sheet community, and we envisage participation from 10-15 ice sheet models.

3）耦合 AOGCM-ISM 实验（与标准 CMIP6 实验设置相同，但包含演变的冰盖模式（ISM）：GCM 向 ISM 发送基于能量平衡的 SMB，ISM 向 GCM 发送陆面高程和地表类型的调整）

3) Coupled AOGCM-ISMs experiments (same set up as standard CMIP6 experiments but with evolving ice sheets models (ISM): GCM sends ISM an energy balance based SMB, and ISM sends GCM adjustments to land surface elevation and surface type)

• piControlwithism：工业革命前控制实验，其目标是产生一个接近现实、无漂移的耦合态，并评估系统性的模式偏差。起转（spin up）可能需要 GCM 与 ISM 异步耦合，直至系统达到准平衡态，随后再进行数百年时长的运行（建议 500 年），以捕捉非受迫的自然变率。

• piControlwithism: the pre-industrial control, where the aim is to produce a realistic non-drifting coupled state, and assess systematic model bias. The spin up may require the GCM and ISM to be asynchronously coupled until the system reaches quasi-equilibrium, which would be followed by a multi-hundred years run (500 yrs suggested), in order to capture unforced natural variability.

• 1pctCO2withism：CO₂ 每年增加 1%，在 140 年内增至四倍，并在 4xCO₂ 水平上再保持恒定二至四个世纪。

• 1pctCO2withism: the 1% per yr CO2 increase to quadrupling CO2 over 140 yrs and kept constant at 4xCO2 for an additional two to four centuries.

该实验与 piControlwithism 一道，是用于分析耦合冰盖-气候系统的核心实验。实验将与不含冰盖的标准 DECK 以及由标准 DECK 强迫的独立 ISM 进行比较，以诊断冰盖-气候反馈的强度，以及因排除冰盖模式而给预估带来的相关不确定性。

This experiment, along with piControlwithism, are the core experiments that will be used for analysis of coupled ice sheet-climate system. Experiment would be compared to the standard DECK without ice sheets and to the standalone ISM forced by the standard DECK, in order to diagnose the strength of ice sheet-climate feedback and the associated uncertainty in projections resulting from excluding ice sheet models.

因此，1pctCO2、1pctCO2withism 和 1pctCO2forcedism 的实验时长，对参加该实验的各组而言需要保持一致。

Length of experiment 1pctCO2, 1pctCO2withism and 1pctCO2forcedism therefore needs to be the same for groups participating in this experiment.

建议这些实验至少运行 350 年、鼓励最多运行 500 年，因为 COMBINE 工作的结果表明，冰盖模式耦合运行在模拟约 250-300 年后开始与未耦合运行出现明显分歧。

It is suggested the experiments are run for a minimum of 350 yrs and up to 500 yrs is encouraged, because results from COMBINE effort indicate that ice sheet model coupled runs start to clearly divert from the uncoupled runs after about 250-300 yrs of simulations.

• ssp5-8.5withism：用于分析耦合系统以及来自耦合框架的海平面预估的情景，可与独立冰盖模式的预估进行比较。

• ssp5-8.5withism scenario for analysis of coupled system and sea level projections from a coupled framework, which can be compared to the standalone ice sheet model projection.

实验将覆盖 21 世纪，并最好运行至 23 世纪。其设置将沿用标准 SSP5-8.5 的设置，因此可能首先需要以耦合 AOGCM-ISM 的设置完成 CMIP6 Historical 模拟。

Experiment would cover the 21st century and preferably run out to the 23rd century. The set up would follow the set up for the standard SSP5-8.5, which may therefore first require the CMIP6 Historical simulation to be performed too with a coupled AOGCM-ISM setting.

注：我们建议先开展工业革命前控制实验和"每年 1% 的 CO₂ 增至四倍"实验，随后进行 ScenarioMIP SSP5-8.5。

Note: We suggest that the pre-industrial control and 1% yr CO2 to quadrupling CO2 experiments are performed first, followed by ScenarioMIP SSP5-8.5.

模式组可以决定对格陵兰和南极冰盖都开展实验，或只专注于其中一座冰盖。这些实验与对应的标准 CMIP AOGCM 设置之间，只应在冰盖的处理方式上有所不同，以免反馈的探索受到其他改动的影响。

Modeling groups could decide to carry out the experiments for both the Greenland and Antarctic ice sheets, or to focus on one ice sheet. These experiments should only differ from the equivalent standard CMIP AOGCM setting in the manner in which the ice sheet is treated, so that the exploration of feedbacks is not affected by other changes.

我们提议探索的反馈包括：反照率-融化反馈、高程-SMB 反馈、降水-海冰反馈、淡水（径流以及冰山崩解和冰下融化）-海洋反馈、大气环流-海洋热通量反馈（如 tip-jet 急流、下降风）。

Feedbacks that we propose to explore include albedo-melt feedback, elevation-SMB feedback, precipitation-sea ice feedback, fresh water (runoff and icebergs calving and submarine melting)-ocean feedback, atmospheric circulation – ocean heat flux feedback (e.g. tip-jets, katabatic winds).

这类耦合实验已由 3 个模式中心（IPSL、MPI-M、DMI）开展，MeteoFrance 也即将作为欧洲 COMBINE 项目的一部分开展此类实验。

This type of coupled experiments have been carried out by 3 modeling centers (IPSL, MPI-M, DMI) and soon MeteoFrance as part of the European COMBINE project.

这些耦合模式（IPSL：IPSL-GRISLI；MPI-M：MPI-ESM-PISM 和 MPI-ESM-SICOPOLIS；DMI：EC-Earth-PISM，以及即将加入的 CNRM-GRISLI）已在 COMBINE 报告《与格陵兰和南极模式耦合的 AOGCM 性能评估》（Assessment of performance of AOGCMs coupled to Greenland and Antarctic models，http://www.combine-project.eu/fileadmin/user_upload/combine/dels/D4.3.pdf）和《各分量的反馈：冰冻圈》（Feedbacks of individual components: Cryosphere，http://www.combine-project.eu/fileadmin/user_upload/combine/dels/D7.7_v2.pdf，其第二部分为"在 ESM 中纳入交互式格陵兰冰盖的影响"）中得到描述和评估。

These coupled models (IPSL: IPSL – GRISLI; MPI-M: MPI-ESM – PISM and MPI-ESM – SICOPOLIS; DMI: EC-Earth – PISM, and soon CNRM-GRISLI) were described and evaluated in the COMBINE reports 'Assessment of performance of AOGCMs coupled to Greenland and Antarctic models' (http://www.combine-project.eu/fileadmin/user_upload/combine/dels/D4.3.pdf) and 'Feedbacks of individual components: Cryosphere' (http://www.combine-project.eu/fileadmin/user_upload/combine/dels/D7.7_v2.pdf, in the second part: 'Impacts of including an interactive Greenland ice sheet in ESM).

将动力冰盖纳入 AOGCM 的工作也正在 CESM、GFDL 和 ModelE 等模式中开展，因此预计约有 8-10 个模式组将有能力为 CMIP6 运行此类实验。

Efforts of including dynamic ice sheets into AOGCMs are also occurring with CESM, GFDL and ModelE for example, so it is expected that about 8-10 groups will be in a position to run such experiments for CMIP6.

这些实验的首要目标是：改进由冰盖变化引起的海平面预估，并区分这些预估中源于气候强迫的不确定性与源于冰盖模式的不确定性。

The primary goal of these experiments is to improve sea level projections due to changes in the ice sheets, and assessing the uncertainty in these projections due to climate forcing versus that arising from ice sheet models.

次要目标是理解冰盖如何影响气候以及如何受气候影响。

The secondary goal is to understand how ice sheets affect and are affected by climate.

因此，这些实验将有助于阐明 CMIP6 所考虑的关键科学问题："地球系统如何响应强迫？""系统性模式偏差的起源和后果是什么？"以及"在情景不确定的情况下，我们如何评估未来的气候变化？"

These experiments will thus shed light on the key science questions considered by CMIP6: "How does the Earth system respond to forcing?", "What are the origin and consequences of systematic model biases", and "How can we assess future climate change given uncertainty in scenarios?".

这些目标直接服务于气候与冰冻圈（CliC）计划及世界气候研究计划的"冰冻圈"大挑战和"海平面上升"大挑战。

These goals directly contribute to the Cryosphere Grand Challenge and the Sea level Rise Grand Challenge of the Climate and Cryosphere (CliC) project and the World Climate Research Program.

最后，ISMIP6 的海平面预估将对影响、适应与脆弱性（IAV）群体和政策制定者具有现实意义。

Finally, the ISMIP6 sea level projections will be relevant to the Impacts Adaptation and Vulnerability (IAV) community and policy makers.

与其他 MIP 可能存在的协同效应包括：

Possible synergies with other MIPs include:

• 高分辨率模式比较计划（HighResMIP）。我们将利用高分辨率运行的结果，量化提高分辨率对我们独立冰盖套件的影响，并与 DECK 运行的结果进行比较。我们还将考察大气阻塞等特定过程，以了解极端融化速率事件在我们的运行中得到多好的捕捉。

• High Resolution Model Intercomparison Project (HighResMIP). We will use the results from the high-resolution runs to quantify the impact of increased resolution in our standalone ice sheet suite, and to compare against the results from the DECK runs. Particular processes such as atmospheric blocking will be looked at to understand how well extreme melt-rate events are captured in our runs.

• 协调区域气候降尺度试验（CORDEX）。CORDEX 的结果将与 DECK 运行对照使用，以量化低分辨率运行或 HighResMIP 运行中未能捕捉的额外敏感性。降尺度后的 CORDEX 结果中的偏差和额外变率将被引入离线冰盖模式运行。

• Coordinated Regional Climate Downscaling Experiment (CORDEX). The CORDEX results will be used against the DECK runs to quantify additional sensitivities not captured in the low-resolution runs or HighResMIP runs. Biases and additional variability in the downscaled CORDEX results will be introduced in the offline ice sheet model runs.

• 陆面、积雪与水分模式比较计划（LS3MIP）。LS3MIP 的目标之一是评估气候模式中积雪覆盖描述的现状，这会影响冰盖上空的表面物质平衡。这些含陆面模块的实验可能有助于理解和量化由表面强迫引起的海平面不确定性。

• Land Surface, Snow and Moisture (LS3MIP). One of the objectives of LS3MIP is an evaluation of the current state of the snow cover representation in climate models, which impacts the surface mass balance over the ice sheets. These experiments with land-module may help towards understanding and quantifying the uncertainty in sea level due to surface forcing.

• 情景模式比较计划（ScenarioMIP）。我们正在与 ScenarioMIP 指导委员会成员进行讨论，以支持将 SSP5-8.5 延长到原计划的 2015-2100 时段之后（理想情况下至 2300 年）。

• Scenario Model Intercomparison Project (ScenarioMIP). We have an ongoing discussion with members of the ScenarioMIP steering committee to support an extension of the SSP5-8.5 beyond the planned 2015-2100 timeframe (ideally up to year 2300).

• 模式比较观测计划（Obs4MIP）。我们将使用现有数据库中的观测资料，检验纳入动力冰盖对模拟的影响。我们还将建议补充与冰盖和表面物质平衡相关的数据集。

• Observations for Model Intercomparison (Obs4MIP). We would use the observations available on the current database to test how the inclusion of dynamic ice sheets affects the simulations. We would also suggest additional datasets that are pertinent to ice sheets and surface mass balance.

• 模式比较再分析计划（Ana4MIP）。我们将使用再分析资料评估 AOGCM 的表面物质平衡，并可能将其用作冰盖的当代强迫。

• Reanalysis for Model Intercomparison (Ana4MIP). We would use reanalysis in the assessment of the surface mass balance from AOGCM, and potentially as contemporary forcing for the ice sheets.

• 古气候模式比较计划（PMIP）。ISMIP6 独立冰盖实验 lastInterglacialforcedism 是与 PMIP 的一项合作，计划使用并扩充 PMIP 实验（如可能，包括时间切片和瞬变实验）。我们计划继续与 PMIP 就不同时期耦合气候-冰盖模拟的设计保持交流。

• Paleoclimate Modelling Intercomparison Project (PMIP). The ISMIP6 standalone ice sheet experiment lastInterglacialforcedism is a collaboration with PMIP, planned to use and augment PMIP experiments (time slices and transient, if possible). We plan to continue exchange with PMIP on the design of coupled climate-ice sheet simulations for different time periods.

与其他 MIP 的这些协同效应展示了气候研究群体内部的潜在合作。希望其他 MIP 有兴趣利用我们的模拟，来研究冰盖变化如何影响其所擅长的气候分量。

These synergies with other MIPs illustrate potential collaborations within the climate community. It is hoped that other MIPs would be interested in using our simulations to investigate how changes in the ice sheets affect the component of the climate that is their expertise.

如可能，请对建议的实验进行优先级排序，并说明理由**

If possible, a prioritization of the suggested experiments, including any rationale**

对于耦合 AOGCM-ISM，我们建议先开展工业革命前控制实验和"每年 1% 的 CO₂ 增至四倍"实验，随后进行 ScenarioMIP 的 SSP5-8.5。

For the coupled AOGCM-ISM, we suggest that the pre-Industrial control and 1% yr CO2 to quadrupling CO2 experiments are performed first, followed by the SSP5-8.5 of ScenarioMIP.

因此，我们的层级 1（Tiers 1）实验为：piControlwithism 和 1pctCO2withism，它们便于评估冰-气候反馈，且许多模式组已经开展过。

Our Tiers 1 experiments are thus: piControlwithism and 1pctCO2withism, which allow for an easier evaluation of ice-climate feedback and have already been performed by many modeling groups.

而我们的层级 2（Tiers 2）实验 ssp5-8.5withism 则更贴近我们与 CMIP6 未来气候同步的海平面上升预估目标；SSP5-8.5 也将是我们用独立冰盖模式进行海平面预估的重点。

Our Tiers 2 experiment, ssp5-8.5withism, is however more relevant to our goal of sea-level rise projections that are in sync with the CMIP6 future climate, and SSP5-8.5 will be the focus of our sea level projection with standalone ice sheet models.

CMIP6 认可 MIP 所存档的全部模式输出，预计将按与 CMIP 输出相同的条款提供使用。目前大多数模式组发布的 CMIP 数据均允许不受限制地使用。如果您反对开放获取您实验的输出，请说明理由。**

All model output archived by CMIP6-Endorsed MIPs is expected to be made available under the same terms as CMIP output. Most modeling groups currently release their CMIP data for unrestricted use. If you object to open access to the output from your experiments, please explain the rationale.**

无异议。

No objections.

CMIP DECK/CMIP6 数据请求的输出与过程诊断变量清单**

List of output and process diagnostics for the CMIP DECK/CMIP6 data request**

o 该变量是应为所有 CMIP6 实验收集，还是仅为某些指定的子集收集；输出是否需要覆盖每个实验的整个时段，还是只需某些较短的时段。

o whether the variable should be collected for all CMIP6 experiments, or only some specified subset and whether the output is needed from the entire length of each experiment or some shorter period or periods;

对于标准气候模拟（不含动力冰盖），变量至少应在 CMIP6 AMIP、历史模拟、工业革命前控制实验、"每年 1% 的 CO₂ 增至四倍"、ScenarioMIP SSP5-8.5 和 PMIP 末次间冰期的整个实验时段内收集。

For the standard climate simulations (with no dynamic ice sheets), the variables should be collected at a minimum for the CMIP6 AMIP, Historical Simulation, Pre-Industrial Control, 1% yr CO2 to quadrupling CO2, ScenarioMIP SSP5-8.5 and the PMIP Last Interglacial, for the entire length of the experiment.

对于气候模式与动力冰盖耦合的模拟，变量将仅为 piControlwithism、1pctCo2withism 和 ssp5-8.5withism 实验收集（见表 1）。

For the simulations with climate models coupled to dynamic ice sheets, the variables would only be collected for the piControlwithism, 1pctCo2withism, and ssp5-8.5withism experiments (see Table 1).

o 该输出是否只有在交互式使用某些分量或诊断工具时才有意义（例如交互式碳循环或大气化学，或仅在安装了 COSP 模拟器的情况下）。

o whether the output might only be relevant if certain components or diagnostic tools are used interactively (e.g. interactive carbon cycle or atmospheric chemistry, or only if the COSP simulator has been installed);

优先级 1 的变量始终具有相关性，它们也是 CMIP5 中的优先级 1 变量。

The variables of priority 1 are always relevant and are variables that were variables of priority 1 in CMIP5.

部分较低优先级的变量仅对带有冰盖上覆积雪模式或交互式冰盖模式的模式提出要求。

Some variables of lower priority are required for models that have either snow models over the ice sheets or interactive ice sheet models.

o 该变量是否面向下游用户（如影响研究人员、WG2 用户），抑或其主要用于理解与分析气候系统本身。请尽可能具体地说明需要该变量的原因。

o whether this variable is of interest to downstream users (such as impacts researchers, WG2 users) or whether its principal purpose is for understanding and analysis of the climate system itself. Be as specific as possible in identifying why the variable is needed.

变量请求的主要目的是理解与分析气候系统，或强迫独立冰盖模式。

The principle purpose of the variable request is to understand and analyze the climate system, or force the standalone ice sheet models.

部分变量（如表面径流或冰山排放）会影响海平面，因此对下游用户有意义。

Some variables (such as surface runoff or iceberg discharge) will affect sea level and are thus of interest to downstream users.

o 变量能否重网格化到公共网格上，这样做是否会损失某些关键信息。

o whether the variables can be regridded to a common grid, or whether there is essential information that would be compromised by doing this;

对于源自冰盖网格的变量，使用原生网格可能更可取。

The use of native grid may be preferable for variables that would be originating from the ice sheet grid.

然而，如提交给 WIP 的电子表格及下文所示，这些变量可以重网格化到一个公共的极射赤面网格上。

However, as indicated in the spreadsheet submitted to the WIP and below, the variables may be regridded to a common polar stereographic grid.

o 如果数据请求规模较大，则需要说明所请求各变量的相对重要性（以分层清单表示）。

o the relative importance of the various variables requested (indicated by a tiered listing) is required if the data request is large.

现有的 CMIP5 CMOR 表 Amon（月平均大气场）、Omon（月平均海洋场）和 LImon（月平均陆面冰冻圈场）已包含许多诊断和比较冰川陆地/冰盖上空气候以及导出冰盖强迫所需的输出。

The current CMIP5 CMOR tables Amon (Monthly Mean Atmospheric Fields), Omon (Monthly Mean Ocean Fields), and LImon (Monthly Mean Land Cryosphere Fields) already contains many of the output required to diagnose and intercompare the climate over glaciated land/ice sheets and to derive forcing for the ice sheets.

然而，还需要少量额外变量，以便正确地导出冰盖强迫，并记录耦合 AOGCM-ISM 实验中演变冰盖的输出（如冰高程变化）。

However a few additional variables are needed to properly derive the forcings for ice sheets and to record outputs from the evolving ice sheets in the coupled AOGCM-ISMs experiments (such as ice elevation change).

表 2 和表 3 列出了我们对计划在 ISMIP6 中使用或尚缺失的 Amon、LImon 和 Omon 变量的评估。

Table 2 and 3 list our assessment of the Amon, LImon, and Omon variables that we plan to use in ISMIP6, or that are missing.

我们已在 CMIP 和 WIP 规定的截止日期前完成了 CMIP6 数据请求表格。所提交的电子表格包含表明变量请求重要性的分层清单。

We have completed the CMIP6 data request forms by the deadlines set by CMIP and WIP. The submitted spreadsheet contains a tiered listing indicating the importance of the variable request.

保存于 Amon 和/或 LImon 表、将被 ISMIP6 使用的变量单位现有 CMOR 变量名及 CMIP5 位置，以及注释。层级
近地面气温（2 m）Ktas，位于 Amon1
表面温度Kts，位于 Amon1
积雪内部温度Ktsn，位于 LImon2
冰盖与雪/粒雪之间界面处的温度（新增）K类似于 Olmon 中的 tsnint，但针对冰川陆地。这将是用于强迫冰盖模式的温度2

Any proposed contributions and recommendations for**

o 用于模式评估的模式诊断量与性能指标；

冰盖上空区域的模式评估将包括现场、航空、卫星数据和再分析资料。

Model evaluation over the ice sheets will include in situ, airborne, satellite data and reanalysis.

这些冰冻圈数据产品大多目前尚不在 obs4MIPs 数据库中，我们将与 obs4MIPs 密切合作以解决这一问题。

Most of these cryospheric data products are not currently available in the obs4MIPs database and we will work closely with obs4MIPs to rectify this.

由于需要同时评估冰盖上空及周边的气候强迫（即 AOGCM 模式输出）和冰盖模式的响应，这一过程较为复杂。

The process is complicated by the need to evaluate both climate forcing over and around the ice sheets (i.e., AOGCM model output) and ice-sheet model response.

我们计划在 2015 年与数据提供者和模式研发者举行一次研讨会，以最终确定评估计划。

We plan to have a workshop with data providers and modelers in 2015 to finalize the evaluation plan.

近期的 IMBIE 项目（Shepherd 等，2013）提供了一个极佳的范例：冰盖观测群体协同工作，提供适于检验冰盖模式的一致化产品。

The recent IMBIE project (Shepherd et al 2013) provides an excellent example of the ice-sheet observational community work together to provide a reconciled product suitable for testing ice-sheet models.

Application for CMIP6-Endorsed MIPs: Land Surface, Snow and Soil Moisture (LS3MIP)

日期：2015 年 6 月 5 日

Date: 5 June 2015

陆面、雪与土壤湿度模式比较计划（LS3MIP）

Land Surface, Snow and Soil moisture MIP (LS3MIP)

MIP 联合主席：Bart van den Hurk (hurkvd@knmi.nl)、Gerhard Krinner (krinner@ujf-grenoble.fr)、Sonia Seneviratne (sonia.seneviratne@ethz.ch)、Chris Derksen (Chris.Derksen@ec.gc.ca)、Taikan Oki (taikan@iis.u-tokyo.ac.jp) 和 Hyungjun Kim (hjkim@rainbow.iis.u-tokyo.ac.jp)
