Link to website: http://www.climate-cryosphere.org/activities/targeted/ls3mip. For sub-projects: http://hydro.iis.u-tokyo.ac.jp/GSWP3, http://www.iac.ethz.ch/GLACE-CMIP, and http://www.climate-cryosphere.org/activities/targeted/esm-snowmip

计划目标与简要概述

Goal of the MIP and brief overview

LS3MIP 实验的目标是对陆面、雪和土壤湿度-气候反馈进行全面评估，并利用受约束的仅陆面模块实验诊断当前 ESM 陆面模块中的系统性偏差。

The goal of the LS3MIP experiment is to provide a comprehensive assessment of land surface, snow, and soil moisture-climate feedbacks, and to diagnose systematic biases in the land modules of current ESMs using constrained land-module only experiments.

陆面上储存的固态与液态水对区域气候及其变率和可预报性具有重要影响，包括对能量循环和碳循环的影响。

The solid and liquid water stored at the land surface has a large influence on the regional climate, its variability and its predictability, including effects on the energy and carbon cycles.

值得注意的是，雪和土壤湿度影响地表辐射与通量分配特性、水分储存以及陆面记忆。

Notably, snow and soil moisture affect surface radiation and flux partitioning properties, moisture storage and land surface memory.

两者都强烈影响大气状况，特别是气温，同时也影响大尺度环流型和降水。

They both strongly affect the atmospheric conditions, in particular air temperature, but also large-scale circulation patterns and precipitation.

然而，各模式对这些反馈的响应和表征存在分歧，且其基础过程中存在系统性偏差。

However, models show divergent responses and representations of these feedbacks as well as systematic biases in the underlying processes.

LS3MIP 将提供量化相关不确定性并更好地约束气候变化预估的手段，这对高度脆弱的区域（人口稠密区、极地区、农业区、陆地生态系统）尤为重要。

LS3MIP will provide the means to quantify the associated uncertainties and to better constrain climate change projections, of particular interest for highly vulnerable regions (densely populated regions, polar regions, agricultural areas, land ecosystems).

下文简要描述雪和土壤湿度在气候系统中的作用以及所提议实验的理据。

A short description of the role of snow and soil moisture in the climate system and of the rationale for the proposed experiments is provided hereafter.

雪过程与雪-气候反馈

Snow processes and snow-climate feedbacks

积雪是地球系统的重要组成部分，它与大气及其所覆盖的表面（陆地、冰、海冰）相互作用。

Snow cover is an essential component of the Earth System that interacts with the atmosphere and the surfaces it covers (land, ice, sea ice).

它也是气候系统内（正）反馈的一个重要来源。

It is also an important source of (positive) feedbacks within the climate system.

2013 年提出了一项 WCRP/CliC 倡议，即 ESM-SnowMIP 模式比较计划，作为对 WCRP 大挑战“变化气候中的冰冻圈”的贡献。

A WCRP/CliC Initiative was proposed in 2013 for an ESM-SnowMIP intercomparison programme as a contribution to the WCRP Grand Challenge Cryosphere in a Changing Climate.

该倡议建立在评估气候模式中积雪表征现状的基础上，目前积雪界各观测与模拟团队正在广泛开展这一评估。

This initiative builds on the evaluation of the current state of snow cover representation in climate models, which is being broadly addressed by observational and modeling groups across the snow community.

它是 LS3MIP 实验的核心要素。

It is a core element of the LS3MIP experiment.

已有研究表明，CMIP5 模式低估了观测到的北极地区（Derksen and Brown, 2012）和北半球（Brutel-Vuilmet et al., 2013）春季积雪趋势。

It has been shown that CMIP5 models underestimate the observed spring snow cover trend in the Arctic (Derksen and Brown, 2012) and in the Northern Hemisphere (Brutel-Vuilmet et al., 2013).

气候系统中与雪相关的气候反馈主要源于众所周知的反照率反馈（如 Qu and Hall, 2007），该反馈也是导致北极放大的主要机制之一（如 Holland and Bitz, 2003）。

Snow-related climate feedbacks in the climate system arise primarily because of the well-known albedo feedback (e.g. Qu and Hall, 2007) that is also one of the main mechanisms leading to Arctic Amplification (e.g. Holland and Bitz, 2003).

气候模式中与雪相关的偏差可能通过该反馈产生，也可能通过春季融雪引起的能量汇以及雪对下层土壤的强烈隔热效应产生。

Snow-related biases in climate models may arise through this feedback, but also through the energy sink induced by snow melting in spring and through the strong thermal insulation effect of snow on the underlying soil.

Koven et al. (2012) 将 CMIP5 模式模拟的北半球多年冻土范围存在的强烈偏差与这些模式中对雪的表征联系起来。

Koven et al. (2012) related strong biases in the simulated Northern Hemisphere permafrost extent in CMIP5 models to the representation of snow in these models.

由于雪/大气反馈很强，很难区分并量化观测雪趋势与模式雪趋势之间分歧的各种潜在原因。

Because of strong snow/atmosphere feedbacks, it is difficult to distinguish and quantify the various potential causes for disagreement in observed versus model snow trends.

这些原因包括：CMIP5 模式对近期春季增暖趋势的低估（如 Brutel-Vuilmet et al., 2013）、对雪过程表征的不足（尤其是雪/反照率反馈方面，Qu and Hall, 2014）、CMIP5 模式在中纬度地区和北极普遍存在的融雪前雪水当量（SWE）正偏差（Brown and Mote, 2009）、多数模式未予考虑的雪上吸光性杂质沉降增加（如 Dumont et al., 2014），或以上因素与其他未知过程的组合。

These causes include: the underestimation of the recent spring warming trend in CMIP5 models (e.g., Brutel-Vuilmet et al., 2013), weaknesses in their representation of snow processes, especially regarding the snow/albedo feedback (Qu and Hall, 2014), a positive pre-melt snow water equivalent (SWE) bias in CMIP5 models across the mid latitudes and the Arctic (Brown and Mote, 2009), increased deposition of light-absorbing impurities on snow which is not accounted for in most models (e.g., Dumont et al., 2014), or a combination of these with other unknown processes.

更好地理解积雪与气候之间的联系，对于解释近年来观测到的变化至关重要，这些变化包括与大气和海洋环流变率的联系，以及气候模式对北极极地放大的错误表征。

A better understanding of the links between snow cover and climate is critical to interpret the observed changes in recent years including links to variability in the atmospheric and ocean circulation, and the misrepresentation of polar amplification by climate models in the Arctic.

这是提高对积雪预估及其在亚北极（北方）和北极气候中作用的信心的先决条件。

It is a prerequisite for increasing the confidence in the projections of snow cover and its role in the subarctic (boreal) and Arctic climate.

这种理解对于长期改进气候模式中雪的表征也是必要的，它还将影响气温、径流和土壤湿度的季节至年际预测。

This understanding is also necessary for the long-term improvement of the representation of snow in climate models, which will also impact seasonal to interannual prediction of temperature, runoff and soil moisture.

SnowMIP1（Etchevers et al., 2002）和 SnowMIP2 项目（Essery et al., 2009）评估了不同复杂度的雪模式利用局地气象强迫模拟积雪演化的能力。

The SnowMIP1 (Etchevers et al., 2002) and SnowMIP2 projects (Essery et al., 2009) evaluated the capacity of snow models of different complexity to simulate the snowpack evolution from local meteorological forcings.

这些项目基于在有限数量的仪器观测站点上对雪模式独立模拟的评估（另见 http://www.wcrp-climate.org/index.php/modelling-wgcm-mip-catalogue/57-unifying-themes/modelling-wgcm/catalogue-of-model-intercomparison-projects/276-modelling-wgcm-catalogue-snowmip）。

These projects were based on the evaluation of stand-alone simulations of snow models over a limited number of instrumented sites (see also http://www.wcrp-climate.org/index.php/modelling-wgcm-mip-catalogue/57-unifying-themes/modelling-wgcm/catalogue-of-model-intercomparison-projects/276-modelling-wgcm-catalogue-snowmip).

然而，这些开创性项目并未探索雪-气候相互作用，且局限于站点尺度。

However these pioneering projects did not explore snow-climate interactions, and were limited to the site scale.

LS3MIP 将同时考虑全球尺度的独立雪模拟和气候模拟的雪输出。

LS3MIP will consider both stand-alone snow simulations at the global scale and snow outputs from climate simulations.

将设计专门的实验，用于评估和理解当前气候模式中的雪反馈，并评估未来预估中与雪相关的不确定性。

Dedicated experiments will be designed for evaluating and understanding snow feedbacks within current climate models and assessing snow-related uncertainties in future projections.

这些将是 CliC/WCRP 协调的 WCRP 大挑战“变化气候中的冰冻圈”的一项关键行动。

These will be a key action of the WCRP Grand Challenge Cryosphere in a Changing Climate coordinated by CliC/WCRP.

土壤湿度过程与土壤湿度-气候反馈

Soil moisture processes and soil moisture-climate feedbacks

土壤湿度在很大程度上调节着陆面的能量平衡和水分平衡（Koster et al., 2004; Seneviratne et al., 2010; van den Hurk et al., 2011）。

Soil moisture modulates the energy and water balance at the land surface to a large extent (Koster et al., 2004; Seneviratne et al., 2010; van den Hurk et al., 2011).

它与植被、融雪、地下水、边界层过程和大气水汽相互作用，并且是可用淡水资源、热浪与干旱传播以及土壤侵蚀的关键要素。

It interacts with vegetation, melting snow, ground water, boundary layer processes, atmospheric moisture, and is a key element for available fresh water resources, heat wave and drought propagation and soil erosion.

土壤湿度的调节作用在许多相关时间尺度上都很突出：陆面通量的日循环，干旱、洪水和极端高温的（次）季节可预报性，支配旱季水分缓冲的年循环，以及气候态随降水和蒸发型变化而发生的变化（如 Betts 2004, Ek and Holtslag 2004, Santanello et al. 2009, Koster et al. 2010a,b, Douville et al. 2012, Mueller and Seneviratne 2012, Quesada et al. 2012, Dirmeyer et al. 2013, Miralles et al. 2014, Greve et al. 2014）。

The modulating role of soil moisture is eminent at many relevant time scales: diurnal cycles of land surface fluxes, (sub-)seasonal predictability of droughts, floods, and hot extremes, annual cycles governing the water buffer in dry seasons, and shifts in the climatology in response to changing patterns of precipitation and evaporation (e.g. Betts 2004, Ek and Holtslag 2004, Santanello et al. 2009, Koster et al. 2010a,b, Douville et al. 2012, Mueller and Seneviratne 2012, Quesada et al. 2012, Dirmeyer et al. 2013, Miralles et al. 2014, Greve et al. 2014).

一个重要的认识是：难以获得可靠的土壤湿度和陆面通量观测，并将其用作建模与可预报性研究的边界条件。

An important notion is the difficulty in generating reliable observations of soil moisture and land surface fluxes that can be used as boundary conditions for modeling and predictability studies.

卫星观测、现场观测、离线模式实验和间接估计都有潜力生成相关信息，但它们大多彼此不一致，覆盖状态的不同子域，且存在方法上的缺陷。

Satellite observations, in situ observations, offline model experiments and indirect estimates all have a potential to generate relevant information, but are largely inconsistent, covering different subdomains of the states, and suffer from methodological flaws.

因此，推导与土壤湿度相关的可预报性及区域/全球气候响应的开创性工作，是通过（成组的）模拟实验开展的。

As a consequence, the pioneering work on deriving soil moisture related predictability and regional/global climate responses has been carried out using (ensembles of) modeling experiments.

以下研究在这方面尤其相关。

The following studies are particularly relevant in this respect.

全球土壤湿度项目（尤其是第二阶段 GSWP2；Dirmeyer et al., 2006）基于一组由伪观测气候强迫驱动的离线陆面模式，生成了包括土壤湿度和地表通量在内的所有陆面状态的 10 年“气候态”（1986-1995）。

The Global Soil Wetness Project (particularly phase 2, GSWP2; Dirmeyer et al., 2006) yielded a 10-year "climatology" (1986-1995) of all land surface states including soil moisture and surface fluxes based on an ensemble of offline land surface models, driven by pseudo-observed climatological forcings.

为扩展该产品的时段和应用，各种后续项目已经开展或正在规划中。

Various follow-up projects to extend the period and applications of this product have taken place or are being planned.

对 CMIP6 来说，记录耦合模式的陆面分量在基于观测的受约束条件下的特征及其主要系统性偏差，具有头等重要性。

For CMIP6 it is of utmost relevance to document the characteristics of the land surface component of the coupled models under observation-based constrained conditions, and document its main systematic biases.

GSWP 第三版正在筹备中（GSWP3；见 http://hydro.iis.u-tokyo.ac.jp/GSWP3）。

A third edition of GSWP is being prepared (GSWP3; see http://hydro.iis.u-tokyo.ac.jp/GSWP3).

CMIP6 集合中大部分陆面模式的参与，使得生成受良好约束的 CMIP6 陆面特征气候态成为可能，并为模式评估和可预报性研究提供输入。

Participation by a large subset of the land surface models used in the CMIP6 ensemble allows the generation of a well constrained CMIP6 climatology of land surface characteristics, and provides input to model evaluation and predictability studies.

因此，将 GSWP3 纳入 CMIP6 计划可视为 CMIP6 的 LMIP，与 AMIP 或 OMIP 相类似。

Therefore, incorporating GSWP3 in the CMIP6 program can be seen as the LMIP of CMIP6, an analogy to AMIP or OMIP.

LMIP 模拟将以 GSWP3 实验为基础，并且在最近的 WGCM-18 会议上与 OMIP 一同被确定为未来可能的 DECK 实验。

The LMIP simulations will build upon the GSWP3 experiments and were identified, together with OMIP, as possible future DECK experiments at the recent WGCM-18 meeting.

在 CMIP6 中，这些“proto-DECK”（DECK 原型）实验被推荐为 Tier 1（第一层级）。

In CMIP6, these "proto-DECK" experiments are recommended for Tier1.

它们将能够评估 CMIP6 陆面模式中土壤湿度和雪过程的表征，以及其他陆面过程（如植被）及相关水通量和能量通量的表征。

They will allow an assessment of the representation of soil moisture and snow processes, as well as of other land surface processes (e.g. vegetation) and associated fluxes of water and energy in the CMIP6 land surface models.

全球陆气耦合实验（GLACE：关于季节预测的第一、二阶段（Koster et al. 2004; 2010），以及关于气候变化预估的 GLACE-CMIP5（Seneviratne et al., 2013））提供了对土壤湿度在气候系统中作用的初步评估。

The Global Land Atmosphere Coupling Experiment (GLACE: Phases 1 and 2 on seasonal forecasting (Koster et al. 2004; 2010) and GLACE-CMIP5 on climate change projections (Seneviratne et al., 2013)) provided first assessments of the role of soil moisture for the climate system.

GLACE-1 分析（Koster et al., 2004）基于一组理想化模式模拟，开创性地识别了土壤湿度对局地水文气候具有显著影响的区域。

The GLACE-1 analysis (Koster et al., 2004) pioneered the identification of regions where soil moisture has a significant impact on the local hydroclimate, based on an ensemble of idealized model simulations.

在季节时间尺度上，过渡性干湿气候区（大多与季风区重合）表现出可识别的土壤湿度-降水耦合。

At the seasonal time scale transitional wet-dry climate regions, mostly coinciding with monsoon regions, display an identifiable soil moisture-precipitation coupling.

将 GLACE 框架扩展到气候时间尺度并用于欧洲的区域气候模拟，Seneviratne et al. (2006) 说明了当前与未来气候条件下耦合强度型的变化，显示出强陆气相互作用区从地中海地区向中欧和东欧转移。

Expanding the GLACE framework at the climate time scale and for regional climate simulations in Europe, Seneviratne et al. (2006) illustrate changes in patterns of coupling strength between present and future climate conditions, showing a shift of the area of strong land-atmosphere interactions from the Mediterranean region to Central and Eastern Europe.

最近，GLACE-CMIP5 多模式实验（Seneviratne et al., 2013）利用这一扩展的 GLACE 框架，研究了土壤湿度在改变区域温度和降水对未来气候强迫的响应中所起的作用。

More recently, the GLACE-CMIP5 multi-model experiment (Seneviratne et al., 2013) uses this expanded GLACE framework to investigate the role of soil moisture in modifying the regional temperature and precipitation response to a future climate forcing.

GLACE-CMIP5 研究以给定海表温度（SST）和植被的有限 CMIP5 大气环流模式（AGCM）集合开展，其实验设计被用作下文详述的第二组 LS3MIP 拟议实验的蓝图。

The experimental design of the GLACE-CMIP5 study, carried out with a limited CMIP5 ensemble with prescribed SSTs (AGCMs) and vegetation, is used as blueprint for the second set of proposed LS3MIP experiments, described in detail below.

新的 LS3MIP 实验将能够全面量化 CMIP6 模式中的土壤湿度-气候反馈，并为评估 CMIP6 ESM 提供参考诊断量，这对应用约束以减少预估中的不确定性至关重要。

The new LS3MIP experiments will allow a full quantification of soil moisture-climate feedbacks in the CMIP6 models and provide reference diagnostics for the evaluation of the CMIP6 ESMs, which will be of key relevance for the application of constraints to reduce uncertainties in projections.

此外，LS3MIP 还将包括对 CMIP6 模式中陆基可预报性变化的评估。

In addition, LS3MIP will include an assessment of changes in land-based predictability in the CMIP6 models.

这些实验建立在 GLACE2 可预报性实验（Koster et al., 2010a）的基础上，该实验表明，采用经观测约束的估算土壤湿度作为初始化所带来的实际温度和降水技巧提升，远低于耦合强度诊断量所暗示的水平。

These experiments build upon the GLACE2 predictability experiment (Koster et al., 2010a), in which the actual temperature and precipitation skill improvement of using observation constrained estimated soil moisture initializations is shown to be much lower than suggested by the coupling strength diagnostics.

初始状态质量有限、可预报性有限，以及对决定信息在水文循环中传播的关键过程表征不佳，这些因素都起了作用。

Limited quality of the initial states, limited predictability and poor representation of essential processes determining the propagation of information through the hydrological cycle in the models all play a role.

对当前最先进气候模式中与陆面相关的可预报性进行更新评估，将揭示关于这些模式表征陆地水文过程的能力、可预报性的固有限制，以及可预报性型随气候变化的可能转变的重要信息（Dirmeyer et al., 2013）。

An update of the land surface related predictability in state of the art climate models will reveal essential information about the models' ability to represent the terrestrial hydrological processes, the inherent limitations to predictability, and possible shifts in patterns of predictability in response to climate change (Dirmeyer et al., 2013).

这将在 LS3MIP 实验的第三个分支中进行评估。

This will be evaluated in the third branch of LS3MIP experiments.

LMIP（GSWP3）和基于土壤湿度的 LS3MIP 实验都是 WCRP 关于水资源可利用性和气候极端事件大挑战的关键行动项目，这些大挑战由 GEWEX 项目协调。

Both the LMIP (GSWP3) and the soil moisture-based LS3MIP experiments are key action items of the WCRP grand challenges on water availability and climate extremes, which are coordinated by the GEWEX project.

LS3MIP 的目标

Objectives of LS3MIP

陆面、雪与土壤湿度模式比较计划（LS3MIP）将包含少量多模式实验，涵盖离线模式（仅陆面）驱动、与大气耦合（由给定的海表温度 SST 驱动）以及嵌入完全耦合 AOGCM 的模拟。

The Land Surface Snow and Soil moisture MIP (LS3MIP) will embrace a small number of multi-model experiments, encompassing simulations driven in offline mode (land-surface only), coupled to the atmosphere (driven by prescribed sea surface temperatures, SSTs), and embedded in fully coupled AOGCMs.

这些实验分为两个组成部分：第一个针对陆面系统性偏差（“LMIP”，以 GSWP3 实验为基础），第二个在综合框架内针对陆面反馈（“LFMIP”，以 ESMsnowMIP 和 GLACE-CMIP 蓝图为蓝本）。

The experiments are subdivided in two components, the first one addressing land systematic biases ("LMIP", building upon the GSWP3 experiment) and the second one addressing land feedbacks in an integrated framework ("LFMIP", building upon the ESMsnowMIP and GLACE-CMIP blueprints).

LS3MIP 实验共同致力于以下目标：

The LS3MIP experiments address together the following objectives:

• 对 CMIP6 DECK 运行中陆面过程（包括地表通量、积雪和土壤湿度表征）现状的评估，揭示主要系统性偏差及其依赖关系（LMIP-protoDECK）

• an evaluation of the current state of land processes including surface fluxes, snow cover and soil moisture representation in CMIP6 DECK runs, revealing main systematic biases and their dependencies (LMIP-protoDECK)

• 在观测约束的历史（陆面再分析）和预估未来（影响评估）条件下，考虑土地利用/土地覆盖变化，利用 CMIP6 模式的陆面模块对长期陆地能量/水/碳循环进行多模式估算。（LMIP）

• a multi-model estimation of the long-term terrestrial energy/water/carbon cycles, using the surface modules of CMIP6 models under observation constrained historical (land reanalysis) and projected future (impact assessment) conditions considering land use/land cover changes. (LMIP)

• 对雪和土壤湿度反馈在区域对改变后的气候强迫响应中所起作用的评估，重点关注历史与未来情景运行中气候极端事件、水资源可利用性和高纬度气候的制约因素（涉及北极放大及干旱/热浪特征）（LFMIP）

• an assessment of the role of snow and soil moisture feedbacks in the regional response to altered climate forcings, focusing on controls of climate extremes, water availability and high-latitude climate in historical and future scenario runs (addressing Arctic amplification and drought/heatwave characteristics) (LFMIP)

• 对陆面过程对区域温度/降水型当前和未来可预报性贡献的评估。（LFMIP）

• an assessment of the contribution of land surface processes to the current and future predictability of regional temperature/precipitation patterns. (LFMIP)

这些目标回应了 CMIP6 三个总体问题中的每一个：气候变化的区域反馈和响应是什么，当前气候模式的系统性偏差是什么，以及关于生成预测和情景的前景如何。

These objectives respond to each of the three CMIP6 overarching questions: what are regional feedbacks and responses to climate change, what are the systematic biases in the current climate models, and what are the perspectives concerning the generation of predictions and scenarios.

LS3MIP 在 WCRP 和 CMIP6 中的嵌入

Embedding of LS3MIP within WCRP and CMIP6

如图 1 所示，LS3MIP 正在解决 WCRP 的核心研究问题，并与 WCRP 的大部分活动相关。

As illustrated in Figure 1, LS3MIP is addressing core research questions of the WCRP and is relevant for a large fraction of the WCRP activities.

它由 WCRP 四个核心项目中的两个（CliC 和 GEWEX）发起，并与 WCRP 三大挑战（变化气候中的冰冻圈、水资源可利用性的变化和气候极端事件）直接相关。

It is initiated by two out of four WCRP core projects (CliC and GEWEX) and directly related to three WCRP Grand Challenges (Cryosphere in a Changing Climate, Changes in Water Availability, and Climate Extremes).

LMIP 实验将提供全球尺度雪和土壤湿度历史变化的最佳估计，从而能够评估各大洲淡水、农业干旱和径流极端事件的变化。

The LMIP experiment will provide best estimates of historical changes in snow and soil moisture on global scale, thus allowing the evaluation of changes in freshwater, agricultural drought, and streamflow extremes over continents.

LFMIP 实验对于评估耦合模式下陆面过程的关键反馈和系统性偏差具有高度相关性，并且还涉及陆地上两个主要反馈回路：参与北极放大的雪-反照率-温度反馈，以及导致温度极端事件重大变化的土壤湿度-温度反馈。

The LFMIP experiment is of high relevance for the assessment of key feedbacks and systematic biases of land surfaces processes in coupled mode, and is also addressing two of the main feedback loops over land: The snow-albedo-temperature feedback, involved in Arctic Amplification, and the soil moisture-temperature feedback leading to major changes in temperature extremes.

因此，LS3MIP 直接针对“变化气候中的冰冻圈”和“水资源可利用性的变化”两大挑战所依据的一些主要问题，并且还将为“气候极端事件”大挑战提供关于温度和水文极端事件的重要见解。

Hence LS3MIP is directly addressing some of the main questions underlying the Cryosphere in a Changing Climate and Changes in Water Availability Grand Challenges, and will also provide essential insights on temperature and hydrological extremes for the Climate Extremes Grand Challenge.

此外，LS3MIP 还将促进各群体之间的数据和知识交流，因为雪和土壤湿度动态常常相互关联（如 Hall et al. 2008），并共同对水文变率作出贡献（如 Koster et al. 2010b）。

In addition, LS3MIP will also allow the exchange of data and knowledge across communities, as snow and soil moisture dynamics are often interrelated (e.g. (Hall et al. 2008) and contribute together to hydrological variability (e.g. Koster et al. 2010b).

因此，LS3MIP 将构成 WCRP 内的一个核心要素，把若干群体联系在一起，这些群体实际上研究的是同一个物理对象：陆地上液态或固态形式的水。

LS3MIP will thus constitute a core element within WCRP, binding together several communities that, in fact, address a common physical object: water on land, in its liquid or solid form.

图 1：LS3MIP 与 WCRP 核心项目和大挑战的相关性

Figure 1: Relevance of LS3MIP for WCRP Core Projects and Grand Challenges

此外，LS3MIP 将为 WCRP 内的其他研究群体提供相关见解，例如对进入海洋的淡水输入的估计（与海平面变化和区域影响相关）、对已被证明强烈调节区域气候变率并因此与区域气候信息相关的反馈的评估，以及关于陆地气候对大尺度环流型和云出现频率反馈的研究。

In addition, LS3MIP will provide relevant insights for other research communities within WCRP, such as estimates of freshwater inputs to the oceans (which are relevant for sea-level changes and regional impacts), the assessment of feedbacks shown to strongly modulate regional climate variability and thus relevant for regional climate information, as well as the investigation of land climate feedbacks on large-scale circulation patterns and cloud occurrence.

因此，这也意味着可能对 WCRP 的其他大挑战和核心项目作出贡献。

This will thus also imply potential contributions to the other WCRP grand challenges and core projects.

图 2：LS3MIP 在 CMIP6 中的嵌入

Figure 2: Embedding of LS3MIP within CMIP6

图 2 说明了 LS3MIP 在 CMIP6 中的嵌入。

Figure 2 illustrates the embedding of LS3MIP within CMIP6.

LS3MIP 明确填补了一个重大空白，使得能够在 CMIP6 框架内考虑陆面系统性偏差和陆面反馈。

LS3MIP clearly fills a major gap, by allowing the consideration of land systematic biases and land feedbacks within the CMIP6 framework.

在这一背景下，LS3MIP 可被视为更大的“LandMIP”系列实验的一部分，该系列全面处理来自陆面的偏差、不确定性、反馈和强迫（图 3），并与针对海洋或大气过程的类似实验互补。

In this context, LS3MIP can be seen as part of a larger "LandMIP" series of experiments fully addressing biases, uncertainties, feedbacks and forcings from the land surface (Figure 3), which are complementary to similar experiments for ocean or atmospheric processes.

特别是，我们注意到：LS3MIP 侧重陆面过程中的系统性偏差（LMIP）和陆面过程对气候系统的反馈（LFMIP），而互补的 LUMIP 实验（单独的提案）则针对陆面强迫对气候系统的作用。

In particular, we note that while LS3MIP focuses on systematic biases in land surface processes (LMIP) and on feedbacks from the land surface processes on the climate system (LFMIP), the complementary LUMIP experiment (separate proposal) addresses the role of land surface forcing on the climate system.

植被和碳库在气候系统中的作用是 LUMIP 与 LS3MIP 的一个交汇点。

The role of vegetation and carbon stores in the climate system is a point of convergence between LUMIP and LS3MIP.

特别是，LMIP/GSWP3 实验将作为 LS3MIP 和 LUMIP 实验共同的仅陆面参考实验。

In particular, the LMIP/GSWP3 experiment will serve as land-only reference experiments for both the LS3MIP and LUMIP experiments.

此外，还将与 C4MIP 实验建立联系，涉及雪和土壤湿度过程（尤其是干旱）对陆地碳交换的影响及其对气候系统的反馈。

In addition, there will also be links to the C4MIP experiment with respect to impacts of snow and soil moisture processes (in particular droughts) on terrestrial carbon exchanges and resulting feedbacks to the climate system.

图 3：LS3MIP 在与陆面相关的各 MIP 中的嵌入情况概览。

Figure 3: Overview of the embedding of LS3MIP in land-related MIPs.

LS3MIP 将能够量化由雪和土壤湿度过程引起的陆面系统性偏差和反馈，而 LUMIP 则针对陆面对气候的强迫。

LS3MIP will allow the quantification of land systematic biases and feedbacks induced by snow and soil moisture processes, while LUMIP addresses land forcing on climate.

拟议实验概览

Overview of the proposed experiments

作为 LS3MIP 的一部分，提议开展若干互补实验（见图 4 和表 1）：

A number of complementary experiments are proposed as part of LS3MIP (see Figure 4 and Table 1):

（1）离线陆面模式实验（“陆面离线模式比较计划” Land offline MIP，LMIP）：

(1) Offline land model experiment ("Land offline MIP", LMIP):

在 GSWP3 的背景下，提供气象强迫数据，用于以离线模式驱动气候模式中的陆面模块。

In the context of GSWP3 meteorological forcings are made available to drive land modules from climate models in an offline mode.

对陆面状态和通量的离线陆面模拟，能够评估雪、土壤湿度和陆面通量、碳库和植被状态的趋势与变率，以及气候变化影响。

Offline land simulations of land surface states and fluxes allow for the evaluation of trends and variability of snow, soil moisture and land surface fluxes, carbon stores and vegetation states, and climate change impacts.

目前正在汇编辅助数据（如土地利用/覆盖变化、地表参数、CO2 浓度）以及用于启动（spin-up）和执行实验的书面协议。

Ancillary data (e.g., land use/cover changes, surface parameters, CO2 concentration) and documented protocols to spin-up and execute the experiments are currently being compiled.

LMIP 气象强迫由 GEWEX-GLASS 专家组开发并提供，该专家组在大尺度陆面模式评估领域拥有长期经验。

The LMIP meteorological forcing is developed and provided by the GEWEX-GLASS panel, which has a long-standing experience in the domain of large-scale land surface model evaluation.

尽管如此，一些已知和未知的问题仍不可避免。

Nevertheless, some known and unknown issues inevitably remain.

在受大尺度强迫数据已知问题影响的区域，或在出现许多陆面模式共有的显著系统性大尺度偏差的区域，可以通过对大尺度和样地尺度气象数据与模拟进行并行评估来识别这些问题，其中样地尺度模拟由直接观测的气象数据驱动。

In areas affected by known issues with large-scale forcing data or in areas where conspicuous systematic large-scale biases common to many land surface models appear, these can be identified by a concomitant evaluation of large-scale and plot-scale meteorological data and simulations, the latter being forced by directly observed meteorological data.

我们的分析将利用这些可能性。

Our analysis will take advantage of these possibilities.

关于为离线实验提供的气象强迫的更多信息见附件（第 14 页）。

Additional information on the provided meteorological forcing for the offline experiments is given in the Annex (page 14).

（1a）陆面再分析：LMIP-Hist

(1a) Land reanalysis: LMIP-Hist

将提供一套参考强迫数据和标准偏差订正策略，用于驱动各陆面模式开展历史（1850-2014）模拟。

One set of reference forcing data and a standard bias correction strategy will be provided to drive each land surface model for the historical (1850-2014) simulations.

尽管该历史实验尚未成为 DECK 模拟的正式成员，WGCM 已认识到这些离线实验对模式发展和基准测试过程的重要性。

Although this historical experiment is not yet a formal member of the DECK simulations, the WGCM recognized the importance of these offline experiments for the process of model development and benchmarking.

该历史运行中与 AMIP 大致类似的子时段（1979-2014）构成 LMIP 的 Tier 1（第一层级），并被提议在未来的 CMIP 活动中成为 DECK 的一部分。

The subset (1979-2014) of this historical run, largely analogous to AMIP, constitute Tier 1 of LMIP and is proposed to become part of the DECK in future CMIP exercises.

预计未来将纳入 DECK，因此 LMIP 模拟被确定为 proto-DECK（DECK 原型）实验。

Complementary, additional site level validations using 1d time series of observational forcing variables from selected reference sites will be proposed in parallel to the CMIP6 framework.

(1b) Climate change impact assessment: LMIP-Fut

未来模拟（2015-2100）构成 LMIP 的 Tier 2（第二层级）。

The future simulations (2015-2100) constitute Tier 2 of LMIP.

它侧重于气候变化影响评估（如对水资源可利用性和气候极端事件的影响）以及 CMIP6 各 GCM 的陆面模块对预估未来的敏感性估计。

这里遵循 GLACE‐CMIP5 协议：除 CMIP6 DECK 实验之外，还将开展一组强迫实验，其中陆面状态由预先定义的数据库给定。

Here the GLACE‐CMIP5 protocol is followed, where apart from the CMIP6 DECK experiments a set of forced experiments is carried out, where land surface states are prescribed from an a priori defined database.

与早期实验不同，这里预期开展耦合 AOGCM 模拟，并以历史（1980‐2014）与未来（2015‐2100）模拟作为参照。

For the future a single scenario from the ScenarioMIP will be selected at a later stage.

所给定的陆面状态可因参与模式的模式结构不同而有所差异，但至少包括水分储库（土壤湿度、雪质量），也可扩展到与植被或温度有关的其他预报量。

The land surface states that are prescribed may vary across the participating models depending on the model structure, but at least include the water reservoirs (soil moisture, snow mass), but may be extended to other prognostic quantities related to vegetation or temperature.

早期 GLACE 相关实验的经验已揭示出若干技术与科学问题：

The earlier experience with GLACE‐related experiments has revealed a number of technical and scientific issues:

技术方面：由于在大多数 GCM 中陆面模块是描述大气的代码的组成部分，给定陆面动力过程需要一个非常规的技术接口，在整个模拟过程中读取并替换变量。

Technical aspects: because in most GCMs the land surface module is an integral part of the code describing the atmosphere, prescribing land surface dynamics requires a non‐conventional technical interface, reading and replacing variables throughout the entire simulations.

LS3MIP 的许多参与者此前参加过 GLACE 类实验，但对其中一些而言，代码调整仍需投入技术工作。

Many participants to LS3MIP have participated earlier in GLACE‐type experiments, but for some the code adjustments will require a technical effort.

在此接口中，需要就外部读取变量的选择、解决与其他静态或动态变量可能存在的失配问题做出一些非平凡的选择。

In this interface some non‐trivial choices have to be made on the selection of variables read in externally, resolving possible mismatches with other static or dynamic variables.

鉴于陆面方案的种类繁多，对该流程进行标准化并不可行；如何实现该接口由各研究团队自行决定，他们处于优化该接口的最佳位置。

A standardization of this procedure is, given the wide variety of land surface formulation, not feasible; the decision on how to implement this interface is up to the research teams, who are in the best position to optimize this interface.

可能实现方式的差异会增加模式集合所产生的不确定性范围，其程度类似于土地利用、通量订正或降尺度的实现方式所增加的不确定性。

The disparity of possible implementations is adding to the uncertainty range generated by the model ensemble, similar to the degree to which implementation of land use, flux corrections or downscaling adds to this uncertainty range.

对给定陆面变量这一协议之贡献的理解，有赖于对建模团队实现该接口方式的细致记录。

Understanding of the contribution of the protocol to prescribe land surface variables is helped by a careful documentation of the way the modelling groups have implemented this interface.

LS3MIP 领导层将在各参与建模团队之间组织关于强迫技术的详细讨论，以尽可能促成同质化的实现，并将确保对初步与最终 LS3MIP 运行中给定陆面变量进行细致且协调的检查。

The LS3MIP leadership will organize a detailed discussion of the forcing techniques among the participating modeling groups in order to favor as much as possible a homogenous implementation, and it will ensure careful and coordinated checks of the prescribed land‐surface variables in preliminary and final LS3MIP runs.

水与能量守恒：与 AMIP、松弛逼近（nudged）和资料同化实验类似，给定陆面状态的实验不守恒水与能量。

Water and energy conservation: similar to AMIP, nudged, and data assimilation experiments, the prescribed land surface experiments do not conserve water and energy.

如果例如地表蒸发或径流对土壤湿度或雪状态存在强非线性依赖，那么陆面对干、湿条件的不对称响应甚至可能导致系统性地产生或消灭水或能量。

A systematic generation or destruction of water or energy can even in emerge as a result of asymmetric land surface responses to dry and to wet conditions, if e.g. surface evaporation or runoff depend strongly non‐linearly to soil moisture or snow states.

此外，未表征的过程（如灌溉取水或与地下水的交换）可能导致收支失衡。

Also, unrepresented processes (such as water extraction for irrigation or exchange with the groundwater) may lead to imbalances in the budget.

这种对水和能量平衡的系统性改变可能与预估的气候变化信号发生相互作用，其中被改变的气候态土壤状况可对气候变化引起的温度或降水信号做出贡献。

This systematic alteration of the water and energy balance may interact with the projected climate change signal, where altered climatological soil conditions can contribute to the climate change induced temperature or precipitation signal.

在实验分析中，将考察这种不对称性以及能量/水收支不闭合的问题，并将其置于气候态能量与水平衡及其气候趋势²的背景中。

In the analyses of the experiments this asymmetry and lack of energy/water balance closure will be examined and put in context of the climatological energy and water balance and its climatic trends2.

² 若这一问题在参与建模团队中引起足够兴趣，可设想开展额外实验以强制实现水守恒（至少在无雪季节），即规定任何加入或撤出土壤的水都取自（或加入）径流或地下水储量；若这一做法不可行，则这部分额外的水不予提供。这将对应于一个最大灌溉实验，可作为敏感性实验以更详细地研究这一问题。

2 In case this question spurs sufficient interest among the engaged modeling groups, additional experiments enforcing water conservation (at least during the snow‐free season) can be envisaged by imposing that any water added to or withdrawn from the soil is taken from (added to) runoff or groundwater storage, and if this is not possible this additional water is not provided. This would correspond to a maximum irrigation experiment that could serve as a sensitivity experiment to investigate this issue in more detail.

早期的 GLACE 类实验表明，当给定土壤水状况取计算气候态平均所用样本的中位数而非平均值时，水守恒问题往往得到缓解。

Earlier GLACE‐type experiments revealed that often the issue of water conversation is reduced when prescribed soil water conditions are taken as the median rather than the mean of a sample over which a climatological mean is calculated.

因此，我们将在 LS3MIP 中使用中位数的土壤水与雪状况。

Therefore, we will use median soil water and snow conditions in LS3MIP.

我们进一步指出，我们的许多模拟在仅大气模式下开展，该模式下水与能量守恒本来就不被满足。

We further note that many of our simulations are carried out in the atmosphere‐only mode in which water and energy conservation is not respected anyway.

(2a) 核心实验：有 2 个实验被视为“核心”：

(2a) Core experiments: 2 experiments are considered to be “core”:

• 由“现代气候”状况（如 1980‐2014）导出的给定气候态，旨在诊断气候时间尺度上陆气反馈的作用；

• prescribed climatology derived from “present climate” conditions (e.g. 1980‐2014), aiming at diagnosing the role of land‐atmosphere feedback at the climate time scales;

• 使用瞬变 30 年滑动平均的给定气候态，与标准 CMIP6 运行对比可诊断强陆气耦合区域的转移，以及与陆面状态相关的潜在可预报性的变化。

• prescribed climatology using a transient 30‐yr running mean, where a comparison to the standard CMIP6 runs allows diagnosing shifts in the regions of strong land‐atmosphere coupling, and shifts in potential predictability related to land surface states.

两个模拟都覆盖历史时段并延伸至 2100 年，基于后续阶段确定的情景强迫。

Both simulations cover the historical period and extend to 2100, based on a forcing scenario to be identified at a later stage.

在这两种情形（以及下文相应情形）中，将使用耦合模式的气候态中位数土壤水与雪水当量，而非气候态平均值（见上文）。

In both cases (and in corresponding cases below), the coupled model’s climatological median soil water and snow water equivalent for will be used instead of the climatological mean (see above).

我们注意到，“由现代气候状况导出的给定气候态”实验可被视为理想化的未来灌溉实验。

We note that the “prescribed climatology derived from present climate conditions” experiments can be seen as an idealized future irrigation experiment.

计划输出高时间分辨率数据（逐日，部分场与时间片段为次日），以研究陆面‐气候反馈（包括雪与土壤湿度反馈）对陆地气候极端事件的作用。

Output in high temporal resolution (daily, as well as sub‐daily for some fields and time slices) is planned in order to address the role of land surface‐climate feedbacks (including snow and soil moisture feedbacks) on climate extremes on land.

这些输出可仅为较短的时间片段生成。

These outputs may be generated for shorter time slices only.

每个核心模拟的单个成员被视为 Tier 1 层级模拟的一部分，但鼓励开展多成员实验（并纳入 Tier 2 层级的模拟集合）。

A single member of each of these core simulations is considered to be part of the Tier 1 simulations, but multi‐member experiments are encouraged (and included in a Tier 2 set of simulations).

对 CMIP DECK 与 CMIP6 实验所提议评估/分析的概览

Overview of the proposed evaluation/analysis of the CMIP DECK and CMIP6 experiments

LS3MIP 汇集了气候模式研发者、雪与土壤湿度模式专家，以及土壤湿度和雪的性质、质量与范围的局地与遥感数据专家。

LS3MIP brings together climate modelers, snow and soil moisture model specialists and experts in local and remotely sensed data of soil moisture and snow properties, mass and extent.

这种多样性体现在 LS3MIP 指导小组的构成中，并确保实验设置、模式评估以及结果的分析/解释都是贴切的。

This diversity is reflected in the composition of the steering group of LS3MIP and ensures that the experiment setups, model evaluations and analyses/interpretations of the results are pertinent.

雪的分析

Analyses for snow

关于气候模式运行的分析，大尺度雪质量（SWE，雪水当量）与积雪范围（SCE）数据集对 LS3MIP 框架中历史模拟（即 AMIP 运行与历史耦合运行）的分析尤为重要。

Concerning the analysis of climate model runs, large‐scale datasets of snow mass (SWE) and snow cover extent (SCE) are particularly relevant for the analysis of the historical simulations in the LS3MIP framework (i.e. the AMIP runs and the historical coupled run).

这些大尺度、高质量的雪数据可通过指导小组的构成，经由与卫星雪产品对比评估实验（SnowPEX，http://calvalportal.ceos.org/projects/snowpex）的密切联系获取。

These large‐scale, high‐quality snow data are available through close links to the Satellite Snow Product Intercomparison and Evaluation Experiment (SnowPEX, http://calvalportal.ceos.org/projects/snowpex), via the composition of the steering group.

历史模拟（耦合与 AMIP）中这些基本雪相关变量的表征质量将对照这些数据集进行评估。

The quality of the representation of these fundamental snow‐related variables in the historical simulations (coupled and AMIP) will be evaluated against these datasets.

需要历史模拟的输出，以更新观测与历史模拟之间一致性的分析，并确定陆地积雪范围与质量的变率和趋势的新预估（此前已用 CMIP3 与 CMIP5 输出在 Brown and Mote (2009)、Derksen and Brown (2012)、Brutel‐Vuilmet et al. 2013 等研究中加以检验）。

Output from the historical simulations are required to update analyses of the agreement between observations and historical simulations, and determine new projections of the variability and trends in terrestrial snow cover extent and mass (this was examined with CMIP3 and CMIP5 output in studies such as Brown and Mote (2009); Derksen and Brown (2012); Brutel‐Vuilmet et al. 2013).

这些分析除其本身的意义外，还可为解释模式在北方与极地气候表征中的普遍缺陷提供线索。

These analyses, besides their genuine interest, can also provide clues to the interpretation of general model deficiencies in the representation of boreal and polar climates.

将对 DECK 模拟中积雪覆盖区反照率的表征进行分析。

The representation of albedo over snow‐covered areas in DECK simulations will be analyzed.

现有多个卫星反演数据集可用于评估模拟反照率，包括 16 天 MODIS 数据（2001 年至今；http://modis‐atmos.gsfc.nasa.gov/ALBEDO/）和最近更新的每日两次 APP‐x 产品（1982‐2011；http://stratus.ssec.wisc.edu/products/appx/appx.html）。

Multiple satellite‐derived datasets are available for the evaluation of simulated albedo, including 16‐day MODIS data (2001‐present; http://modis‐atmos.gsfc.nasa.gov/ALBEDO/) and the recently updated twice‐daily APP‐x product (1982‐2011; http://stratus.ssec.wisc.edu/products/appx/appx.html).

将特别关注模式对森林与山区积雪覆盖率表征的作用。

Specific attention will be paid to the role of the models' representation of snow cover fraction in forested and mountainous areas.

DECK 模拟将用于更新观测与模拟的雪反照率反馈分析，这是确定气候对积雪敏感度的重要诊断量（Qu and Hall, 2014; Fletcher et al. 2012）。

The DECK simulations will be used to update analyses of observed and simulated snow‐albedo feedback, an important diagnostic in determining climate sensitivity to snow cover (Qu and Hall, 2014; Fletcher et al. 2012).

LS3MIP 实验将与对照运行结合分析，以量化雪的各种气候效应，包括对雪反照率反馈的非常精确的估计。

The LS3MIP will be analyzed in concert with the control runs to quantify various climatic effects of snow, including very accurate estimates of snow albedo feedback.

例如，给定反照率实验（模拟组 2c）不允许气候变暖时积雪覆盖区植被的光学性质发生变化。

For example, the prescribed albedo experiments (simulation set 2c) do not allow the optical properties of vegetation to change in snow‐covered areas as the climate warms.

然而，给定 SWE 的实验确实允许这种效应存在。

However, the prescribed SWE experiments do allow for this effect.

PAGE 173

可将给定 SWE 实验中地表反照率的变化与对照实验中总反照率的变化相比较，以量化积雪覆盖区地表反照率变化在多大程度上源于植被变化而非积雪变化。

The surface albedo change in the Prescribed SWE experiments can be compared to the overall albedo change in the control experiments to quantify the degree to which the surface albedo changes in snow‐covered areas are due to vegetation changes, rather than snow changes.

这些估计可用于确认：从给定反照率实验诊断出的雪反照率反馈效应不会因植被效应而产生误导。

These estimates can be used to confirm that snow albedo feedback effects diagnosed from the Prescribed Albedo experiments are not misleading due to vegetation effects.

类似地，给定反照率实验包含由融雪引起的土壤湿度与水文变化。

Similarly, the Prescribed albedo experiments contain changes in soil moisture and hydrology due to melting snow.

可将这些与对照实验比较，以确定融雪在多大程度上独立于其对地表吸收太阳辐射的重大影响而影响水文。

These can be compared to the control experiments to ascertain the degree to which snowmelt influences hydrology independently of its substantial influence on surface absorbed solar radiation.

由此可以评估给定 SWE 实验所产生的与雪反照率反馈无关的雪效应达到了何种程度。

In this way, one can assess the degree to which the Prescribed SWE experiments produce snow effects unrelated to snow albedo feedback.

本项目第一阶段的地理重点是两个半球的大陆积雪，既包括无冰区（欧亚大陆北部与北美），也包括大型冰盖（格陵兰与南极洲）。

The geographical focus of the first stage of this project is on the continental snow cover of both hemispheres, both in ice‐free areas (Northern Eurasia and North America) and on the large ice sheets (Greenland and Antarctica).

在 LS3MIP 的后续阶段，将分析雪对海冰的影响。

In later stages of LS3MIP, the effect of snow on sea ice will be analyzed.

关于海冰上积雪的主要科学问题与近期北极海冰强烈减少的趋势以及雪提前融化的潜在放大效应有关。

Major scientific questions concerning snow on sea ice are related to strong recent trends of Arctic sea ice decline and the potential amplifying effect of earlier snow melt.

这些问题可通过带有动态大气松弛逼近的 AGCM 运行来应对，以消除与北半球环流趋势（AO、NAO）表征失真有关的偏差。

These questions can be tackled by AGCM runs with a dynamic atmospheric nudging to eliminate biases related to misrepresentation of NH circulation trends (AO, NAO).

一些已声明有兴趣参与 LS3MIP 雪相关部分（ESM‐SnowMIP）的建模团队目前正在使用给定雪质量（SWE）和 AMIP 型 DECK 对照运行开展“概念验证”模拟；注意，类似实验已经开展过（如 Lawrence and Slater, 2009; Alexander et al., 2011），证明了所提议实验的可行性与科学意义。

Some of the modeling groups that have declared interest in participating in the snow‐related part of LS3MIP (ESM‐SnowMIP) are currently carrying out “proof of concept” simulations using prescribed snow mass (SWE) with an AMIP‐type DECK control run; note that similar experiments have already been carried out (e.g., Lawrence and Slater, 2009; Alexander et al., 2011), demonstrating the feasibility and scientific interest of the proposed experiments.

土壤湿度的分析

Analyses for soil moisture

分析将聚焦于 1) 离线陆面模拟（LMIP/GSWP3 模拟）的系统性偏差，以及 2) 土壤湿度‐气候反馈对陆地气候状况过去与预估变化的作用。

The analyses will focus on 1) systematic biases in offline land simulations (LMIP/GSWP3 simulations) and on 2) the role of soil moisture – climate feedbacks for past and projected changes in land climate conditions.

就系统性陆面偏差而言，将用历史时段可获得的观测（如径流、储量异常、植被活动）评估 LMIP/GSWP3 模拟，以评估其真实程度以及与实测相比的典型偏差。

In the case of systematic land biases, the LMIP/GSWP3 simulations will be evaluated with observations available over the historical time period (e.g. for runoff, storage anomalies, vegetation activity) to assess their degree of realism and typical biases compared to measurements.

将评估当前陆面模式在表征历史陆地水可用性/干旱变化（源于模式参数化和/或大气强迫，Sheffield et al. 2012, Trenberth et al. 2013, Greve et al. 2014）方面的不确定性，以及陆气之间水、能量与碳交换的系统性偏差（如 Mueller and Seneviratne 2014）。

Uncertainties of current land surface models in the representation of historical variations in land water availability/droughts (due to model parameterizations and/or atmospheric forcings, Sheffield et al. 2012, Trenberth et al. 2013, Greve et al. 2014) as well as systematic biases in water, energy and carbon exchanges between the land and the atmosphere (e.g. Mueller and Seneviratne 2014) will be assessed.

这些评估将用于对未来陆地状况离线模拟以及耦合实验的评估。

These assessments will be used for the evaluation of the offline simulations for future land conditions as well as the coupled experiments.

就土壤湿度‐气候反馈而言，重点将放在以下主题上：

In the case of soil moisture‐climate feedbacks, the focus will be set on the following topics:

1. 量化土壤湿度变率对陆地气候变率（趋势、年代际变率、年际异常、极端事件）的影响及其与大尺度驱动因子（大尺度变率模态、海洋‐气候相互作用）的相互作用

1. The quantification of the impact of soil moisture variability for climate variability (trends, decadal variability, interannual anomalies, extremes) on land and its interaction with large‐scale drivers (large‐scale modes of variability, ocean‐climate interactions)

2. 将模式在陆地温度、降水、径流、植被活动、碳汇上的分歧归因于土壤湿度的表征、相关过程（植物蒸腾与光合作用）以及对大气的反馈

2. The attribution of model disagreement in land temperature, precipitation, runoff vegetation activity, carbon sink to the representation of soil moisture, related processes (plant transpiration and photosynthesis) and feedbacks to the atmosphere

3. 利用表征已识别土壤湿度‐气候反馈的观测，推导涌现约束以减小平均气候与极端事件（高温、干旱、洪水）预估的不确定性

3. The derivation of emergent constraints to reduce uncertainties in projections of mean climate and extremes (hot temperatures, droughts, floods) using observations characterizing the identified soil moisture‐climate feedbacks

4. 区域尺度评估模式土壤湿度/陆面表征偏差与气候响应之间的关系

4. The regional assessment of the relationship between bias in modelled soil moisture/land surface representation and climate response

PAGE 174

5. 对土壤湿度动力变化“热点”的地理格局及其对干旱、热浪、灌溉限制或河流流量异常发生的影响的稳健估计。

5. A robust estimate on the geographical patterns of “hot spots” of changes in soil moisture dynamics and their impact on occurrence of droughts, heat waves, irrigation limitations or river discharge anomalies.

6. 评估土壤湿度对当前与未来气候中陆地上次季节至季节可预报性的作用。

6. The assessment of the role of soil moisture for subseasonal to seasonal predictability over land in both present and future climate.

提议的时间安排

Proposed timing

所提议的实验是复刻 Historical 与 ScenarioMIP 模拟的连续模式运行。

The proposed experiments are continuous model runs duplicating the Historical and ScenarioMIP simulations.

AMIP 模式运行计划作为 Tier 2 层级的实验集合。

AMIP mode runs are foreseen as a Tier 2 set of experiments.

实验设置需要为读取和给定陆面特征编写适量的额外代码，而许多团队已经参加过此前的实验。

The experimental setup requires a reasonable amount of additional coding for reading and prescribing land surface characteristics, while many groups already participated in one of the earlier experiments.

预计 LS3MIP 的反馈模拟将在第一组核心 CMIP6 实验（即 DECK 与历史运行）之后开展。

It is anticipated that the feedback simulations of LS3MIP are carried out after the first set of core CMIP6 experiments (i.e. DECK and historical runs).

目前计划在 GSWP3 背景下开展 ESM 陆面模块非耦合模式的独立模拟，并将于 2016 年初启动。

Stand‐alone simulations with the ESMs’ land surface modules in uncoupled mode are currently planned in the context of GSWP3, and will initiate early 2016.

CMIP6 Historical Simulation 实验中陆面过程的评估将在历史运行可用后立即开始。

The evaluation of land surface processes in CMIP6 Historical Simulation experiments will start as soon as historical runs are available.

将用 6 个月的预备期广泛征询气候模拟界的意见，以最终确定详细的实验设计。

A 6 month preliminary period will be dedicated to a wide consultation of the climate modeling community aiming at finalizing the detailed experiments design.

附录：离线强迫

Annex: the offline forcing

LMIP 的大气边界条件基于 20 世纪再分析（20CR）（Compo et al. 2011），仅同化地面气压，并使用观测的月海表温度与海冰分布。

The atmospheric boundary condition for LMIP is based on 20th Century Reanalysis (20CR) (Compo et al. 2011) assimilating only surface pressure and using observed monthly sea‐surface temperature and sea‐ice distribution.

20CR 天气变率的集合不确定性已经过评估，且这种不确定性随时间变化的观测网络而变化。

The ensemble uncertainty in the synoptic variability of 20CR has been evaluated, and this uncertainty varies with the time‐changing observation network.

发现位势高度（500 hPa）与气温（850 hPa）和独立的长序列（1905‐2006）高空数据具有高相关性。

High correlations for geopotential height (500 hPa) and air temperature (850 hPa) with an independent long record (1905‐2006) of upper‐air data are found.

尽管观测密度随时间和地点变化，基于探空数据的长期相关性与当今最先进的三天预报技巧相当。

Although observation density varies over time and location, the long‐term radiosonde based correlation is similar to the state‐of‐the‐art three days forecast skill.

谱松弛（spectral nudging）动力降尺度技术能有效地在更高空间分辨率上保留天气特征。

A spectral nudging dynamical downscaling technique effectively retains synoptic features in the higher spatial resolution.

使用观测的额外偏差订正带来了显著改进。

Additional bias corrections using observations introduce considerable improvements.

作为动力降尺度的进一步工作，已应用垂直阻尼（Hong and Chang 2012）与单集合成员订正（Yoshimura and Kanamitsu 2013）。

As further efforts putting into the dynamical downscaling, vertical damping (Hong and Chang 2012) and single ensemble member correction (Yoshimura and Kanamitsu 2013) have been applied.

图 A1 显示了强迫数据生成框架在每一步中相对于原始再分析的表现。

Figure A1 shows the performance of the forcing data generation framework in each step relative to the original reanalysis.

以 FLUXNET 中 20 个全球分布的原位观测站的日变率的位相与振幅作为参考。

Phase and amplitude of daily variability of 20 globally distributed in‐situ observation sites in FLUXNET are used as a reference.

尽管固有异质性导致与降水原位观测相比存在显著差异，许多变量（如长波与短波向下辐射、气温）表现出与观测相似的变率。

Although the intrinsic heterogeneity leads to significant differences comparing to in‐situ observations for precipitation, many variables (e.g., long‐ and short‐wave downward radiation and air temperature) show variability similar to the observations.

MIP 的目标与简要概述*

Goal of the MIP and a brief overview*

人类土地利用活动已导致地球表层生物地球化学和生物物理性质发生巨大变化，并由此对气候产生影响。

Human land-use activities have resulted in large changes to the biogeochemical and biophysical properties of the Earth surface, with resulting implications for climate.

在未来，土地利用活动可能进一步扩展和/或加剧，以满足日益增长的食物、纤维和能源需求。

In the future, land-use activities are likely to expand and/or intensify further to meet growing demands for food, fiber, and energy.

CMIP5 在研究土地利用对气候的影响方面取得了定性层面的科学进展，首次在耦合碳-气候模式预估中显式地计入全球格点化土地利用变化（过去—未来）的效应。

CMIP5 achieved a qualitative scientific advance in studying the effects of land-use on climate, for the first time explicitly accounting for the effects of global gridded land-use changes (past-future) in coupled carbon-climate model projections.

为促成这一进展，首个一致的格点化土地利用数据集（过去—未来）得以建立，将历史土地利用数据与来自综合评估模式的未来预估相衔接，并采用气候模式所需的标准格式。

Enabling this advance, the first consistent gridded land-use dataset (past-future) was developed, linking historical land-use data, to future projections from Integrated Assessment Models, in a standard format required by climate models.

结果表明，土地利用对气候的影响虽不确定，但其量级足够大且足够复杂，因此有必要围绕土地利用开展一项面向 CMIP6 的扩展活动。

Results indicate that the effects of land-use on climate, while uncertain, are sufficiently large and complex to warrant an expanded activity focused on land-use for CMIP6.

土地利用变化是地球系统的一种基本强迫，因此 LUMIP 与 CMIP6 问题 1“地球系统如何响应强迫？”直接相关且必不可少。

Land-use change is an essential forcing of the Earth System, and as such LUMIP is directly relevant and necessary for CMIP6 Question 1: "How does the Earth System respond to forcing?"

LUMIP 还将在应对 WCRP 大科学挑战方面发挥重要作用，特别是就“AIMES

LUMIP will also play a strong role in addressing the WCRP Grand Challenges, particularly with respect to the "AIMES

合作主题：生物圈强迫与反馈”而言。

theme for collaboration: biospheric forcings and feedbacks".

由于土地利用变化影响范围广泛、拟议的主要活动众多，LUMIP 对 CMIP6 科学问题 2 和 3 以及许多 WCRP 大科学挑战（包括气候极端事件、区域气候信息和水资源可利用性）也具有交叉相关性。

Due to the broad range of effects of land-use change and the major activities proposed, LUMIP is also of cross-cutting relevance to CMIP6 science questions 2 and 3, and to many of the WCRP Grand Challenges including Climate Extremes, Regional Climate Information, and Water Availability.

LUMIP 的目标是迈出下一步，促成、协调并最终回答与土地利用对气候的影响有关的最重要科学问题。

The goal of LUMIP is to take the next steps, and enable, coordinate, and ultimately address the most important science questions related to the effects of land-use on climate.

LUMIP 的主要科学问题是：

The primary science questions of LUMIP are:

• 土地利用和土地利用变化对气候和生物地球化学循环有什么影响（过去—未来）？ • 是否存在有望帮助减缓和/或适应气候变化的区域土地管理策略？ • 气候变化对土地利用和土地利用变化有什么影响？*

• What are the effects of land use and land-use change on climate and biogeochemical cycling (past-future)? • Are there regional land management strategies with promise to help mitigate and/or adapt to climate change? • What are the effects of climate change on land-use and land-use change? *

在回答这些问题的同时，LUMIP 还将回答一系列更细致的科学问题，以便比以往任何时候都更深入、更精细地为学界阐明过程层面的归因、不确定性、数据需求以及其他相关问题。

In addressing these questions, LUMIP will also address a range of more detailed science questions to get at process level attribution, uncertainty, data requirements, and other related issues in more depth and sophistication for the community than possible to date.

特别值得关注的是：区分并量化化石燃料排放与土地利用变化各自对气候的影响，区分生物地球化学效应与生物地球物理效应，区分土地覆被变化相对于土地管理变化的独特影响，以及陆气耦合强度对土地利用气候影响的调制作用。

Of particular focus will be the separation and quantification of the effects on climate from fossil fuel emissions and land-use change, biogeochemical from biogeophysical effects, the unique impact of land cover change versus land management change, and modulation of land use impact on climate by land-atmosphere coupling strength.

设想了三大类科学活动。

Three major sets of science activities are envisioned.

第一，将制定一套指标和诊断规程，用于量化模式在土地利用方面的表现及相关敏感性。

First, a set of metrics and diagnostic protocol will be developed to quantify model performance, and related sensitivities, with respect to land use.

作为这项活动的一部分，将确定基准数据产品，以帮助约束模式。

As part of this activity, benchmarking data products will be identified to help constrain models.

这些指标将被纳入国际陆面模式基准评估（ILAMB）系统。

These metrics will be incorporated into the International Land Model Benchmarking (ILAMB) system.

LUMIP 对基准评估/指标的强调与 CMIP 对指标日益增长的重视相契合。

This benchmarking/metrics emphasis in LUMIP dovetails with expanding emphasis in CMIP on metrics.

第二，数据标准化工作将借鉴 CMIP5 的经验教训和规程，并与新的历史数据、当前数据、IAM 和 ESM 合作，为 CMIP6 模式试验生成一套增强的标准化土地利用数据，在这些相关领域之间传递尽可能多的公共信息。

Second, data standardization efforts will build off the lessons learned and protocols in CMIP5, and work with new historical data, present data, IAMS, and ESMs to produce an enhanced standardized land-use data for CMIP6 model experiments passing the maximum amount of common information between these relevant domains.

新的输出数据标准化也将丰富并改进对模式试验结果的分析。

New output data standardization will also enrich and improve analysis of model experiment results.

特别强调的是在 CMIP6 中推动亚网格陆面信息的存档。

Particular emphasis is on promoting the archival of subgrid land information in CMIP6.

在大多数陆面模式中，物理、生态和生物地球化学的陆面状态变量与地表通量是针对若干不同的地表类型或土地管理“图块”（例如自然植被与次生植被、农作物、牧场、城市、湖泊、冰川）分别计算的。

In most land models, physical, ecological, and biogeochemical land state and surface flux variables are calculated separately for several different land surface type or land management 'tiles' (e.g., natural and secondary vegetation, crops, pasture, urban, lake, glacier).

通常（包括在 CMIP5 存档中），图块专属的量被取平均，仅报告格元平均值。

Frequently, including in the CMIP5 archive, the tile-specific quantities are averaged and only grid-cell mean values are reported.

因此，关于各地表类型如何响应气候变化和/或直接人为改造的大量有价值信息被丢失了。

Consequently, a large amount of valuable information is lost with respect to how each surface type responds to climate change and/or direct anthropogenic modifications.

LUMIP 正在起草一份提案，概述在多个陆面图块上存档选定关键变量的需求与规程（草案见附录 A）。

LUMIP is developing a proposal outlining the need and protocol for archival for selected key variables on multiple land tiles (see Appendix A for draft proposal).

第三，已设计了一套高效的模式试验方案，包括理想化情形和基于情景的情形，用于分离并量化土地利用效应。

Third, an efficient model experiment design including both idealized and scenario-based cases has been developed to isolate and quantify land-use effects.

这些试验（详见下文）既包括有、无瞬变土地利用的理想化模拟，也包括真实情景模拟。

These experiments, described in greater detail below, include both idealized and realistic scenario simulations with and without transient land use.

该试验规程支持对耦合陆面模式和离线陆面模式（以观测气象为强迫）进行综合分析，这将有助于理解和评估与土地利用相关的强迫响应和气候反馈，以及这些响应与陆面、大气模式偏差的关系。

The experimental protocol enables integrated analysis of coupled and offline land models (forced with observed meteorology) which will support understanding and assessment of the forced response and climate feedbacks associated with land-use and the relationship of these responses to land and atmosphere model biases.

* 注：用于回答这一问题的试验未包含在本提案中，因为据我们了解，目前几乎没有地球系统模式具备回答该问题的能力。

* Note that experiments to address this question are not included in this proposal because our understanding is that very few Earth System Models have the capability to address this question yet.

我们在 LUMIP 中保留这一问题，因为它是高优先级的土地利用变化科学问题，LUMIP 将通过各模式单独的努力加以推进，直到有足够多的模式具备进行双向气候—土地利用相互作用的能力。

We maintain this question within LUMIP because it is a high priority land use change science question that LUMIP will promote through individual model efforts until enough models have the capability to do two-way climate-land use interactions.

LUMIP 的优先事项和模式试验是与若干现有的模式比较活动和关注土地利用在气候中作用的研究计划密切协商制定的，这些活动和计划包括 LUCID、GSWP3、LUC4C、TRENDY 和 AgMIP。

LUMIP priorities and model experiments have been developed in close consultation with several existing model intercomparison activities and research programs that focus on the role of land use in climate including LUCID, GSWP3, LUC4C, TRENDY, and AgMIP.

此外，已开始并正在进行与其他拟议 CMIP MIP 的讨论，以确保我们所提议的试验相互补充而非重复。

In addition, discussions have begun and are ongoing with other proposed CMIP MIPs to ensure that our proposed experiments are complementary and not duplicative.

这些拟议的 MIP 包括 ScenarioMIP、AerChemMIP、C4MIP、LS3MIP、DAMIP 和 RFMIP。

These proposed MIPs include ScenarioMIP, AerChemMIP, C4MIP, LS3MIP, DAMIP, and RFMIP.

拟议试验概述*

An overview of the proposed experiments*

LUMIP 提出一个两阶段、分层级的模式试验计划。

LUMIP proposes a two phase, tiered, model experiment plan.

第一阶段（可尽快启动）将以理想化的耦合模式和陆面模式试验为特色，旨在改进过程理解、评估模式如何表征土地利用变化对气候的影响，并量化模式对潜在土地覆被和土地利用变化的敏感性。

Phase one, which can start soon, will feature idealized coupled and land-only model experiments designed to improve process understanding and assess how models represent the impact of changes in land use on climate, as well as to quantify model sensitivity to potential land cover and land use changes.

第二阶段试验将基于历史土地利用以及 ScenarioMIP 确定的真实情景。

Phase two experiments will be based on historical land use and realistic scenarios identified by ScenarioMIP.

第二阶段试验旨在分离历史及预估的未来土地利用变化对气候的作用。

Phase two experiments are designed to isolate the role of historical and projected future land-use changes on climate.

由于可能开展的试验数量超过了所有小组在可用资源下能够完成的量，试验按重要性分层排序。

As there are more possible experiments than are achievable with available resources by all groups, experiments are tiered in order of importance.

模式试验的细节如下。

Details of the model experiments are included below.

总请求量包括（全部为标准分辨率）：

The total request includes (all at standard resolution):

第 1 层级：GCM/ESM 520 年；仅陆面 165 年 第 2 层级：GCM/ESM 330 年；仅陆面 1650 年 第 3 层级：GCM/ESM 280 年；仅陆面 120 年

Tier 1: 520 years GCM/ESM; 165 years LND-only Tier 2: 330 years GCM/ESM; 1650 years LND-only Tier 3: 280 years GCM/ESM; 120 years LND-only

第一阶段试验概述

Overview of Phase 1 experiments

第一阶段包括两组试验（见表 1）。

Phase 1 consists of two sets of experiments (see Table 1).

第一组试验是理想化毁林试验，可在受控且一致的模拟集合中分析土地覆被变化引起的生物地球物理和生物地球化学响应以及相关的气候变化。

The first set of experiments are idealized deforestation experiments that enable analysis of the biogeophysical and biogeochemical response to land cover change and the associated changes in climate in a controlled and consistent set of simulations.

这一理想化毁林试验（指定面积的森林连续 50 年每年被移除）对土地利用变化模拟界而言是全新的，其设计在一定程度上与 DECK 中的 1% CO2 模拟类似/互补。

The idealized deforestation experiment in which as specified area of forest is removed each year for 50 years is new to the land use change modeling community and is designed to be somewhat analogous/complementary to the 1% CO2 simulations in the DECK.

该理想化毁林试验的优点是，在土地覆被变化方面更容易确保各模式间的一致性（不同模式对真实土地覆被变化的表征差异是一个长期困扰以往土地覆被变化模式比较计划（如 LUCID）的问题）。

This idealized deforestation experiment has the advantage that it will be easier to ensure conformity across models in terms of the land cover change (differences in the representation of realistic land cover changes across different models is a problem that has plagued prior land cover change model intercomparison projects, e.g. LUCID).

两个模拟中心正在开展理想化毁林试验的测试模拟。

Two modeling centers are conducting test idealized deforestation simulations.

另有区域毁林模拟（第 3 层级）正在 LUCID/LUC4C 项目内规划。

Additional regional deforestation simulations (Tier 3) are being planned within the LUCID/LUC4C projects.

这些区域试验的规程将由 LUCID 和 LUC4C 制定。

Protocols for these regional experiments will be developed by LUCID and LUC4C.

第一阶段的第二组试验是一系列离线纯陆面模拟，将建立在 LS3MIP 中提议的 LMIP 模拟之上。

The second set of Phase 1 experiments are a series of offline land-only simulations, which will build on the LMIP simulation proposed in LS3MIP.

该组试验旨在评估土地覆被变化的设定方式以及越来越全面的土地管理处理如何影响碳、水和能量循环对土地利用变化的响应。

This series of experiments is designed to assess how the specification of land cover change and increasingly comprehensive treatment of land management affects the carbon, water, and energy cycle response to land use change.

只有有限数量的模式能够执行全部试验，但试验设计将根据各模式的能力允许多层次的参与。

Only a limited number of models will be able to perform all the experiments, but the experimental design will allow for multiple levels of participation, according to each model's capabilities.

该组试验利用了若干已联系模拟中心预期的最先进模式发展成果，并将有助于为未来 CMIP 的土地利用设定优先事项。

This set of experiments utilizes state-of-the-art model developments anticipated across several contacted modeling centers and will contribute to the setting of priorities for land use for future CMIPs.

计划于 2015 年开展测试试验，以最终确定试验设计。

Test experiments are planned for 2015 to finalize the experimental design.

必须承认，所有观测历史强迫数据集都存在相当大的误差和不确定性，这些数据集中所表示的天气和气候趋势可能无法准确反映现实，尤其是在进入底层再分析或格点产品的数据非常有限的偏远地区。

It is critical to acknowledge that all observed historic forcing datasets are subject to considerable errors and uncertainty and that the weather and climate trends represented in these datasets may not accurately reflect reality, especially in remote regions where very limited data went into either the underlying reanalysis or the gridded products.

这些局限在将模式输出（例如潜热通量）与观测估计值比较时构成挑战，因为误差可能

These limitations pose a challenge when comparing the model outputs (like latent heat flux, for example) to observed estimates because errors may

实际上是强迫数据集误差的函数，而非模式本身的问题。

actually be a function of errors in the forcing dataset rather than the model.

GSWP3 数据集正在接受彻底的分析，其优势与局限（特别是趋势方面）将在一篇或多篇论文中予以记录。

The GSWP3 dataset is being put through a thorough analysis and its strengths and limitations, especially with respect to trends, will be documented in one or more papers.

LUMIP 与 LS3MIP 正在共同考虑，是否有价值请求使用额外的强迫数据集开展试验（另有若干世纪尺度的数据集可用），以便评估强迫不确定性。

LUMIP, in conjunction with LS3MIP, are considering whether or not there is value in requesting runs with an additional forcing dataset (several others century-scale are available) to enable an assessment of forcing uncertainty.

额外的离线试验可能给模拟中心带来过重负担，因此若纳入，将放在第 3 层级，面向有兴趣探究强迫不确定性问题的团队。

Additional offline runs could be an excessive burden on modeling centers so if this is included, it would be in Tier 3, aimed at groups that are interested in pursuing the forcing uncertainty question.

无论不确定性如何，纳入所有模式均以同一历史气候强迫的纯陆面试验都具有重要价值，因为这能够在各模式之间对模拟的陆面对气候变化和/或土地利用变化的响应进行清晰得多的比较。

Irrespective of the uncertainties, there is strong value in the inclusion of land-only experiments in which all models are forced with the same historical climate since it enables much cleaner comparison across models of the simulated land response to climate change and/or land use change.

第二阶段试验概述

Overview of Phase 2 experiments

第二阶段试验建立在 CMIP6 Historical 模拟、历史 LMIP 模拟以及 ScenarioMIP 模拟的基础之上。

The Phase 2 experiments build off of the CMIP6 Historical and historical LMIP simulations as well as the ScenarioMIP simulations.

它们将包括土地利用保持不变或改用替代土地利用情景的纯陆面及耦合的历史和未来模拟（表 2）。

They will include land-only and coupled historical and future simulations with land use held constant or modified to an alternative land use scenario (Table 2).

这些模拟将用于从生物地球物理和生物地球化学影响两方面评估土地利用对气候的作用，并将受到检测与归因 MIP 的关注。

These simulations will be used to assess the role of land use on climate from the perspective of both the biogeophysical and biogeochemical impacts and will be of interest to the Detection and Attribution MIP.

特定模式配置的科学优势：

Scientific advantages for particular model configuration:

• 浓度驱动模拟可聚焦于对气候的生物地球物理影响，并有助于确定在何时/何地可将土地管理用作区域气候减缓工具。

• Concentration-driven simulations allow focus on biogeophysical impacts on climate and help establish when/where land management could be used as a regional climate mitigation tool.

• 排放驱动模拟可评估对气候的完整反馈，并评估 IAM 关于土地利用和土地利用变化碳通量的预测是否与 ESM 模拟的土地利用排放一致。

• Emission-driven simulations allow assessment of the full feedback onto climate and assess whether or not IAM predictions about land use and land use change carbon fluxes are consistent with ESM modeled land use emissions.

• 在浓度驱动情景中纳入低和中等/高辐射强迫情景下的试验，可以考察土地利用变化的影响在气候变化的不同水平以及 CO2 施肥效应的不同水平下有何差异。

• Including experiments in low and medium/high radiative forcing scenarios in concentrationdriven scenarios allows examination of how the impact of land use change differs at different levels of climate change and at different levels of CO2 fertilization.

因此，在预估时段，LUMIP 为高、低辐射强迫情景各增加一个模拟：采用来自不同 SSP-RCP 配置的土地利用（土地利用差异显著），但其他所有强迫与原始 ScenarioMIP 模拟保持一致（例如，ScenarioMIP SSP3-7 包含强烈毁林；LUMIP 试验将是 SSP3-7，但采用 SSP1-2.6 的土地利用，即造林情景）。

Consequently, for the projection period, LUMIP includes an additional simulation for both a high and a low radiative forcing scenario with land use from a different SSP-RCP configuration with strongly different land use but with all other forcings remaining the same as in the original ScenarioMIP simulation (e.g., ScenarioMIP SSP3-7 includes strong deforestation; LUMIP experiment will be SSP3-7 but with SSP1-2.6 land use, which is afforestation scenario).

请注意，这些模拟应视为敏感性模拟，因为它们包含一套彼此不一致的强迫（例如，在一个其他方面均等同于 SSP3-7 的模拟中使用 SSP1-2.6 的土地利用）。

Note that these simulations should be considered sensitivity simulations since they will include a set of forcings that are inconsistent with each other (e.g., land use from SSP1-2.6 in a simulation that in all other respects is equivalent to SSP3-7).

CMIP DECK 与 CMIP6 试验拟议评估/分析概述*

An overview of the proposed evaluation/analysis of the CMIP DECK and CMIP6 experiments*

目标是建立一套有用的模式诊断，以便系统评估土地利用—气候反馈，并在产生这些反馈的过程中改进对陆面和大气各自作用的归因。

The goal is to establish a useful set of model diagnostics that enable a systematic assessment of land use-climate feedbacks and improved attribution of the roles of both land and atmosphere in terms of generating these feedbacks.

需要对陆面和大气对土地覆被变化的响应进行更系统的评估，这是 LUCID 研究的主要结论之一。

The need for more systematic assessment of the terrestrial and atmospheric response to land cover change is one of the major conclusions of the LUCID study.

Boisier 等（2012）和 de Noblet-Ducoudré 等（2012）指出，LUCID 各模式所展示的土地利用—气候关系各不相同，这凸显了改进陆面模式评估诊断的必要性。

Boisier et al. (2012) and de Noblet-Ducoudré et al. (2012) argue that the different land use-climate relationships displayed across the LUCID models highlights the need to improve diagnostics for land surface model evaluation.

这些分析需要评估陆面模式在非耦合（离线）模拟中对土地覆被扰动的响应，以及陆面与大气分量之间的耦合。

These analyses need to assess how land surface models respond to a landcover perturbation in uncoupled (off-line) simulations as well as coupling between land and atmosphere components.

此前未得到细致研究的一个分析维度是：某个模式特有的区域陆气耦合强度特征如何影响该模式模拟土地利用变化对气候的影响。

One axis of analysis that has previously not been investigated in great detail is how a particular model's regional land-atmosphere coupling strength signature affects how the model simulates the impact of land use change on climate.

就此，LUMIP 将与 LS3MIP 对接，研究陆气耦合强度与土地利用变化对天气和气候影响之间的交叉关系。

Here, LUMIP will interface with LS3MIP to investigate the cross-relationship between land-atmosphere coupling strength and landuse change impacts on weather and climate.

此外，LUMIP 将推动基于观测的土地利用变化生物地球物理和生物地球化学指标的开发，这些指标将有助于约束模式动力学，并与 CMIP 对指标日益增长的重视相契合。

In addition, LUMIP will promote the development of biogeophysical and biogeochemical metrics of land use change, based on observations, that will help constrain model dynamics and dovetails with expanding emphasis in CMIP on metrics.

任何有用的指标都将被纳入正在开发中的国际陆面模式基准评估（ILAMB）软件包。

Any useful metrics will be integrated into the International Land Model Benchmarking (ILAMB) package that is currently under development.

同时具备纯陆面和耦合的历史模拟，使得能够对陆面和大气在模拟的土地利用变化响应中的作用进行系统得多的评估。

The availability of both land-only and coupled historic simulations enables a much more systematic assessment of the roles of land and atmosphere in the simulated response to land use change.

LUMIP 还提议开发一套指标，用于量化模式在一系列空间尺度和时间尺度上对土地利用的响应，进而可用于定量比较不同模式、不同区域和不同土地管理情景之间的模式响应。

LUMIP also proposes to develop a set of metrics that quantify a model response to land use across a range of spatial scales and temporal scales that can then be used to quantitatively compare model response across different models, regions, and land management scenarios.

对于给定变量（例如地表气温），诊断计算将针对一对有、无土地利用变化的模拟（离线或耦合）进行。

For a given variable, say surface air temperature, the diagnostic calculations will be completed for a pair of simulations (offline or coupled) with and without land use change.

在一系列空间尺度上——从单个格元直至区域（5°×5° 和 10°×10°）、大陆乃至全球——

Across a range of spatial scales, spanning from a single grid cell up to regional (5o by 5o and 10o by 10o) to continental to global,

将考察控制模拟与土地利用变化模拟之间的季节平均差异。

seasonal mean differences between control and land use change simulations will be examined.

差异将以两种方式表达：季节平均差异（及其基于 student-t 检验的统计显著性）和信噪比（其中“噪声”指模式中模拟的自然年际气候变率）。

Differences will be expressed both in terms of seasonal mean differences (and their statistical significance based on student-t tests) and in terms of signal to noise (where 'noise' refers to the natural interannual climate variability simulated in the model).

对极端事件的影响（如 Davin 等，2014）将受到特别关注。

Effects on extremes (e.g. Davin et al. 2014) will receive particular attention.

分析可聚焦于关键区域，例如美国中部的集约农业区和亚马逊的毁林区，对每个区域从点尺度向大陆尺度逐级扩展。

Analysis could focus on critical regions, such as the intensive agricultural region in the central United States and the deforestation region in the Amazon, telescoping out from point to continental scale for each region.

将考虑五个主要变量（净辐射、蒸散、温度、降水和陆面碳储量），它们共同表征土地利用对气候的生物地球物理和生物地球化学影响。

Five primary variables will be considered (net radiation, evapotranspiration, temperature, precipitation, and land carbon stocks) that together characterize the biogeophysical and biogeochemical impacts of land use on climate.

前两个变量——净辐射和蒸散（ET）——定义了地表对土地利用变化的生物地球物理响应，将在离线和耦合模式两种框架下进行评估。

The first two variables, net radiation and evapotranspiration (ET) define the surface biogeophysical response to land use change and will be evaluated in both offline and coupled model contexts.

温度和降水对净辐射与 ET 生物地球物理变化的响应将仅在陆气模拟中进行评估。

The temperature and precipitation response to biogeophysical changes in net radiation and ET will be evaluated in land-atmosphere simulations only.

陆面碳储量可在离线和耦合模拟中进行评估。

Land carbon stocks can be evaluated in offline and coupled simulations.

在该框架内可以开展若干条与评估土地利用—气候效应（相对于自然变率和温室气体引起的气候变化）相关的分析路线。

There are several axes of analysis that can be performed within this framework that are relevant to assessing land use-climate effects relative to natural variability and greenhouse gas-induced climate change.

例如，通过改变分析中所包含的年数和/或集合成员数，可以确定在何种时间/空间尺度上能够检测到土地利用变化信号。

For instance, by varying the number of years and/or the number of ensemble members included in our analysis, one can establish over what time/spatial scale a land use change signal can be detected.

还可以研究：与例如时间切片陆气模拟相比，在含人为温室气体强迫的瞬变气候模拟中分离土地利用—气候信号的相对难度。

One can also investigate the relative difficulty in isolating a land use-climate signal in transient climate simulations with anthropogenic greenhouse gas forcing versus, for example, timeslice atmosphere-land simulations.

附录 A：CMIP6 选定陆面输出的亚网格存档

Appendix A: Sub-grid archiving of selected land output for CMIP6

联合任务负责人：Elena Shevliakova 和 David Lawrence

Co Task Leads: Elena Shevliakova and David Lawrence

注：详细的亚网格存档规程（包括模式应如何处理“边缘情况”的说明，例如若某模式不表示某种土地利用图块该怎么办）正在制定中，并将在各模拟中心之间传阅。

Note: A detailed protocol for sub-grid archiving, including instructions about how models should deal with 'edge cases' (e.g., what if a model doesn't represent one of the land use tiles) is being developed and will be circulated among the modeling centers.

最终规程将收录在 GMD 特刊论文中，并将在 LUMIP 网站上发布。

A final protocol will be included in the GMD special issue paper and will also be posted on the LUMIP website.

1. 动机

1. Motivation

大多数 CMIP5 级别的气候模式和地球系统模式（ESM）通过将每个陆面格元划分为具有相似生态、生物地球化学和水文特征的分区（即图块或单元）来表示陆面亚网格空间异质性。

The majority of CMIP5-class climate models and Earth system models (ESMs) represent land sub-grid spatial heterogeneity by splitting each land grid into sections (i.e. tiles or units) with similar ecological, biogeochemical, and hydrological characteristics.

当前陆面分量捕捉两类亚网格异质性：1）水文类——被液态或冻结水覆盖的陆面（如湖泊、湿地、冰川）或未被覆盖的陆面（如裸地和植被地表）；2）土地利用和土地管理引起的异质性（如农田、牧场、城市、自然与次生植被，即采伐林、人工林、弃耕地）。

Current land components capture two kinds of sub-grid heterogeneity: 1) hydrological - land surfaces covered by liquid or frozen water (e.g. lakes, wetlands, glaciers) or not (e.g. bare and vegetated surfaces) and 2) land-use and land management induced (e.g. cropland, pastures, urban, natural and secondary, i.e., harvested forests, plantations, abandoned land).

亚网格分块既适用于陆面分量的地上部分，也适用于地下部分。

Sub-grid tiling applies to both above- and below-ground sections of the land components.

物理、生态和生物地球化学的陆面状态变量与地表通量按每个图块分别计算。

Physical, ecological, and biogeochemical land state variables and surface fluxes are calculated separately for each tile.

然而，通常（包括在 CMIP5 存档中），

However, frequently, including in the CMIP5 archive,

图块专属变量被取平均，只报告格元平均值。

the tile-specific variables were averaged and the grid-cell mean values were reported.

因此，关于具有不同水文和土地利用属性的各地表类型如何响应气候变化和/或直接人为改造的大量有价值信息被丢失了。

Consequently, a large amount of valuable information was lost with respect to how each surface type with different hydrological and land-use properties responds to climate change and/or direct anthropogenic modifications.

为了更好地表征地表气候及其变率和变化，我们提议扩展 CMOR 数据约定，以捕捉水平方向的陆面亚网格异质性。

In order to better characterize surface climate, its variability and change, we propose to expand the CMOR data convention in order to capture horizontal land sub-grid heterogeneity.

除陆面格元值外，我们还提议请求在多个陆面图块上提供选定变量的子集。

In addition to the land-grid cell values, we propose to request a subset of selected variables on multiple land tiles.

这一报告与存档方式的修改将显著扩展地球系统模式输出在科学分析和气候变化影响研究中的用途。

This reporting and archiving modification will significantly expand the utility of Earth System Model output for scientific analysis and climate change impacts studies.

每个陆面模式都有独特的图块划分方案，因此存档规程需要足够通用，以适应现有各种模式结构。

Each land model has a unique tiling scheme so the archiving protocol needs to be general enough to work for the range of existing model structures.

2. 拟议的亚网格报告方案

2. Proposed sub-grid reporting

2.1 图块类型

2.1 Types of tiles

在 CMIP6 框架下，我们提议为 4 个类别的子集报告图块专属信息，以捕捉土地利用引起的地表异质性：（1）自然与次生土地类型（包括裸地和植被湿地），（2）牧场，（3）农田，以及（4）城市。

In the context of CMIP6 we propose to report tile-specific information for a subset of 4 categories to capture land-use induced surface heterogeneity: (1) Natural and Secondary land types (including bare ground and vegetated wetlands), (2) pasture-land, (3) croplands, and (4) urban.

其余图块（如湖泊、河流和冰川）将被排除在所报告的图块专属数值之外。

The remaining tiles, such as lakes, rivers and glaciers, will be excluded from the reported tile-specific values.

拟议的土地利用图块报告单元集合与 CMIP6 历史土地利用重建和未来情景中将使用的土地利用单元高度对应。

The proposed set of land-use tile reporting units closely corresponds to land-use units to be used in the CMIP6 historical land-use reconstructions and future scenarios.

原始植被（即从未受 LULCC 活动影响的自然植被）与次生植被（即先前被采伐过的或建立在弃耕农地上的自然植被）被合并，因为大多数陆面模式尚不能区分这两类土地类型。

Primary (i.e., natural vegetation never affected by LULCC activity) and secondary vegetation (i.e., natural vegetation that has previously been harvested or establishes on abandoned agricultural lands) are combined because most land models do not yet distinguish between these two land types.

Tile-type table note (bilingual): reconstruction of the page-187 tile type / suffix / comment table; text cells translated, suffixes kept as in the original.

对于选定的关键变量，除格元平均值外，还请求为每个图块分别提供数据。

For selected key variables, data is requested for each tile separately, in addition to the grid cell mean.

包含生物地球化学信息的图块将报告最多四类生物地球化学示踪物储量（如碳、氮）——植被、土壤、凋落物和人为储存。

The tiles containing biogeochemical information will report up to four stocks of biogeochemical tracers (e.g. Carbon, Nitrogen) – vegetation, soil, litter, and anthropogenic storage.

后者仅在一部分陆面模式中使用，反映了这样一个事实：部分采伐的碳不会立即释放到大气中，而是延迟一年到百年不等（如木制品、食物）。

The latter is used in a subset of land models and reflects the fact that some harvested carbon is not released into the atmosphere immediately, but rather with some time-delay from a year to century (e.g., wood products, food)

2.2 按图块报告的变量

2.2 Variables reported by tile

亚网格图块变量应按以下结构提交，以叶面积指数（LAI）为例：

Subgrid tile variables should be submitted according to the following structure, using Leaf Area Index (LAI) as an example:

laiLut(lon, lat, time, landusetype4)

laiLut(lon, lat, time, landusetype4)

landusetype4 维度的顺序为 spl、crp、pst、urb，其中“spl”=次生与原始土地，“crp”=农田，“pst”=牧场，“urb”=城市。

landusetype4 dimension with the order spl, crp, pst, urb where "spl" = secondary and primary land, "crp" = cropland, "pst" = pastureland, and "urb" = urban.

图块变量报告的注意事项：对于含湖泊或冰川的格元，urb+spl+crp+pst 的面积比例之和可能不等于 1。

Notes for tiled variable reporting: Sum of fractional area for urb+spl+crp+pst may not add up to 1 for grid cells with lakes or glaciers.

若某模式不表示所请求的图块之一，则应报告为缺失值。

If a model does not represent one of the requested tiles, then it should be reported as missing value.

当一个以上土地利用图块共享信息时（例如，若牧场和农田共享同一土壤柱），则应为两个图块都提供重复信息。

In cases where more than one land use tile shares information (e.g., if pastureland and cropland share same soil column), then duplicate information should be provided for both tiles.

关于图块报告的更多细节将收录在 LUMIP 的 GMD 论文中。

Further details on tile reporting will be included in the LUMIP GMD paper.

请求的变量集合有限（见 LUMIP 数据请求电子表格），包括描述（a）亚网格结构及其随时间演变、（b）生物地球化学通量、（c）生物地球物理变量、（d）LULCC 碳转移以及（e）土地利用图块碳储量的变量。

A limited set of variables are requested (see LUMIP data request spreadsheet) including variables that describe (a) the subgrid structure and how it evolves through time, (b) biogeochemical fluxes, (c) biogeophysical variables, and (d) LULCC carbon transfers, and (e) carbon stocks on land use tiles.

我们认识到，各模式对 LU 过程的实现差异很大，可能只能报告变量的一个子集。

We recognize that models have very different implementation of LU processes and may only be able to report a subset of variables.
