协调 CMIP6 海洋分析并提供海洋/海冰比较

Coordinating CMIP6 ocean analyses & providing an ocean/sea‐ice comparison

OMIP 为评估、理解并改进参与 CMIP6 的气候与地球系统模式中的海洋/海冰/示踪物/生物地球化学分量提供了一个框架。

OMIP provides a framework for evaluating, understanding, and improving ocean/sea‐ice/tracer/biogeochemical components of climate and earth system models contributing to CMIP6.

OMIP 通过两种相互关联的方式来实现这一目标。

OMIP addresses this goal in two related manners.

1. 海洋诊断：OMIP 为所有包含海洋分量的 CMIP6 模拟协调 CMIP6 海洋诊断（包括海洋物理、惰性化学示踪物和生物地球化学）。

1. Ocean Diagnostics: OMIP coordinates CMIP6 ocean diagnostics (including ocean physics, inert chemical tracers, and biogeochemistry) for all CMIP6 simulations that include an ocean component.

此类使用海洋分量的 CMIP6 模拟包括但不限于 CMIP6/DECK、CMIP6/historical、CMIP6/OMIP 海洋/海冰、CMIP6/C4MIP 和 CMIP6/FAFMIP 扰动模拟。

Such CMIP6 simulations using an ocean component include, but are not limited to, the CMIP6/DECK, CMIP6/historical, CMIP6/OMIP ocean/sea ice, CMIP6/C4MIP, and CMIP6/FAFMIP perturbation simulations.

2. 全球海洋/海冰模拟：OMIP 为两个使用共同大气数据集的强迫全球海洋/海冰模拟（一个 Tier 1 和一个 Tier 2）提供了协议。

2. Global Ocean/sea‐ice Simulation: OMIP provides a protocol for two global ocean/sea‐ice simulations forced with common atmospheric data sets (one Tier 1 and one Tier 2).

OMIP 海洋/海冰模拟包含物理、惰性化学和生物地球化学示踪物分量。

The OMIP ocean/sea‐ice simulations include physical, inert chemical, and biogeochemical tracer components.

OMIP 为以下类型的研究提供框架：

OMIP provides a framework for the following types of studies:

1. 研究驱动季节、年际和年代际变率的物理、化学和生物地球化学机制；

1. To investigate physical, chemical, and biogeochemical mechanisms that drive seasonal, inter‐annual, and decadal variability;

2. 将海洋-气候变化归因于边界强迫或自然变率；

2. To attribute ocean‐climate variations to boundary forced versus natural;

3. 评估各种机制在不同模式和强迫数据集之间的稳健性；

3. To evaluate robustness of mechanisms across models and forcing data sets;

4. 通过补充来自数据同化的海洋再分析，在观测与模拟之间架起桥梁；

4. To bridge observations and modeling by complementing ocean reanalysis from data assimilation;

5. 提供可用于气候（如年代际）预测初始化的、一致的海洋和海冰状态。

5. To provide consistent ocean and sea‐ice states useful for initialization of climate (e.g., decadal) predictions.

合并 OMIP 与 OCMIP

Merging OMIP and OCMIP

为回应 WGCM 于 2015 年 2 月 18 日提出的意见，本更新版 OMIP 提案与先前独立的 OCMIP（海洋碳模式比较计划）合并。

In response to the WGCM comments provided 18 Feb 2015, this updated OMIP proposal merges with the previously separate OCMIP (Ocean Carbon Model Inter‐comparison Project).

CMIP6 将不再有单独的 OCMIP 提案。

There is no longer a separate OCMIP proposal for CMIP6.

将海洋物理、化学和生物地球化学工作合并为 OMIP 这一个项目，使得参与 CMIP6 的海洋物理、化学和生物地球化学各团体之间能够高效沟通。

The merger of ocean physical, chemical, and biogeochemical efforts into a single project, OMIP, allows for efficient communication across ocean physical, chemical, and biogeochemical groups participating in CMIP6.

因此，本文件中使用的名称"OMIP"指的是 CMIP6 模拟中的海洋物理、化学和生物地球化学方面。

Hence, the name “OMIP” used in this document refers to the ocean physical, chemical, and biogeochemical aspects of CMIP6 simulations.

I. OMIP：CMIP6 海洋分量的诊断分析

I. OMIP: Diagnostic analysis of CMIP6 ocean components

CMIP6/OMIP 的第一个职责是为所有涉及海洋分量的 CMIP6 试验协调诊断分析。

The first role for CMIP6/OMIP is to coordinate diagnostic analysis for all CMIP6 experiments that involve an ocean component.

作为该职责的一部分，CLIVAR OMDP 及合作者编写了一份 CMIP6 海洋模式诊断文档（Griffies et al. 2015），该文档建立在早前的 CMIP5 文档（Griffies et al. 2009）基础之上。

As part of this role, CLIVAR OMDP and collaborators produced a CMIP6 ocean model diagnostic document (Griffies et al. 2015), which built from the earlier CMIP5 document (Griffies et al. 2009).

Griffies et al (2015) 文档（在本提案中作为 CMIP6_OMIP_physics_diagnostics.pdf 提交）对包含海洋分量的所有 CMIP6 模拟中需要采样的海洋物理场提出了建议和科学依据。

The Griffies et al (2015) document (submitted in this proposal as CMIP6_OMIP_physics_diagnostics.pdf) presents recommendations and scientific justifications for sampling physical ocean fields included as part of all CMIP6 simulations that include an ocean component.

2（原书页码）

2

此外，我们制作了三份诊断电子表格，也随本 OMIP 提案一并提交。

In addition, we have produced three diagnostic spreadsheets, also submitted with this OMIP proposal.

这些电子表格列出了需要从包含海洋分量的 CMIP6 试验中保存的海洋诊断量。

These spreadsheets list ocean diagnostics to be saved from CMIP6 experiments that include an ocean component.

每份电子表格均以海洋领域最新的 CMIP5 版本为起点。

Each spreadsheet started from the most recent CMIP5 version for the ocean.

对 OMIP 电子表格中的条目进行了编辑，以删除过时的诊断量、在需要之处澄清早前的 CMIP5 诊断量，并添加新的诊断量。

Entries to the OMIP spreadsheets were edited to remove obsolete diagnostics, to clarify earlier CMIP5 diagnostics where needed, and to add new diagnostics.

1. 海洋物理（CMIP6_OMIP_physics_standard_output.xls）：第一份电子表格基于 Griffies et al (2015) 详述的诊断量，该文档侧重于物理海洋诊断量。

1. Ocean physics (CMIP6_OMIP_physics_standard_output.xls): The first spreadsheet is based on the diagnostics detailed in Griffies et al (2015), which focuses on physical ocean diagnostics.

这些诊断量应为所有在包含海洋分量的任何 CMIP6 试验中运行的海洋模式保存。

These diagnostics should be saved for all ocean models run as part of any CMIP6 experiment where an ocean component is included.

2. 海洋惰性化学（CMIP6_OMIP_chemistry_standard_output.xls）：CMIP6/historical、CMIP6/OMIP-A 和 CMIP6/OMIP-B 模拟要求输出三种惰性化学物质，即 CFC11、CFC12 和 SF6。

2. Ocean inert chemistry (CMIP6_OMIP_chemistry_standard_output.xls): Three inert chemical species, CFC11, CFC12, and SF6, are requested for CMIP6/historical, CMIP6/OMIP‐A, and CMIP6/OMIP‐B simulations.

这些示踪物建立在 OCMIP 以往各阶段的基础之上，最近的一次是在 CMIP5 期间开展的工作。

These tracers build on past phases of OCMIP, most recently efforts undertaken during CMIP5.

它们通过与观测数据库的比较，有助于评估海洋模拟的各要素。

They help in evaluating elements of the ocean simulation through comparisons with the observational databases.

3. 海洋生物地球化学（CMIP6_OMIP_biogeochemistry_standard_output.xlsx）：所有涉及综合地球系统模式的 CMIP6 试验，以及本文档所述 CMIP6/OMIP-A 和 CMIP6/OMIP-B 试验，都应保存海洋生物地球化学诊断量。

3. Ocean biogeochemistry (CMIP6_OMIP_biogeochemistry_standard_output.xlsx): Ocean biogeochemical diagnostics should be saved from all CMIP6 experiments involving comprehensive earth system models, as well as the CMIP6/OMIP‐A and CMIP6/OMIP‐B experiments described in this document.

将对 CMIP6 的海洋生物地球化学分量进行评估和比较，其中部分重点放在评估改用更细网格间距所带来的收益上。

The ocean biogeochemical components of CMIP6 will be evaluated and compared, with some emphasis placed on assessing what is gained by moving to finer grid spacing.

此外，将比较使用相同 CMIP6 海洋生物地球化学模式的耦合模拟与强迫模拟，以评估平均状态和内部变率有何差异。

In addition, coupled and forced simulations with the same CMIP6 ocean biogeochemical models will be compared to assess how mean state and internal variability differ.

这些诊断电子表格的并集代表了经由 OMIP 协调的 CMIP6 海洋相关诊断量的完整体系。

The union of these diagnostic spreadsheets represents the full suite of CMIP6 ocean related diagnostics as coordinated through OMIP.

II. OMIP：为相互比较提供海洋/海冰模拟

II. OMIP: Providing ocean/sea‐ice simulations for inter‐comparison

OMIP 项目的第二部分包括一个 Tier 1（OMIP-A）和一个 Tier 2（OMIP-B）强迫全球海洋/海冰模拟。

The second portion of the OMIP project consists of one Tier 1 (OMIP‐A) and one Tier 2 (OMIP‐B) forced global ocean/sea ice simulation.

本节详述这两个模拟的相关方面。

Aspects of these two simulations are detailed in this section.

OMIP 的物理分量基于 CORE-II

The physical component of OMIP is based on CORE‐II

OMIP 海洋/海冰模拟的物理分量遵循 Griffies et al. (2012) 的强迫协议，该协议曾用于协调海洋-海冰参照试验（CORE）年际变化模拟（CORE-II）。

The physical component of the OMIP ocean/sea ice simulation follows the forcing protocol of Griffies et al. (2012), which has been used for the Coordinated Ocean‐ice Reference Experiments (CORE) inter‐annually varying simulation (CORE‐II).

• CORE-II 模拟使用 Large and Yeager (2009) 汇编的大气数据集来强迫物理海洋场。

CORE‐II simulations use atmospheric data sets compiled by Large and Yeager (2009) to force physical ocean fields.

• CORE-II 强迫覆盖 1948-2009 年共 62 年的时段。

CORE‐II forcing covers the 62‐year period from 1948‐2009.

• CORE-II 大气强迫数据集由美国国家大气研究中心（NCAR）和 NOAA 地球物理流体动力学实验室（NOAA/GFDL）共同支持。

CORE‐II atmospheric forcing data sets are collaboratively supported by the U.S. National Center for Atmospheric Research (NCAR) and the NOAA Geophysical Fluid Dynamics Laboratory (NOAA/GFDL).

• 所有数据集、块体通量公式代码、技术报告和其他支持代码以及发布说明均可在 http://www.clivar.org/clivar‐panels/omdp/core‐2 获取。

All data sets, codes for the bulk flux formulae, technical report, and other support codes along with the release notes are available at http://www.clivar.org/clivar‐panels/omdp/core‐2

3（原书页码）

3

• CORE-II 研究由 WCRP 气候变率与可预报性（CLIVAR）海洋模式发展工作组（OMDP）协调（OMDP 的前身是海洋模式发展工作组 WGOMD）。

CORE‐II studies are coordinated by the WCRP Climate Variability and Predictability (CLIVAR) Ocean Model Development Panel (OMDP) (OMDP was formerly known as the Working Group on Ocean Model Development, WGOMD).

已有 20 多个国际海洋与气候模拟团体开展了 CORE-II 后报模拟。

More than 20 international ocean and climate modelling groups have performed CORE‐II hindcast simulations.

这些模拟正在约十个独立研究中进行分析，每个研究聚焦海洋气候系统的某一特定方面。

The simulations are being analyzed in roughly ten separate studies, each focusing on a specific aspect of the ocean climate system.

例如，包括以北大西洋经向翻转环流为重点的北大西洋平均状态分析（Danabasoglu et al., 2014），以及对全球和区域海平面变化的评估（Griffies et al., 2014）。

Examples include analysis of mean states in the North Atlantic with a focus on the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (Danabasoglu et al., 2014) and an assessment of global and regional sea level changes (Griffies et al., 2014).

记录更多 CORE-II 研究的论文将于 2015 年期间发表在期刊《Ocean Modelling》的特刊上。

Manuscripts documenting further CORE‐II studies will be published during 2015 in a special issue of the journal Ocean Modelling.

OMIP 的惰性化学示踪物分量基于 OCMIP2

The inert chemical tracer component of OMIP is based on OCMIP2

OMIP 的化学分量包括在线模拟 CFC11、CFC12 和 SF6。

The chemical component of OMIP includes the simulation of CFC11, CFC12, and SF6 online.

CFC11 为高优先级（level=1），而 CFC12 和 SF6 为 level=2 优先级。

CFC11 is high priority (level=1), whereas CFC12 and SF6 are level=2 priority.

模拟协议基于 OCMIP2 协议，可在 http://ocmip5.ipsl.jussieu.fr/OCMIP/phase2/simulations/CFC/HOWTO‐CFC.html 获取。

Simulation protocols are based on the OCMIP2 protocol available at http://ocmip5.ipsl.jussieu.fr/OCMIP/phase2/simulations/CFC/HOWTO‐CFC.html

SF6 模拟与 CFC 模拟完全相同，只是其大气历史、溶解度和 Schmidt 数不同。

The SF6 simulation is identical to the CFC simulations, except that its atmospheric history, solubility, and Schmidt number differ.

这些惰性被动示踪物与物理示踪物温度、盐度一起在线计算，且独立于生物地球化学模式。

These inert passive‐tracers are computed online along with the physical tracers temperature and salinity, and they are independent of the biogeochemical model.

CMIP6/historical 和 CMIP6/OMIP 模拟应包含这些物种。

These species should be included for the CMIP6/historical and CMIP6/OMIP simulations.

OMIP 的生物地球化学分量基于 OCMIP3

The biogeochemical component of OMIP is based on OCMIP3

OCMIP3 的详情可在 http://ocmip5.ipsl.jussieu.fr/OCMIP/phase3/simulations/NOCES/HOWTO‐NOCES.html 获取。

Details of OCMIP3 are available at http://ocmip5.ipsl.jussieu.fr/OCMIP/phase3/simulations/NOCES/HOWTO‐NOCES.html

每个团体将使用各自的预报型海洋生物地球化学模式，在线耦合到其物理海洋分量。

Each group will use its own prognostic ocean biogeochemical model, coupled online to its physical ocean component.

每个物理-生物地球化学模拟将如上所述用 CORE-II 大气状态强迫，如可能则覆盖五个强迫循环的全部 310 年。

Each physical‐biogeochemical simulation will be forced as described above with the CORE‐II atmospheric state, if possible over the full 310 years of the five forcing cycles.

• 大气的边界条件包括施加恒定的大气 O2 浓度（摩尔分数 0.20946），以及遵循观测变化的大气 CO2。

Boundary conditions for the atmosphere include an imposed constant atmospheric concentration of O2 (mole fraction of 0.20946), but a variable atmospheric CO2 that follows observations.

• 模式将添加两个示踪物，用于大气 CO2 固定为 278 ppm 的平行前工业世界。

Models will add two tracers for a parallel preindustrial world where atmospheric CO2 is fixed at 278 ppm.

因此，生物地球化学模式将包含第二个溶解无机碳（DIC）示踪物和第二个总碱度示踪物（ALK），以隔离自然 CO2 并跟踪模式漂移。

Thus biogeochemical models will include a second dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC) tracer and a second total alkalinity tracer (ALK) in order to isolate natural CO2 and keep track of model drift.

• 所有模式将使用可获得的生物地球化学场气候态进行初始化；氧以及总溶解无机氮、磷和硅的初始化将依赖世界海洋图集（World Ocean Atlas (2013)）。

All models will be initialized with available climatologies for biogeochemical fields for oxygen as well as total dissolved inorganic nitrogen, phosphorus, and silica will rely on the World Ocean Atlas (2013).

4（原书页码）

4

• DIC 和 ALK 场将从 GLODAPv2 网格化数据（基于 WOCE 和 CLIVAR 期间的离散观测）初始化。

The DIC and ALK fields will be initialized from the GLODAPv2 gridded data (based on discrete measurements during WOCE and CLIVAR).

• 铁的初始场将基于 GEOTRACES 数据库，该数据库的网格化版本将作为 OMIP 的一部分提供。

Initial fields for iron will be based on the GEOTRACES database, with a gridded version of this database provided as part of OMIP.

• 其他示踪物的初始化不太关键，例如浮游植物生物量仅限于上层 200 米，并像其他生物示踪物一样快速达到平衡。

Initialization of other tracers is less critical, e.g., phytoplankton biomass is restricted to the top 200 m and equilibrates rapidly as do other biological tracers.

• 模拟叶绿素与海洋动力学之间的直接耦合不是强制性的。

Direct coupling between simulated chlorophyll and ocean dynamics is not mandatory.

也就是说，用于计算太阳辐射在水柱中穿透的光学模式不要求在动力学分量和生物地球化学分量中相同。

That is, the optical model used to compute the penetration of solar radiation in the water column is not required to be the same in the dynamical and biogeochemical components.

• 各团体可自由使用其偏好的边界条件来描述进入海洋的各种营养盐来源（通过大气沉降、河流排放和沉积物再活化）以及碳的侧向输入（例如来自河流和地下水排放）。

Groups are free to use their preferred boundary conditions for the different sources of nutrients to the ocean (via atmospheric deposition, river discharge, and sediment mobilization) as well as lateral input of carbon (e.g., from river and groundwater discharge).

• 所有强迫文件将在 OCMIP 网站上更新至 2009 年。

All forcing files will be updated through 2009 on the OCMIP web sites.

OMIP-A 与 OMIP-B 试验概要

Summary of the OMIP‐A and OMIP‐B experiments

Tier 1 OMIP 模拟（OMIP-A）包括一个全球海洋/海冰/惰性化学/生物地球化学试验，至少运行 CORE-II 强迫的五个重复循环。

The Tier 1 OMIP simulation (OMIP‐A) consists of one global ocean/sea‐ice/inert‐chemical/biogeochemical experiment run for a minimum of five repeating cycles of the CORE‐II forcing.

OMIP-A 涉及两条路径：

OMIP‐A involves two paths:

• 无法运行生物地球化学的团体可以参与物理/化学部分。

The groups that are unable to run with biogeochemistry can participate in the physical/chemical portion.

在这里，需要位温（或保守温度）、盐度和理想年龄。

Here, potential (or Conservative) temperature, salinity and ideal age are required.

此外，还包含惰性化学示踪物，其中 CFC11 为必需场，CFC12 和 SF6 为可选变量。

In addition, the inert chemical tracers are included with CFC11 as a required field and CFC12 and SF6 as optional variables.

• 第二条路径在第一条路径的基础上增加一个在线生物地球化学模式。

The second path adds an online biogeochemistry model to the first path.

将 62 年的 CORE-II 强迫数据重复五次，总积分长度为 310 年。

With 62‐years of CORE‐II forcing data repeated five times, the total integration length is 310 years.

主要分析将聚焦于第五个循环。

Primary analyses will focus on the fifth cycle.

不过，鼓励归档全部五个循环的结果，例如以便评估漂移。

However, archiving results for all five cycles is encouraged, e.g., in order to assess drift.

该模拟是一个 Tier 1 试验。

This simulation is a Tier 1 experiment.

Tier 2 OMIP 模拟（OMIP-B）要求来自同样具备生物地球化学能力、且能负担千年尺度 spin-up 的团体。

The Tier 2 OMIP simulation (OMIP‐B) is requested from the same groups having biogeochemistry and able to afford a millennial‐scale spin‐up.

与 OMIP-A 中使用观测气候态初始化生物地球化学不同，该模拟将使用已 spin-up 至少 1000 年（理想情况为 5000 年）的模式示踪物场进行初始化。

Rather than using observed climatologies to initialize the biogeochemistry as in OMIP‐A, this simulation will be initialized with model tracer fields that have been spun up for at least 1000 years, ideally for 5000 years.

此外，为评估深海环流，OMIP-B 模拟（及其 spin-up）将包含放射性碳（遵循 OCMIP2 协议的非生物 DIC 和 DI14C），这与 Tier 1 OMIP-A 模拟不同。

In addition, to evaluate deep‐ocean circulation the OMIP‐B simulation (and its spin‐up) will include radiocarbon (abiotic DIC and DI14C following the OCMIP2 protocol), unlike the Tier 1 OMIP‐A simulation.

除此之外，OMIP-B 将与 OMIP-A 完全相同。

Otherwise, OMIP‐B will be identical to OMIP‐A.

大气强迫数据集和物理场试验协议的详情见 Griffies et al. (2012) 和 Danabasoglu et al. (2014)，它们遵循 CORE-II 协议。

Details of the atmospheric forcing datasets and the experimental protocol for the physical fields are available in Griffies et al. (2012) and Danabasoglu et al. (2014), and they follow the CORE‐II protocol.

惰性化学示踪物遵循 OCMIP2，生物地球化学示踪物遵循 OCMIP3。

Inert chemical tracers follow OCMIP2, and biogeochemical tracers follow OCMIP3.

1. 初始化：

1. Initialization:

a. 位温（或保守温度）和盐度使用一月平均的、基于观测的气候态从静止状态初始化。

a. Potential temperature (or Conservative temperature) and salinity are initialized using January‐mean observational‐based climatology from a state of rest.

5（原书页码）

5

b. 惰性人为化学示踪物（CFC11、CFC12、SF6）在 1936 年 01 月 01 日初始化为零（该日期出现在第 4 个 CORE-II 强迫循环中，模式日期为 0237 年 01 月 01 日）。

b. Inert anthropogenic chemical tracers (CFC11, CFC12, SF6) are initialized to zero on 01January 1936 (which occurs during the 4th CORE‐II forcing cycle at model date 01 January 0237).

c. 生物地球化学示踪物按上文给出的细节初始化。

c. Biogeochemical tracers are initialized according to details given above.

d. 海冰场通常从取自另一个模拟的现有状态初始化。

d. Sea ice fields are generally initialized from an existing state taken from another simulation.

2. 强迫：

2. Forcing:

a. 表面热通量由来自 CORE-II 的辐射通量确定（Large and Yeager 2009）。

a. Surface heat fluxes are determined by radiative fluxes from CORE‐II (Large and Yeager 2009).

湍流热通量基于海洋状态和 CORE-II 大气状态计算。

Turbulent heat fluxes are computed based on the ocean state and CORE‐II atmospheric state.

b. 湍流通量的块体公式必须遵循 Large and Yeager (2009) 的方法。

b. Bulk formulae for turbulent fluxes must follow the Large and Yeager (2009) method.

c. 不对表面温度施加任何恢复项。

c. There is no restoring term applied to the surface temperature.

d. 表面水通量由 CORE-II 提供，包括降水和河流径流。

d. Surface water fluxes are provided by CORE‐II, including precipitation and river runoff.

e. 表面盐度通常被阻尼到月平均的、基于观测的气候态。

e. Surface salinity is generally damped to a monthly observational‐based climatology.

每个模式团体自行确定其模式所用盐度恢复的细节。

Each model group determines details for the salinity restoring used for their model.

由于海洋-海冰模式中与高纬过程相关的物理敏感性，对所有模式采用统一的盐度恢复方法不可行（Griffies et al., 2009）。

A unified salinity restoring method for all models is not feasible due to physical sensitivities in ocean‐ice models related to high latitude processes (Griffies et al., 2009).

f. 大气惰性化学示踪物（CFC11、CFC12 和 SF6）在 CORE-II 强迫的前三个循环中保持其前工业值（零），随后自模式日期 0237 年 01 月 01 日（对应日历日期 1936 年 01 月 01 日）起按照 OCMIP2 协议变化。

f. Atmospheric inert‐chemical tracers (CFC11, CFC12, and SF6) are held to their preindustrial values (zero) for the first three cycles of the CORE‐II forcing, then changed according to the OCMIP2 protocol starting at model date 01 January 0237, corresponding to calendar date 01 January 1936.

或者，为节省计算资源，惰性化学示踪物可以只在该日期激活，从大气和海洋中的零浓度开始。

Alternatively, to save computational resources, the inert chemical traces could be activated only on that date, starting from zero concentrations in the atmosphere and ocean.

g. 生物地球化学示踪物按照 OCMIP3 强迫。

g. Biogeochemical tracers are forced according to OCMIP3.

OMIP 模拟协议的计划演进

Planned evolution of the OMIP simulation protocol

如本提案所述，两个 CMIP6/OMIP 试验（OMIP-A 和 OMIP-B）使用 Large and Yeager (2009) 强迫数据集，遵循 Griffies et al (2012) 协议。

As proposed here, the two CMIP6/OMIP experiments (OMIP‐A and OMIP‐B) use the Large and Yeager (2009) forcing data sets, following the Griffies et al (2012) protocol.

此外，预计于 2016 年推出的新大气强迫数据产品将纳入 CMIP6/OMIP 的未来阶段。

Additionally, new atmospheric forcing data products, anticipated in 2016, will be incorporated into future phases of CMIP6/OMIP.

拥有多个强迫产品将能更稳健地理解对强迫的敏感性，并将向基于观测的大气产品开发者提供反馈。

Having multiple forcing products will enable a more robust understanding of sensitivities to forcing, and will provide feedback to those developing the observational‐based atmospheric products.

OMIP 科学指导委员会将在新的进展和扩展可用时更新 OMIP 协议。

The OMIP Scientific Steering Committee will update the OMIP protocol as new developments and extensions become available.

III. 结束语

III. Closing remarks

海洋学和气候科学界对分析所有包含海洋模式分量的 CMIP6 模拟的海洋输出表现出极大兴趣。

The oceanography and climate science communities have expressed great interest in analyzing ocean output from all CMIP6 simulations that include an ocean model component.

此类分析包括物理、化学和生物地球化学诊断要素。

Such analyses include physical, chemical, and biogeochemical diagnostic elements.

OMIP 通过详细规定使用海洋分量的 CMIP6 模拟需要输出的诊断量，为 CMIP6 海洋诊断提供了框架。

OMIP provides the framework for CMIP6 ocean diagnostics by detailing diagnostics to be output from CMIP6 simulations using an ocean component.

此外，两个（一个 Tier 1 和一个 Tier 2）OMIP 全球海洋/海冰试验使得能够对 CMIP6 气候与地球系统模式的海洋/海冰/化学/生物地球化学分量进行系统的相互比较。

Furthermore, the two (one Tier 1 and one Tier 2) OMIP global ocean/sea ice experiments allow for systematic inter‐comparison of the ocean/sea‐ice/chemical/biogeochemical components of CMIP6 climate and earth system models.

参与 CMIP6/OMIP 试验的海洋与气候模拟团体将非常乐于使用 OMIP 海洋/海冰协议来评估其海洋模拟。（注：此句跨越第 193-194 页分页处。）

Ocean and climate modeling groups participating in CMIP6/OMIP experiments will be keenly interested in evaluating their ocean simulations using the OMIP ocean/sea ice protocol.

6（原书页码）

6

这种评估将有助于加深我们对耦合气候与地球系统模式中所用海洋/海冰/化学/生物地球化学分量的理解。

This evaluation will help to improve our understanding of ocean/sea‐ice/chemical/biogeochemical components used in coupled climate and earth system models.

MIP 的目标与简要概述*

Goal of the MIP and a brief overview*

自 20 世纪 90 年代以来，PMIP 围绕以下目标不断发展：

Since the 1990s, PMIP has developed with the following objectives:

- 评估用于气候预测的气候模式在模拟现今及近期气候变率范围之外、具有充分文献记载的过去气候方面的能力；

- to evaluate the ability of climate models used for climate prediction in simulating well-documented past climates outside the range of present and recent climate variability

- 理解这些气候变化的机制，特别是不同气候反馈的作用。

- to understand the mechanisms of these climate changes, in particular the role of the different climate feedbacks

为实现这些目标，PMIP 积极推动了古数据综合、多模式分析（包括对过去与未来模拟的模式结果之间关系的分析）以及模式—数据比较。

To achieve these goals, PMIP has actively fostered paleo-data syntheses, multi-model analyses, including analyses of relationships between model results from past and future simulations, and model-data comparisons.

这些工作首先聚焦于大气环流模式（AGCM）的结果（PMIP1），随后扩展到海气耦合环流模式（OAGCM）及包含碳循环反馈的海气耦合模式（AOGCM），从而紧跟 CMIP 的模式发展（PMIP2 与 PMIP3）。

These have first been focusing on the results from Atmospheric General Circulation Models (PMIP1) and then been extended to coupled Ocean-Atmosphere General Circulation Models and AOGCM including carbon cycle feedbacks, thereby closely following model developments for CMIP (PMIP2 and PMIP3).

三项 PMIP3 模拟是 CMIP5 模拟集合的组成部分：近千年、中全新世（约 6000 年前）与末次盛冰期（约 21000 年前），由此首次实现了对过去与未来气候模式结果的严格比较。

Three PMIP3 simulations were part of the CMIP5 ensemble of simulations: the last millennium, the mid-Holocene (~6,000 years ago) and the Last Glacial Maximum (~21,000 years ago), hence allowing, for the first time, the rigorous comparison of model results for past and future climates.

考虑这些时期的原因是：

The rationale for considering these periods was:

- 就末次盛冰期而言，在具有充分文献记载的气候极值上评估模式，尤其是在温度方面，并研究强迫与反馈在形成该气候中的作用；

- for the Last Glacial Maximum, to evaluate the models on a well-documented climatic extreme, especially in terms of temperatures, and study the role of forcings and feedbacks in establishing this climate;

- 就中全新世而言，在北半球气候“最适宜期”上评估与分析模式，其特征为季风增强、温带大陆干旱以及夏季显著偏暖；

- for the mid-Holocene, to evaluate and analyse the models on a climate "optimum" for the northern hemisphere, characterized by enhanced monsoons, extra-tropical continental aridity and much warmer summers;

- 就近千年而言，研究年代际到百年际气候变率的机制（自然变率与太阳、火山和人为强迫影响之比），并参照大量详细记录评估模式性能。

- for the last millennium, to study the mechanisms (natural variability vs impact of solar, volcanic and anthropogenic forcings) of decadal to centennial climate variability and evaluate the models' performance w.r.t numerous detailed records.

针对 CMIP6，我们提议在 PMIP/CMIP 实验组中加入两个新的温暖时期：末次间冰期与中上新世，针对这两个时期的模拟已经开展并对 AR5 做出了重要贡献。

For CMIP6, we propose to include two new warm periods in the PMIP/CMIP set of experiments: the Last Interglacial and the Mid-Pliocene, for which simulations have been performed and significantly contributed to AR5.

PMIP3/CMIP5 与 PlioMIP 在参与度和论文发表方面都非常成功。

PMIP3/CMIP5 and PlioMIP have been very successful in terms of participation and publications.

19 个研究组参与了 PMIP3/CMIP5 模拟，12 个研究组参与了 PlioMIP。

19 groups have contributed to PMIP3/CMIP5 simulations, 12 groups have taken part in PlioMIP.

PMIP3/CMIP5 模拟已被 40 余篇论文使用（截至 2014 年 9 月 11 日），PlioMIP 模拟已成为 20 余篇论文的主题。

PMIP3/CMIP5 simulations have been used in more than 40 publications (as of Sept 11th, 2014) and PlioMIP simulations have been the topic of more than 20 publications.

PMIP 模拟为 IPCC AR5 的两个章节做出了突出贡献：第 5 章“古气候档案信息”与第 9 章“气候模式评估”。

PMIP simulations have brought strong contribution to 2 IPCC AR5 chapters: chapter 5 "information from paleoclimate archives" and chapter 9 "evaluation of climate models".

PMIP 模拟针对多种强迫、并可对照与当前或历史气候差异极大的气候状态的数据，专门回应了 CMIP6 的关键科学问题“地球系统如何响应强迫”。

PMIP simulations specifically address CMIP6 key question on "How does the Earth System respond to forcing" for a variety of forcings and with possible comparisons to data for climates states very different from the current or historical climate.

PMIP 还以不同于今日的有文献记载的气候所提供的视角，回应了关于系统性模式偏差的问题 2（“系统性模式偏差的起源与后果是什么？”）：通过 PMIP 模拟与数据的比较，有助于评估现今的偏差是否也出现在其他气候状态中，以及现今偏差是否影响模拟气候变化幅度的大小。

PMIP also addresses question 2 ("What are the origins and consequences of systematic model biases?") about systematic model biases, with the perspective given by documented climates different from today: PMIP simulations, with comparisons to data, can help assessing whether the biases for present-day are also found for other climate states and whether present-day biases have an impact on the magnitude of simulated climate changes.

最后，PMIP 通过在有文献记载的过去气候案例中考察上述这些问题、并以近千年模拟作为自然变率的参考状态，与问题 3（“在存在气候变率、可预测性与情景不确定性的情况下，我们如何评估未来气候变化？”）直接相关。

Finally, PMIP is relevant for question 3 ("How can we assess future climate changes given climate variability, predictability and uncertainties in scenarios?"), by examining these very questions for documented past climate cases and via the use of the last millennium simulations as reference state for natural variability.

PMIP 模拟正在“云、环流与气候敏感度”重大挑战（Grand Challenge）框架内进行分析。

PMIP simulations are being analyzed within the Grand Challenge "Clouds, Circulation and Climate Sensitivity".

这些模拟还可为其他重大挑战提供有价值的输入，例如关于冰冻圈与区域气候信息的挑战，以及古气候细尺度模拟的挑战。

They can also provide valuable input for other grand challenges, such as those on the Cryosphere and on Regional Climate Information, with the challenge of paleoclimate modelling at fine scale.

事实上，PMIP 的模式输出正越来越多地用于“古影响研究”（paleoimpact studies），涉及生物多样性，或理解气候与环境变化对早期人类的潜在影响。

Indeed, PMIP model output is increasingly used in "paleoimpact studies", on biodiversity or on understanding the potential impact of climate and environmental changes on early Humans.

围绕这些主题已经提出了若干倡议，未来还将得到加强（例如由 P. Braconnot 领导的 Future Earth“快速通道倡议与集群活动”项目“更好地利用古气候模拟比较计划模拟（MAPS）”，这是一个涉及 WGCM、PAGES、CLIVAR、CLiC 与 bioDISCOVERY 的项目）。

Several initiatives have already been proposed along these themes and will be reinforced in the future (e.g. Future Earth "Fast Track Initiatives and Cluster Activities" project "Making better use of the Paleoclimate Modeling Intercomparison Project simulations (MAPS)" led by P. Braconnot, a project concerning WGCM, PAGES, CLIVAR, CLiC and bioDISCOVERY).

拟议的五项实验构成 PMIP 后续研究的参考集合：单强迫实验、瞬变实验（检验模式对气候突变及冰期—间冰期转换的模拟能力）。

The five proposed experiments constitute a reference ensemble for further studies within PMIP: single forcing experiments, transient experiments (testing the models on abrupt climate change and on glacial-interglacial transitions).

Within PMIP, each PMIP working group will organize their set of simulations, as PMIP also federates focused MIPs such as PlioMIP on the Pliocene climate, LIGMIP on the Last Interglacial, PAST2K on the last two millennia.

对于所有这些时期，所用模式与未来气候预估所用模式相同。

For all these periods the model to be used is the same as the one used for future climate projections.

因此，视各研究组而定，所用模式将仅为海气耦合模式，或为地球系统模式。

Therefore depending on the groups the model will be only atmosphere-ocean coupled models or Earth System models.

分析的参考将是 CMIP6 工业化前（pre-industrial）模拟。

The reference for the analyses will be the CMIP6 preindustrial simulation.

下面我们简要描述中全新世与末次盛冰期——这两个时期自 PMIP 启动以来就一直是其重点，并曾是 PMIP3-CMIP5 模拟的组成部分。

Hereafter, we shortly describe the Mid-Holocene and Last Glacial Maximum, periods which have already been a focus of PMIP since its start and which have been part of the PMIP3-CMIP5 simulations.

关于近千年（同属 PMIP3-CMIP5）以及为 CMIP6 提议的两个新时期的更多细节，见下文：末次间冰期与中上新世温暖期。

More details are given below on the Last Millennium (part of PMIP3-CMIP5 as well) and on the two new periods proposed for CMIP6: the Last Interglacial and the Mid-Pliocene Warm Period.

► 中全新世（midHolocene）与末次盛冰期（lgm）：

► Mid-Holocene (midHolocene) and Last Glacial Maximum (lgm):

中全新世（约 6000 年前）与末次盛冰期（LGM，约 21000 年前）构成距今最近的两个准稳定气候极值：

The mid-Holocene (~6000 years ago) and the Last Glacial Maximum (LGM, ~21000 years ago) constitute the most recent quasi-stable climatic extremes:

中全新世常被描述为温暖状态，即“气候最适宜期”，全球水文循环的主导特征（如北非季风与亚洲季风）在此期间增强；

the mid-Holocene is often described as a warm state, or "climate optimum", in which dominant features of the global hydrological cycle, such as the North African and Asian monsoon, were amplified;

LGM 则是一个寒冷极值，当时温室气体浓度处于最低值，大陆冰盖面积达到最大，覆盖北美北部与欧亚大陆西北部的大片区域。

the LGM is a cold extreme in which greenhouse gas concentrations were at their minimum and continental ice-sheet at their maximum size, covering large areas of northern North America and northwestern Eurasia.

自 PMIP 计划启动以来，这两个时期一直是古数据综合工作的重点，因此在温度、水文循环与地表类型方面都有充分的文献记载。

These periods have been the focus for paleo-data syntheses since the beginning of the PMIP project and therefore are well documented in terms of temperature, hydrological cycle and land surface type.

一些长期存在的模式—数据不一致与人们对未来气候变化的关切相呼应，例如与中全新世的现有记录相比，模式系统性地低估了非洲季风降水向大陆北伸的程度。

Some long standing model-data disagreement are echoing preoccupations for future climate change, such as the systematic underestimation of the northward penetration of the African monsoon rainfall onto the continent compared to available records for the MidHolocene.

LGM 有助于研究在形成与 21 世纪末预估的温度响应幅度相当（尽管符号相反）的响应过程中起作用的反馈机制。

The LGM is relevant for studying feedback mechanisms at work in establishing a temperature response as large as (although with an opposite sign) as that predicted for the end of the 21st century.

这两个时期都是检验我们对气候变化机制理解的测试案例：例如环流变化与辐射/云变化之间的相互作用、气候系统各组成部分反馈的相对强度，以及我们对全球与区域气候变化之间联系的理解。

Both periods constitute test cases for our understanding of mechanisms of climate change, such as the interplay between circulation changes and radiation/cloud changes, the respective strengths of feedbacks from different components of the climate system, and for our understanding of the connections between global and regional climate changes.

与 PMIP 前几个阶段相比，将特别重视沙尘对平均气候与气候反馈的影响，以及与植被或交互碳循环相关的边界条件或地表反馈的不确定性。

Compared to the previous phases of PMIP a particular amphasis will be put on the impact of dust on the mean climate and climate feedbacks, as well as on uncertainties in boundary conditions or surface feedbacks related to the vegetation or interactive carbon cycle.

midHolocene 与 lgm 模拟的参考实验均为工业化前控制实验，将这些实验与为研究未来气候变化机制而设计的理想化实验（如 abrupt4xCO2）进行比较也非常有意义。

The reference experiments for both the midHolocene and lgm simulations are the pre-industrial control and it is very interesting to compare those experiments with an idealized experiment designed to study mechanisms of future climate change, such as abrupt4xCO2.

PMIP-CMIP6 将受益于 CFMIP 提议的理想化实验，如 AMIPminus4K 或 abrupt0.5CO2，它们将有助于比较在形成冷气候与暖气候过程中起作用的反馈。

PMIP-CMIP6 will benefit from idealized experiments proposed by CFMIP, such as AMIPminus4K or abrupt0.5CO2 which will help comparing feedbacks at work in setting up a cold climate vs. those at work for a warm climate.

类似地，在 AMIP 实验中将日射取 6ky BP 的值，将非常有助于分析气候系统内强迫与反馈的强度，以及过去与未来气候共同/不同响应的机制。

Similarly, an AMIP experiment with insolation prescribed at a 6ky BP value will be very useful to analyze the strengths of forcings and feedbacks within the climate system and the mechanisms for common/different responses for past and future climates.

这些敏感性实验将作为 PMIP 的一部分，在“从过去到未来”（Past to Future）工作组内讨论。

These sensitivity experiments will be discussed as part of PMIP in the Past to Future working group.

它们将呼应 PMIP1 模拟（http://pmip.lsce.ipsl.fr），而 ESM 模拟将呼应 PMIP2 与 PMIP3 模拟（http://pmip2.lsce.ipsl.fr 与 http://pmip3.lsce.ipsl.fr），由此得以刻画模式再现有文献记载的大尺度气候变化能力的演变。

They would echo PMIP1 simulations (http://pmip.lsce.ipsl.fr), while ESM simulations would echo PMIP2 and PMIP3 (http://pmip2.lsce.ipsl.fr and http://pmip3.lsce.ipsl.fr) simulations, hence allowing a characterization of the models' evolution in their ability to represent documented large climate changes.

► 近千年（past1000）：

► Last Millennium (past1000):

近千年是数百年时间框架内文献记载最充分的气候变化时期。

The last millennium is the best-documented period of climate change in a multi-century time frame.

全新世晚期气候曾发生显著变化，这些变化在历史上留下了痕迹（中世纪气候最适宜期、小冰期）。

Climate has varied considerably during the late Holocene and these changes left their traces in history (Medieval Climate Optimum, Little Ice Age).

然而，由地球气候系统内部变率和外部强迫（太阳、轨道、火山）变化引起的自然波动的相对大小，与归因于人为温室气体的当前全球变暖之间的相对大小，仍存在争议。

However, the relative magnitude of natural fluctuations due to internal variability of the Earth's climate system and to variations in the external forcings (Sun, orbital, volcanic) and the present global warming, attributed to anthropogenic greenhouse gases, is still under debate.

因此，近千年（LM）模拟直接回应了 CMIP6 的第一个关键科学问题：“地球系统如何响应强迫”。

Simulations of the last millennium (LM) therefore directly address the first CMIP6 key scientific question "How does the Earth System respond to forcing".

在与今天相差不大的气候背景条件下考察对（主要是）自然强迫的响应，对于增进对气候变率、环流和区域连通性的理解至关重要。

Investigating the response to (mainly) natural forcing under climatic background conditions not too different from today is crucial for an improved understanding of climate variability, circulation, and regional connectivity.

LM 模拟还可评估年代际及更长尺度上的气候变率，并提供有强迫与无强迫条件下的可预测性信息。

LM simulations also allow assessing climate variability on decadal and longer scales and provide information on predictability under forced and unforced conditions.

这些对近期预测至关重要，因而回应了第三个 CMIP5 科学问题（原文如此）：“在存在气候变率、可预测性与情景不确定性的情况下，我们如何评估未来气候变化”。

These are crucial for near-term predictions and thus address the third CMIP5 scientific question "How can we assess future climate changes given climate variability, predictability and uncertainties in scenarios".

通过提供对照观测与古气候重建的深入模式评估——尤其关注对强迫响应的细节——LM 模拟服务于“理解系统性模式偏差的起源与后果”，因而同时也回应了 CMIP6 的第二个科学问题。

In providing in-depth model evaluation with respect to observations and paleoclimatic reconstructions in particular addressing details of response to forcing, LM simulations serve to "understand origins and consequences of systematic model biases", thus addressing also the second CMIP6 scientific question.

LM 将基于 DECK 实验，特别是作为无强迫参考的工业化前控制模拟以及历史模拟。

LM will build on DECK experiments, in particular the pre-industrial control simulation as unforced reference and the historical simulations.

此外，LM 为始于 19 世纪的历史模拟提供初始条件，这些初始条件被认为优于 piControl 状态，因为它们包含了强迫历史的综合信息（例如 19 世纪初的大规模火山喷发）。

Moreover, LM provide initial conditions for historical simulations starting in the 19th century that are considered superior to the piControl state as it includes integrated information from the forcing history (e.g. large volcanic eruptions in the early 19th century).

在 PMIP 内部，相当数量的个人研究者与模式组承诺开展 LM 模拟。

Within PMIP, a considerable number of individual researchers and modelling groups is committed to perform LM simulations.

这些模拟将基于 PMIP3/CMIP5 中积累的经验，当时有十多个模式组参与，共 15 个 LM 实验存储在 ESGF 数据库中。

The simulations will base on experience gained in PMIP3/CMIP5 where more than a dozen modelling groups participated and a total of 15 LM experiments where stored in the ESGF database.

若干研究（部分体现为 AR5 第 5 章的条目）凸显了 LM 多模式集合的价值。

Several studies, partly reflected by entries in the AR5 chapter 5, have highlighted the value of the LM multi-model ensemble.

PMIP3 LM 工作组（WG Past2K）与 PAGES 的 PAGES2k 倡议密切合作，推动气候变量与变率模态的区域重建。

The PMIP3 LM working group (WG Past2K) is closely cooperating with the PAGES initiative PAGES2k promoting regional reconstructions of climate variables and variability modes.

合作工作聚焦于重建—模式比较（如 Bothe et al., 2013）与变率模态评估（如 Raible et al., 2014）。

Collaborative work has focused on reconstruction-model intercomparison (e.g. Bothe et al., 2013) and assessment of variability modes (e.g. Raible et al., 2014).

对重建与模拟的综合评估推动了模式评估与过程理解的进展（如 Lehner et al., 2013; Sicre et al., 2013; Jungclaus et al., 2014）。

Integrated assessment of reconstruction and simulations has led to progress in model evaluation and process understanding (e.g. Lehner et al., 2013; Sicre et al., 2013; Jungclaus et al., 2014).

WG Past2K 将推动未来的联合分析与研讨会，汇聚观测与模拟两方面的专长。

WG Past2K will promote future common analyses and workshops bringing together observational and modelling expertise.

对 CMIP6 而言，进展可期：新的、更全面的火山强迫重建（Sigl et al., 待发表）、改进的模式，以及确保从工业化前过去到未来无缝衔接模拟的实验方案。

For CMIP6 progress is expected owing to new, more comprehensive reconstructions of volcanic forcing (Sigl et al., in preparation), improved models, and an experimental protocol that ensures seamless simulations from the pre-industrial past to the future.

更高分辨率的模拟将能够评估更多区域细节与过程，例如风暴路径、降水。

Higher-resolution simulations will allow assessing more regional details and processes, e.g. storm-tracks, precipitation.

► 末次间冰期：

► Last Interglacial:

IPCC 第一工作组 AR4 与 AR5 的《决策者摘要》均包含关于末次间冰期（LIG）的陈述：

The Summary for Policymakers for both the IPCC WG1 AR4 and AR5 included statements on the Last Interglacial (LIG):

“有很高信度认为，末次间冰期（129000 至 116000 年前）的全球平均海平面最大值在数千年间比现在至少高 5 米，并且有高信度认为其未超过现在水平以上 10 米。

"There is very high confidence that maximum global mean sea level during the last interglacial period (129,000 to 116,000 years ago) was, for several thousand years, at least 5 m higher than present, and high confidence that it did not exceed 10 m above present.

在末次间冰期，格陵兰冰盖很可能对更高的全球平均海平面贡献了 1.4 至 4.3 米，这意味着南极冰盖以中等信度另有贡献。

During the last interglacial period, the Greenland ice sheet very likely contributed between 1.4 and 4.3 m to the higher global mean sea level, implying with medium confidence an additional contribution from the Antarctic ice sheet.

这一海平面变化发生在不同的轨道强迫背景下，且高纬地表温度（数千年的平均值）比现在至少高 2°C（高信度）。”

This change in sea level occurred in the context of different orbital forcing and with high-latitude surface temperature, averaged over several thousand years, at least 2°C warmer than present (high confidence)."

然而，AR4 与 AR5 都没有针对 LIG 的协调模拟，用以评估温度的极地放大、海冰的季节记忆以及降水/风暴路径变化对格陵兰冰盖稳定性及其对海平面高水位贡献的相互作用，也无法评估海洋与大气温度及环流的相互作用对南极冰盖稳定性的影响。

Yet the AR4 and AR5 had no coordinated simulations for the LIG to assess the interplay of polar amplification of temperature, seasonal memory of sea ice, and precipitation/storm track changes on the stability of the Greenland ice sheet and its contribution to the sea level high stand nor the interplay of oceanic and atmospheric temperatures and circulation on the stability of the Antarctic ice sheet.

AR5 中评估的 LIG 气候模式模拟虽然由许多模式组完成，但各模拟的强迫设置不一，且常常未使用与 CMIP5 未来预估相同的模式/分辨率，因此提供了有用但不完整的评估手段（第 5 章；Lunt et al., 2013）。

Climate model simulations for the LIG assessed in the AR5, although completed by many modeling groups, varied in their forcings and often were not made with the same model/same resolution as the CMIP5 future projections, thus providing a useful but incomplete means for assessment (Chapter 5; Lunt et al., 2013).

同样地，AR5 中评估的格陵兰冰盖模拟使用了离线模式，并采用多种气候强迫设置（第 5 章）。

Similarly, Greenland ice sheet simulations assessed in the AR5 used offline models with a variety of climate forcing setups (Chapter 5).

当时没有可用于评估南极冰盖（特别是西南极冰盖）对 LIG 海平面高水位贡献的模拟。

No simulations were available to assess the Antarctic ice sheet (particularly, the West Antarctic Ice Sheet) contribution to the LIG sea level high stand.

我们提议为 LIG（lastInterglacial）开展一项 PMIP-CMIP6 时间切片实验，以确定该时期更暖的大气与海洋温度、降水变化以及地表能量平衡变化对冰盖热力学与动力学的相互作用。

We propose a PMIP-CMIP6 time-slice experiment for the LIG (lastInterglacial) to determine the interplay of warmer atmospheric and oceanic temperatures, changed precipitation, and changed surface energy balance on ice sheet thermodynamics and dynamics during this period.

这些时间切片实验的输出将被 ISMIP6 用于驱动独立的冰盖实验（lastIntergacialforcedism）。

The output from these time-slice experiments will be used by ISMIP6 to force standalone ice sheet experiments (lastIntergacialforcedism).

仍不确定的是，冰盖模式与气候模式能在多大程度上预测冰盖的稳定性，以及本世纪内是否可能越过阈值。

Still uncertain are how well ice sheet and climate models can predict the stability of the ice sheets and if thresholds may be passed this century.

LIG 模拟将具有很高的社会意义，因为它对海平面变化以及海冰和季风都有重要启示。

A LIG simulation will be of high societal relevance because of implications for sea level changes as well as sea ice and monsoons.

在温暖的过去间冰期中，LIG 最适合用于 CMIP6 评估，因为其数据相对丰富，包括：冰芯——提供充分混合温室气体、含沙尘与海盐的气溶胶的测量，以及作为温度代用指标的稳定水同位素，对格陵兰还提供冰盖高度与范围；

The LIG is the most suitable of the warm past interglacials for a CMIP6 assessment because of the relative wealth of data including: ice cores providing measurements of well-mixed greenhouse gases, aerosols including dust and sea salt, and stable water isotopes as a proxy for temperature, as well as for Greenland, ice sheet elevation and extent;

海洋记录——提供海洋温度与地质示踪剂，可用于解释水团与翻转环流强度；

marine records for ocean temperatures and geotracers that can be interpreted in terms of water masses and overturning strength;

洞穴石笋——提供季风强度指标；

speleothems that provide indication of monsoon strength;

以及指示温度与植被的陆相记录。

and terrestrial records that indicate temperature and vegetation.

此外，新的记录正在细化我们对海冰范围、火灾与生物多样性的认识。

As well, new records are refining our knowledge of sea ice extent, fire, and biodiversity.

拟议的 LIG 的 PMIP-CMIP6 模拟尤其切合 WCRP 重大挑战“冰冻圈变化与区域海平面上升”，同时也切合“区域气候信息”与“云、环流与气候敏感度”，因为数据记录显示其强迫大、因而区域响应也大。

The proposed PMIP-CMIP6 simulation for the LIG is particularly relevant to the WCRP Grand Challenges: Changes in Cryosphere and Regional Sea-level Rise, but also to Regional Climate Information and Clouds, Circulation and Climate Sensitivity because of the large forcings and thus large regional responses as recorded in the data.

它很好地回应了以下广泛的科学问题：1. 地球系统如何响应强迫？2. 系统性模式偏差（尤其是在高纬地区、以及与冰盖稳定性相关的偏差）的起源与后果是什么？

It addresses well the broad scientific questions: 1. How does the Earth System respond to forcing? and 2. What are the origins and consequences of systematic model biases (especially at high latitudes and relevant to the stability of the ice sheets)?

作为 PMIP 与 ISMIP6 的一部分，一些研究组还将开展瞬变耦合冰盖—气候模拟以及其他独立冰盖模拟，这些模拟将给出海平面的变化速率——若应用离线 GIA 模式，还包括区域海平面——以及这些模式启动下一次冰期开始能力的度量。

As part of PMIP and ISMIP6, some groups will additionally perform transient coupled ice sheet-climate simulations as well as other standalone ice sheet simulations that will provide rates of change for sea level, including regional sea level if offline GIA models applied, as well as a measure of the capability of these models to initiate the next glacial inception.

► 上新世温暖期

► Pliocene warm period

上新世是地球历史上大气 CO2 浓度接近现代水平（约 400 ppmv）、同时保持近乎现代大陆格局的最后一个时期。

The Pliocene epoch was the last time in Earth history when atmospheric CO2 concentrations approached modern values (~400 ppmv) whilst at the same time retaining a near modern continental configuration.

IPCC 第五次评估报告第 5 章（Masson-Delmotte et al., 2013）指出，上新世的模式—数据比较以高信度表明，平均地表温度高于工业化前水平（Dowsett et al., 2012; Haywood et al., 2013）。

The IPCC 5th Assessment report chapter 5 (Masson-Delmotte et al., 2013) states that that model–data comparisons for the Pliocene provide high confidence that mean surface temperature was warmer than pre-industrial (Dowsett et al., 2012; Haywood et al., 2013).

基于大规模数据综合（Lunt et al., 2010; Dowsett et al., 2012），全球平均海表温度估计比 1901–1920 年平均值高 +1.7°C。

Global mean sea surface temperatures have been estimated to be +1.7°C above the 1901–1920 mean based on large data syntheses (Lunt et al., 2010; Dowsett et al., 2012).

现有气候模式模拟给出的全球平均地表气温范围，相对于 1901–1920 年平均值在 +1.9°C 至 +3.6°C 之间（Haywood et al., 2013）。

Exiting climate model simulations have produced a range of global mean surface air temperature of +1.9°C and +3.6°C relative to the 1901–1920 mean (Haywood et al., 2013).

模式模拟表明，经向温度梯度有所减小（由于高纬增暖），这对未来极地冰盖的稳定性与海平面具有重要影响（如 Miller et al. 2012）。

Model simulations have indicated that meridional temperature gradients were reduced (due to high latitude warming), which has significant implications for the stability of polar ice sheets and sea level in the future (e.g. Miller et al. 2012).

植被资料汇编（Salzmann et al., 2008）表明，全球干旱荒漠面积缩小、北方森林取代苔原，而气候模式预测水文循环增强，但模式间差异较大（Haywood et al., 2013）。

Compilations of vegetation (Salzmann et al., 2008) have indicated that the global extent of arid deserts decreased and boreal forests replaced tundra, and climate models predict an enhanced hydrological cycle, but with a large inter-model spread (Haywood et al., 2013).

东亚夏季风以及其他季风系统可能也有所增强（Zhang et al. 2013）。

The East Asian Summer Monsoon, as well as other monsoon systems, may also have been enhanced (Zhang et al. 2013).

尽管 AR5 评估了上新世的气候模式模拟，但这些模拟并非来自与 CMIP5 未来预估相同的模式/分辨率，从而削弱了学界对照未来气候变化的类似预测、评估和比较全球与区域上新世气候变化的能力（Haywood et al., 2013）。

Although climate model simulations for the Pliocene were assessed in the AR5, these simulations were not derived from the same model/same resolution as the CMIP5 future projections, thus reducing the communities' ability to assess and compare changes in global and regional Pliocene climates, vis-à-vis similar predictions of future climate change (Haywood et al., 2013).

我们提议为上新世开展一项 CMIP6 时间切片实验，以理解地球气候系统对接近现代浓度大气 CO2 的长期响应（更长期的气候敏感度，即地球系统敏感度），并理解海洋环流、北极海冰、气候变率模态（如 ENSO）的响应，以及水文循环的全球响应与季风系统的区域变化。

We propose a CMIP6 time-slice experiment for the Pliocene to understand the long term response of the Earth's climate system to a near modern concentration of atmospheric CO2 (longer term climate sensitivity or Earth System Sensitivity), and to understand the response of ocean circulation, Arctic sea-ice, modes of climate variability (e.g. ENSO), as well as the global response in the hydrological cycle and regional changes in monsoon systems.

上新世模拟将具有很高的社会意义，因为它有可能为决策者提供信息：为在长期（2100 AD 之后）将全球年平均温度升幅控制在 2 至 3 °C 以内，需要何种减排情景。

A Pliocene simulation will be of high societal relevance because of its potential to inform policy makers on required emission reduction scenarios designed to prevent global annual mean temperatures increase by more than 2 to 3 °C in the long term (beyond 2100 AD).

拟议的上新世 CMIP6 模拟切合 WCRP 重大挑战中的两项。

The proposed CMIP6 simulation for the Pliocene is relevant to two of the WCRP Grand Challenges.

其中包括“云、环流与气候敏感度”：由于 CO2 强迫增强（与现代 CO2 强迫相当），这为考察接近现代大气 CO2 浓度下的平衡气候态提供了独特机会。

This includes Clouds, Circulation and Climate Sensitivity because of the enhanced CO2 forcing (contemporaneous with modern CO2 forcing), providing a unique opportunity to examine an equilibrium climate state to a near modern concentration of atmospheric CO2.

上新世气候档案所保留的极地放大格局可与最新一代 CMIP 模式直接比较，为解决潜在的极地放大问题做出宝贵贡献。

The pattern of polar amplification preserved Pliocene climate archives can be compared directly with the latest generation of CMIP models making a valuable contribution towards addressing the potential polar amplification problem.

通过分析 CMIP 模式中的上新世极地放大，并考察上新世北冰洋季节性无海冰这一地质解释，我们的 CMIP6 模拟还将回应 WCRP 重大挑战“冰冻圈变化”。

Through the analysis of Pliocene polar amplification in CMIP models, and examining the geological interpretation of a seasonally sea-ice free Arctic Ocean during the Pliocene, our CMIP6 simulation will also address the WCRP Grand Challenge of Changes in the Cryosphere.

尽管上新世海平面重建存在不确定性，但 IPCC AR5 以高信度指出，上新世海平面高于工业化前时代，多种独立方法表明海平面上升幅度在 10 至 20 米之间。

Whilst uncertainty exists in Pliocene sea level reconstruction, IPCC AR5 states with high confidence that Pliocene sea-levels were higher than the pre-industrial era, with a number of independent methods indicating a sea-level rise of between 10 and 20 m.

这表明，在 CO2 浓度约为 400 ppmv 的条件下，格陵兰冰盖与南极冰盖都可能存在长期不稳定性（Miller et al. 2012）。

This indicates potential long term instability of both the Greenland and Antarctic Ice Sheets (Miller et al. 2012) with CO2 concentrations at approximately 400 ppmv.

CMIP6 上新世实验将用于上新世冰盖模式比较计划，以便未来更好地约束上新世冰盖模式模拟中的气候强迫。

CMIP6 Pliocene experiments will be used within the Pliocene Ice Sheet Model Intercomparison Project in order to better constrain the climatological forcing in ice sheet model simulations for the Pliocene in the future.

PMIP 内部有一个组织良好、非常活跃的上新世气候模式研究者社群，上新世工作组是 PMIP3 中最成功的工作组之一。

There is a well-organized and highly active of community of Pliocene climate modellers within PMIP, with the Pliocene working group being one of the most successful working groups within PMIP3.

该工作组与美国地质调查局（USGS）联系密切；过去 25 年来，USGS 一直运行着一个卓有成效的、聚焦上新世环境重建的核心计划，其数据被用于支撑几乎所有针对上新世开展的模式—数据比较。

The working group is closely associated with the United States Geological Survey (USGS) who has had a highly productive core program focused on Pliocene environmental reconstruction for the last 25 years, and their data has been used to underpin almost all model-data comparisons performed for the Pliocene.

因此，CMIP6 有望继续获得 USGS 的大力支持以及用于与模式输出比较的新上新世数据集。

Thus, CMIP6 can expect a high degree of continued support and new Pliocene data sets from the USGS for comparison with model outputs.

该实验将回应以下广泛的科学问题：1. 地球系统在长期上如何响应与现代相当的 CO2 强迫？2. CO2 引起的极地放大对冰盖、海冰与海平面稳定性的意义是什么？

The experiment will address the broad scientific questions: 1 How does the Earth System respond in the long term to CO2 forcing analogous to that of the modern? and 2 What is the significance of CO2 induced polar amplification for the stability of the ice sheets, sea-ice and sea-level?

拟议的 CMIP DECK 与 CMIP6 实验评估/分析概述*

An overview of the proposed evaluation/analysis of the CMIP DECK and CMIP6 experiments*

PMIP 受益于与 PAGES 及 INQUA（国际第四纪研究联合会）在模式—数据比较方面的紧密联系。

PMIP benefits from strong links with PAGES and INQUA (International Union for Quaternary Science) for model-data comparisons.

midHolocene 与 lgm：参照现有数据（系统化基准检验，cf. Harrison et al, Climate Dynamics, 2013），在温度与水文循环两方面进行评估。

midHolocene and lgm: evaluation w.r.t available data (systematic benchmarking, cf. Harrison et al, Climate Dynamics, 2013), both in terms of temperature and hydrological cycle.

这些评估利用陆上与海洋的独立气候重建。

These evalutions make use of independent climate reconstructions over land and ocean.

将特别关注模式偏差与未来气候模式结果之间的联系。

A specific focus will be put on the link with model biases and model results for future climate.

PMIP 已设立专门工作组，以改进与海洋数据（COMPARE 组）及同位素数据（参见 http://pmip3.lsce.ipsl.fr/ 的“working groups”标签页）的比较。

Specific working groups in PMIP have been set up to improve the comparisons with marine data (COMPARE group) and isotopic data (cf. http://pmip3.lsce.ipsl.fr/, "working groups" tab).

这为定量模式评估提供了新的方法与新的可能。

This provides new methodologies and new possibilities for quantitative model assessments.

past1000：采用新颖的统计方法（Sundberg et al., 2012; Moberg et al., 2014; Bothe et al., 2013）与检测/归因技术（Schurer et al., 2014）开展深入分析。

past1000: In-depth analyses using novel statistical approaches (Sundberg et al., 2012; Moberg et al., 2014; Bothe et al., 2013) and detection/attribution techniques (Schurer et al., 2014).

对变率与环流模态变化的面向过程的分析。

Process-oriented analyses on variability and changes in circulation modes.

部分由专门的敏感性研究支持，例如在 VolMIP 中。

Partly supported by dedicated sensitivity studies, e.g. in VolMIP.

lastInterglacial：CMIP6 实验将分析北极地区起作用的反馈强度及其对格陵兰冰盖稳定性的潜在影响。

lastInterglacial: The CMIP6 experiment will analyse the strength of feedbacks at work in the Arctic, and their potential implications for the stability of the Greenland ice sheet.

将特别强调海洋环流的热量年度再分配，以及北大西洋次表层增暖向南部海洋传输的潜在作用——这对西南极冰盖底部融化具有意义。

A particular emphasis will be put on the annual redistribution heat by the ocean circulation and the potential role of the transmission of the subsurface warming from North Atlantic to Southern ocean, with implication for basal melting of West Antarctic ice Sheet.

来自海冰、水汽与云的高纬反馈将是重点，热带与高纬水文循环之间的相对变化亦然。

High latitude feedbacks from sea-ice, water vapor and cloud will be a focus, as well as the relative changes between the tropical and high latitude water cycle.

上新世温暖期：CMIP6 实验将评估模式模拟一段 CO2 引起全球变暖的近期时段的能力，并评估气候系统关键组成部分（海冰、变率模态、季风、风暴路径、植被）对接近现代 CO2 强迫的长期响应。

Pliocene Warm Period: The CMIP6 experiment will evaluate the ability of models to simulate a recent interval of CO2-induced global warmth, and assess the response of critical components of the climate system to near modern CO2 forcing in the long term (sea-ice, modes of variability, monsoons, storm tracks, vegetation).

与其他温暖时期或间冰期不同，上新世保留了大陆格局与天文强迫等关键的现代边界条件。

Unlike other warm periods or interglacials the Pliocene retains critical modern boundary conditions such as the continental configuration and astronomical forcing.

上新世的变化信号很大，因此信号与不确定性之比使模式预测的变化能够被有把握地归因。

The signal of change in Pliocene is large and therefore the signal to uncertainty ratio enables model-predicted changes to be attributed with confidence.

其中一些诊断与模式评估将作为 PMIP 横向分析组（transverse analyses groups）工作的一部分开展。

Some of these diagnosics and model evaluations will be performed as part of PMIP transverse analyses groups.

特别是，PMIP“Past2Future”工作组旨在识别并理解过去与未来气候模式模拟之间的关系，并利用现有古数据评估这些关系的一致性。

In particular, the PMIP "Past2Future" working group aims at identifying and understanding relationships between model simulations for past and future climates and at using available paleodata to evaluate the consistency of these relationships.

因此，其工作可能基于全部 PMIP 模拟，并辅以与未来气候变化相关的选定模拟。

Its work is therefore potentially based on all PMIP simulations together with selected simulations relevant for future climate change.

拟议时间安排*

Proposed timing*

理想情况下，past1000 应在历史模拟之前运行，且 past1000 与历史模拟之间过渡期的强迫应保持连续。

Ideally past1000 should be run before the historical simulations and forcings should be continuous over the transition between the past1000 and historical runs.

所有其他实验可在 DECK 参考模拟运行完成后尽快开展。

All other experiments can be run as soon as the reference simulation in DECK is run.

中全新世（midHolocene）与末次盛冰期（lgm）

midHolocene and lgm

（摘自 Braconnot 等，《自然·气候变化》，2012 年）+ http://pmip3.lsce.ipsl.fr

(taken from Braconnot et al, Nature Climate Change, 2012) + http://pmip3.lsce.ipsl.fr

中全新世（MH）与末次盛冰期（LGM）模拟是平衡态试验，呈现特定时期气候的“快照”。

Mid-Holocene (MH) and Last Glacial Maximum (LGM) simulations are equilibrium experiments, presenting a “snapshot” of climate at a specific time.

表 2 总结了 PMIP 各阶段 MH 与 LGM 试验所使用的边界条件。

Table 2 summarises the boundary conditions used for MH and LGM experiments during the various phases of PMIP.

气候的最终外强迫（或驱动因子）是由地球轨道变化所决定的入射太阳辐射（日射）的变化。

The ultimate external forcing (or driver) of climate is change in incoming solar radiation (insolation) as determined by changes in the Earth’s orbit.

这些变化可以精确地给定。

These changes can be specified precisely.

由于地球轨道参数的缓慢变化，MH 日射的季节与纬度分布不同于现今（公元 1950 年），使北半球季节差异的幅度增大约 60 Wm-2。

Due to the slow variations of Earth’s orbital parameters, the seasonal and latitudinal distribution of MH insolation was different from present (1950 C.E), enhancing the magnitude of the seasonal contrast in the Northern Hemisphere by about 60 Wm-2.

LGM 的日射强迫与现今非常相似。

Insolation forcing at the LGM was very similar to present.

当模式不显式模拟诸如冰盖累积、伴随的海陆分布变化或大气成分演变等缓慢过程时——这些过程都会引起在较短时间尺度上须视为气候强迫的变化——则这些边界条件（下称强迫）必须在 MH 和 LGM 试验中予以给定。

When models do not explicitly simulate slow processes such as the build up of ice sheets, concomitant changes in land-sea distribution, or the evolution of atmospheric composition, all of which lead to changes that have to be considered as climate forcings on shorter timescales, then these boundary conditions (hereafter forcings) have to be prescribed in the MH and LGM experiments.

随着模式复杂性的演化，所需给定的强迫集合也随之演化。

As models have evolved in complexity, so the set of forcings that has to be prescribed has also evolved.

在 PMIP 第一阶段（PMIP1），试验使用大气环流模式进行，海洋状态作为强迫给定。

In the first phase of the PMIP (PMIP1), the experiments were performed with atmospheric general circulation models and the state of the ocean was prescribed as a forcing.

在 PMIP 第二阶段（PMIP2），部分模式纳入植被动力学，但海气耦合环流模式（OAGCM）的植被覆盖与反照率仍须给定。

In the second phase of PMIP (PMIP2), some models incorporated vegetation dynamics but vegetation cover and albedo still had to be specified for the coupled ocean-atmosphere general circulation models (OAGCMs).

与陆地和海洋碳循环相关的某些过程在早期 PMIP 试验中被忽略，但在 PMIP3 所使用的部分模式中将作为交互分量纳入。

Some processes, such as those associated with the terrestrial and marine carbon cycle, have been ignored in the earlier PMIP experiments, but will be included as interactive components of some of the models used in PMIP3.

在所有试验中，大气成分都利用冰芯结果来给定。

In all experiments the atmospheric composition is prescribed using results from icecores.

PMIP 下一阶段将在可能的情况下沿用 PMIP3 的边界条件。

The next phase of PMIP will make use of the PMIP3 boundary conditions whenever possible.

一个可预见的主要演变与大气模式中沙尘循环的交互式计算有关，为此还必须考虑植被的变化。

A major foreseen evolution is related to the interactive computation of the dust cycle in atmospheric models, for which changes in vegetation also have to be taken into account.

PMIP2 与 PMIP3 建议使用交互式植被或给定的前工业化植被二者之一。

PMIP2 and PMIP3 recommended the use of either interactive vegetation or prescribed pre-industrial vegetation.

对于 PMIP-CMIP6，那些包含沙尘循环交互式表征的模式

For PMIP-CMIP6, those models which include an interactive representation of the

将必须考虑植被的变化。

dust cycle will have to account for changes in vegetation.

这一具体议题将与各模式小组进行讨论。

This particular topic will be discussed with the modelling groups.

lgm 试验将作为参照基准，据此发展针对边界条件不确定性的敏感性试验。

The lgm experiment will be the reference from which sensitivity experiments to uncertainties in boundary conditions will be developed.

特别是，对冰盖重建的敏感性将在 PMIP 的 LGM 冰盖不确定性工作组内进行检验。

In particular, the sensitivity to ice sheet reconstructions will be tested within the PMIP working group on LGM ice sheet uncertainties.

这些 PMIP-CMIP6 LGM 试验也将作为瞬变冰消期试验（由冰消期工作组协调）的起点。

These PMIPCMIP6 LGM experiments will also be starting points for transient deglaciation experiments (coordinated by the working group on the deglaciation).

Last Interglacial

基于 PMIP3 内讨论过的协议。

Based on the protocol discussed within PMIP3.

对于 CMIP6，我们提议开展距今 127 ka（ky BP）时间切片的模拟——大轨道强迫（图 1），大响应。

For CMIP6, we propose a simulation for the 127ky BP time slice - large orbital forcing (Figure 1), large responses.

- 轨道参数设定为 127 ka。

- Orbital parameters set to 127ka.

- 温室气体浓度由冰芯很好地确定 [CO2 275 ppm；CH4 709 ppb；N2O 266 ppb]。

- Greenhouse gas concentrations well-known from ice cores [CO2 275ppm; CH4 709ppb; N2O 266 ppb ].

- 现代地理、冰盖与植被；

- modern geography, ice sheets, and vegetation;

- 从 CMIP6 前工业化 DECK 模拟初始化；

- Initialize from CMIP6 pre-industrial DECK simulation;

- 时长：spinup（加速平衡）之后 ≥ 100 年。

- length: ≥ 100 years after spinup.

左轴为纬度，底轴为距今千年数。

该模拟将作为其他 PMIP LIG（末次间冰期）模拟的参照基准：末次间冰期内的其他时间切片（距今 125、122 ky BP），以及覆盖整个间冰期的瞬变模拟。

This simulation will constitute a reference for additional PMIP LIG simulations: other time slices within the last interglacial (125, 122 ky BP), transient simulations for the whole interglacial.

与其他 MIP 的可能协同

Possible synergies with other MIPs

PMIP 模拟可在以下主题上与其他 MIP 互动：

PMIP simulations can serve to interact with other MIPs on the following themes:

CF-MIP（云反馈）：在 aquaplanet（水行星）设置下开展专门的通用理想化敏感性试验：SST 减 4 K 的 AMIP 模拟、abrupt0.5xCO2、太阳扰动突增试验，由 CF-MIP 与 PMIP 联合分析。

CF-MIP (cloud feedbacks): dedicated common idealized sensitivity experiments to be run in aquaplanet set up: AMIP simulations with SSTs minus 4K, abrupt0.5xCO2, abrupt solar perturbation experiments, to be co-analysed in CF-MIP and PMIP.

冰盖（ISMIP6）：评估与大冰盖相关的气候-冰冻圈相互作用和海平面变化。

ICE SHEETS (ISMIP6): Assessment of the climate and cryosphere interactions and the sea level changes associated with large ice sheets.

特别是，末次间冰期模拟将用于强迫 ISMIP6 中的冰盖模式。

In particular, the Last Interglacial simulations will be used to force ice sheet models in ISMIP6.

预计在 CMIP6 框架之外，还有 PMIP 与 ISMIP 小组联合设计的其他试验：瞬变间冰期试验（气候模式输出强迫冰盖模式）以及气候-冰盖耦合试验。

Additional experiments co-designed by the PMIP and ISMIP groups are foreseen outside the CMIP6 exercise: transient interglacial experiments, with climate model output forcing an ice sheet model, and coupled climate-ice sheet experiments.

海洋/海冰：共同评估海洋在低频变率（例如海洋热含量或热输送的多年代际变化）中的作用。

OCEAN/SEA_ICE: Mutual assessment of the role of the ocean in low-frequency variability, e.g. multi-decadal changes in ocean heat content or heat transport.

为海洋提供包含长期强迫历史的初始条件。

Provide initial conditions for the ocean including long-term forcing history.

碳循环（C4MIP）：评估碳循环演变及地球系统各子分量之间的反馈。

CARBON CYCLE (C4MIP): Assessment of carbon-cycle evolution and feedbacks between sub-components of the Earth System.

评估碳储存的古气候重建。

Evaluation of paleo reconstructions of carbon storage.

土地利用：应加强联系，以便更好地将 past1000 与历史模拟衔接起来。

LAND USE: Links should be reinforced for better connecting past1000 to historical simulations.

对于 past1000 模拟的分析，无论在生物物理还是碳循环方面都很有用。

Useful for analysis of past1000 simulations, for biophysical as well as carbon cycle aspects.

VolMIP（火山强迫）：对特定火山事件的分析对于 past1000 模拟的批判性分析非常有用。

VolMIP (volcanic forcing): analysis of specific volcanic events very useful for critical analysis of past1000 simulations.

VolMIP 将系统地评估气候对火山强迫响应中的不确定性，而 LM 模拟则在长时间瞬变模拟中描述气候对火山强迫的响应，其中相关不确定性来自所选用的火山强迫输入数据：二者共同评估强迫响应。

VolMIP would systematically assess uncertainties in the climate response to volcanic forcing, whereas LM simulations describe the climate response to volcanic forcing in long transient simulations where related uncertainties are due to chosen input data for volcanic forcing: mutual assessment of forced response.

SOLARMIP：与 VolMIP 兴趣相似，预计将在 past1000 试验分析方面开展互动。

SOLARMIP: similar interests as for VolMIP, interactions are foreseen for the analysis of the past1000 experiments.

检测/归因：长尺度千年模拟对该主题非常有用。

DETECTION/ATTRIBUTION: long millennium simulations can be very useful for this topic.

试验的潜在益处

Potential benefits of the experiments

试验对以下方面的潜在益处

Potential benefits of the experiments to

(A) 气候模拟界

(A) climate modeling community

改进对强迫响应以及强迫变化与内部变率的评估

Improved assessment of forced response and forced vs. internal variability

增进对自然强迫响应中哪些过程最为重要的认识（例如 past1000 试验中由太阳辐射变化引起的臭氧变化）

Improved knowledge on which processes are important in the forced response to natural forcing (e.g. ozone changes owing to solar radiation changes for the past1000 experiment)

(B) 综合评估模拟（IAM）界，

(B) Integrated Assessment Modelling (IAM) community,

(C) 影响、适应与脆弱性（IAV）界

(C) Impacts Adaptation and Vulnerability (IAV) community

所有试验：

All experiments:

识别不同气候条件下生态系统与水资源可得性的阈值

Identification of thresholds for ecosystems and water availability under different climate conditions

改进对自然变率（包括前工业化边界条件下的极端事件）的评估。

Improved assessment of natural variability including extreme events under preindustrial boundary conditions.

识别在自然强迫下，变化（原文如此：changes 重复）会导致特定脆弱性（如区域海平面）的区域

Identification of regions where, under natural forcing, changes, changes lead to specific vulnerability (e.g. regional sea-level)

，以及 (D) 政策制定者。

, and (D) policy makers.

量化一系列过去气候变化的幅度与速度，并与自然变率以及近期和未来的气候趋势相比较。

Quantification of magnitude and speed of a range of past climatic changes compared to the natural variability and recent and future climatic trends.

这些变化对水资源可得性与生态系统的影响。

Impact of these changes on water availability and ecosystems.

拟议试验的优先级排序

Prioritization of the proposed experiments

如有可能，请对建议的试验进行优先级排序，并说明理由**

If possible, a prioritization of the suggested experiments, including any rationale**

每项拟议的 CMIP6 PMIP 试验都可独立运行，因为它们聚焦于不同的时间段。

Each proposed PMIP experiment for CMIP6 can be run independently, because they focus on different time periods.

中全新世与 lgm 试验自 PMIP 创立以来就是其重点，可以评估自 PMIP1 首个纯大气 GCM 以来的新模式版本。

The midHolocene and lgm experiments have been the focus of PMIP since its start and allow for an evaluation of new model versions since the first atmosphere-only GCMs in PMIP1.

因此，我们要求将这两项模拟之一作为参加 PMIP-CMIP6 试验的入场券。

We therefore require one of these two simulations to be performed as an entry card to PMIP-CMIP6 experiments.

为 CMIP6 提议的全部五项 PMIP 试验具有同等优先级，每项试验都是 PMIP 内一组敏感性试验的核心。

All five PMIP experiments proposed for CMIP6 have equal priority, each experiment being the core of a set of sensitivity experiments to be run within PMIP.

PMIP 试验相对于 CMIP6 的组织结构见下图。

The organization of the PMIP experiments w.r.t CMIP6 is given in the figure below.

补充试验将由每个 PMIP 工作组（http://pmip3.lsce.ipsl.fr/groups.shtml）设计，并邀请各模式小组在此框架内加入对这些试验的讨论。

The complementary experiments will be designed by each PMIP working group (http://pmip3.lsce.ipsl.fr/groups.shtml) and modelling groups are invited to join the discussions on these experiments in this framework.

Model output

由 CMIP6 认可 MIP 归档的全部模式输出，预计将与 CMIP 输出按相同条款开放获取。

All model output archived by CMIP6-Endorsed MIPs is expected to be made available under the same terms as CMIP output.

大多数模式小组目前以不受限制使用的方式发布其 CMIP 数据。

PMIP (all experiments): no objections

List of output and process diagnostics for the CMIP DECK/CMIP6 data request**

该变量应为全部 CMIP6 试验收集，还是仅为其指定的某个子集收集；输出是需要每个试验的全时段，还是某个或某些较短时段；

whether the variable should be collected for all CMIP6 experiments, or only some specified subset and whether the output is needed from the entire length of each experiment or some shorter period or periods;

PMIP（全部试验）：与 historical/scenario 相同的 CMOR 变量集合（但鉴于试验长度，缩减高频输出集合），部分模拟使用 COSP 模拟器（部分年份）

PMIP (all experiments): same set of CMOR variables as historical/scenario (but reduced set of high-frequency output given the length of experiment), some simulations with COSP simulator (subset of years)

whether the output might only be relevant if certain components or diagnostic tools are used interactively (e.g. interactive carbon cycle or atmospheric chemistry, or only if the COSP simulator has been installed);

PMIP 全部试验：ESM 所需诊断（即 ESM 全部分量 + 强迫 + 反馈分析）+ 示踪物与同位素（列表待讨论，初稿随变量列表一同发出）

PMIP all-experiments: diagnostics needed for ESM (i.e all components of the ESM + forcings + feedback analyses) + tracers and isotopes (lists to be discussed, first draft sent along with variable lists)

该变量是否对下游用户（如影响研究人员、WG2 用户）有意义，或者其主要目的是用于理解和分析气候系统本身。

whether this variable is of interest to downstream users (such as impacts researchers, WG2 users) or whether its principal purpose is for understanding and analysis of the climate system itself.

请尽可能具体地说明为什么需要该变量。

Be as specific as possible in identifying why the variable is needed.

PMIP 全部时期：用于驱动区域气候模式、冰盖模式（ISMIP）或生态模式（陆面变量）或沙尘模式的变量子集。

PMIP all periods: subset of variables for driving regional climate models, ice-sheet models (ISMIP) or ecological models (land surface variables) or dust models.

PMIP past1000 与中全新世：用于研究极端事件或变率的变量子集

PMIP past1000 and midHolocene: subset of variables for investigating extreme events or variability

变量是否可以重新插值到统一网格，还是这样做会损失某些关键信息；

whether the variables can be regridded to a common grid, or whether there is essential information that would be compromised by doing this;

the relative importance of the various variables requested (indicated by a tiered listing) is required if the data request is large.

See also previous PMIP requests (CMIP5 or PMIP3 ESGF): same set of CMOR variables as historical/scenario (possibly reduced set of high-frequency output owing to length of experiment)

任何拟议的、相对 CMIP5 在 NetCDF 元数据（受控词汇表）、文件名及数据档案（ESGF）检索词方面的变更。**

Any proposed changes from CMIP5 in NetCDF metadata (controlled vocabularies), file names, and data archive (ESGF) search terms.**

需与所有 MIP 讨论的事项（原文如此：Needs to discussed）

Needs to discussed with all MIPs

Explanation of any proposed changes (relative to CMIP5) that will be required in CF, CMOR, and/or ESGF.**

PMIP 受益于 ESGF 上的两个条目：通过 CMIP5 项目获取 PMIP3-CMIP5 试验，或通过 PMIP3 项目获取其他 PMIP3 试验或未参加 CMIP5 的小组的试验。

PMIP benefits from two entries on ESGF: via the CMIP5 Project for PMIP3-CMIP5 experiments or the PMIP3 project for other PMIP3 experiments or for groups which do not take part in CMIP5.

如能像现在这样，在同一个系统上仍可检索两个（乃至多个 MIP 的）数据库，将非常方便。

It would be very convenient to still be able to search through both (or indeed multi-MIP) data bases on the same system, as can be done now.

用于模式评估的模式诊断与性能指标；

model diagnostics and performance metrics for model evaluation;

past1000: use diagnostics that have been defined for DECK historical/scenario simulations.

可用于评估拟议试验的观测/再分析数据产品。

observations/reanalysis data products that could be used to evaluate the proposed experiments.

说明这些产品是否可在 obs4MIPs/ana4MIPs 数据库中获得，或是否有计划将其纳入；

past1000 模拟将受益于将观测资料扩展至 19 世纪初。

past1000 simulations will benefit from observations to be extended to the early 19th century.

past1000 模拟将与古气候重建进行比对和联合分析，尤其是通过 Paleodata 数据库提供的日益增长的 PAGES2K 重建集合。

past1000 simulations will be compared, mutually analysed with paleo reconstructions, most importantly the growing set of PAGES2K reconstructions that are available through Paleodata data bases.

中全新世与 lgm 的 PMIP 数据综合（http://pmip3.lsce.ipsl.fr/synth/）

PMIP data syntheses for midHolocene and lgm (http://pmip3.lsce.ipsl.fr/synth/)

将提供新的综合资料，用于表征全新世期间的高分辨率变率（paleoVar PMIP 工作组）

new syntheses will be available for characterizing high resolution variability during the Holocene (paleoVar PMIP working group)

以开源语言（如 python、NCL、R）编写的用于模式基准检验与评估的工具、代码或脚本。

tools, code or scripts for model benchmarking and evaluation in open source languages (e.g., python, NCL, R).

PMIP 内部正在讨论通用分析脚本。

Common analyses scripts are being discussed within PMIP.

For past1000: in the framework of the PMIP working group Past2K advanced statistical analyses and evaluation tools have been developed (e.g. Bothe et al., 2013; Moberg et al., 2014).

各模式小组的参与意向

Expression of interest from modelling groups

截至 2014 年 11 月 28 日，PMIP 已收到 9 个模式小组对末次间冰期试验、10 个模式小组对中全新世、lgm 和 past1000 试验、以及 11 个模式小组对上新世暖期试验的参与意向。

On Nov 28th 2014, PMIP has received the expression of interest from 9 modelling groups for the lastInterglacial experiment, 10 modelling groups for the midHolocene, lgm and past1000 experiments and 11 modelling groups for the Pliocene Warm Period experiment.

计划中的出版物

Planned publications

PMIP-CMIP6 协议将发表于拟在 GMD 开设的 CMIP6 专刊与 PMIP 专刊。

The PMIP-CMIP6 protocols will be published in the CMIP6 and PMIP special issues to be opened in GMD.

我们还计划与参与模式小组的联系人共同撰写“首批结果论文”，发表于 GMD 或 Climate of the Past。

We also plan “first results papers” co-authoring contacts of the participating modelling groups, either in GMD or in Climate of the Past.

Appendix: message sent to all PMIP participants in June 2015

各位同仁：

Dear all,

PMIP 的 CMIP6 提案已获 CMIP 专家组认可。

The PMIP proposal for CMIP6 has been endorsed by the CMIP panel.

您可在 PMIP 网站上找到 PMIP/CMIP6 文档（总体介绍见 https://wiki.lsce.ipsl.fr/pmip3/doku.php/pmip3:cmip6:design:index，提案本身见 https://wiki.lsce.ipsl.fr/pmip3/lib/exe/fetch.php/pmip3:cmip6:design:cmip6endorsedmips_pmip.pdf）。

You can find the PMIP/CMIP6 document on the PMIP website (https://wiki.lsce.ipsl.fr/pmip3/doku.php/pmip3:cmip6:design:index for the general presentation and https://wiki.lsce.ipsl.fr/pmip3/lib/exe/fetch.php/pmip3:cmip6:design:cmip6endorsedmips_pmip.pdf for the proposal itself).

借此，我们承诺：

By doing this we committed:

- 在 GMD 的 CMIP6 专刊上发表一篇关于 PMIP 实验设计的论文，

-to a paper on the experimental design of PMIP in the CMIP6 special issue of GMD,

- 与为 PMIP 做出贡献的模式小组联合署名一篇论文来报告我们的结果。

-to report our results by co-authoring a paper jointly with the modelling groups who contribute to PMIP.

本邮件旨在介绍 PMIP 本年度的计划。

This email is to provide some information on PMIP plans for the year.

我们既要满足 CMIP 的要求，也要确保 PMIP 整体活动得到充分宣传并为学界所理解。

We have both to fulfill the CMIP requirements and to make sure PMIP activity as a whole is well advertised and understood by the community.

首先，PMIP 参与者必须为各试验的边界条件定义做出贡献。

First of all, it is important that PMIP participants contribute to the definition of the boundary conditions for the different experiments.

请在 PMIP wiki（https://wiki.lsce.ipsl.fr/pmip3/doku.php/pmip3:cmip6:design:index）上发表您的意见。

Please post your comments on the PMIP wiki (https://wiki.lsce.ipsl.fr/pmip3/doku.php/pmip3:cmip6:design:index).

您将看到针对不同试验的专门页面。

You will find dedicated pages for the different experiments.

我们还需要在试验之间做一些交叉核对，并确定一些细节。

We still have some cross checking to do between experiments and to fix some of the details.

- PMIP 对 CMIP6 GMD 专刊的贡献

- PMIP contribution to CMIP6 GMD special issue

计划发表一篇 GMD 论文（由 Masa Kageyama 牵头，其协调了 PMIP 对 CMIP6 的响应）。

A GMD paper is planned (led by Masa Kageyama, who coordinated the PMIP response to CMIP6).

这篇论文将从目标与协议两方面描述 PMIP/CMIP6 试验。

This manuscript will describe the PMIP/CMIP6 experiments in terms of objectives and protocol.

该论文的提交截止日期为 2015 年 12 月。

The deadline for submission of this paper is December 2015.

第二篇论文（协调作者待定）将记录每个模式小组如何落实协议并开展试验，并展示模拟的初步结果。

A second paper (coordinating author not identified yet) will document how each modeling groups has implemented the protocol and performed the experiments, and present preliminary results of the simulations.

这篇论文将涵盖所有做出贡献的模式小组，以表彰那些选择开展古气候模拟的模式小组。

This paper will involve all the contributing modeling groups, in order to give credit to the modeling groups who have elected to run the palaeo-simulations.

我们计划于 2016 年年中前提交这篇论文，并将联系相关人员索取信息与输出。

We plan to submit this paper by mid-2016, and will be contacting people for information and outputs.

- PMIP GMD 专刊

- PMIP GMD special issue

与 CMIP6 重点并行，我们将开设一期 PMIP GMD 专刊，作为发表介绍每个 PMIP 时期及相应试验（PMIP MIP）论文的载体。

In parallel to the CMIP6 focus, we will open a PMIP GMD special issue as a vehicle for publishing manuscripts presenting each PMIP period and corresponding experiments (PMIP MIPs).

我们预计这些 PMIP 描述性论文将于 2016 年底前定稿。

We anticipate that these PMIP description papers will be finalized by the end of 2016.

对于每个 PMIP MIP（PMIP 时期），论文将讨论试验的目标与边界条件、描述参照模拟、讨论需要敏感性试验的主要不确定性，并概述任何其他协调性或敏感性试验。

For each PMIP MIP (PMIP period) the manuscript will discuss the objectives of the experiments and the boundary conditions, describe the reference simulations, discuss major uncertainties requiring sensitivity experiments, and outline any other coordinated or sensitivity experiments.

计划是每篇论文由该 MIP 的协调人牵头；所有 MIP 参与者都将获邀为论文撰稿。

The plan is for each manuscript to be led by the coordinators of the MIP; all participants in the MIPs will be invited to contribute to the manuscript.

边界条件定义的贡献者也将被列为共同作者。

The contributors to the definition of the boundary conditions will also be included as co-authors.

PMIP 有不同类型的工作组，一些按 MIP 组织，另一些则更偏向分析。

PMIP has working groups of different types, some organized as MIP and others more oriented towards analyses.

分析类工作组也获邀为 GMD 专刊做出承诺，突出它们希望解决的关键科学问题与方法论问题。

Analytical working groups are also invited to commit to the GMD special issue highlighting the key questions they would like to address and the methodological questions.

现已为每个工作组开设了 wiki 页面，并邀请 PMIP 参与者贡献和/或牵头开展部分分析。

A wiki page has now been opened for each of the working groups and PMIP participants are invited to contribute and/or lead some of the analyses.

数据综合对于数据-模式比对和模式评估是必需的，无论是对于 CMIP6/PMIP 模拟还是其他 PMIP 模拟。

Data syntheses are required for data-model comparisons and model evaluation, both for the CMIP6/PMIP simulations and for the other PMIP simulations.

“基准检验”（benchmarking）工作组将确定正在开展哪些重要数据综合工作，以及还需要哪些额外努力。

The “benchmarking” working group will identify what major data syntheses are being undertaken and what additional efforts are required.

我们计划为 GMD CMIP6 专刊撰写一篇论文（由 Sandy Harrison 与 Patrick Bartlein 协调），记录五个 CMIP6/PMIP 时期数据的可得性，并讨论各数据集在年代模型处理、质量控制与不确定性方面的共性与差异。

We plan to produce a paper for the GMD CMIP6 special issue (coordinated by Sandy Harrison and Patrick Bartlein) that will document the availability of data for the five CMIP6/PMIP time periods and discuss communalities and differences between the data sets in the treatment of age models, quality control and uncertainties.

Everybody who is working on data syntheses for these time periods is invited to contribute to this paper, with the first step being to identify data contributions visa the “benchmarking” wiki page.
