MIP 的目标与简要概述*

Goal of the MIP and a brief overview*

RFMIP 旨在理解各模式所受的辐射强迫。

RFMIP aims to understand the radiative forcing to which models are subject.

本项目将通过把每个模式中温室气体和气溶胶的瞬时辐射强迫计算结果与覆盖现今、过去和未来气候代表性状态范围的参考计算进行比较，来评估其准确性。

The project will assess the accuracy of instantaneous radiative forcing calculations for greenhouse gases and aerosols in each model by comparing these to reference calculations across a range of states representative of present-day, past, and future climates.

我们将通过征集并分析为此目的设计的匹配模拟，仔细诊断有效辐射强迫的多样性在多大程度上源于快速调整、瞬时辐射强迫和气候背景态的变化，从而提高每个模式以及每个 DECK 或其他实验的有效辐射强迫的已知准确度和空间细节。

We will increase the accuracy and spatial detail with which effective radiative forcing is known for each model and for each DECK or other experiment by requesting and analyzing matching simulations designed for this purpose, carefully diagnosing the degree to which the diversity in effective radiative forcing is due to variations in rapid adjustments, instantaneous radiative forcing and climatological base state.

我们将通过征集历史至近未来的模拟来形成闭环，在这些模拟中人为气溶胶的光学属性和云活性属性受到严格控制，从而让我们能够确定观测到的历史记录中哪些方面始终一致地显现，因而可归因于气溶胶强迫。

We will close the circle by requesting historical-to-near-future simulations in which anthropogenic aerosol optical and cloud-active properties are tightly controlled, allowing us to determine which aspects of the observed historical record consistently emerge and so can be attributed to aerosol forcing.

本项目与 CMIP6 标准的契合如下：

The project is aligned with CMIP6 criteria as follows:

本 MIP 至少回应 CMIP6 的一个关键科学问题

The MIP addresses at least one of the key science questions of CMIP6

CMIP6 的指导性问题之一聚焦于模式对强迫的响应；若无法精确量化强迫，就无法回答这一问题。

One of the guiding questions for CMIP6 centers on models' response to forcing; it is not possible to answer this question without the ability to quantify the forcing precisely.

RFMIP 对"响应强迫"这一问题至关重要，并且与另外两个 CMIP 问题也相关。

RFMIP is central to the question of response to forcing and relevant for the other two CMIP questions.

准确诊断 CMIP 模式中的强迫及其误差，是理解各模式响应在模拟之间的离散度、以及（例如）理解任何可能的模式偏差的关键。

Accurate diagnosis of forcing and its errors in CMIP models is key to understanding the spread of models response across simulations and, for example, understanding any possible model bias.

解释预估结果同样需要理解模式所受的强迫，而理解辐射传输处理在多大程度上引入误差，是评估模式偏差的一个关键来源的核心。

Interpreting projections also requires an understanding of the forcings to which models are subject and understanding the degree to which the treatment of radiative transfer introduces errors is central to evaluating a key source of model biases.

本 MIP 在实验设计、数据格式和文档方面遵循 CMIP 标准

The MIP follows CMIP standards in terms of experimental design, data format and documentation

计算有效辐射强迫的模式积分请求遵循传统的 CMIP 协议。

Model integration requests for calculations of effective radiative forcing follow traditional CMIP protocols.

具有给定气溶胶属性的积分可能需要对现有模式进行少量代码修改，但大体上将遵循一个已经由多个建模中心通过 Easy Aerosol 项目（http://www.wcrp-climate.org/index.php/gc-clouds-circulationactivities/gc4-clouds-initiatives/368-gc-clouds-inititative3-easy-aerosol）实现并测试过的协议。

Integrations with prescribed aerosol properties may require small code changes to existing models but will largely follow a protocol that has been already implemented and tested by a number of modeling centers through the Easy Aerosol project (http://www.wcrp-climate.org/index.php/gc-clouds-circulationactivities/gc4-clouds-initiatives/368-gc-clouds-inititative3-easy-aerosol).

用于评估气溶胶光学属性的数据请求不同寻常之处在于，它请求在少数几个快照时刻的、光谱分辨率详尽的信息，但除此之外只是一个简单的诊断信息请求。

The data request for the assessment of aerosol optical properties is unusual in requesting spectrally-detailed information at a few snapshots, but otherwise is a simple request for diagnostic information.

离线辐射传输计算的请求将建立在"站点"基础设施之上。

Requests for offline radiative transfer calculations will build on the "site" infrastructure.

参考逐线计算将由 RFMIP 执行，按 CMIP 约定格式化，并通过 ESG 提供给参与的建模中心。

Reference line-by-line calculations will be performed by RFMIP, formatted to comply with CMIP conventions, and made available to participating modelling centres on the ESG.

已有足够数量的建模小组同意参加本 MIP

A sufficient number of modeling groups have agreed to participate in the MIP

这些请求是通过初步的电子邮件讨论和一次专门的研讨会（2014 年 9 月，汉堡）制定出来的。

These requests were developed through preliminary email discussions and a dedicated workshop (Hamburg, Sept, 2014).

已向气候建模小组（HadGEM、GFDL、CCCM、CanESM、ECHAM、IPSL、NorESM、MIROC）、AeroCom/AerChemMIP 以及辐射强迫界征集了意见。

Input has been solicited from climate modeling groups (HadGEM, GFDL, CCCM, CanESM, ECHAM, IPSL, NorESM, MIROC), AeroCom/AerChemMIP, and the radiative forcing community.

RFMIP 的后两个阶段是在与 EC-Earth 和 CNRM 群体的磋商下制定的。

The second two phases of RFMIP have been developed in consultation with the EC-Earth and CNRM communities.

与 CMIP 专家组进行了多轮互动。

There have been several rounds of interactions with the CMIP panel.

十一个建模小组已同意执行全部层级 1（Tier 1）的 RFMIP 计算。

Eleven modeling groups have agreed perform all Tier 1 RFMIP calculations.

本 MIP 建立在共享的 CMIP DECK 实验之上

The MIP builds on the shared CMIP DECK experiments

本项目将精确量化 4xCO2 和历史积分中的强迫；通过揭示辐射传输中的误差，它可能会减小强迫的离散度，并且将按设计缩小一组实验的强迫离散度。

The project will precisely quantify forcing in 4xCO2 and historical integrations, It may lead to decreased spread in forcing by uncovering errors in radiative transfer and will, by design, narrow the spread in forcing for one set of experiments.

承诺参与制定 CMIP6 数据请求并分析数据

A commitment to contribute to the creation of the CMIP6 data request and to analyze the data

数据请求已提供并经过完善。

Data requests have been provided and refined.

美国能源部已资助两位协调人（Pincus、Forster）开展部分分析工作。

The US DoE has funded two of the coordinators (Pincus, Forster) to perform part of the analyses.

同一提案将支持参考辐射传输计算（Mlawer、Collins、Ramaswamy）。

The same proposal will support reference radiative transfer calculations (Mlawer, Collins, Ramaswamy).

已有若干小组承诺参与分析（CICERO/UiO、Leeds、UKMO、GFDL、Colorado、Berkley、PCMDI、MPI、LMD/CNRS、GISS）。

Several groups have committed to the analyses (CICERO/UiO, Leeds, UKMO, GFDL, Colorado, Berkley, PCMDI, MPI, LMD/CNRS, GISS).

承诺确定模式评估和改进过程理解所需的观测，并直接或间接地为将这类数据集作为 obs4MIPs 的一部分提供出来作出贡献

A commitment to identify observations needed for model evaluation and improved process understanding, and to contribute directly or indirectly to making such datasets available as part of obs4MIPs

逐线模式的参考计算相当于辐射强迫领域的观测，因为它们已经过充分校准、光谱细节详尽的观测的广泛检验。

Reference calculations by line-by-line models are the radiative forcing equivalent of observations because they have been extensively tested against well-calibrated, spectrally detailed observations.

这些参考计算将在 ESG 上提供，以便各模式能够对其辐射传输进行持续的检验。

These reference calculations will be made available on the ESG so models can run ongoing tests on their radiative transfer.

晴空通量观测将为 RFMIP 的给定气溶胶试验约束辐射强迫，且已通过 ESG 分发。

Observations of clear-sky flux will constrain radiative forcing for the prescribed aerosol runs of RFMIP and are already distributed through the ESG.

所提议的实验对 CMIP6 具有核心重要性

The proposed experiment is of central importance to CMIP6

若不量化强迫，学界将无法理解模式响应的离散度。

Without quantifying forcings the community will not be able to understand the spread of model responses.

所提议的实验至少已由两个建模小组运行过

The proposed experiment has been run at least by two modeling groups already

CMIP5 中有九个建模小组执行了固定 SST 模拟。

Fixed SST simulations were performed by nine modeling groups in CMIP5.

Easy Aerosol 方法已由八个建模中心（MPI、UKMO、CAM、NCAR、GFDL、IPSL、CICERO）测试。

The Easy Aerosol methodology has been tested by eight modeling centers (MPI, UKMO, CAM, NCAR, GFDL, IPSL, CICERO).

一项在 4xCO2 条件下使用离线计算评估辐射参数化准确性的试点工作吸引了 6 个 GCM 代码（约代表 16 个建模中心）和 2 个参考代码。

A pilot assessment of radiative parameterization accuracy using offline calculations under 4xCO2 conditions attracted 6 GCM codes (representing roughly 16 modeling centers) and 2 reference codes.

RFMIP 与该原型仅在于规模不同。

RFMIP differs from this prototype only in scale.

所提议的实验在多模式背景下对众多气候研究者都有用处。

The proposed experiment is useful in a multi-model context and to a number of climate researchers.

我们的重点在于理解响应的多模式离散度，尤其是其中有多大程度源于强迫的离散、而非敏感度的离散。

Our focus is on understanding the multi-model spread in response, especially the degree to which this is due to spread in forcing as opposed to spread in sensitivity.

这按定义对于确定系统性偏差的来源至关重要。

This is by definition essential for establishing origins of systematic biases.

我们期望非常广泛的研究群体能充分利用我们请求的数据和我们所做的参考计算。

We expect a very wide community to take full advantage of the data we request and the reference calculations we make.

我们获得了其他提议中的 MIP（例如 AerChemMIP、LUMIP、PDRMIP、VolMIP、ScenarioMIP）的支持。

We have support from other proposed MIPs (e.g. AerChemMIP, LUMIP, PDRMIP, VolMIP, ScenarioMIP).

承诺对所提议的实验进行科学分析、评估和利用。

A commitment to scientifically analyze, evaluate and exploit the proposed experiment.

项目负责人及其团队是 CMIP 及相关模式结果的非常活跃的发表者。

The PIs and their groups are very active publishers of CMIP and related model results.

我们期望本项目的成果能对经过同行评议的文献作出重要贡献。

We expect the results of the project to make important contributions to the refereed literature.

所提议实验的概述*

An overview of the proposed experiments*

RFMIP-IRF-AER：我们将请求关于气溶胶和地表在垂直方向和光谱上分辨的光学属性的详细诊断信息，以及关于大气物理和化学状态的详细信息，用于现今和工业革命前条件下的快照。

RFMIP-IRF-AER: We will request detailed diagnostic information on the vertically- and spectrally-resolved optical properties of aerosols and the surface, along with detailed information about atmospheric physical and chemical state, for snapshots at present-day and pre-industrial conditions.

这些信息将与对晴空瞬时辐射强迫的模式计算的请求相配对。

These will be paired with requests for model computations of clear-sky instantaneous radiative forcing.

这将使载荷与光学属性之间关系的多样性得以量化，并提供准确性评估所需的数据。

These will allow the diversity in relationships between burden and optical properties to be quantified and will provide data required for accuracy assessments.

RFMIP-IRF-GHG：我们将请求用与模式在线版本完全相同的离线辐射传输模式，计算垂直分辨的宽波段积分长波和短波通量，

RFMIP-IRF-GHG: We will request calculations of vertically-resolved broadband-integrated longwave and shortwave fluxes made with off-line radiative transfer models identical to the model's online

使用指定的多个廓线的大气状态（温度和湿度分布）和地表属性。

version, using specified atmospheric states (distribution of temperature and humidity) and surface properties over many profiles.

一系列这样的计算将评估各种条件下气体辐射传输近似的准确性。

A series of such calculations will assess the accuracy of radiative transfer approximations for gases under various conditions.

RFMIP-ERF：我们将请求一系列 30 年非耦合（仅大气+陆面）模拟，其中海表温度和海冰浓度取自该模式工业革命前的 AOGCM 控制模拟。

RFMIP-ERF: We will request a series of 30-year uncoupled (atmosphere+land only) simulations with prescribed sea-surface temperatures and sea-ice concentrations from the preindustrial AOGCM control simulation of the model.

每个模拟都与 DECK 或其他某个 MIP 的现有模拟相匹配，从而能够准确诊断该实验的有效辐射强迫。

Each simulation is matched to an existing simulation from the DECK or some other MIP and will enable the accurate diagnosis of effective radiative forcing for this experiment.

直接辐射强迫和快速调整可以用新开发的核方法进行分析。

Direct radiative forcing and rapid adjustments can be analyzed using newly developed kernel methodologies.

固定海表温度的更长积分，与所提议的 DAMIP AOGCM 历史模拟和 RCP8.5 模拟配对，将使我们能够计算瞬态辐射强迫。

Longer runs with fixed sea-surface temperature, paired with the proposed DAMIP AOGCM historical and RCP8.5 simulations, will allow us to calculate transient radiative forcings.

RFMIP-Historical：我们将请求 1850 年至 2020 年"历史+情景"耦合模拟的小型集合，其中光谱相关的人为气溶胶光学属性和云相互作用被直接给定。

RFMIP-Historical: We will request small ensembles of "historical+scenario" coupled runs from 1850 to 2020 in which spectrally-dependent anthropogenic aerosol optical properties and cloud interactions are directly prescribed.

请求的模拟有三种类型：包含全部强迫的历史模拟、仅含自然强迫的历史模拟（此处将使用 DAMIP 模拟），以及（优先级较低）仅含非温室气体强迫的历史模拟。

Three types of simulations are being requested: historical simulations with all forcings, historical simulations with only natural forcings (here the DAMIP simulations will be used) and, at lower priority, historical simulations with only non-GHG forcing.

随时间变化、具有空间型态的给定值将基于模式与观测混合的气候态。

The time-dependent spatially-patterned prescription will be based on a hybrid model-observation climatology.

这种方法已在 MPI-ESM 中开发并实现。

Such an approach has already been developed and implemented within the MPI-ESM.

一个非平稳性因子将用于考虑逐日变化。

A non-stationarity factor will account for day-to-day variations.

这些模拟将用于评估在气溶胶直接和间接效应受约束的集合中，历史时期的哪些方面稳健地显现出来。

These simulations will be used to assess which aspects of the historical period emerge robustly from ensembles in which aerosol direct and indirect effects are constrained.

对 CMIP DECK 和 CMIP6 实验的拟议评估/分析概述*

An overview of the proposed evaluation/analysis of the CMIP DECK and CMIP6 experiments*

我们不会孤立地对 DECK 或其他实验进行直接分析。

We will perform no direct analysis of DECK or other experiments in isolation.

辐射参数化准确性评估（RFMIP-GHG、RFMIP-AER）适用于大多数 DECK 实验，尤其适用于 AMIP、耦合历史模拟和 4xCO2 实验。

The assessment of radiative parameterization accuracy (RFMIP-GHG, RFMIP-AER) is applicable to most DECK experiments, but especially the AMIP, coupled historical, and 4xCO2 experiments.

30 年固定 SST/海冰模拟（RFMIP-ERF）将使我们能够为 DECK 的耦合历史模拟和 4xCO2 实验，以及检测与归因 MIP（人为、均匀混合温室气体、气溶胶+臭氧、自然）和土地利用 MIP（土地利用）所请求的模拟，确定有效辐射强迫、快速调整和直接辐射强迫的准确区域变化。

Thirty year fixed SST/sea-ice simulations (RFMIP-ERF) will allow us to determine accurate regional variations of effective radiative forcing, rapid adjustments and direct radiative forcing for the DECK's coupled historical, and 4xCO2 experiments, and for simulations requested by the Detection and Attribution MIP (anthropogenic, well-mixed greenhouse gases, aerosols+ozone, natural) and Land Use MIP (land use).

具有给定人为气溶胶光学属性的模拟（RFMIP-Historical）将为 DECK 中已有的历史耦合模拟提供有益的补充，并将补充检测与归因 MIP 下的活动。

Simulations with prescribed anthropogenic aerosol optical properties (RFMIP-Historical) will provide a useful complement to historical coupled simulations present in the DECK and will complement activities under the Detection and Attribution MIP.

它们将用于检验这样一个假设：强于 -1 W/m2 的现今气溶胶强迫与 1950 年之前的温度记录不相容。

They will be used to evaluate the hypothesis that a present day aerosol forcing stronger than -1 W/m2 is incompatible with the temperature record prior to 1950.

Proposed timing*

诊断有效辐射强迫所需的模拟请求（包括所需的诊断场规格说明）现已提供。

Requests for simulations required to diagnose effective radiative forcing, including specification of the diagnostic fields are required, are available now.

气溶胶诊断输出的详细请求（CMOR 表）正在定稿中。

Detailed requests (CMOR tables) for aerosol diagnostic outputs are being finalized.

离线辐射计算的大气规格说明将在 2015 年底前提供。

Prescriptions of aerosol optical properties to be used in specified-aerosol simulations will be available by the end of 2015.

RFMIP-IRF-AER 的气溶胶诊断请求

They will also provide the basis for the sampling of aerosol optical properties needed to assess radiative transfer errors in the project's next stage.

RFMIP-IRF-GHG 的离线辐射传输计算

Offline radiative transfer calculations for RFMIP-IRF-GHG

离线辐射传输计算旨在确定辐射传输误差在多大程度上造成瞬时辐射强迫估计的多样性，以及该误差如何依赖于大气背景状态和强迫本身。

Offline radiative transfer calculations are intended to identify the degree to which errors in radiative transfer contribute to diversity in estimates of instantaneous radiative forcing, and how this error depends on the background state of the atmosphere and on the forcing itself.

这些计算需要基础设施投入（创建或改造一个可追溯到在线版本的离线辐射传输代码），但计算负担非常小。

These calculations require an investment in infrastructure (the creation or adaptation of an off-line radiative transfer code traceable to the on-line version) but are a very small computational burden.

层级 1

TIER 1

这些计算为现今（PD，2015）和工业革命前（PI，1850）条件、用于评估平衡气候敏感度的强迫（4xCO2），以及用于评估快速调整的条件（PD+4K）提供基线误差估计。

These calculations provide baseline error estimates at present-day (PD, 2015) and pre-industrial (PI, 1850) conditions, for the forcing used to assess equilibrium climate sensitivity (4xCO2) and under conditions used to assess rapid adjustments (PD+4K).

我们请求对一组指定大气条件进行以下晴空计算。

We request the following clear sky calculations for a set of prescribed atmospheric conditions.

1. PD 温室气体浓度配 PD 大气（无气溶胶）

1. PD greenhouse gas concentrations with PD atmospheres (aerosol-free)

2. PI greenhouse gas concentrations with PD atmospheres (aerosol-free)

4. PD greenhouse gas concentrations in PD+4K conditions, assuming constant relative humidity and using a vertical shift transform to map surface warming to atmospheric structure (aerosol-free)

5. "未来"：结合 CO2、温度和湿度的同步增加（无气溶胶）

5. "Future" combining simultaneous increases in CO2, temperature, and humidity (aerosol free)

这些计算探究 CO2 强迫在一系列浓度下的准确性，这些浓度涵盖与过去数值（与 PMIP 的末次盛冰期计算相关）及未来浓度相关的范围。

These calculations explore the accuracy of CO2 forcing across a range of concentrations relevant to past values (relevant for Last Glacial Maximum calculations for PMIP) and future concentrations.

所有计算均使用无气溶胶、晴空的 PD 大气条件，CO2 浓度取自 {0.25, 0.5, 2, 3, 8} 倍 PI 值。

诊断 RFMIP-ERF 有效辐射强迫的模式积分

Model integrations to diagnose effective radiative forcing for RFMIP-ERF

模式积分请求旨在使基于排放的框架和给定浓度的框架都能给出一致的辐射强迫；我们建议 CMIP6 在所有 MIP 中统一采用这一计算辐射强迫的方法，并建议其他 MIP 尽可能与 RFMIP 挂钩。

Model integration requests are designed to give consistent radiative forcings in both emission-based and prescribed-concentration frameworks and we recommend that CMIP6 standardizes to this methodology for computing radiative forcings across all MIPs and that other MIPs link to RFMIP as far as possible.

RFMIP 专注于理解从工业革命前（PI，1850）到现今（PD，2015）的强迫变化。

RFMIP concentrates on understanding forcing changes from preindustrial (PI, 1850) to present day (PD, 2015).

时间切片实验的协议是单个 30 年非耦合模拟，其中海表温度（SST）和海冰分布被指定，植被可以相互作用。

The protocol for time-slice experiments is a single 30-year uncoupled simulation in which sea surface temperature (SST) and sea ice distributions are specified and vegetation may interact.

除非另有说明，海冰和人为强迫因子均按 PI 值指定。

Sea ice and anthropogenic forcing agents are specified at PI values unless noted.

对该方法的检验表明，30 年积分可将大范围的区域强迫型态约束到优于 0.1 Wm-2。

Tests of this method demonstrate that 30-year integrations constrain broad regional patterns of forcing to better than 0.1 Wm-2.

层级 1

TIER 1

这些积分将使我们能够量化现今的辐射强迫。

These integrations will allow us to quantify the radiative forcing at present day.

我们请求以下积分：

We request the following integrations:

a) 30 年 PI 控制模拟，使用来自 PI AOGCM 控制积分的月平均固定 SST 和海冰气候态。

a) 30 year PI control with monthly averaged fixed SST and sea-ice climatology from the PI AOGCM control integration.

用作所有其他积分的对照。

To be used as control for all other integrations

b) 同 a)，加 4xCO2

b) As a) with 4xCO2

c) 同 a)，加 PD 人为强迫因子

c) As a) with PD ANTHROPOGENIC forcers

d) 同 a)，加 PD 均匀混合温室气体（在基于排放的模式中加间接效应）

d) As a) with PD WMGHGs (+indirect effects in emission based models)

e) 同 a)，加 PD 气溶胶和臭氧（与 AerChemMIP 的额外强迫估计挂钩）

e) As a) with PD AEROSOLS and OZONE (linking to additional forcing estimates from AerChemMIP)

f) 同 a)，加 PD 土地利用（地表反照率/粗糙度、蒸腾）。
改变植被，但将温室气体浓度固定在工业革命前水平。
（与 LUMIP 挂钩）

f) As a) with PD LAND USE (surface albedo/roughness, transpiration).
Change vegetation but fix GHG concentrations and preindustrial levels.
(linking to LUMIP)

气溶胶云相互作用的非线性对于理解历史强迫演变尤为重要（Carslaw et al., 2013）。

Non-linearity of aerosol cloud interactions are particularly important for understanding historical forcing evolution (Carslaw et al., 2013).

这两个实验旨在在模式之间量化这一点。

These two experiments are designed to quantify this across the models.

TIER2b

现今以外时期的强迫对于理解历史和未来变化的某些方面非常重要。

Forcings at periods other than present are important for understanding aspects of historical and future change.

不同的应用很可能需要不同的时间切片。

Different applications will likely require different time-slices.

用层级 1 的时间切片方法评估瞬态的火山和太阳强迫也很困难。

It is also difficult to evaluate transitory volcanic and solar forcing using a time-slice methodology of Tier 1.

因此我们提议评估整个 1850-2100 时期的强迫，重点是层级 1 未评估的自然强迫。

Therefore we propose to evaluate forcings over the full 1850-2100 period, concentrating on natural forcings not evaluated in Tier 1.

CMIP5 模式的瞬态强迫依赖一种粗略的两步残差法来诊断全球平均 ERF 估计（Forster and Taylor, 2006; Forster et al., 2013）。

Transient forcings from CMIP5 models relied on a crude two-step residual method to diagnose globally averaged ERF estimates (Forster and Taylor, 2006; Forster et al., 2013).

该方法假设基于 CO2 的气候敏感度适用于所有情景，并且该方法因噪声而存在显著误差。

This method assumed that a CO2-based climate sensitivity was applicable across scenarios and the method had significant errors due to noise.

两步法是 CMIP6 的一种可能备选方案。

The two-step method is a possible fall-back for CMIP6.

两步法可以通过使用固定 SST 和海冰（PD ctrl）的瞬态气候模式积分加以改进。

The two-step method can be improved on by using transient climate model integrations with fixed SST and sea ice (PD ctrl).

HadGEM2 的初步工作表明，用这种方法需要三个集合成员才能将全球强迫的年际变化约束到优于 0.1 Wm-2。

Preliminary work with HadGEM2 indicates that three ensemble members with this method would be needed to constrain interannual variation on global forcing to better than 0.1 Wm-2.

需要进一步的工作来核实不同集合规模的数量准确性。

Further work is needed to verify the number of accuracy of different ensemble sizes.

我们将请求 1850-2100 年固定 SST 和海冰气候积分（包括交互式植被）的小型集合。

We will request small ensembles of 1850-2100 fixed SST and sea ice climate integrations (including interactive vegetation).

这些请求与 DAMIP AOGCM 的请求相匹配，从而形成强迫与响应积分成对一致，最大化科学收益。

These requests are matches of DAMIP AOGCM requests to have pairs of consistent forcing and response integrations, maximizing the science benefit.

i) 历史 + RCP8.5（全强迫积分），强迫加在 a) 的 PI 控制之上

i) Historical + RCP8.5 (all forcing integration) with forcings added to PI control from a)

j) 自然（太阳和火山）强迫加在 a) 之上，仅到 2015 年

j) Natural (solar and volcanoes) forcings added to a), only to 2015

k) 气溶胶（及其间接效应）加在 a) 之上，

k) Aerosols (and their indirect effects) added to a),

l) 均匀混合温室气体变化加在 a) 之上

l) WMGHG changes added to a)

TIER 3

瞬态均匀混合温室气体强迫很可能可以从层级 1 的结果中推断出来。

Transient WMGHG forcing can likely be inferred from tier 1 results.

不过，DAMIP 提议了一个瞬态 AOGCM 均匀混合温室气体试验，在少数几个模式中检验其强迫是有益的。

However, a transient AOGCM WMGHG run is proposed by DAMIP and it is useful to check its forcing in a few models.

RFMIP-Historical 的指定气溶胶属性模式积分

Model integrations with specified aerosol properties for RFMIP-Historical

此处我们请求气溶胶光学属性（包括云-辐射相互作用）被给定的积分。

Here we request integrations in which aerosol optical properties including cloud-radiation interactions are prescribed.

该给定值预期是一个单一的可解析描述的空间型态，具有时间恒定的光谱变化（建立在 Easy Aerosols 经验之上）和随时间变化的强度。

The prescription is expected to be a single analytically-described spatial pattern with time-constant spectral variation (building on the Easy Aerosols experience) and time-varying strength.

我们的目标是确定在人为气溶胶辐射强迫受到严格约束的集合中，历史记录的哪些方面稳健地显现出来。

Our goal is to determine which aspects of the historical record robustly emerge from ensembles in which the radiative forcing by anthropogenic aerosols is tightly constrained.

RFMIP 的核心目标之一是确保所有模式使用共同的气溶胶光学属性给定值。

One of the central aims of RFMIP it to ensure that all models use a common prescription of aerosol optical properties.

过去曾有一种想法，即可以使用基于浓度的气溶胶属性给定值，例如取自基于排放的气溶胶模式的集合平均。

In the past there has been the idea that one could use a concentration based aerosol prescription of aerosol properties derived, for instance, from the ensemble average of emission based aerosol models.

这一策略有若干缺点，曾在以往几轮 CMIP 中导致令人困惑的不一致：

This strategy has several drawbacks that have led to confusing inconsistencies in previous iterations of CMIP:

(1) AerChemMIP 的实验设计雄心很大，以致多模式平均的气候态强迫要很晚才能获得，而且将没有机会对其进行彻底评估。

(1) AerChemMIP has an ambitious experimental design so that climatological forcing from the multi-model mean will only become available very late and there will not be a chance to thoroughly evaluate it.

(2) AerChemMIP 各模式对气溶胶的描述高度异质，因此多模式平均意味着对不同子集合取不同的平均。

(2) The AerChemMIP models have a very heterogeneous description of the aerosol so a multi-model mean implies different averages over different sub-ensembles.

由于不同子集合中变化的气溶胶组分之间存在相关性，这种做法是不可靠的（即，含硝酸盐的模式通常硫酸盐强迫较小，因为这些物种相互关联）。

This is unsound because of correlations in varying aerosol components in the different sub-ensembles (i.e., models with nitrate usually have smaller sulfate forcing because these species are linked).

(3) 基于浓度的做法的数据量很大。

(3) The data volumes for a concentration-based are large.

过去的经验表明，将它们插值到不同的模式网格容易出错。

Past experience has shown that interpolating them to the different model grids is error prone.

(4) 由基于排放的模式导出的强迫场与当前对气溶胶分布的理解不一致。

(4) The forcing fields derived from the emission-based models are inconsistent with present understanding of the aerosol distribution.

打个比方来说，这就好比用基于排放的模式得到的 CO2 浓度的多模式平均来驱动历史模拟，而不是将 CO2 浓度与我们现今和过去记录的理解相挂钩。

To put this in context it would be like forcing the historical simulations with the multi-model mean of the CO2 concentrations from the emission based models rather than tying the CO2 concentrations to our understanding of the present and past record.

基于这些理由，我们认为 AerChemMIP 专注于"理解排放如何影响浓度以及不同模式预测的浓度所对应的辐射强迫"这一重要问题；但是，对于旨在探索历史记录并满足 DAMIP 的模拟，CMIP 专家组应建议建模中心使用 RFMIP 的气溶胶给定值。

For these reasons we see AerChemMIP as focusing on the important problem of our understanding of how emissions effect concentrations and the radiative forcing associated with the concentrations predicted by different models but that, for simulations designed to explore the historical record and to satisfy DAMIP, the CMIP panel should recommend that modeling centers use the RFMIP prescription of aerosols.

我们乐于与排放界和 AerChemMIP 合作，将拟议用于 CMIP 的气溶胶气候态扩展到未来，这对执行 Scenario 试验或近期预估的模式会有用处。

We are happy to work with the emissions community and AerChemMIP to extend the aerosol climatology proposed for use in CMIP to the future, which would be useful for models performing the Scenario runs or near term projections.

我们与 HighResMIP 保持密切联系；他们非常有兴趣使用 RFMIP 的气溶胶给定值，特别是考虑到第 (1) 点和第 (3) 点。

We are in close contact with HighResMIP; they are very interested in using the RFMIP prescription of the aerosol particularly in light of points (1) and (3).

ScenarioMIP (Scenario MIP) ｜ 情景模式比较计划（上）

 MIP 目标与简要概述*：总体目标

 Goal of the MIP and a brief overview* Overall objectives

ScenarioMIP 的目标是基于不同的合理¹未来情景模拟未来气候结果，以便：

The goal of ScenarioMIP is to simulate future climate outcomes based on alternative plausible1 future scenarios in order to:

（1）促进综合研究，从而不仅更好地理解这些情景对物理气候系统造成的后果，而且更好地理解其对社会的气候影响，包括对减缓与适应的考量。

(1) Facilitate integrated research leading to a better understanding not only of the physical climate system consequences of these scenarios, but also of the climate impact on societies, including considerations of mitigation and adaptation.

ScenarioMIP 实验的结果将为合理的未来情景提供新的气候信息，从而促进跨越多个群体的综合研究，包括（1）气候科学、（2）综合评估建模（IAM）与减缓、以及（3）影响、适应与脆弱性（IAV）群体。

The results of the ScenarioMIP experiments will provide new climate information for plausible future scenarios that will facilitate integrated research across multiple communities including the (1) climate science, (2) integrated assessment modeling (IAM) and mitigation, and (3) impacts, adaptation and vulnerability (IAV) communities.

（2）为解决关于与基于情景的研究相关的强迫特定方面之气候效应的针对性科学问题提供基础，例如：关于土地利用与近期气候强迫因子（NTCF，如对流层气溶胶、臭氧和甲烷）的不同假设对气候变化及其影响的作用。

(2) Provide a basis for addressing targeted science questions regarding the climate effects of particular aspects of forcing relevant to scenario-based research, e.g., the effect of different assumptions on land use and near-term climate forcers (NTCFs), such as tropospheric aerosols, ozone and methane, on climate change and its impacts.

¹ 我们将“合理”狭义地定义为：在模式中可行实现、且已在同行评议文献中作为旨在被视为合理未来的情景发表的结果（区别于敏感性分析、思想实验或对未来的其他刻画方式）。

1 We define plausible in a narrow sense as outcomes feasible to achieve in a model and published in the peer reviewed literature as scenarios intended to be considered as plausible futures (as opposed to sensitivity analyses, thought experiments, or other characterizations of the future).

（3）为各类旨在改进基于多模式集合量化预估不确定性的方法的国际工作提供基础，同时考虑模式性能、模式依赖性与观测不确定性（这拓展了源自 DECK 实验和 CMIP6 历史模拟的知识基础，并允许在不同时间尺度上量化不确定性）。

(3) Provide a basis for various international efforts that target improved methods to quantify projection uncertainties based on multi-model ensembles, taking into account model performance, model dependence and observational uncertainty (this extends the knowledge basis derived from the DECK experiments and the CMIP6 Historical Simulation and allows for the quantification of uncertainties on different timescales).

在气候研究所涉各学科中提供“用于整合的情景”这一首要目标被认为是最高优先级，理由如下：

The first objective on providing “scenarios for integration” across the disciplines involved in climate research is considered to be the highest priority for the following reasons:

 用于整合的情景服务于庞大的科学受众，支撑着数百项基于情景的研究，这些研究涉及物理气候变化、减缓、影响与适应方面各种各样的科学问题。

 Scenarios for integration serve a large scientific audience, underpinning hundreds of scenariobased studies addressing a wide variety of scientific questions regarding physical climate changes, mitigation, impacts, and adaptation.

拥有共同的气候与社会经济情景，是增强各类研究直接可比性的关键手段，使我们得以得出综合性的结论——而若依赖各种互不协调的研究，这类结论是无法获得的。

Having common climate and socioeconomic scenarios serves as a critical means to enhance direct comparability of a wide variety of studies, allowing synthetic conclusions to be drawn that would not be possible from a variety of uncoordinated studies.

 基于此类广泛使用情景的气候模拟，是 2007 年在 Noordwijkerhout 建立的新情景流程的关键要素（Moss 等，2007；2010）；如果没有气候模拟来支持同时利用气候与社会未来的综合研究，该情景流程便无法运转。

 Climate simulations based on such broad-use scenarios are critical elements of the new scenario process established at Noordwijkerhout in 2007 (Moss et al., 2007; 2010); without climate simulations to support integrated studies that draw on both climate and societal futures, the scenario process cannot function.

CMIP5 模拟将继续支撑这一流程直至 2020 年，而 CMIP6 情景被视为这一贡献的关键延续。

CMIP5 simulations will continue to underpin this process through 2020, and CMIP6 scenarios are seen as a critical continuation of that contribution.

 用于整合的情景是连接 IPCC 各工作组评估以及综合报告的关键手段。

 Scenarios for integration serve as a key means for connecting the assessments of different working groups of IPCC as well as in the Synthesis Report.

 一套共同的用于整合的情景，减少了各研究项目为支持基于情景的研究而自行开发情景信息的需求。

 A common set of scenarios for integration reduces the need for individual research projects to develop their own scenario information to support scenario-based studies.

共同情景的可获得性减少了工作可能出现的重复，并使许多原本无法开展基于情景研究的团队得以开展此类研究。

The availability of common scenarios reduces possible redundancy in efforts and makes scenario-based research feasible for many groups that otherwise would not be able to carry it out.

由于关于单个强迫与强迫路径之气候效应的针对性问题对基于情景的研究同样非常重要，其他 MIP（见下文）正在提出此处所拟情景的一组变体，以解决这些针对性问题。

Because targeted questions regarding the climate effects of individual forcings and forcing pathways are also very important to scenario-based research, a set of variants of the scenarios proposed here are being proposed in other MIPs (see below) to address these targeted questions.

因此，ScenarioMIP 中的情景不仅发挥跨研究群体整合的功能，而且充当锚定情景，以此为基础设计变体，用于解决 AerChemMIP、C4MIP、DAMIP、GeoMIP、ISMIP6、LUMIP 和 RFMIP 中的针对性问题。

Thus, the scenarios in ScenarioMIP not only serve the function of integration across research communities, but also serve as anchoring scenarios from which variants are designed to address targeted questions in AerChemMIP, C4MIP, DAMIP, GeoMIP, ISMIP6, LUMIP, and RFMIP.

此外，ScenarioMIP 提出的部分情景将被用作 DCPP MIP 短期预测、CORDEX 区域降尺度以及 ClimateServicesMIP 提供气候信息的基础。

In addition, some of the scenarios proposed by ScenarioMIP will be used as a basis for short-term predictions by DCPP MIP, for regional downscaling in CORDEX, and for provision of climate information by ClimateServicesMIP.

本文档讨论其他 MIP 中的实验如何与 ScenarioMIP 的设计相关联。

This document discusses how the experiments in the other MIPs relate to the design of ScenarioMIP.

背景

Background

在 2013 年 10 月 WGCM17 会议之后，ScenarioMIP 科学指导委员会成立；这是此前 IAM、IAV 与气候建模群体在 2013 年 7 月于科罗拉多州 Snowmass 举行的综合评估与影响群体年会、以及 2013 年 8 月于科罗拉多州 Aspen 举行的 AGCI CMIP6 专题会议讨论的结果。

A ScenarioMIP Scientific Steering Committee was formed following the October 2013 WGCM17 meeting as an outcome of earlier discussions among the IAM, IAV and climate modeling communities at the annual meeting of the integrated assessment and impacts communities in Snowmass, CO, in July 2013, and the AGCI session on CMIP6 in Aspen, CO, in August 2013.

科学指导委员会与其他群体（见下文）一道，系统地研究了若干可能对实验设计产生重大影响的问题，包括：对气候模式—情景组合进行统计抽样的可能性；利用型态缩放（pattern scaling）或其他气候模式输出的统计仿真器来满足部分基于情景的气候信息需求的可能性²；以及为了在网格单元水平上产生显著不同的气候结果，各情景之间（在全球平均强迫或温度变化方面）所需存在的差异。

The Scientific Steering Committee together with other communities (see below) systematically investigated a number of issues that could substantially influence the experimental design, including the possibility of statistically sampling climate model-scenario combinations, the potential for pattern scaling or other statistical emulators of climate model output to meet some of the demand for scenario-based climate information,2 and the differences between scenarios (in terms of global average forcing or temperature change) that is required to produce climate outcomes that are significantly different at the grid-cell level.

² 2014 年 4 月，ScenarioMIP 联合主席等人组织了一次为期三天的型态缩放研讨会来探讨这一问题，详见 https://www2.image.ucar.edu/event/PS2014（网址保留原文）。

2 A three-day workshop on pattern scaling was organized by ScenarioMIP co-chairs and others in April 2014 to address this question, see https://www2.image.ucar.edu/event/PS2014.

这些调查得出的结论是：采用稀疏统计抽样的设计方法不可行；型态缩放尚未被证明能够可靠地取代气候模式模拟，来为影响研究生成信息（尽管它在某些应用中可能发挥有限作用）；并且，全球平均温度至少 0.3 °C 的情景差异，可能是在地表相当大一部分区域产生统计上显著的局地温度和降水结果差异所必需的。

Conclusions of these investigations were that a sparse statistical sampling approach to design was unworkable, that pattern scaling has not yet been demonstrated to be able to reliably replace the need for climate model simulations to generate information for impact studies (although it might play a limited role for some applications), and that scenario differences of at least 0.3 C in global average temperature are likely necessary to generate statistically significant differences in local temperature and precipitation outcomes over a substantial fraction of the surface.

基于这些结论，ScenarioMIP 科学指导委员会组织了一个流程，来制定本最终协议。

Informed by these conclusions, a process was organized by the ScenarioMIP Scientific Steering Committee to develop this final protocol.

这一流程包括：通过 2014 年夏在 Snowmass 和 Aspen 举行的后续会议与气候研究、IAM 和 IAV 群体密切互动；与为 CMIP6 制定候选情景的 IAMC 情景工作组代表进行讨论；以及与其他相关研究群体的关键人士进行讨论，包括通过新综合气候变化评估情景国际委员会（ICONICS）和 2014 年 9 月在瑞士伯尔尼举行的 WCRP-IPCC 第一工作组会议。

This process included close interaction with the climate research, IAM and IAV communities through follow-up meetings at Snowmass and Aspen in summer 2014, discussions with representatives of the IAMC Working Group on Scenarios producing candidate scenarios for CMIP6, and discussions with key individuals in other relevant research communities, including through the International Committee On New Integrated Climate change assessment Scenarios (ICONICS) and the WCRP-IPCC WG1 meeting in Bern, Switzerland, in September 2014.

该提案提交给了 2014 年 10 月的 WGCM18 会议并在会上进行了讨论；随后根据该会议的反馈、与其他 MIP 提案的进一步协调、以及 11 月综合评估建模联盟（IAMC）年会上对该提案演示的反馈进行了修订；并于 2014 年 12 月初重新提交给 CMIP 专家组。

That proposal was submitted to and discussed at the October 2014 WGCM18 meeting; revised to reflect feedback at that meeting, additional coordination with other MIP proposals, and feedback from a presentation of the proposal at the annual meeting of the Integrated Assessment Modeling Consortium (IAMC) in November; and resubmitted to the CMIP panel in early December 2014.

该版本的提案描述了基本完整的实验设计，但留有一些设计细节待定；这些细节的最终决定需要 IAV 和 IAM 群体提供更多信息（特别是关于基于 IAM 的排放和土地利用情景的具体结果），并需要与其他 MIP 进一步协调。

That version of the proposal described a largely complete experimental design, but left open a number of details of the design for which final decisions required additional information from the IAV and IAM communities (particularly regarding the specific outcomes of IAM-based emissions and land use scenarios) as well as additional coordination with other MIPs.

自那时起，我们与 IAM 和 IAV 群体密切互动，与若干其他 MIP 共同讨论了实验设计，并从 CMIP 评审流程、以及我们将提案分发给相关团体（包括 ICONICS、TGICA 和 WCRP 区域气候工作组（WGRC））的过程中获得了对提案草案的反馈。

Since that time we have interacted closely with the IAM and IAV communities, jointly discussed experimental designs with several other MIPs, and also received feedback on the draft proposal from the CMIP review process as well as from our own circulation of the proposal to relevant groups including ICONICS, TGICA, and the WCRP Working Group on Regional Climate (WGRC).

基于这一系列互动与反馈，以及 2015 年 5 月 IPCC 情景专家会议的反馈和 CMIP 专家组提供的评审意见，本提案的最终版本对上一版提交内容进行了多处修改。

This final version of the proposal includes a number of changes to the previous submission based on this set of interactions and feedback, as well as on feedback from an IPCC expert meeting on Scenarios in May 2015 and from review comments provided by the CMIP panel.

展望未来，若 ScenarioMIP 获得 CMIP 专家组的正式批准，ScenarioMIP 科学指导委员会（SSC）计划在 2015 年底前撰写并提交一篇关于 ScenarioMIP 实验设计的论文，作为《Geoscientific Model Development》期刊 CMIP6 专刊的一部分。

Moving forward, and contingent on formal approval of ScenarioMIP by the CMIP Panel, the ScenarioMIP SSC plans to write and submit a paper before the end of 2015 on the ScenarioMIP experimental design as part of the CMIP6 special issue in Geoscientific Model Development.

我们还计划与所有参与的建模团队合作撰写一篇论文，介绍气候模式模拟的结果（待其结果可用时），并推进下列科学问题领域的研究。

We also plan to co-author a paper with all participating modeling groups on the results of climate model simulations when they become available and to move forward research in the area of the scientific questions listed below.

科学问题

Scientific questions

ScenarioMIP 拟议实验所针对的科学问题，属于 CMIP6 关注的两大宏观问题，具体如下：

The scientific questions addressed by the experiments proposed in ScenarioMIP fall under two of the broad questions of interest to CMIP6, as follows:

1. 地球系统如何响应强迫？

1. How does the Earth system respond to forcing?

o 地球系统如何响应与 IAM 和 IAV 研究及政策考量相关的强迫路径？

o How does the Earth system respond to forcing pathways relevant to IAM and IAV research and to policy considerations?

o 未来土地利用和 NTCF 排放的合理变化所导致的全球和区域气候变化不确定性有多大？它与多模式在给定强迫路径响应中的不确定性相比如何？

o What is the uncertainty in global and regional climate change due to plausible variations in future land use and NTCFs emissions, and how does it compare to multimodel uncertainty in the response to a given forcing pathway?

o 强迫路径的不同合理形态（如超调）对气候变化结果、进而对减缓、影响与适应问题有多大的影响？

o How much do plausible alternative shapes of forcing pathways (e.g. overshoot) matter to climate change outcomes, and therefore to questions about mitigation, impacts, and adaptation?

o 由模式不确定性（而非情景差异）引起的全球和区域气候不确定性有多大？在没有专门设计来抽样不确定性的情况下，如何利用“机会型”模式集合（model ensemble of opportunity）来估计这种不确定性？

o What is the uncertainty in global and regional climate as a result of model uncertainty (as opposed to scenario variations), and how can this be estimated from a model ensemble of opportunity without a specific design to sample uncertainty?

o 涌现约束（即从整体上考虑多模式集合时，当前气候与预估未来气候特征之间涌现出的统计关系）能否被用于重新校准集合，并降低对给定未来强迫情景响应的不确定性？

o Can emergent constraints (i.e., statistical relationships between features of current and projected future climate that emerge from considering the multi-model ensemble as a whole) be used to recalibrate the ensemble and to reduce the uncertainty in the response to a given scenario of future forcing?

o 此类约束预期在地球系统的哪个部分、何时涌现？它们如何追溯至所模拟的过程？这些过程是否得到了充分的表征？这些信息如何用于改进模式、指明关键观测和监测计划，并将过程理解、检测与归因、预估和不确定性量化联系起来？

o In which part of the Earth System, and when, are such constraints expected to emerge, how do they trace back to modelled processes, are those processes adequately represented, and how can this information be used to improve models, point to critical observations and monitoring programs, and link process understanding, detection and attribution, projections, and uncertainty quantification?

2. 在考虑气候变率、气候可预报性和情景不确定性的情况下，我们如何评估未来气候变化？

2. How can we assess future climate changes given climate variability, climate predictability, and uncertainties in scenarios?

o 对于涵盖与 IAM、IAV 研究及政策相关的全球和区域强迫一系列不确定性的强迫路径，我们如何评估未来气候变化？

o How can we assess future climate changes for forcing pathways spanning a range of uncertainties in global and regional forcing relevant to IAM and IAV research, as well as to policy?

此外，ScenarioMIP 实验通过解决以下问题，回应了基于 WCRP 重大挑战的 CMIP6 主题：

In addition, the ScenarioMIP experiments address the CMIP6 themes based on the WCRP grand challenges by addressing the following question:

合理的未来强迫路径将如何影响气候极端事件、全球和区域气候信息、区域海平面上升、水资源可得性和生物圈反馈？这些影响又将如何影响减缓和适应的可能性？

How will plausible future forcing pathways affect climate extremes, global and regional climate information, regional sea level rise, water availability, and biospheric feedbacks, and how will these effects influence mitigation and adaptation possibilities?

拟议设计概述

Overview of proposed design

实验设计（概览见表 1）由七个 21 世纪情景组成，按优先级分为三个层级。

The experimental design (see Table 1 for an overview) consists of seven 21st-century scenarios grouped into three tiers by priority.

此外，在第二层级内，我们提出：一个辐射强迫在 21 世纪达到峰值后下降的超调情景；其中一个 21 世纪情景的额外集合成员；以及三个长期延伸情景，它们从两个 21 世纪情景的终点开始并延伸至 2300 年。

In addition, within the second tier, we propose an overshoot scenario in which a peak in radiative forcing occurs in the 21st century, additional ensemble members for one of the 21st century scenarios, and three long-term extensions that begin from the end points of two of the 21st century scenarios and extend to 2300.

每个 21 世纪情景都在世纪末达到特定水平的全球平均强迫。

Each 21st century scenario achieves a specific level of global average forcing by the end of the century.

这些情景全球平均强迫水平的选择，基于上文概述的 ScenarioMIP 目标。

Choices of the global average forcing level for these scenarios were based on the ScenarioMIP objectives outlined above.

这些目标意味着，全球平均强迫路径应覆盖广泛的合理强迫水平，与 CMIP5 实验保持连续性，并填补气候科学、IAM 和 IAV 群体感兴趣的 CMIP5 强迫路径中的空白。

These objectives imply that the global average forcing pathways should cover a wide range of plausible forcing levels, provide continuity with CMIP5 experiments, and fill in gaps in CMIP5 forcing pathways that would be of interest to the climate science, IAM, and IAV communities.

基于这些考量，设计中纳入了两类 21 世纪情景：

Based on these considerations, two types of 21st century scenarios were included in the design:

（1）“基于 SSP 的 RCP”：RCP 的新版本，它们基于共享社会经济路径（SSP；O’Neill 等，2014；van Vuuren 等，2014）以及由此衍生的新 IAM 模式模拟。

(1) “SSP-based RCPs”: new versions of the RCPs that are based on the Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs; O’Neill et al., 2014; van Vuuren et al., 2014) and new IAM model simulations derived from them.

SSP 是作为平行进程的一部分而制定的五条新的社会发展路径，它们提供了对未来社会状况的描述，既是推导强迫路径的基础，也是表征对 IAV/IAM 研究重要的脆弱性和减缓能力的基础。

The SSPs are five new societal development pathways that have been developed as part of the parallel process and provide descriptions of future societal conditions that serve as the basis both for deriving forcing pathways and for characterizing vulnerability and mitigative capacity important for IAV/IAM studies.

（2）“缺口情景”：RCP 未覆盖的新强迫路径，包括新的未减缓 SSP 基线情景或新的减缓路径。

(2) “Gap scenarios”: new forcing pathways not covered by the RCPs, including new unmitigated SSP baselines or new mitigation pathways.

这些 SSP 被命名为 SSP1–SSP5。

The SSPs are named SSP1-SSP5.

虽然它们仅代表未来各种可能社会经济轨迹的一个子集，但其设计旨在覆盖减缓与适应所面临的从低到高的一系列挑战。

While they represent only one subset of wide range of possible socio-economic trajectories in the future, they were designed to span a range of low and high challenges for mitigation and adaptation.

除一个例外（RCP8.5 只能通过假设 SSP5 实现）外，21 世纪情景的所有全球平均强迫路径都可以通过假设不同的 SSP 来实现。

With one exception (RCP8.5 which is achievable only by assuming SSP5) all global average forcing pathways for the 21st century scenarios can be achieved by assuming different SSPs.

主导假设是：对于同一条全球强迫路径，不同 SSP 所产生气候结果的差异，相对于区域气候〔下文续，见第 233 页〕而言可能很小。

The dominant hypothesis is that differences in climate outcomes produced by different SSPs for the same global forcing pathway are likely small relative to regional climate

（续第 232 页末句）变率、各气候模式之间的不确定性、以及用于研究 IAV 群体所关注结果的影响模式中的不确定性而言可能很小。

variability, uncertainty across climate models, and uncertainty in impact models used to investigate outcomes of interest to the IAV community.

因此，基于用某一 SSP 产生的强迫路径的气候模拟，将被用于旨在研究同一条全球平均强迫路径、但在另一 SSP 所给定的未来社会经济条件下的效应的研究。

Therefore, climate simulations based on a forcing pathway produced with one SSP will be used in studies aimed at investigating the effects of that same global average forcing pathway but under future socioeconomic conditions given by a different SSP.

然而，这一假设在多大程度上成立，仍然是一个悬而未决的科学问题。

However, the degree to which this hypothesis is correct remains an open scientific question.

因此，我们在为每条全球平均强迫路径选择 SSP 时，考虑了气候结果对 SSP 选择的敏感性可能高于预期的可能性。

We therefore choose an SSP for each global average forcing pathway by taking into consideration the possibility that the sensitivity of climate outcomes to SSP choice may be larger than anticipated.

为顾及这种可能性，我们的选择基于以下一项或多项目标：

To account for that possibility, choices were based on one or more of the following goals:

（1）促进气候研究，以更多地了解同一条全球平均强迫路径下可能随 SSP 而异的强迫各要素的气候效应，特别是土地利用变化和气溶胶排放所产生的影响。

(1) facilitate climate research to learn more about the climate effects of aspects of forcing that may vary by SSP for the same global average forcing pathway, particularly those from land-use changes and aerosol emissions.

（2）使给定全球平均强迫路径所选 SSP 产生的结果，与选择其他 SSP 时本会产生的气候之间的差异最小化。

(2) minimize differences in climate between the outcomes produced by the SSP chosen for a given global average forcing pathway and the climate that would have been produced by choosing other SSPs.

通过选择其土地利用和气溶胶路径在同一条全球平均强迫路径下相对于其他 SSP 居中的 SSP，可以使这些差异最小化。

These differences would be minimized by choosing an SSP with land use and aerosol pathways that are central relative to other SSPs for the same global average forcing pathway.

然而，鉴于难以确定“居中”情景（例如由于要考虑多个变量和区域），在实践中这一目标意味着避免选择土地利用或气溶胶趋势相对于其他 SSP 属于离群值的 SSP。

However, given difficulties in identifying a central scenario (due for example to consideration of multiple variables and regions), in practice this goal implies avoiding SSPs with trends for land use or aerosols that are outliers relative to other SSPs.

（3）确保与对 IAM/IAV 群体最相关的情景保持一致。

(3) ensure consistency with scenarios that are most relevant to the IAM/IAV community.

对于给定的全球平均强迫路径，并非所有情景都被预期对 IAM 和 IAV 研究具有同等的相关性。

Not all scenarios for a given global average forcing pathway are anticipated to be equally relevant to IAM and IAV research.

这一目标意味着选择我们预期特别相关的 SSP，这样即使土地利用和气溶胶的气候效应最终大于预期，气候模拟仍将与该情景保持一致。

This goal implies choosing the SSP that we anticipate to be especially relevant, so that if the climate effects of land use and aerosols turn out to be larger than anticipated, climate simulations will still be consistent with that scenario.

 MIP 目标与简要概述*：总体目标

 Goal of the MIP and a brief overview* Overall objectives

在气候研究所涉各学科中提供“用于整合的情景”这一首要目标被认为是最高优先级，理由如下：

The first objective on providing “scenarios for integration” across the disciplines involved in climate research is considered to be the highest priority for the following reasons:

 用于整合的情景服务于庞大的科学受众，支撑着数百项基于情景的研究，这些研究涉及物理气候变化、减缓、影响与适应方面各种各样的科学问题。

 Scenarios for integration serve a large scientific audience, underpinning hundreds of scenariobased studies addressing a wide variety of scientific questions regarding physical climate changes, mitigation, impacts, and adaptation.

 基于此类广泛使用情景的气候模拟，是 2007 年在 Noordwijkerhout 建立的新情景流程的关键要素（Moss 等，2007；2010）；如果没有气候模拟来支持同时利用气候与社会未来的综合研究，该情景流程便无法运转。

 Climate simulations based on such broad-use scenarios are critical elements of the new scenario process established at Noordwijkerhout in 2007 (Moss et al., 2007; 2010); without climate simulations to support integrated studies that draw on both climate and societal futures, the scenario process cannot function.

 用于整合的情景是连接 IPCC 各工作组评估以及综合报告的关键手段。

 Scenarios for integration serve as a key means for connecting the assessments of different working groups of IPCC as well as in the Synthesis Report.

 一套共同的用于整合的情景，减少了各研究项目为支持基于情景的研究而自行开发情景信息的需求。

 A common set of scenarios for integration reduces the need for individual research projects to develop their own scenario information to support scenario-based studies.

（1）“基于 SSP 的 RCP”：RCP 的新版本，它们基于共享社会经济路径（SSP；O’Neill 等，2014；van Vuuren 等，2014）以及由此衍生的新 IAM 模式模拟。

(1) “SSP-based RCPs”: new versions of the RCPs that are based on the Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs; O’Neill et al., 2014; van Vuuren et al., 2014) and new IAM model simulations derived from them.

（2）“缺口情景”：RCP 未覆盖的新强迫路径，包括新的未减缓 SSP 基线情景或新的减缓路径。

(2) “Gap scenarios”: new forcing pathways not covered by the RCPs, including new unmitigated SSP baselines or new mitigation pathways.

总体而言，表 1 中详述的提案具有以下总体特征：

Overall, the proposal detailed in Table 1 has the following general features:

要求参与本 MIP 的任何模式运行少量情景（第 1 层级 4 个，仅要求每个模式对每个情景运行一次），而第 2、3 层级中的模式运行具有额外科学价值。

A small number of scenarios (4 in Tier 1, with only one run per scenario being requested from each model) required for any model participating in this MIP, with model runs of additional scientific value in Tiers 2 and 3.

第 1 层级覆盖了未来强迫路径中广泛的不确定性范围，对气候科学、IAM 和 IAV 研究十分重要，同时为许多其他 MIP 的实验提供关键的锚定情景（见表 1 最后一列）。

Tier 1 spans a wide range of uncertainty in future forcing pathways important for research in climate science, IAM, and IAV studies, while also providing key scenarios to anchor experiments in a number of other MIPs (see last column in Table 1).

第 2 层级在第 1 层级情景的基础上，通过补充感兴趣的情景进一步填补强迫路径的范围，并包含额外的集合成员和长期延伸。

Tier 2 builds on Tier 1 scenarios by further filling in the range of forcing pathways with additional scenarios of interest and also includes additional ensemble members and long-term extensions.

第 3 层级将提供一个低于 RCP 2.6 强迫路径的情景，旨在为政策界对全球平均气温较工业化前水平升温不超过 1.5 °C 这一目标的关切提供信息。

Tier 3 would provide a scenario lower than the RCP 2.6 forcing pathway intended to inform policy interest in a global average temperature limit below 1.5 °C warming above preindustrial levels.

与 RCP 具有相似强迫的情景新版本将继续支持基于情景的 IAM 和 IAV 研究直至 2020 年代中期。

The new versions of the scenarios with similar forcing as the RCPs will continue to support scenario-based IAM and IAV research into the mid-2020s.

这些情景不仅将基于新的（CMIP6）气候模式，还将基于由新的 IAM 模式运行依据 SSP 生成的更新强迫路径。

These scenarios will be based not only on new (CMIP6) climate models, but also on updated forcing pathways generated by new IAM model runs based on the SSPs.

四个新的“缺口”情景将探索现有 RCP 之外的强迫路径：一个代表文献中许多基线情景（即无减缓）强迫水平（约 7 W/m2）的情景，一些回应关于介于 RCP 2.6 与 4.5 之间（3.7 W/m2）及低于 RCP 2.6 的减缓路径的政策讨论的情景，以及一个探索 21 世纪强迫达峰对气候科学和政策影响的超调路径。

The four new “gap” scenarios will explore forcing pathways beyond those of the existing RCPs: a scenario that is representative of the forcing level of many baseline scenarios (i.e., no mitigation) in the literature (around 7 W/m2), scenarios that addresses policy discussions of mitigation pathways that fall between RCPs 2.6 and 4.5 (3.7 W/m2) and below RCP 2.6, and an overshoot pathway that explores the climate science and policy implications of peak in forcing during the 21st century.

可为许多其他 MIP（见下文）中的实验提供锚定的情景，用于研究针对性问题，例如土地利用、气溶胶及其他 NTCF 以及超调对气候结果的影响；碳循环反馈；以及冰盖-气候相互作用。

Scenarios that can anchor experiments in a number of other MIPs (see below) to investigate targeted questions, including for example the influence of land use, aerosols and other NTCFs, and overshoot on climate outcomes; carbon cycle feedbacks; and ice sheet-climate interactions.

我们在此列出设计中每个情景更具体的描述和论证，以及设计的一些总体性特征。

We list here more specific descriptions and justifications for each of the scenarios in the design, as well as for some over-arching features of the design.

对于每一个 21 世纪情景，我们描述其强迫路径的相关性以及选择该 SSP 的理由。

For each of the 21st century scenarios, we describe the relevance of the forcing pathway and also the rationale for the choice of the SSP.

第 1 层级：21 世纪情景

Tier 1: 21st century scenarios

SSP5-8.5：该情景代表合理未来路径范围的高端，更新了 CMIP5 中的 RCP8.5 路径，并计划供许多其他 MIP 使用以帮助解决其科学问题。

SSP5-8.5: This scenario represents the high end of the range of plausible future pathways, updates the RCP8.5 pathway in CMIP5, and is planned to be used by a number of other MIPs to help address their scientific questions.

选择 SSP5 作为该强迫路径的原因在于，它是唯一排放量高到足以产生这一强迫水平的 SSP。

SSP5 was chosen for this forcing pathway because it is the only SSP with emissions high enough to produce this level of forcing.

SSP3-7.0：该情景代表合理未来强迫路径范围的中到高端。

SSP3-7.0: This scenario represents the medium to high end of the range of plausible future forcing pathways.

它填补了 CMIP5 强迫路径中的一个缺口，该缺口尤为重要，因为它代表的是若干个（未减缓的）SSP 基线共有的强迫水平。

It fills a gap in CMIP5 forcing pathways that is particularly important because it represents a forcing level common to several (unmitigated) SSP baselines.

这些基线情景对于关注量化“避免的影响”的 IAV 研究将非常重要，而量化“避免的影响”需要将减缓情景中的影响与未减缓基线情景中发生的影响进行比较。

These baseline scenarios will be very important to IAV studies interested in quantifying “avoided impacts,” which requires comparing impacts in a mitigation scenario with those occurring in an unmitigated baseline scenario.

选择 SSP3 是因为 SSP3-7.0 是一个既具有显著土地利用变化（特别是全球森林覆盖减少）又具有高 NTCF 排放（特别是 SO2）的情景，因此它将在 LUMIP 和 AerChemMIP 中发挥重要作用，解决与情景相关的、关于区域气候对土地利用和气溶胶敏感性的问题。

SSP3 was chosen because SSP3-7.0 is a scenario with both substantial land use change (in particular decreased global forest cover) and high NTCF emissions (particularly SO2) and therefore will play an important role in LUMIP and AerChemMIP, addressing scenario-relevant questions about the sensitivity of regional climate to land use and aerosols.

此外，SSP3（结合该强迫路径）与 IAM/IAV 研究尤其相关，因为它将相对较高的社会脆弱性（SSP3）与相对较高的强迫结合在一起。

In addition, SSP3 (combined with this forcing pathway) is especially relevant to IAM/IAV studies because it combines relatively high societal vulnerability (SSP3) with relatively high forcing.

该情景也将被用作我们所请求的大集合（下文讨论）的基础。

This scenario would also be used as the basis for our requested large ensemble (discussed below).

SSP2-4.5：该情景代表合理未来强迫路径范围的中间部分，并更新了 CMIP5 中的 RCP4.5 路径。

SSP2-4.5: This scenario represents the medium part of the range of plausible future forcing pathways and updates the RCP4.5 pathway in CMIP5.

它将用于：CORDEX MIP（与 SSP5-8.5 一起）进行区域降尺度——该产品对 IAV 界非常有价值；DCPP MIP 进行到 2030 年的短期预测；以及 DAMIP 将其作为历史模拟的延续，以更新对 2015 年以后单一强迫作用的基于回归的估计，并将其作为参考情景将单一强迫实验运行到未来。

It will be used by CORDEX MIP (along with SSP5-8.5) for regional downscaling, a product that will be very valuable to the IAV community, by DCPP MIP for short-term predictions out to 2030, and by DAMIP as a continuation of the historical simulations to update regression-based estimates of the role of single forcings beyond 2015 and to run single forcing experiments into the future by using it as the reference scenario.

选择 SSP2 是因为其土地利用和气溶胶路径相对于其他 SSP 并不极端（因此对 DAMIP 和 DCPP MIP 的关注点而言显得居中性），同时也因为它作为一个将中等社会脆弱性与中等强迫水平相结合的情景，与 IAM/IAV 研究相关。

SSP2 was chosen because its land use and aerosol pathways are not extreme relative to other SSPs (and therefore appear as central for the concerns of DAMIP and DCPP MIP), and also because it is relevant to IAM/IAV research as a scenario that combines intermediate societal vulnerability with an intermediate forcing level.

SSP1-2.6：该情景代表合理未来强迫路径范围的低端，并更新了 CMIP5 中的 RCP2.6 路径。

SSP1-2.6: This scenario represents the low end of the range of plausible future forcing pathways and updates the RCP2.6 pathway in CMIP5.

选择 SSP1 是因为它具有显著的土地利用变化（特别是全球森林覆盖增加），并将被 LUMIP 用来帮助解决其科学问题。

SSP1 was chosen because it has substantial land use change (in particular increased global forest cover) and will be used by LUMIP to help address their scientific questions.

从 IAM/IAV 的角度看，该情景高度相关，因为它将低脆弱性与低减缓挑战以及低强迫信号结合在一起。

From the IAM/IAV perspective this scenario is highly relevant since it combines low vulnerability with low challenges for mitigation as well as a low forcing signal.

因此，该情景描绘了一个从可持续发展角度看“最佳情形”的未来。

The scenario depicts thus a “best case” future from the sustainability perspective.

第 2 层级：21 世纪情景

Tier 2: 21st century scenarios

SSP1-6.0：该情景填补了中等强迫路径范围，并更新了 CMIP5 中的 RCP6.0 路径。

SSP1-6.0: This scenario fills in the range of medium forcing pathways and updates the RCP6.0 pathway in CMIP5.

选择 SSP1 是因为它作为界定未减缓 SSP 基线情景强迫范围低端的情景与 IAM/IAV 研究相关，并且因为它可与 SSP1-2.6 一起用于研究不同全球平均强迫路径之间影响的差异，即使土地利用和气溶胶的区域气候效应结果很强。

SSP1 was chosen because it is relevant to IAM/IAV research as a scenario that defines the low end of the forcing range for unmitigated SSP baseline scenarios and because together with SSP1-2.6 it could be used to investigate differences in impacts across global average forcing pathways even if the regional climate effects of land use and aerosols turn out to be strong.

SSP4-3.7：该情景填补了合理未来强迫路径范围低端的一个缺口。

SSP4-3.7: This scenario fills a gap at the low end of the range of plausible future forcing pathways.

减缓政策界对到 2100 年达到 3.7 W/m2 的情景有浓厚兴趣，因为 4.5 W/m2 与 2.6 W/m2 强迫水平（由 RCP 描绘）之间的减缓成本差异显著。

There is substantial mitigation policy interest in scenarios that reach 3.7 W/m2 by 2100, since mitigation costs differ substantially between forcing levels of 4.5 W/m2 and 2.6 W/m2 (depicted by the RCPs).

气候模式模拟将可以把 3.7 情景的影响与 4.5 或 2.6 情景中发生的影响进行比较，以评估这些情景的相对成本与收益。

Climate model simulations would allow for impacts of a 3.7 scenario to be compared to those occurring in the 4.5 or 2.6 scenarios, to evaluate relative costs and benefits of these scenarios.

选择 SSP4 是因为它作为减缓挑战相对较低的情景（SSP4）与 IAM/IAV 研究相关，因此与相对较低的强迫路径是合理的搭配。

SSP4 was chosen because it is relevant to IAM/IAV research as a scenario with relatively low challenges to mitigation (SSP4) and therefore is a plausible pairing with a relatively low forcing pathway.

第 2 层级：21 世纪超调

Tier 2: 21st century overshoot

该情景通过研究相对于更长期目标而言 21 世纪辐射强迫出现显著超调的影响，填补了现有气候模拟中的一个缺口。

This scenario fills a gap in existing climate simulations by investigating the implications of a substantial 21st century overshoot in radiative forcing relative to a longer-term target.

此类超调在影响、减缓与适应方面的影响受到浓厚关注，而其研究始于理解这样一条路径的气候后果。

There is substantial interest in the impact, mitigation and adaptation implications of such overshoot, which begins with understanding the climate consequences of such a pathway.

该类别中现有的 IAM 情景相对于 2100 年的水平产生 1-1.5 W/m2 的超调，因此我们预期情景将具有大致这一程度的超调。

Existing IAM scenarios within this category produce an overshoot of 1-1.5 W/m2 relative to the level in 2100, so we anticipate a scenario with approximately this degree of overshoot.

强迫的超调将相对于第 1 层级的 SSP1-2.6 情景发生，并可能相对于其延伸情景发生。

The overshoot in forcing will occur relative to the Tier 1 SSP1-2.6 scenario, and possibly to its extension.

第 2 层级：大集合

Tier 2: Large ensemble

对于基于情景的研究而言，表达内部变率对气候结果的影响非常重要。

It is important for scenario-based research to represent the influence of internal variability on climate outcomes.

为满足这一需求，同时节省模式运行量，我们请求各模式仅对一个情景运行多个初始条件集合成员，其依据的假设是：针对一个情景估计出的变率可以应用于其他情景的结果。

To accommodate this need, while also economizing on model runs, we request that models run multiple initial condition ensemble members only for one scenario, based on the assumption that variability estimated for one scenario can be applied to outcomes for others.

我们请求针对 SSP3-7.0 情景（一个第 1 层级情景）开展该集合，原因有二：

We are requesting this ensemble be carried out for the SSP3-7.0 scenario (a Tier 1 scenario) for two reasons:

该情景在 21 世纪末达到的相对较高强迫水平，将使我们能够在相当大范围的全球平均辐射强迫和温度变化内探索内部变率的潜在变化；而如果大集合是在较低情景（如 RCP4.5）上运行，则无法对此进行评估。

The relatively high forcing level reached by this scenario by the end of the 21st century will enable the exploration of potential changes in internal variability over a substantial range of global average radiative forcing and temperature change, which could not be assessed if the large ensemble was run for a lower scenario, e.g. RCP4.5.

理解变率在广泛强迫水平范围内的潜在变化，对于支持将大集合下的变率转移到其他我们仅请求单个集合成员的情景这一可能性至关重要。

Understanding potential changes in variability over a wide range of forcing levels is essential to support the possibility of transferring variability under the large ensemble to other scenarios for which we request only a single ensemble member.

SSP3-7.0 具有相对较强的土地利用变化和高 NTCF 排放（不同于 SSP5-8.5 情景），因此已被确定为一个重要的实验，LUMIP 和 AerChemMIP 将在其上开展变体实验，以研究土地利用和气溶胶排放区域差异的气候影响。

SSP3-7.0 has relatively strong land use change and high emissions of NTCFs (unlike the SSP5-8.5 scenario), and therefore has been identified as an important experiment on which variants will be conducted by LUMIP and AerChemMIP to investigate the climate implications of regional differences in land use and aerosol emissions.

这一主题对基于情景的研究也非常重要。

This topic is also very important to scenario-based studies.

在那些 MIP 中，由多个初始条件集合成员所实现的开展信噪比研究的机会将是至关重要的。

In those MIPs, the opportunity to conduct signal-to-noise studies made possible by multiple initial condition ensemble members will be critical.

我们请求各模式运行 9 个额外集合成员（若无法达到 9 个，则尽可能多）。

We request that models run 9 additional ensemble members (if not 9, then as many as possible).

这些额外集合成员将被视为第 2 层级情景（即不是参与 ScenarioMIP 所必需的模式运行）。

These additional ensemble members would be considered Tier 2 scenarios (i.e., not required model runs for participation in ScenarioMIP).

对于所有其他情景，仅请求单个集合成员。

For all other scenarios, only a single ensemble member is requested.

第 2 层级：长期延伸

Tier 2: Long-term extensions

气候界和影响界对情景延伸至 2100 年之后有着浓厚的兴趣。

There is strong interest from the climate and impacts communities in long-term extensions of scenarios beyond 2100.

ScenarioMIP 的长期延伸将由三个实验组成。

The ScenarioMIP long-term extensions will consist of three experiments.

其中两个实验将提供长期变化的低值与高值情形，包括以与 CMIP5 中这些情景延伸相似的风格对 SSP5-8.5 和 SSP1-2.6 进行的延伸。

Two of these will provide low and high cases for long-term change, comprising extensions for SSP5-8.5 and SSP1-2.6 in a style similar to the extensions of these scenarios in CMIP5.

对于 SSP5-8.5，这涉及最终将排放降低到一个在简单气候模式中被发现到 2300 年时会在相对较高水平上产生平衡辐射强迫的水平。

For SSP5-8.5, this involves emissions that are eventually reduced to a level that is found to produce equilibrated radiative forcing at a relatively high level by 2300 in a simple climate model.

对于 SSP1-2.6，这涉及对 2100 年达到的负碳排放的延伸，从而导致强迫缓慢下降。

For SSP1-2.6 this involves an extension of the negative carbon emissions reached in 2100, leading to slowly declining forcing.

为补充这些情形，一个额外的实验将考察从 2100 年开始对 SSP5-8.5 进行快速脱碳的影响，并在 2200 年前将所有排放线性降低到 SSP1-2.6 的水平；该实验预计到 2300 年将产生显著的辐射强迫超调。

To complement these cases, an additional experiment will consider the implications of rapid decarbonization from SSP5-8.5 beginning in 2100, and will linearly reduce all emissions to SSP1-2.6 levels by 2200, an experiment which is expected to produce a significant overshoot of radiative forcing by 2300.

第 3 层级：21 世纪情景

Tier 3: 21st century scenarios

低于 RCP2.6 的情景：该情景代表文献中按其辐射强迫路径衡量处于范围最低端的情景。

Scenario below RCP2.6: This scenario represents the very low end of the range of scenarios in the literature measured by their radiative forcing pathway.

在辐射强迫方面显著低于 RCP2.6 的合理 IAM 情景十分罕见，且直到最近才出现在同行评审文献中。

Plausible IAM scenarios more than incrementally below RCP2.6 in terms of radiative forcing are rare and have only recently become available in the peer reviewed literature.

政策界对能够为将全球平均升温限制在较工业化前水平高 1.5°C 这一可能目标提供信息的情景有浓厚兴趣。

There is policy interest in scenarios that would inform a possible goal of limiting global mean warming to 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels.

我们将这样的情景纳入第 3 层级，是因为在 SSP 框架下的这类情景尚未由 IAM 界开发出来，而且 SSP1-2.6 情景及其长期延伸也可部分地为 1.5 °C 升温影响的分析提供信息。

We include such a scenario in Tier 3 because such a scenario in the context of SSPs has not yet been developed by the IAM community and because the SSP1-2.6 scenario and its long-term extension can in part also inform analyses of the implications of 1.5 °C warming.

将其纳入 ScenarioMIP 设计的条件是：由综合评估建模联盟（IAMC）情景科学工作组所代表的 IAM 界开发出这样的情景。

Its inclusion in the ScenarioMIP design is conditional on the IAM community, as represented by the Integrated Assessment Modeling Consortium (IAMC) Scientific Working Group on Scenarios, producing such a scenario.

这样的情景很可能会相对于第 1 和第 2 层级的情景延迟一段时间才可用于气候模式模拟。

It is likely that such a scenario would become available for climate model simulations at some delay relative to scenarios in Tiers 1 and 2.

排放驱动模拟与浓度驱动模拟之比较

Emissions- vs concentration-driven simulations

我们建议将 ScenarioMIP 设计中规定的情景作为浓度驱动实验来运行。

We recommend that the scenarios specified in the ScenarioMIP design be run as concentration-driven experiments.

这样的情景与这些情景将在更广泛研究界中扮演的“整合”角色更为一致。

Such scenarios are more consistent with the “integration” role that these scenarios will play in the broader research community.

基于情景的研究的概念框架建立在研究不同气候未来影响的基础上。

The conceptual framework for scenario-based research is based on investigating the implications of alternative climate futures.

这些气候未来（对给定情景而言）在浓度驱动运行中比在排放驱动运行中更为相似（考虑到碳循环的不确定性），因此将更好地服务于总体情景框架的这一目的。

These climate futures will be more similar (for a given scenario) in concentration-driven runs than in emissions-driven runs (given uncertainties in the carbon cycle), and therefore will better serve this purpose of the overall scenario framework.

浓度驱动情景仍通过其对给定浓度路径所允许的人为碳排放的影响，表达碳循环和气候-碳循环反馈中的不确定性。

Concentration driven scenarios still represent uncertainty in the carbon cycle and in climate-carbon cycle feedbacks, through their influence on the anthropogenic carbon emissions allowable for a given concentration pathway.

事实上，表明各模式间允许排放不确定性的 ESM 结果将是 IAM 界一个非常重要的成果。

Indeed, ESM results indicating the uncertainty across models in allowable emissions will be a very important outcome for the IAM community.

我们认识到，浓度驱动情景无法评估反馈的放大效应（即气候变化影响碳循环、产生更多排放和更多气候变化，进而进一步影响碳循环等）。

We recognize that concentration-driven scenarios do not allow for assessing amplification effects of feedbacks (in which climate change influences the carbon cycle, producing more emissions and more climate change, and further influencing the carbon cycle, etc.).

然而，放大效应可以在其他 C4MIP 模拟中加以研究。

However, amplification could be investigated in other C4MIP simulations.

CMIP5 模式与 CMIP6 模式之比较

CMIP5 vs CMIP6 models

CMIP6 气候预估将由于新一代气候模式以及新的排放和土地利用情景集合两方面原因而不同于 CMIP5 的气候预估。

CMIP6 climate projections will differ from those for CMIP5 due to both a new generation of climate models as well as a new set of scenarios of emissions and land use.

对多个研究界而言，评估仅由气候模式变化所造成的气候结果差异将是有用的。

For multiple research communities it will be useful to evaluate the difference in climate outcomes that is due to of the changes in climate models alone.

例如，这样的评估对于确定 CMIP5 和 CMIP6 结果能否（以及如何）共同用于影响与适应研究，或 IAM 和 IAV 研究人员是否应在 CMIP6 运行可用时放弃 CMIP5 运行而转向 CMIP6 运行，都很有价值。

For example, such an evaluation is valuable in order to determine whether CMIP5 and CMIP6 results could be used together in research on impacts and adaptation (and how), or whether IAM and IAV researchers should abandon CMIP5 runs in favor of CMIP6 runs when they become available.

开展能为这一评估提供信息的模拟，并不属于正提交给 CMIP6 的 ScenarioMIP 设计的一部分。

It is not part of the ScenarioMIP design being proposed to CMIP6 to carry out simulations that would inform this evaluation.

然而，我们认为，如果至少有几个气候建模团队研究这一问题，对研究界将是有益的。

However, we believe it would be interesting to the community if at least a few climate modeling teams investigated this question.

可能的途径包括：用上一代（CMIP5）模式运行新的基于 SSP 的情景，用新一代（CMIP6）模式运行上一代（RCP）情景，或利用气候模式仿真器开展相关分析。

Possible approaches include running the new SSP-based scenarios with the previous (CMIP5) generation of models, running the previous (RCP) scenarios using the new (CMIP6) generation of models, or carrying out relevant analyses with climate model emulators.

与其他 MIP 的联系

Connections to other MIPs

ScenarioMIP 设计旨在为在其他 MIP 中运行的针对性情景提供基础，以解决关于气候变化结果对这些情景特定方面（尤其是土地利用和 NTCF 排放）敏感性的具体问题。

The ScenarioMIP design is intended to provide a basis for targeted scenarios to be run in other MIPs in order to address specific questions regarding the sensitivity of climate change outcomes to particular aspects of these scenarios, especially land use and emissions of NTCFs.

我们在此描述协调实验的当前计划。

We describe here current plans for coordinated experiments.

ScenarioMIP 设计中目前已成为其他 MIP 计划一部分的情景汇总，见上文的实验设计表。

A summary of the scenarios within the ScenarioMIP design that are currently part of plans for other MIPs is provided in the experimental design table above.

气溶胶与化学模式比较计划（AerChemMIP）

Aerosols and Chemistry MIP (AerChemMIP)

AerChemMIP 有一个针对气候对近短期气候强迫因子敏感性的第 1 层级实验（另有第 2、3 层级的相关研究）。

AerChemMIP has a Tier 1 experiment (with additional Tier 2 and 3 related studies) directed at the sensitivity of climate to near term climate forcers.

该实验将以 ScenarioMIP 的 SSP3-7.0 情景为起点，通过假设污染控制（即空气污染物最大可行削减）设计该情景的低空气污染物变体。

This experiment will use the SSP3-7.0 scenario from ScenarioMIP as a starting point and devise a lower air pollutant variant of this scenario by assuming pollution controls, or maximum feasible reductions in air pollutants.

此外，AerChemMIP 将利用 LUMIP 在 SSP3-7.0 上的土地利用变体（采用 SSP1-2.6 的土地利用）来研究土地利用变化与大气化学之间的耦合。

In addition, AerChemMIP will make use of the LUMIP land-use variant on SSP3-7.0 (with land use from SSP12.6) to study couplings between land-use changes and atmospheric chemistry.

耦合气候碳循环模式比较计划（C4MIP）

Coupled Climate Carbon Cycle MIP (C4MIP)

ScenarioMIP 将就浓度驱动与排放驱动模拟方面的针对性情景与 C4MIP 进行协调。

ScenarioMIP will coordinate with C4MIP on targeted scenarios regarding concentration vs emission driven simulations.

虽然 ScenarioMIP 协议将建议进行浓度驱动模拟（见上文），但 C4MIP 第 1 层级将建议对 SSP5-8.5 进行排放驱动模拟，以探索碳循环反馈对预估气候变化的影响。

While the ScenarioMIP protocol will recommend concentration-driven simulations (see above), C4MIP/Tier 1 will recommend emission-driven simulations for the SSP5-8.5 in order to explore the implications of carbon cycle feedbacks on projected climate change.

如前所述，C4MIP 也对情景延伸至 2100 年以后（例如像 CMIP5 那样到 2300 年）感兴趣，以研究气候变化对在更长的时间尺度上运行的地球系统分量（植被、多年冻土、海洋环流和碳输出等）的影响。

As mentioned before, C4MIP also has an interest in the extensions of scenario beyond 2100 (e.g. up to 2300 as in CMIP5) in order to investigate climate change impacts on Earth System components that operate on longer time scales (vegetation, permafrost, oceanic circulation and carbon export, etc.).

C4MIP 对分析 ScenarioMIP 超调情景表达了浓厚的兴趣。

C4MIP has expressed high interest in analyzing the ScenarioMIP overshoot scenario.

鉴于地球工程可能是避免超调的一种选项，超调情景对 GeoMIP 也具有潜在兴趣。

Overshoot scenarios are also of potential interest to GeoMIP given that geoengineering may be an option for avoiding overshoot.

检测与归因模式比较计划（DAMIP）

Detection and Attribution MIP (DAMIP)

DAMIP 计划将 SSP2-4.5 作为锚定情景，在此基础上规定延伸至世纪末的各个单一强迫模拟并随后进行比较。

DAMIP plans to use SSP2-4.5 as an anchoring scenario on the basis of which individual forcing simulations extended to the end of the century will be specified and then compared.

这些实验旨在区分不同强迫因子的气候效应，并促进观测约束的识别及其在未来预估中的应用。

These experiments are aimed at distinguishing the climate effects of different forcers and facilitating the identification of observational constraints and their use in future projections.

SSP2-4.5 还将用于将历史（全强迫）运行延伸至 2020 年，以便在截至 2015 年之后数年的观测记录所提供的观测约束范围内，用于对各单一强迫作用的基于回归的估计（到那时 CMIP6 输出将可用，下一次 IPCC 评估报告也将开始撰写）。

SSP2-4.5 will also be used to extend the historical (all forcing) runs to 2020 for use in regression-based estimates of the role of individual forcings within the observational constraint provided by observational records up to the years beyond 2015 (by the time CMIP6 output will be available and the next IPCC assessment report will be written).

年代际预测模式比较计划（DCPP MIP）

Decadal Predictions MIP (DCPP MIP)

DCPP MIP 计划将 SSP2-4.5 强迫用于其到 2030 年的初始化短期预测，并将 SSP2-4.5 运行作为比较以评估这些预测的预测技巧。

DCPP MIP plans to use SSP2-4.5 forcings for its initialized short-term predictions out to 2030, and SSP2-4.5 runs as comparison to evaluate the prediction skills of those predictions.

地球工程模式比较计划（GeoMIP）

Geoengineering MIP (GeoMIP)

GeoMIP 提出了若干实验，这些实验将以 ScenarioMIP 的两个情景为基础，并在此基础上实施地球工程措施。

GeoMIP has proposed several experiments that will use two scenarios from ScenarioMIP as a basis from which geoengineering measures would be implemented.

其他 ScenarioMIP 情景的强迫路径将作为这些措施的目标。

Forcing pathways from other ScenarioMIP scenarios would serve as targets for those measures.

特别是，SSP5-8.5 将作为四个实验的基础：利用地球工程将强迫降低到中等强迫（G6Sulfur 和 G6Solar 实验）或低强迫（G6Sulfur_SSP1-2.6）第 1 层级情景；研究卷云变薄的效果（G7Cirrus 实验）；以及研究固定水平的平流层气溶胶注入的效果（GeoFixed10、20、50）。

In particular, SSP5-8.5 would be used as a basis for four experiments: using geoengineering to reduce forcing to a medium forcing (G6Sulfur and G6Solar experiments) or low forcing (G6Sulfur_SSP1-2.6) Tier 1 scenario, investigating the effect of cirrus cloud thinning (G7Cirrus experiment), and investigating the effect of fixed levels or stratospheric aerosol injections (GeoFixed10, 20, 50).

G6Sulfur 和 G6Solar 实验还将延伸至 2100 年以后，应用地球工程将 SSP5-8.5 超调延伸的强迫降低到中等强迫第 1 层级情景的强迫水平。

For the G6Sulfur and G6Solar experiments will also be extended beyond 2100, with geoengineering applied to reduce forcing from the overshoot extension of SSP5-8.5 down to the forcing level of the medium forcing Tier 1 scenario.

此外，中等强迫第 1 层级情景将用作平流层气溶胶注入实验（G4SSA）的基础。

In addition, the medium forcing Tier 1 scenario would be used as a basis for a stratospheric aerosol injection experiment (G4SSA).

冰盖模式比较计划（ISMIP6）

Ice Sheet MIP (ISMIP6)

ISMIP 将提出两类实验，它们将利用 ScenarioMIP 某一情景的长期延伸，以研究百年时间尺度上的冰盖响应和冰-气候相互作用。

ISMIP will be proposing two types of experiments that will draw on long-term extensions of a scenario from ScenarioMIP in order to investigate ice sheet response and ice-climate interactions on centennial timescales.

特别是，SSP5-8.5 延伸至 2300 年将用于为离线（非耦合）冰盖模拟提供气候模式输出，并为完全耦合的冰盖-气候模式实验提供排放/浓度。

In particular, an extension of SSP5-8.5 to 2300 would be used to provide climate model output for offline (uncoupled) ice sheet simulations, and to provide emissions/concentrations for fully coupled ice sheet-climate model experiments.

土地利用模式比较计划（LUMIP）

Land Use MIP (LUMIP)

LUMIP 计划设计以 ScenarioMIP 两个情景为基础来检验土地利用变化敏感性的实验。

LUMIP plans to design experiments that use two scenarios from ScenarioMIP as a basis for testing sensitivity to land use change.

这两个情景在强迫水平和土地利用变化两方面都将有所不同。

These two scenarios would differ both in forcing levels and in land use change.

这两个情景将是 SSP3-7.0 和 SSP1-2.6 情景。

These two scenarios will be the SSP3-7.0 and the SSP1-2.6 scenarios.

这两个情景跨越约 4.5 W/m2 的范围（2100 年分别为 7.0 与 2.6 W/m2），并且可能在土地利用变化上差异显著——SSP3-7.0 中为显著毁林，SSP1-2.6 中为净造林。

These two scenarios span a range of approximately 4.5 W/m2 (7.0 vs 2.6 W/m2 in 2100), and likely will differ substantially in land use change, with substantial deforestation in the SSP3-7.0 and net afforestation in SSP1-2.6.

辐射强迫模式比较计划（RFMIP）

Radiative Forcing MIP (RFMIP)

RFMIP 计划针对一个合理的未来情景（最好是高强迫路径）估计不同模式中的辐射强迫。

RFMIP has plans to estimate radiative forcing in different models for a plausible future scenario, preferably a high forcing pathway.

目前候选情景是 SSP5-8.5，其强迫将在 RFMIP 实验的理想化设置中应用于当前日期固定的海表温度。

At the moment the candidate is SSP5-8.5, whose forcings would be applied to current day fixed SSTs in the idealized setting of the RFMIP experiments.

脆弱性、影响与适应（VIA）咨询组

Vulnerability, Impacts, Adaptation (VIA) Advisory Group

研究气候变化后果和潜在适应的研究人员是 CMIP 输出和产品的关键用户群体。

Researchers examining the consequences of climate change and potential adaptations are a key user group of CMIP outputs and products.

ScenarioMIP 将通过 VIA 咨询委员会和其他相关团体与影响界建立密切联系，以促进综合研究，从而不仅更好地理解这些情景对气候系统的物理后果，而且更好地理解气候对社会的影响。

ScenarioMIP will establish a close link with the impact community through the VIA Advisory Board and other relevant groups to facilitate integrated research that leads to a better understanding not only of the physical consequences of these scenarios on the climate system, but also of the climate impact on societies.

特别是，ScenarioMIP 将与 VIA 咨询委员会联系，以确保情景的气候模式输出能够推导出部门特定指数（例如生态系统的热损害度日、农业和水资源的连续无雨日）。

In particular ScenarioMIP will link with the VIA Advisory Board to ensure that the climate model output from the scenarios allows for sector-specific indices being derived (e.g., heat damage degree days for ecosystems, consecutive dry days for agriculture and water resources).
